tei:div.tei:p: kyi /ḍā ( 7jikṣechi— gā ji snapye 4dza caṇa pho ༷sprerishasgrujizherda sgyusdu spre/ ne / ༵ /‘ — / ju ri rāgyispyo — kyi / / lo / be — ’ wā7 tsho / /////////sdi /pa / / /// /ci — — // tho4rī rngo// // / / 3141/ re zashāzhi na — /// // tsā / ’’ // tsā/ ///ṭwāṃhūṃ/ //byuj-ig ca/ / ///chi ༈ ༷ trī ‘ dzosko ci lko ṇḍisto ‘byecici /—/ tshasku bhe ji —dngha— ke 5 /zlo6ci lha/ lto ji 4
/ / lho skornad da2ka ldan gyisnyelhagarga rtsosga py-iogarga/ bulhagarga/ /(bar cha/blo bzapa dpal ldan gyis brtsams/krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang /

pro rshatsho rtswa sdu 4//ṭwāṃ 47byehūṃ ༵two skuhphu ༵rā na7/ |shlau rṇakhu — /lko li8 pa rsātrī di stuṭwāṃ sproraduñtsa rdzoshā/ri4 7lho byeske ༅sgru— sta tho 4 ho lhu neerā rte mi rgyu thā no ( ༷ rngo 9 rirlo rirmeshāmo4nee rṣa lya chi tsho ji tre snye/ ci stse zhertsa ‘ tsa sderwa la mibyu / skyi 3 (dwosmye 5 sne snye trī ‘ nga‘ 7/ tsu 74 ri spyo rtso sgoldi dku 4 rtegyishā༄ ཿ 7tshodi—meṭwāṃ nyushosgyuldatswa ༷ snaspyabhe rternyo rmepyo rmi spropho ṭwāṃshodzā sna hūṃstojus dije shā 4ne za〉 dhetshoṭwāṃtswa 7 ‘4stu dro7 bhe 6dzha ṭwāṃchones rwa ’ bye smu zadī riblospo /4 rke — shā kyi ṅka༄ trīrdargu༄ kyicho sakhomisnyeXske mitshi 75 spyo dku hwa sngeḥrke ñtsa sna li rlobyo1spyortswa spre shka rī—— rdo sku4 ༄moglorke byerno 〉dzwa rine tsho ri sngu byecho ji nee lku〉ra ki chosī tre phorne wa log nga rdo rnate sto sdurwa tsho /tre rsā bhemi shrībye (skru'ine ṣe /lha tho—4wa rnye trī4 mi snyaXlke ༵5 ༄ ) ca

1dgedape skun gsal bshad/rtsom pa po gis steng blo bzang dpal ldan ni mdo smad re skong tsho 'du zhes pa'i sder yab chos mdzad dang yum sgron ma gnyis kyi sus su rab byung bco lnga ba'i lcags sbrul spyi lo 1881 la sku bltams/ dgung lo bcu pa la rab tu byung ste gis steng dga' ldan chos 'phel gyi sgrub grwar zhugs/ der klog gi slob dpon zhig bsten te phral sbyor gyi klog dang skyabs 'gro sogs bslabs/ rong bo bde chen chos 'khor gling gi dus zhabs pa mtsho byung dgyes pa'i dpal las sum rtags dag gsum dang snyan ngag rgya rtsis/ nag rtsis/ sdeb sbyor/ sa/ tsān dbyangs gsum sogs la mkhas par sbyangs/dgung lo nyer bzhi pa la sgos steng dgon par gnang ba zhus te sde'u rtsa bkra shis chos sdings kyi chos grwar zhugs te zhwa dmar paṇḍi ta dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang dge bshes chen mo hor chen ye shes rgya mtsho rnam gnyis kyi mdun nas bsdus grwa dang tshad ma rnam 'grel/ phar phyin/ dbu ma/mngon pa mdzod/ 'dul ba bcas gzhung bka' pod lnga dang / gsang—sngags—kyi rgyud sde sogs la zhib tu sbyangs pas mkhas pa'i go 'phang brnyes/dgung lo zhe bdun par shar skal lngan blo bzang 'phrin las lung chartogs rgya mtshos yongs 'dzin du bkur/ de dang chabs mtshungs rong chen kirti sku phreng bcu ba ngag dbang blo bzang bstan pa tshe ring dang 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtsho sogs slob ma'i tshogs kyang mang du bskyangs/ de ltar

2mkhas chen blo bzang dpal ldan mchog ni rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhas grags rgyasu pa tsam ma yin par/ gzhung de dang de'i dka' gnad la sgro 'dogs chod pa'i sgo nas 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rnam thar sku tshe dang snyoms par mdzad pa lags shing / de nas dgung lo re bzhi pa shing sprel spyi lo1944 ba'i zla bcu gcig tshes nyer gnyis kyi mtshan mor sku 'das/ /spyir khong gis mdzad pa'i gsung rtsom mang du mchis par bshad mod/yul dus rgyu rkyen sna tshogs pa'i dbang gis phal che ba zhig rnyed dka' bar gyur/ da lta bzhugs pa ni mkhas dbang tshe tan zhabs drung mchog gis gtsang bshu bskyon te thugs bsrel gnang ba'ici pod gnyis bzhugs pa de dang / lung yon dgon pa'i e waṃ dpe mdzod kyi phyag dpe'i khrod nas rnyed pa ci rigs yin la/ de dag gi nang nas thu ba dgon dang stag tshang lha mo sogs kyi par ma 'ga' zhig las gzhan dag ma yig rtsom gdan dang bu yig gang rung dbu med du bris pa rnams phyogs bsgrigs byas nas par du bskrun pa yin/sprung go'i pod kyi shes rig dpe than khang nas /spyi lo 1990zla 1 tshes5la/

dkar chaga'ajam dpal rnam par rol ba'i ting nge 'dzin las byung ba'i legs par bshad pa chu'i 'khrul 'khor/ ( 3 〉/dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil gyi mkhas pa'i ya nga rtser rlom pa dngul ra'i hre bo la springs pa'i pho nya mi 'jigs seng ge khros pa'i nga ro (187〉 brgal lan rdo rje'i gzegs ma la rnam par dpyad pa gsang 'dzin mtshon gyi 'khor lo/ (20 1〉bde chen rtsis gzhung gi stong 'jug lhan thabs bzhugs so// (256〉mgur/ (285)dpal rigs pa'i dbang phyug yab sras kyi lam srol dri ma med pa las 'ong ba rigs gzhung dge legs 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhegs so// (291〉chab shog gi skor/ (363〉snyan ngag gi pho nya gzhon nu don rab tu grub pa/ (518〉zhu 'phrin rig byed dbyangs kyi snying bo/ (535〉rtogs brjod gser gyi me tog (541〉
spruska nagon skalka lhan budun pu checapy-idaska bla na rghaṃ bubad daskolka lhan ska sge haṃg ntun ldo zhes py-i bu 2zhun(bar cha/

ci )tshe/ /'jam dpal rnam par rol pa'i ting nge 'dzin las byung ba'i legs par bshad pa chu'i 'khrul 'khor zhes bya ba b.lugs so/ /oṃ bde legs su gyur cig zung 'jug chu shel nor bu'i rtse dga' rnam dag 'od gsal mkha' las ngom/ /phyogs kun skas rwan grangs med skrun la byang chub rdo rje'i dpal las mtho/ /'phrin las me tog sar ba sar bas swo mtshoḍi gos can kun khyab pa/ /dpal ldan phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i mtshan yang 'dzam gling yongs kyi rgyan/ /phyogs kyi skalta bzang dregs ldaXn dga' bas nyer 'dus par/ /sdo bzad ring lugs spel la 'asdin zis zla braswā bsaX/ /zhwang rtosas pad tshal rgu mardzu'i mthar yang rab rgyas pa/ /'jigs braXl dbyāng gaug phyoXgs sbus rtam par rgyaX bas skyongs/ /da3 leṭa yon tan mi mnyam rin chen gyis/ /༷dun ldan skal bzang banywan 'asdon chen po yang / /zhabs skyes rgya mtshoX'i gling la nyer 'du na/ /khyod gzhan riṭa kyi cod pan gang du btsal/ /blo chen rgyal ba kun gyi bstan pa'i dpyid/ /

44/ — khyod yon mdzad pa bsdung po'i rjes 'gro ba/ /'di yis graskyas paX ba dan 'phur ba gzhan/ /ri dbang drung na rdul bzhin kho bos sems/ /snying dbus tshon sna lnga pa'i lding khang du/ /zhabs sen zla tshes gsar ba'i 'od chags pas/ /yid la shes rab mngon dga'i dpal grub pa/ /khyod mthur nges pa rnyed do 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /swa ra su ñtsa'i sngags tshig rol mo'i dbyangs/ /lan gcig 'khrol bas lnga rig shes bya'i gnas/ /lag mthil ri mo'i rnam pa ltar mtshon pa'i/ /mkhyen gter gsang ba'i lha mo mgrin par rol/ /zla sa/zhon bye ba phrag brgyas ma mtshon pa'i/ /ngang ba'i bu mo sgyu ma'i gar mkhan ma/ /smra ba'i 'bab stegs dri za'i dga' tshal las/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rgyud mangs ci yang rdungs/ /dgag sgrub lung rigs srol bzang phyogs kyi mkhar/ /'phags nas thub bstan nyin cho/ra byed pa'e dpal/ /sngon byon mkhas pa'i zhabs skyes mand+ra ra/ /snying nas gus pas zur phud rgyan du 'dzin/ /sdug bsngal me yi bud shing che / /ngan song lus rten ma bzung bar/ /mtho ris chos kyi skyed tshal mar/ /rten bzang dpag bsam rnyed pas spro/ /'dod pa sbrul gyi gdengs ka yi/ /grib ma bsil ba'i tshal btang nas/ /thub bstan legs bris khang bzang du/ /nges par 'byung 'dis zhugs pas spro/ /phal ba'i rgyan la ma sred par/ /dam pa rin chen mang bo'i rgyan/ /lus la rang gi grib ma bzhin/ /mngon bsten skal bzang rgyas pas spro/ /rnam dpyod ya khyor gcig gis kyang / /nang don rig pa'i rgya mtsho 'bum/ /'chu na tha snyad rig pa'i rdzing / /khron pa'i chu zhes gleng bas spro/ /dpal

5ldan mkhas mang rigs pa'i grwar/ /lung rigs rno ba'i mtshon bkye bas/ /don rnams zhum zhing 'dar ba bzhin/ /lag pa'i mthil la nyal bas spro/ /khengs ldan rgol ba'i ral ba mang / /rkang mthil rdul gyis brdzis pa yi/ /drag shul spyod pa ma bzod nas/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan 'gyel bas spro/ / dbeen gsum ri bo'i dga' tshal nas/ /dpyad 'jog 'o ma la 'thungs pas/ /bstan la mi 'khrul gnad kyi gzer/ /thebs pa'i bang mdzod brnyes pas spro/ /bcu phrag rig pa'i rnga bo che/ /rgyun chad med par rab brdungs pas/ /bgrang yas skal bzang rigs pa'e bu/ /mi zad rtse dgas rol pas spro/ /lhag par bstan la ston pa bzhin/ /rlabs chen mdzad pas mngon mtho ba/ /che ba'i che mchog dam pa mang / /rang sras tshul gyis snyems pas spro/ /gos dmar can gyi dbang po 'di/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas ma btang bas/ /mtha' dbus med par grags dkar gyi/ /ba dan rnam par bsgrongs pas spro/ /de phyir lung dang rigs pa'i me tog rnam dpyod snyim pas mkha' la gtor/ /pha rol rgol ba'i nang gi rmongs mun legs bshad nyi ma'i 'od kyis sel/ /shazur gnas mkhas dang mkhas pa'i bzhin ras 'dzum zer ga pur chu yis bkru/ /phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i 'gro ba 'di kun don ldan gtam gyis brel bar bya/ /legs bshad chu yi 'khru la 'khor chen pos bskal ba'i me dpung sathar byed cing / /srid la chags pa'i dri ma kun 'khrud nges 'byung bsam pa'i bzhin ras gsal/ /thar lam dbyar gyi dpal mo rab rgyas sku bzhi'i snye ma g.yur du za/ /e ma de sgad ngo mtshar gtam 'di dge bar nyon ju

6cig grogs po kye/ /de ltar rtsom pa la 'jug pa'i sgo rab tu yangs pa dag dge legs su phye ste las su bya ba'i rim pa rnam par dag pa'i ngang tshul la 'jug par bya'o//de yang thog mar 'di ltar gleng bar bya ste/ 'o skol gyi ston pa yang dag par rdzogs rpā'i sangs rgyas skye rgu thams cad kyi ma 'dris pa'i gnyen du gyur—pa gang gi rjes su 'jug pa'i grub pa'i mtha' smra ba bzhi la gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag mi 'dra ba'i bzhed tshul za 'og gi ri mo ltar sna tshogs pa zhig yod par ma zad/ grub pa' mtha' gcig la'ang der zhugs kyi mkhas pa—so so'i 'dod tshul 'dra dang 'dra min ro mnyam du ma gyur pa ches mang zhing /ser 'bras so so'i yig cha mdzad pa po dag gi bzhed mtshams la yang / ded dpon chen po rnams kyi phyag rnyed kyi rin po che la rigs mang du mchis pa ltar/ dgongs pas bzhed phyogs mi 'dra ba'i rigs ni zad du med do/ /de nyid kyi phyir na skabs su gleng ba'i don la'ang 'di ltar snang ste/ kun gzigs lnga ba chen po dang paṇa chen bsod nams grags pas sdug bsngal —bden pa dang 'khor ba don gcig tu gsungs/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas mdzod mtha' dpyod las de ltar gsungs kyang phar phyin mtha' rshadapyod las nang gi sdug bden dang 'khor ba don gcig tu gsungs/ rje—btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos 'khor ba dang kun nyon phyogs —kyi rten 'brel don gcig tu dgongs shing de dag so so la thugs rtse gtad —sa'i lung yang bzhed phyogs kyis btsal pa gang ji snyed re bzhugs snang ngo //de lta na yang bdag ni dam pa de dag la shes nas mi phyed pa'i dad gus ni

7 mnyam par ldan/ 'gal ba la mi 'khrul ba'i tshad ma skye ba ni chos nyid kyi/ rigs pas khegs/ spyi brtol gyis de dag gi sa/sung gi cha la 'di yin dang 'di min gyi mgo ltag 'byed pa'i snying kham ni phra/ gang zag la dag snang dang chos la brtag dpyad dgos par gsungs pa'i man ngag ni yid la sim pas/ 'phags pa'i yul gyi shing rta chen po rnams kyis gsung rab lta ba'i mig tu byin pa'i gzhung chen mo dag dang / bod yul gangs can gyi tshad ma'i ston pa chen po rgyal ba gnyis pa'i 'khrul bral legs bshad kyi nyi zla thod du bcings/ tsho che gsal myur zab kyi shes rab rab tu rno ba'i mig zur zum— pa med par gdangs te/ dam pa'i srol ka yang dag pa 'i gzhung lam du zhugs pa na/ dam bca' snga ma nyid bka' dang bstan bcos dri ma med pa mtha' dag gi dgongs pa gzhan du 'khyog pa med par lung rigs kyis grub pa'e tshul la nges pa gzhar yang mi g.yo pa thob nas/ tshul de nyid mdo sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i legs par bshad pa bar ma chad par rgyu ba'i ngag gi sgo ya ngas por grol ba las dus dang dus su yang yang thal ba/rang sras rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs kyi ze'u 'bru/ mkhas pa dang grub pa' sku yon lhun grub tu rdzogs pa gang gis rtsod yig 'jigs med rigs pa'i gad rgyangs su'ang phyogs tsam zhig bkod par mdzad do/ /tshul de ni gzu bor gnas shing mkhyen dpyod kyi spyan dang ldan pa dag la/ /ji skad du/ dge ldan legs bshad las/ mkhas pa mkhas pa'i drung na mdzes/ /yon tan ji bzhin mthong bas yin/ /rin thang med pa'i nor bu de/ /ded dpon lag tu mdzes la ltos/ /zhes pa'i ngang tshul ji lta ba bzhin gyur

8na yang / blun po mi byed dgu byed pas/ /skye bo sus kyang tshod 'dzin dka'/ /kla klo'i yul ljo ngas kha cig na/ /ma nyid bag mar len la ltos/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ byang kha'i bre ser 'brong la 'phangs kyang lho kha'i rgya stag rna ba gzer ba'i dpe la song ste/ rang la ma babs pa'i la rgya cichags sdang gis khur du khyer ba 'ga' zhig gis/ mi byed dgu byed sna tshogs pa'e sgo nas lugs gnyis gang dang yang mi mthun pa'i bsam sbyo ra ya nga ba du ma bstan srid kyi gshed du spros shing / khe lag sems gsum la brgal lan shog ldeb tsam yang 'dri ba'i 'khos ka ma byung ba'i sdug yus kyis 'bras sgo klu 'bum pa rdo bis shes rab la re mthong chen pos snga mo zhig nas 'bri bskul yang yang byas so/ /khong ba chos srid kyi rgya mtsho g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dbus ljongs rdo rjo'i gdan du sdod yun ring gshis lugs gnyis dpyod pa'e mig ris tsam mchis pa gzhir byas mod/ blun po don la mi lta bar/ /gzhan gyis brid pa'i dbang du gtong / /zhes pa'i dri zhig bro bas yin nam/ gang ltar yang yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po gung thang blo gros zhal snga nas la rtsom skul gyi yi ge phul zhing / rang nyid nas kyang yod dgu rtsal sprugs kyis shugs phyung ste brgal lan zhig 'dri bzhin yod tshul kho rang gi drung nas snga phyir 'ongs pa du mas bsnyad de lo grangs drug bdun tsam song ngo / /nyid 'dzam gling rgyan kyi chos sde chen pordzidapal ldan 'bras dkar spungs pa'i dge bshes drag gras yi na pas ches ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i legs bshad kyi skyes bzang po zhig 'byung nges pas legs par byung na/ skyes rabs las/ legs par smras pa rnams kyi rin

9 thang zhig /gal te nges par bcad du rung na ni/ /de yi rin du rgyal srid nyid kyang sbyin/ /khyod kyis gyod kyang smra bar ga la 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar byas pa gzo ba'i lan ci nus kyis ldon par bya zhing / de lta min yang nged gnyis bzang ngan gnyis/ char gyis dbus dang khams su skad sgra che ba'i yang rtser son pa'i spun du skyes gshis lo shas la bstan pa'i rgyan du che ba'i legs bshad do bsdos pa re skur res bgyis chog par gda' ba dang / yang gcig kho rang stod kyi kha 'bar dang / nga rang smad kyi kha 'bar gnyis g.yar thug pas rtsod rigs mdzis pa'i yan lag ku re snag shog gron pa bcer che ba re bgyis kyang mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams bzhad gad slong ba'i bdag rkyen nyams mtshar du song na'ang chog snyam gyis nam sleb la re ba nar mar kham bri bar bsgugs so/ /nam zhig shing phag dgun smad sug mthil du 'byor bar/ kho bas grags pa g.yu 'brug gi skad la za yang / grog ma la 'brug dang phye leb la khyung du 'ur ba las rna'/ ma'i grags pa ma yin zhing / nang phug byis pa'i mdzub rtses gzhal nus kyi star ga rang byon du grub pas lci yang gi tshad spyang srang la gzhal ma dgos par lag tshod kyis thig pa byung la/ rjod byed shwa ba'i rwa co las gzengs che yang brjod don e raṇḍa'i 'bras bu las stong pa 'di la lan gyi ngal ba cher ma dgos kyang / dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing khams nas 'bel gtam bgyid rung gi yul du dmigs pa dang / legs par bshad pa'i mol mchid spro yul gyi grogs rnyed pa la sa dang po rab tu dga' bar glo bur du son pa lta bu'i spro ba snying thag pa nas skyes so//

10smras pa/ 'dzam gling sa gzhir 'og min chos kyi zhing / dum bur chags pa 'bras dkar spangs pa'i sde/ /gang der ma mthong rgyang ring mdza' ba'i grogs/ /shes rab ming gi cod pan phyogs su 'dzum/ /de yi rnam dpyod pir gyi rtse mo gang / /lung rigs tshon rtsis ri mo'i mar me ni / /rang gsal nam mkha'i nor gyi gdengs ka la/ /mun sel skyes su btegs pas ci yang ngal/ /legs bshad 'bras bu'i khur gyis ma bzung yang / /dbus gtsang dpag bsam tshal las skyes bzangs su/ /bsrings phyir dman pa'i lcang lo phra mo 'di/ /a shwa tha yi 'dab ma bzhin du bsrel//ma mthong grogs su khug pa'i bshes/ /khyod la bdag bzhin zla ba'i 'dzum//'dab ma brgya pa'i chu skyes gang / /ā di'i bu la ji bzhin rgod/ /nyi gzhon lang tsho dar babs pas/ /utpal dri bzang dga' mar bzhin/ /lung rigs sen rjes gsar ba yis/ /khyod la das/'a ba'i dus ston sbyin// de tshe gtsug phud ldan pa'i khyu/ /sprin gyi sgra yis sgeg pa yis/ /mjug zlo skor ba'i gar bzhin du/ /sor mo'i sgro gshog gtsug tu sgyur/da ni 'bras sgo klu 'bum pa rdo bis lhas byin la/ mdo smad reb gong pa gis steng 'char ka nas skyes lan legs bshad kyi rin chen byur bur spungs te bstar ba la gsum/ zhib mo rnam 'thag tu 'gog pa long ba'i gom 'gros su gsal bar byed pa/ 'khrul gzhan mdzub ston gyis mtshon pa long ba'i mdzub tshugs su gsal bar byed pa/ skyon mtshang rags bsdus kyi khres po rang nyos rang sdug gi khur du skur ba'o/ /dang po la gsum las/6dang po ni/ re zhig 'di 'dri bar bya ste/ kye grogs po dam pa lags/ khyod

byu —— )/)/kyis zag bcas thams cad lta ci/ nyer len gyi phung po dang / sdug bsngal 'byung rung gi gnas ngan len sogs kyang khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ma yin par de la zag tshor btang snyoms kyis khyab pa dang / nyon mongs las byung ba'i zag phung gzhan lta ci/ rgyud bsdus kyi zag phung la'ang nyer len gyi phung pos ma khyab par de la kun nyon phyogs kyi ming gzugs ci rigs kyi rten 'brel gyis khyab pa dang / phyi'i sdug bden lta ci/ nang gi sdug bden la yang 'khor bas ma khyab par de la 'gro ba snga ma nas 'gro ba phyi mar 'gro ba/ kun nyon gsum gyi sgo nas skye 'chi brgyud mar byas pa'am byed pa zhig gis khyab po zhes shugs bskyed nas smra ba 'di ni rgyal ba'i bka'/ shing rta chen po'i gzhung / rje yab sras kyi gsung rab/ ser 'bras dge gsum gyi yig cha gcig gi gsung tshul dang phyogs tsam yang mi mthun zhing / lhag pūr khyed kyis de gsum la sgrub byed gang bkod thams cad rang gi yig char ched dmigs kyi dgag pa 'ba' zhig tu song 'dug na khyod la de ltar smra dgos kyi khag ci zhig babs/ pha rgan bzhad pa'e rdo rje la ngo mi gnong / rang dgon stod smad gnyis ka la zhe mi 'jigs/ rigs mthun la rgyar re ba kun la ngo mi tsha'am cis smyos pa lags/ zhes 'dri'o/ /kho bo cag ni la rgya'i chags sdang gi snyo chu khong du mid/ bzlog med gyi lung rigs mi bzad pas sems rtsa dkrugs/ sngon goms ma rig pa'i gdon gyis rang rgyud brlams pa'i dbang gis ma nges byung rgyal gyi sa gtsubs rdo gtsubs 'di ltar byas te rang lam rang gis bsdubs / rang pha rang gis bsad/ rang mgo rang gis rmas pa 'di bzhin gyur pa rang labs so zer na/ khyod bden khyod bden/

12tshad mar gyur ba'i legs bshad las/ mkhas pa rang la nye ba la/ ri bag phebs sems bde ster bar byed/ /seng ges ri dwags mtha' dag gi /dbugs dbyung byas pa'i byung ba ltos/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar sgod rang nga dang chos kyi grogs su song bas nye bar gyur tsa na 'phral phugs kyi don chen po rnams bdag gis bsgrub par bya yis/ sems bde bar mdzod cig /da ni khyod kyis thog mar 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang de'i sdug bsngal ba la khyad par phye ste bsgrubs pa 'di la brjod par bya ste/ kho bo cag gis/bdag gi pha bla ma thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa de nyid nas lam khrid chen mor/ zag bcas kyi tshor ba bde sdug btang snyoms gsum dang / de dag dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems sems byung rnams dang / bdag rkyen dbang po rnams dang / dmigs rkyen yul gsum bcas thams cad la sdug bsngal skyed pa'i nus pa'am sa bon yod pas 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal du 'jog pa la dgongs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal du gsungs/ zhes bka' stsal pa 'di ltar 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang / de'i sdug bsngal ba la zag bcas ril gyis 'jog pa da nga /spyir sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal ba la khyad par phye ste dang por dam bcas/ bar du sgrub byed spros/ da dung phyogs de rgya cher sgrub par 'gyur na/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal ba la khyad par grub zin sgrub pa'e ngal ba khur du brtsags pa'i khres po chen po 'di ci'i phyir bdag gir byas/ gal te rgyu mtshan de nyid kyis 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang de'i sdug bsngal ba gnyis mi 'dra bar 'grub pa la bsams so zer na/ /kro dang kub la khyad par ches

13che ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis sangs 'phags dang sangs rgyas 'phags pa'ang mi 'dra bar bzhag dgos pa'i ngang tshul tsam du zad de/ 'o na/ tshor ba sdug bsngal dang tshor ba sdug bsngal ba/ tshor bde dang tshor ba bde ba/ tshor ba btang snyoms dang tshor ba btang snyoms pa rnams la'ang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par bzhag dgos pa rgyu mtshan de kas ci'i phyir mi 'grub/ 'grub po zer na / yongs su grags pa'i tha snyad/ dri ma med pa'i rigs pa/ tshad mar gyur pa'i lung rnams dang 'gal bar 'gyur la/ mi 'grub na snga ma 'grub la phyi ma mi 'grub pa'i rgyu mtshan rdul bye ba brgyar gshags pa'i cha tsam yang rnyed par mi 'gyur ro/ /'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang de'i sdug bsngal ba la khyad par de 'dra rung na/ kho bos don byed nus stong dang don byed nus pas stong pa lu'ang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gnam sa tsam zhig yod dgos par khas blangs na khyed lhas byin gtso 'khor lnga mdza' bo ma skyes dgra dang bcas pas so 'debs na ma gtogs nged dga' bo spun drug la ci byar yod/gzhan yang / so thar dang so sor thar pa/ legs spyad dang legs par spyad pa sogs kyis khyod la ma nges pa brjod na/ ya rabs kyi lam srol ring du dor/ ngo tsha dang khrel yod kyi gos lag mthil tsam yang med par gcer bur ker langs kyi brtul zhugs lag nas te rtsod gzhi mi gcig pa tsam gyi u tshugs 'ba' zhig gi tshig ma ṇir bzla ba las legs par bshad pa'i ngag tshig skugs ba'i yī sgra tsam yang 'byin rgyu ga la yod/ spyir sdug bsngal ba zhes pa sdug bsngal gyi zlas drangs pa'i sdug bsngal ba tsam go rgyu ma yin par 'du byed gyi sdug bsngal dang don gcig tu go dgos si 'i tshul ni/ mi rtag

14pa/ mi sdod pa/ 'gyur ba/ 'gag pa/ 'jig pa rnams khyad gzhi 'dus byas dang sbyar tshe 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa nas 'dus byas thams cad 'jig pa zhes 'dus byas la khyab byed dang de dag don gcig par 'ong ba bzhin du/ sdug bsngal ba/ sdug bden/ sdug bsngal bden pa/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ba/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal/khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ba rnams kyang don gcig ming gi rnam grangs zag bcas thams cad la khyab byed du 'jug pa can yin la/ de'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyis/ zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes sogs kyis zag bcas thams cad la de dag gi tha snyad sbyar zhing / sbyar badzhaltar yongs su grags la/ grags pa ltar rgya bod kyi bstan bcos ji snyed pa—zhig las tshig sdud yod med kyi khyad par ci rigs tsam ma gtogs don gcig par gsungs pa ni mdo dang bstan bcos rnam par dag pa de dag gi sgra don gnyis gar log bshad dang kyog bshad kyi lhad ma zhugs pa'i rang —mdangs su yod de sngon yang mang du thal la da dung 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /yang khyod kyis zag bcas la 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis ma khyab par sgrub rshabyed kyi rigs pa la 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang de'i sdug bsngal ba gnyis don gcig ma yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa 'di tsam las ri bong gi spu'i rtse mo tsam yang smras ma byung bas 'di la brjod par bya ste/ mdo dbus kyi bkrarshashis sgo mang gnyis su rigs par sbyangs kyang rang la bkra shis pa'i rigs parsha'adi gcig pu las phyag tu ma chud pa'i ded dpon lag stong khyod soms shigadon dam dang don dam bden pa/ kun rdzob dang kun rdzob pa/ sdug—

15bden dang sdug bsngal bden pa/ kun 'byung dang kun 'byung bden pa/'gog bden dang 'gog pa'i bden pa/ lam bden dang lam gyi bden pa rnams la'ang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par 'byed rigs par thal/ bon phrug khyod kyi zhe 'dod ngan pa de 'thad pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang de'i sdug bsngal ba la khyad 'byed mi rigs par thal/ tshor ba sdug bsngal dang tshor ba sdug bsngal ba/ tshor bde dang tshor ba bde ba/ tshor ba btang snyoms dang tshor ba btang snyoms pa la khyad 'byed mi rigs pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na rang skad dang 'gal/ ma grub na spyi skad dang 'gal/ ma khyab na chos skad dang 'gal lo/ /gzhan yang / 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang de'i sdug bsngal ba gnyis don gcig par thal/gzugs phung dang gzugs kyi phung bo/ mgo dang mgo bo sogs ming gi cha shas bsdus ma bsdus tsam las don gcig pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir// 'dod na rang gi zhen phyogs dang 'gal/ ma grub na mkhas pa'i bzhed phyogs dang 'gal/ ma khyab na rigs pa'i 'gro phyogs dang 'gal lo/ /de ltar na lung dang rigs pa mi bzad pa'i gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo ci yang bkye ba'i zil ma bzod pa'i tshe lung rigs kyi skyabs gnas yang dag rdul tsam yang ma rnyed par/ tshig sdud kyi dbang gis ming gi cha shas ba sgra yod med tsam gyi gseng lam mgo mi chud sa la lus shong rdzong gis skyabs btsal ba ni/ mu stegs ston pa drug gis bcom ldan 'das kyi cho 'phrul ma bzod par tshal logs su sa/ba pa na/ 'jigs pas skrag pa'e mi rnams ni/ /phal cher ri dang nags tshal dang / /kun dga' dang ni mchod gnas kyi/ /ljon shing

16 rnams la skyabs 'gro ste/ /skyabaso de gtso bo ma yin zhing / /skyabs de mchog gyur ma yin la/ /zhes gsungs pa'i ngang tshul ji lta ba bzhin thog tu babs pa'o/ /gzhan yang / mi rtag dang mi rtag pa/ 'dus byas dang 'dus byas pa/ 'dus ma byas dang 'dus ma byas pa/ rna dbang dang rna ba'i dbang po/ mig dbang dang mig gi dbang po sogs dang / snod du bcug dang snod du bcug pa/ nang du gzhug dang nang du gzhug pa rnams kyang don mi 'dra/ bar thal/ ming cha ba sgra bsdus ma bsdus tsam gyi sgo nas 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang de'i sdug bsngal ba ba/nyis don mi 'dra ba'i stong bshad gso ba che ba de'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ yongs grags mi bslu ba'i tha snyad/ gnod sgrub yang dag gi rigs pa/ lung tshig rnam dag gi shes byed gang gis kyang de dag mi 'dra ba'i khyad par 'byed mi nus pa 'chad par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ sa/la te rtsod gzhi mi gcig pas so snyam na/nged kyi ngor ba kun dga' bzang po 'di/ /lcang ra chos mdzad pa dang brtsad pa'i tshe/ /'khor gsum brgya phrag dngos 'gal byas na yang / /chos can mi gcig gsungs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes grags pa de 'don pa sgyur la/ nged tsho'i klu 'bum rdo bis lhas byin 'di/ /sges steng 'char ka ba dang brtsaja pa'i tshe/ /'khor gsum brgya phrag dngos 'gal byas na yang / /chos can mi gcig gsungs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes rang gi slob 'khor ko ko/ li ka dang / khan da dra ba bya dang / ka ta mor ka ti cu dang / rgya mtshos byin sogs la kha na na'i bar 'don du chug cig gzhan yang / kun rdzob bden pa zhes pa'i tshig zur gyi kun rdzob la ma rig pa

17rwang / de sgrub kyi phyogs chos zhes pa'i tshig zur gyi phyogs la de sgrub kyi shes 'dod chos can dang / de sgrub kyi mthun phyogs zhes pa'i tshig zur gyi phyogs—la de sgrub kyi bsgrub bya'i chos kyis khyab pa bzhin du 'dir yang sdug bsngal gsum pa de dang de'i tshig zur gyi sdug bsngal la tshor ba sdug bsngal gyis khyab po/ /de ltar na 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal zhes pa'i tshig zur gyi sdug bsngal ni tshor ba sdug bsngal dang / de'i tshig zur gyi 'du byed pa ni sdug bsngal de 'du byed pa'am skyed pa'i don can du go dgos pas na/ sdug bsngal de 'du byed pa/ sdug bsngal de 'du byed nus/ sdug bsngal de 'du—byed nus pa/ sdug bsngal de 'du byed nus can/ sdug bsngal de 'du byed pa'i chos can zhes pa rnams la ming cha pa dang can sogs sbyar ma sbyar gyi khyad tsam las don la khyad par gtan nas med pa blo gros dang ldan pa dag gis rtogs sla bar yod do/ /yang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang de'i sdug bsngal ba la khyad par med par thal/ rang dus skad cig gnyis bar mi rtagarang dus skad cig gnyis par mi rtag pa/ rang dus skad cig gnyis par mi sdod pa/ rang dus skad cig gnyis par mi sdod can/ rang dunu/ skad cig sa/nyis par 'gyur ba/ rang dus skad cig gnyis par 'gag pa rnams tshig gis brjod tshul tsam las don mi 'dra ba med pa bzhin yin nga/'e phyir te/ de'i sdug bsngal ba zhes pa'i ba sgra yang nus can dang nus ldan gyi don du yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang / 'du byed kyi sdub༈ bsngal dang de'i sdug bsngal ba la khyad 'byed na/ 'dus byas gzhan dbang dang / 'dus byas gzhan dbang ba dang / 'dus byas gzhan dbang can rnams la'ang mi

18 'dra ba'i khyad par phye ste de dag zhib 'grel mtha' dpyod kyi lugs su 'chad pa'i stong bshad kyis la sngon med legs bshad du sgrogs dang / mgo bo bcad nas mdzes rgyan dang / rna ba bcad nas lham mthil byed pa khyod rigs pa smra ba'i yang rtser son pa'i grags pa mched par 'gyur ro/ /des na ming gi cha shas tsam la 'bros sa bcol ba ni 'phyon ma'i padma la gab sa 'cha' ba ste sngon gyi brgya byin gyi brtul zhugs blangs pa gor ma chag pas/drang srong gi dmod pas log bshad kyi mtshan ma stong du rang shugs kyis song ba nyid kho bos snying rjes bden tshig gis rtog ge pa skam po 'u thug pa 'i tshig gi 'khri ba'i 'dzin mtshams kyi mig stong du gyur cig ces bden pa bdar bar bgyi'o/ /spyi skad mkhas pa'i gzhung lam las/ /brgal nas 'jigs pa'i g.yang sa na/ /rang srog srung ba'i nal bu khyod/ /byol te 'gro ba'i khyu la song / /min na dkar mo rtse rgyal gyi/ /cod pan thogs te pha yi chos/ /klog pa mdzes kyi rgyal ba'i gzhung / /dkrug pa'i las kyis phung la soms/yang khyod kyis zag tshor btang snyoms kyi dmigs bdag grogs gsum gyi zag bcas rnams kyis tshor ba de skyed pa dang de'i grogs byed pa ci rigs kyi sgo nas sdug bsngal bar byed pas 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ba la 'jog spyang / 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal la zag tshor btang snyoms kho na 'jog go zer ba de la 'di brjod par bya ste/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal la zag tshor btang snyoms kyis ma khyab par thal/ de la zag bcas ṣpems cad 'jog dgos pari phyir/ der thal/ spyir sdug bsngal gsum po

19 'di/ skyes tsam nas gnod pa'i cha nas dang po/ de lta min yang 'gyur ba'am 'gags pa na 'phral du gnod pa skyed pa'i cha nas gnyis pa/skyes tsam dang 'phral du gnod pa mi skyed kyang phugs su gnod pa skyed pa'i cha nas gsum pa bzhag pa gang zhig de ltar 'phral phugs ci rigs su gnod pa 'byung rung gi nus pa can ma yin pa'i zag bcas med pa'i phyir— dang / gnad de ka'i dbang gis bstan pa'i bdag po/ shing rta po/ rje yab sras/ bdag gi rje bla ma thams cad ma/khyen pa sogs tshad mar gyur pa'i skyes mchog mtha' yas pas zag bcas thams cad 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal du bka' stsal pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang /'du byed kyi sdug bsngal la tshor bas ma khyab par thal/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal lam de'i sdug bsngal ba'i don rgyu la ltos te las dang nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang can du yod pa dang / 'bras bu la ltos te sdug bsngal 'du byed pa'i nus pa'am sa bon gtan chags su yod pa can la 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal lam de'i sdug bsngal ba zhes sngon byon gyi mkhas grub de snyed kyis bka' stsal pa'i legs bshad kyi drang thig de ka rang babs su bzhag chog pa'i phyir dang / de lta min par khyod kyi u tshugs bzhin 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi don tshor btang skyed pa'i don du bshad pa'i rgya bod kyi gzhung tshad 2na gcig kyang med pa'i phyir dang / gal te yod na khyod kyis de dang de mu tig star la brgyus pa bzhin du bkod chog pa la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyis zag bcas thams cad 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal du gsungs pa ni dngos btags ma byed pa'i bshad pa'o zhes

20ngo tsha khrel 'das kyi dkyog bshad dang log bshad kyi tshangs thig dgu 'khyog tu btab ste log 'dzin 'ba' zhig gi phyogs la ske chad chad du 'then pa las/ rang 'dod kyi shes byed du 'gro nges pa'i rgya bod kyi gzhung tshad ldan gcig gi tshig zur skra'i rtse mo brgya stong du gshags pa'i cha tsam yang 'dren rgyu ma rnyed pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang / 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi don de ltar yin te/ dper na de sgrub kyi mthun phyogs zhes pa'i phyogs la de sgrub kyi bsgrub chos su 'gro rgyu de bzhag nas/ skabs kyi 'god tshul ltar phyogs btags pa ba de dang mthun pa phyogs mthun zhes pa'i don can de la tshig sbyor gyi dbang gis mthun phyogs zhes brjod cing / bdag med yin na sgra bdag med du sgrub pa'i mthun phyogs yin pas khyab zer ba bzhin du/'dir yang khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal zhes pa'i tshig zur gyi sdug bsngal de tshor ba sdug bsngal dang / 'du byed ni sdug bsngal de skyed pa dang /khyab pa ni sdug bsngal de skyed nus par nges pa ste/ sdug bsngal 'du byed nus pas khyab pa 'e/sa pa'i don can du gnas pa la tshig sbyor gyi dbang gis khyib pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang /— tshig sdud kyis 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal zhes brjod cing / zag bcas yin na sdug bsngal 'du byed nus pas khyab pas na/ de yin na 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin pas khyab po zhes gnad kyi 'gag mdo 'a di ka thugs la bzhag nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ 'du byed thams cad sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes dang / shing rta chen pos/ ci'i phyir 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid du brtag ce na/ zhes pa nas/ de gnyis ka'i gnas ngan len yongs su 'dzin pa dang / de gnyis ka las ma thar pa

21mi rtag pa nyid kyis rjes su bcings pas grub pa dang bde ba ma yin pas kyang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid du blta'o/ /zhes dang / rje bla mas/gnas ngan len rjes su 'brel bas 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes dang / sdug bsngal dang nyon mongs kyi gnas ngan len gtan chags par yod pas 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal/ zhes sogs dang / bdag gi bla ma thams cad mkhyen pas/ yul gsum bcas thams cad la sdug bsngal skyed pa'i nus pa'am sa bon yod pas 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal du 'jog ces gsungs pa sogs rgya bod kyi mkhas pa dang grub pa'i skyes mchog phal mo che tshul 'di la zhal mthun pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang / 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal tshor btang kho nar 'dod pa mi 'thad par thal/ dper na dug dang 'dres nges su sbyar ba'i kha zas la dug gis ma zin pa'i cha med pa dang /des 'phral du tshor bde sogs skyed kyang phugs su srog 'phrog pa tshun gyi sdug bsngal skyed pa ltar/ zag bcas gzhan lta ci/ srid rtse'i phun tshogs kyang cha thams cad la sdug bsngal skyed pa'i nus pa gtan chags su yod pas/ gnas skabs bskal chen mang por 'dod pa'i 'bras bu 'byin yang nam zhig mnar med yan chad kyi sdug bsngal skyed par byed pa ni phun tshogs de nyid 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin pa'i don yin pa'i phyir dang / de dag—de ltar sdug bsngal skyed pa'i rang bzhin du sgom pa ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngatshwasgom tshul yin pa'i phyir dang / de ltar bsgoms na 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal la der ngo shes pa'i sgo nas srid pa'i phun tshogs ma lus pa la zhen log gi nges 'byung yang dag pa skyesmoba'i phyir dang / gnad de'i dbang gis/ 'du

22 byed sdug bsngal la dgongs nas/ /sdug bsngal bsgom par gsungs pa yin/ /zhes kyang gsungs pa'i phyir dang / tshor btang tsam la sdug bsngal skyed pa'i nus pa yod pa dang / tshor btang gi rkyen grogs sogs la tshor btang skyed pa'i nus pa yod par bsgoms pas khams gsum po ma lus pa la zhen log rnal ma skye ba'i gnas med pa'i phyir ro/ /de las gzhan du/ zag bcas rnams tshor btang gi rkyen grogs su 'gro tshul sems pa zag bcas thamasacad 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bar sgom pa'i don dang / de ltar bsams pas nges 'byung skye bar 'dod na ni/ dug can gyi zas zhim mngar can 'phral bde'i rkyen du che tshul sems bde kha zas de nyid skyon can du lta tshul yin par thal ba dang / de ltar bsams pas de la zhen log skye bar thal ba dang / bsam gtan bzhi ba'i rgyu snyoms 'jug sogs tshor btang skyed pa'i nus ldan du sems pa'ang de sdug bsngal bar sgom tshul yin par thal ba dang / de ltar goms pas snyoms 'jug de la mi 'dod pa'i blo 'byung bar thal ba dang / 'dod yon lnga tshor ba de'i rgyur sems pa'ang de sdug bsngal bar sgom tshul yin par thal ba dang / de lta ra bsams pas 'dod sred je 'phel du mi 'gro bar thal ba dang / sems can thams cad la zhen log dang nges 'byung rang chas su yod par thal ba sogs mi 'dod bzhin du khas len dgos pas na/ nyer len gyi phung po 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ma yin zhing srid pa'i phun tshogs mtha' dag zag tshor btang snyoms kyi rkyen grogs ci rigs su sems pa 'du byed kyi sdug yasngal sgom tshul du 'dod mkhan chos 'di ba pa la nges 'byung bsam pa'i

23gshed ma khyod gcig pu las sngar yang ma byung zhing phyis kyang khyed kyis smon lam log 'debs byed na ma gtogs 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang / 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal tshor btang kho nar 'dod pa'i khyod kyi u tshugs de mi 'thad par thal/ lam rim sogs las lha mi'i go 'phang thob kyang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal las ma 'das par gsungs pa'ang / de dag sdug bsngal 'du byed pa'i rang bzhin las ma 'das pa'i don yin gyi/ tshor btang dang de'i rkyen grogs ci rigs las ma 'das pa'i don ma yin pa'i phyir dang / 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sems tshul mthar thug pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal sgom pa nyid la gsungs pa'ang zag bcas nyer len gyi phung bo thams cad sdug bsngal grub pa dang 'grub pa'i rten byed pa'i nus pa can dang / nad dang 'bras dang zug rngu ltar gnod pa skyed nus kyi bdag nyid can du sgom pa la byed kyi/ tshor btang tsam grub pa dang 'grub pa'i snod dang de skyed pa la nade sogs dang 'dra bar sgom pa la mi byed pa'i phyir dang / zag bcas la rang bzhin gyis bde ba'i bdag nyid can du 'dzin—pa'i blo phyin ci log dang dmigs pa gcig la dmigs nas 'dzin stangs dngos su 'gal ba'i blo sgom pa'ang sngar bshad pa ltar yin gyi/ zag tshor btang snyoms kyi rang bzhin nam de skyed pa'i ngang tshul can du 'dzin pa la mi byed pa'i phyir dang / zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal skyed pa'i rangarshabazhin can du sgom pa ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal phra mo sgom rshatshul yin jing / de ltar srid pa'i bde ba mthar thug pa zhig yan yang sdug bsngal skyed pa'i rang bzhin las ma 'das pa ni mthong dka' bas spu dang

24'dra ba dang / so skye lag mthil dang 'dra bas de ji bzhin mi mthong pa dang / 'phags pa sdig dang 'dra bas ni mngon sum du mthong bas na skye 'phags gnyis la—sdug rbesngal phra mo mngon sum du rtogs ma rtogs kyi khyad par bzhag pa'i phyir dang / 'di ni sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa'o/ /zhes pa'ang / zag bcas nyer len gyi phung bo 'di rnams ni sdug bsngal skyed pa'i bdag nyid can kho nar 'phags pa rnams kyis mngon sum du gzigs pa ltar don la gnas pa'i bden pa yin/ zhes pa'i don yin pa sogs 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal sgom tshul sngar bshad pa ltar gnas pa lam rim gyi gzhung brgya phrag mang bo'i skabs de snyed na nyi ma 'bum phrag cig car du shar pa ltar gsal la lhang nger yod cing / srid pa'i phun tshogs thams cad tshor btang gi rang bzhin dang de'i rkyen grogs can du sgom pa sdug bden 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam tshul du bshad pa'i tshig zur srin bu'i sgron me lta bu'ang tshad ldan gyi gzhung na med pa ni snang rung ma dmigs pa nyid kyis grub pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar khyod kyis bshad pa ltar 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bsams pas 'khor ba mtha' dag la zhen log rnal ma skye ba'i gnas med pa dang de ma skyes na thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa gang gi lam du'ang chud mi srid pa dang / de ma byung na thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa mi thob pa'i ldog 'gro dang / de las log pa'i rjes 'gro tshul bzhin du nges na nged kyi pha bla ma'i lam khrid nyams myong tshad mas gtan la phab pa 'di nyid sgrub brgyud kyi dam pa zam ma chad pa'i man ngag gi bcud dang / rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i gnad don

25zab brling phyin ci ma log pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa la nges pa bde blag tu skye bar 'gyur mod/ kha bshad stong shob kyi lhas byin khyod 'dra par skal ba med pa la mya ngan mi che yi/ thos bsam sgom gsum ya ma bral ba'i mkhas pa'i bu rgyud du skyes shing / de lta bu'i pha srol gra ma nyams par 'dzin 'os khur du lci ba 'ga' zhig khyod dang 'dra ba'i ngang tshul du gnas pa la bdag yus che'o/ /bdag lus grib ma'i ri mo sa gzhi la/ /mngon sum rgyan du 'phos la deg brtson pa'i/ /chags sdang stobs kyis gsos pa'i dpa' po rnams/ /pha mes bzang po'i lam srol phyag tu bzhes/ /rmo gzhan yang / sems ma bcos gnyug ma/ gos ma bcos dkar po zer ba'i dpe bzhin/ rang 'dod kyis 'chos sgyur khyod ltar mi dgos par tshig dang don gyi cha mtha' dag rang babs drang thad du sngar smos kyi rgyab tu bzhugs pa'i lung rigs gcig grogs su gcig bzhugs pa'i tshul phyogs tsam brjod par bya ste/ 'di ltar/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal la zag tshor btang snyoms kyis ma khyab par thal/ zag bcas yin na 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin pas khyab pa'i phyir te/ de yin na las nyon gyis skad cig re re la mi rtag cing 'gyur bas khyab ba'i phyir/ zag bcas yin na 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin pas khyab par thal/ de yin na sdug bsngal 'du byed pa'i gnas ngan len 'dzin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ las nyon gyi gzhan dbang gis mi rtag pa yin na 'du byid kyi sdug bsngal yin pas khyab par thal/ de yin na dngos brgyud ci rigs nas lus sems la gnod pa'i bdag nyid can yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ zag bcas kyi 'dus byas yin na 'du byed kyi

26 sdug bsngal lam sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can 'ba' zhig yin pas khyab par thal/ de yin na las nyon gyis dbang med du mi rtag pa'am 'gyur bar byas pa nu/ mthar gnod par byed pa'i mtshan nyid can yin pas khyab snapa'i phyir/ nyer len gyi phung bo yin na 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin pas khyab par thal/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal de nyer len gyi phung bo'i khyab byed yin pa'i phyir dang / de yin na las nyon gyis skye 'jig dang ldan pa dang /sdug bsngal dang po gnyis kyi gnas ngan len dang ldan pa dang / las nyon gyis mi 'gyur bar mtha' gcig tu btang snyoms su skye ba dang gnas pa'i bdag nyid can ma yin pa dang / sdug bsngal dang po gnyis las ma thar bas res sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang res 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal du 'gyur ba rnams yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ zag tshor gsum dang de'i rkyen grogs gang rung yin na 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin pas khyab par thal/de yin na sdug bsngal dang po gnyis kyi sa bon 'dzin pa dang / de gnyis las mthar zhing ma grol ba dang / las nyon gyis mi rtag pa'am 'gyur bas mtha' gcig tu btang snyoms 'ba' zhig tu skye ba dang gnas pa ma yin pa rnams yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ zag bcas kyi phung khams skye mched gsum bo gang rung yin na 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin pas khyab par thal/ de yin na zag med ma yin pa'i de gsum gang rung yin paru khyab pa'i phyir/las nyon gyis bskyed pa'i lus sogs la 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis khyab par thal/ de la las nyon gnyis dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas ngan len nam sa bon dang ldan pas khyab pa'i phyir/ yid du 'ong ba'i zag bcas

27dang / yid du mi 'ong ba'i zag bcas dang / de dag rilas gzhan pa'i bar ma'i zag bcas gang rung yin na 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin pas khyab par thal/ de yin na sdug bsngal gsum po gang rung dang ldan pa'i phung po yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ de dag gi rtags khyab rnams mdo dang / bsdu ba dang / bzhi brgya pa rtsa 'grel dang / nyam sa dang / kun btus rtsa 'grel dang / mdzod rtsa 'grel rnams kyis legs par grub la/ lung rnams rigs pa'i gad rgyangs su bkod 'dug pas der blta bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang / zag bcas kyi tshor pa btang snyoms chos can/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yim par thal/ sdug bsngal dang nyon mongs skyed pa'i gnas ngan len rjes su 'brel ba'i dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur la khyab pa yod dam med/ yod na ni/ khams gsum gyi zag bcas la 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis khyab dgos pas khyod kyi zhe 'dod ngan pa dang rgyab 'gal du song 'dug la/ khyab pa med do zhe na/ de la khyab pa yod par thal/ de bdag cag gi ston pa rgyal ba gnyis pas bkod pa'i thal 'gyur yang dag yin pa'i phyir te/ lam rim las/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i tshor ba btang snyoms te/ gnas ngan len rjes su 'brel bas 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes dang / 'di ni las dang nyon mo ngas pa snga ma'i gzhan dbang du gyur cing sdug bsngal dang nyon mongs pa phyi ma rnams skye ba'i sa bonarjes su 'brel bas na kun tu 'gro ba'i gnas ngan len dang ldan pa'o/ /zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi thal 'gyur yang dag yin pa'i phyir/ gong 'og gi lung rigs kyi skor 'ge ji snyed pa'i gnad don yang 'di la thug ste/

28dper na don dam dpyod byed kyi rigs pa ji snyed pa'i rtsa ba rigs pa'i rgyal bo rten 'brel la thug pa bzhin lkeno/ /stong shob pa khyod bzhin du kha bshad rkyang ba la ma shor bar tshul 'di 'dra zhig go rgyu byung ba'ang pha bla ma de nyid kyi bka' drin kho na lags pas nam mkha' ji srid du sgrub pa'i mchod pa sa ci yang mchod do/ /mang thos rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i grong khyer du/ /dpyad 'jog gru gzings bskyod pa'i rtse dga' yis/ /dpyis phyin go ba'i rin chen 'dren srid kyi/ /rang khyim yan pa'i grogs khyod ngal sos shig /yang / 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin na tshor ba yin pas ma khyab par thal/sdug bsngal skyed byed kyi sa bon yang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin pa'i phyir te / lam rim las/ phung bo 'di la sdug bsngal dang nyon mongs kyi gnas ngan len brtan chags par yod pas 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal de yod na/tshor ba'i sdug bsngal da lta med pa'i skabs re byung yang / de ma thag yang sgo sna tshogs nas sdug bsngal du ma skyed pas na/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngalapani sdug bsngal thams cad la khyab pa dang / sdug bsngal gzhan gnyis kyi rtsa ba yin pas/ 'di la skyo ba mang du bsgom mo/ /zhes nyi ma stong phrag cig car shar ba bzhin du gsal bar gsungs kyang / da dung nyin mo long ba'i brtul zhugs bzung ste/ 'di yang zhib cha med pa'i bam bshad do zer na/rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mtha' dag mngon gyur ba/ /blo bzang rgyal ba yis kyang ma thon pa'i/ rsā /gsar bshad phra men ma yi so nam des/ /phan las gnod pa che bas sgrims shig ang / /zhes ma gsungs sam/ rje bla ma'i rje sa 'jug gi dri e bro/ legs bshad rmang nas dkrug pa'i chos spong gi las labyu

la /rdo/rte////ci'i phyir brel// kha ni mi dge kun gyi bang mdzod yin/ /'di la sgo lcags brgyab na ci ma rung / /zhes pa'i don la lag len ci thub tu bgyis na mi legs sam/ spuyang / 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal la zlag tshor gyis ma khyab par thal/ las nyon las byung ba'i 'dus byas yin na de yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de ltar khyab par bstan pa'i bca' yig chen mo las gsungs pa'i phyir te/ de nyid las/ las dang nyon mongs pa snga ma'i gzhan gyi dbang du gyur pa'i 'du byed thams cad 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang / de la tshor bas ma khyab par thal/ nyer len gyi phung po 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin pa'i phyir/der thal/ de yin pa bstan pa'i gnam thig ring mo las gsungs pa'i phyir te/ de nyid las/ nyer len gyi phung bo grub tsam gyis 'a du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du skye ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang / de la tshor bas ma khyab par thal/ nyer len gyi phung bo lnga bo gang rung yin na de yin bas khyab pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de ltar khyab pa bstan pa'i phyag rgya chen mo'i dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de nyid las/ mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung bo lnga sdug bsdal zhes gsungs pa'i don/ nas/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / sdug bden yin na 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin pas khyab par thal/de yin na las nyon gyi lag rjes su byung ba'i phung po yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/khyab ste/ de ltar khyab pa yod pa ser 'bras dge gsum gyi yig cha kun gyi ma gcig pu rnam bshad snying bo'i rgyan gyi dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de

30 nyid las/ las dang nyon mongartswakyis lag rjes bzhag pa'i zag bcas kyi phung bo gang yin thams cad 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rnam 'grel thar lam gsal byed du'ang tshig de kho na ltar 'byung la/ da dung bsnyon na la rgya'i chags sdang gis smyos pa la shākya thub pas kyang ci yang byar med de/ gna' dus kyi lhas byin bzhin no/ /gzhan yang / tshor ba btang snyoms chos can/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin te/ las nyon gyi gzhan dbang can yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa 'di tha snyad 'ba' zhig sgrub kyi sbyor ba yang dag yin par thal/ las nyon gyi gzhan dbang can de de sgrub kyi rtags yang dag gang zhig de de skub kyi bsgrub bya'i chos su 'gro rgyu'i 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ rtags phyi ma grub ste/ mkhas grub chos gyi rgyal bos/ phung po las dang nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang can yin pa ni 'du byed kyi phung po'i don ldog yin la/ zhes dang / rin chen them skas las kyang / khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal zhes pa de'i don yang las dang nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang can la bya ste/zhes gsungs shing / mdo dang / rgya gzhung / bod kyi mkhas dbang snga ma rje yab sras/ phyi rabs kyi tshad ldan so so'i lung mtha' dang grangs med pa rigs pa'i gad rgyangs su nyi ma shar ba bzhin du gsal ler bzhugs pa'i — phyir/ de ltar lung rigs phan tshun gsal byed kyi rgyan du che ba/ rin thang med pa'i rin po che sha stag gral bsgrigs su 'od 'bar bar gnas pa lta ba/gsar bshad kyog bshad kyi dri ma'i lhad ma zhugs pa/ lung don mtha' dag tshig don dgongs gsum gyi cha la ma bcos rang babs su gnas pa 'di

dzo spyo /rdo/miX// ni/ kho bos yin tshul la yin lugs sgro skur gyis ma bslad bar 'khrul med du bshad pa'i 'bras rtags/ rnam pa thams cad du bdag la nam yang mi bsgu ba'i dpung gzhen/ mkhas pa'i dkyil 'khor la bag yangs su rgyu rung ba'i dan rtags kyi phyag rgya/ sa gtsubs rdo gtsubs ci tsam byas kyang dam bca' mi sgrib pa'i dpal gyi nyi ma rang gsal/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan srid pa'i mthar yang mi g.yo ba'i mtshan ma brtan po nyid du sus mi shes/ de lta bu'i lung rnam par dag pa rnams las 'da' bar yod na khyod ni chos 'di ba la ngo rgol byed pa'i snying kham can te/ bde gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /zhes pa las bzlog ste 'jug pa la ci mi snyagapa'i phyir ro/ /rang la yid ches pher nges kyi lung tshig dri ma med pa gcig kyang mi gda' bar/ rnam par dag pa'i lung gi tshogs bsam gyis mikhyab pa'i rgya mtsho rab tu dwangs pa/ rang gi ngan rtog rus sbal rkyal 'gros kyis ci dgar rnyog par byed pa'i ngang tshul ni rang gzhan gnyis ka chud zos su gtong ba'i bdud las 'ba' zhig ste/ ji skad du/ yid ches lung dang mi ldan par/ /chos rnams ston par byed pa ni/ /mtshan nyid rnam par rtog pa yi sa/ /bdag kyang chud gson gzhan chud gson/ /zhes gsungs—pas so/ /gshen sras khyod kyis 'di smos pas/ re ba can kun rang ma lan/ /'gram pa lag pa la brten nas/ /shugs ring 'byin pas ci yang ngal/ /gzhan yang / khyod kyi bshad tshul de ser 'bras dge gsusagyi yig cha che khag rnams dang mi mthun pa'i tshu la brjod par bya ste/ 'di ltar/ khyod kyis 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal la tshor btang gis khyab par

32bshad de rgyal ba'i bka'/ shing rta chen po'i gzhung / bod kyi mkhas dbangasnga ma dag gi legs bshad/ rje yab sras kyi gsungatsapa rnams dang rgyab 'gal du song tshul smos zin pa de ltar la/ khyod kyi log 'grel de rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i rang lugs dang mi mthun te/ de'i lugs la nyer len gyi phung po lnga char 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin pa'i phyir te/ spyodon rol mtsho las/ gsum pa ni nyer len gyi phung po lnga lta bu/ zhes dang / rta nag rnam 'grel las/ kha cig na re/ sdug bsngal de la/ sdug bsngal misdug bsngal/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang gsum du 'byed rigs so zhe na/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin na sdug bsngal yin dgos par thal/ dam bca' 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ khams gsum la khyab pa'i sdug bsngal bden pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/khyod kyi lugs ngan de nyid paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa'i legs bshad dang yang mi mthun te/ de'i lugs lacizag bcas thams cad 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal du 'jog pa'i phyir te/ phar phyin spyi don yum don gsal sgron las/ de gsum gyi mtshan gzhi yod de/ zag bcas kyi tshor ba sdug bsngal mtha' dag dang / zag bcas kyi tshor ba bde ba mtha' dag dang / de gnyiyolas gzhan pa'i las nyon gyis lag rjes bzhag pa'i zag bcas kyi phung bo mtha' dag rim pa bzhin de gsum gyi mtshan gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de gnyis las gzhan gsungs pa ni— sdug bsngal gsum

33du phye ba'i tha ma'i mtshan gzhi'i dbang du mdzad pa yin te/ spyir rnam bshad las/ las dang nyon mongs kyis lag rjes bzhag pa'i zag bcas kyi shung po gang yin thams cad 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal te/ zhes pa 'di sgra ji bzhin du bzhed 'dun mnga' ba bltas pa tsam gyis dpog pa'i phyir ro/ /lhag par khyod kyi srol ngan de kun mkhyen bla ma'i bzhed pa dang rgyab 'gal tran par thal kun mkhyen bla mas gzugs med pa'i nyer len gyi phung po 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal la bzhag pa'i phyir te/ mtha' dpyod chen mo las/gzugs med khams pa'i rgyud kyi nyer len gyi phung po chos can/ sdug bsngal yin par thal/ de gsum gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ 'du byed kyi de yin pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / bdud rtsi'i thigs par yang / kun btus las/de la sdug bsngal gyi bden pa gang zhe na/ sems can skye ba dang skye ba'i gnas kyis kyang rig par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'khor ba'i gnas dang longs spyod 'di thams cad kyang khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal lin/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bkra shis sgo mang gi bkra mi shis pa khyod sted spyir ser 'bras dge gsum dang / khyad par bkra shis sgo mang gi mkhas sang 'tshogs pa'i dbus su ji ltar 'gro/ yig cha gsum ga mthun par sdug bden la sdug bsngal gsum du phye ba de yang de la tshor ba gsum du phye ba ma ryān par sdug bden la de gsum gang rung gis khyab pa dgongs mthil du gnas pas/ khyod kyi ngan skad de de'i phyogs su'ang song e 'dug gal te yig cha rnamazlo kyi de zhib cha mthon pa'i go thob bam 'grel dang / zhib bshad mtha' dpyod kyi lugs dri ma med pa ni kho bo'i 'di kho na'o zer na/

34 de ni yid la shar yang kha nas 'don pa khyod lha rams pa 'i ming skam thogs pa zhig la cang e mdzes bsam par rigs so/ /legs par bshad pa de snyed cig mthong yang da dung log pa'i grub mtha' mi 'dor bar slog hrul rgyal mtshan du 'phyar ba la ngo sor 'khyer ba ni/ ji skad du/ lha yi rgya‘5 bos char phab kyang / /sa bon mi rung mi 'khrung ltar/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni byung— gyur spyang / /skal ba med pas bzang mi myong / /zhes pa'i don thog tu babs pa'o/ /log par smra ba khyod kyi rtse/ /lus med srag pos bskyod pa na/ /raro gi yig cha'i rang skad kyang / /ha ha sa yi 'og tu bcings/ /kun mkhyen bu rgyud 'ga' mchis na/ /rang pha gsod pa'i dme bo 'di'i/ /mgo bo zam pa'i ru mtshon gyi/ /rgyan du byas kyang su zhig tshim/ / gzhan yang /dzesdug bsngal dang po gnyis la'ang tshor bas khyab pa dang /de dang de'i sdug bsngal dang de dang de'i sdug bsngal ba la khyad par phye ba la'ang mtshon tsam brjod par bya ste/ 'bi ltar/ de ltar 'byed dgos pa yongs su grags pa'i tha snyad kyis yin nam/ rigs pas yin nam/ lung gis yin/ dang po mi 'thad de/ 'jig rten la grags pa'i tha snyad kyis ma yin pa gang zhig bstan bcos la grags pa'i tha snyad kyis ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po sla/ gnyis pa grub ste/ tshor ba yin par thal/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal yin pa'i phyiraspyo/ sems byung yin par thal/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal yin pa'i phyir/ shes pa yin par thal/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal yin pa'i phyir/ zag tsho ra yin par thalu/ dzi sdug bsngal gsum po rī

rme35 gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu gzhan lta ci mtha' dpyod thal phyiro gyi tshul du bsgrigs pa gcig na'ang med pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de 'dra yod na khyod kyis zhib dpyad mtha' dpyod kyi tshul du bris par 'dren 'os pa la zur tsam yang 'dren rgyu ma rnyed pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang / sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal tshor ba rkyang ba la ma grags par thal/ zag tshor yul rkyen grogs dang bcas pa der grags pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sdug bsngal dngos kyi rkyen grogs sogs la sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal du gsungs pa bgrang gis mi lang ba gang zhig de sdug bsngal min par gsungs pa mang yang sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal min par bshad pa khyod kyi stong bshad las gzhan gcig kyang med pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de dag sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal min par gsungs pa yod na khyod kyis min gsal can gyi lung de dag bkod pas/ chog gi yin gsal can gyi lung de snyed la bstan pa 'di la sus kyang smras ma myong ba'i log bshad 'u thug pa'i ngang tshul de 'dra smra mi dgos pa'i phyir/ de ltar khyad 'byed dgos pa rigs pa dang lung gis kyang ma yin te/ de ltar dgos pa'i lung rigs rnam dag gcig kyang med pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sdug bsngal gsum la tshor ba yul dang bcas pa 'jog pa'i lung mtha' yas pa bkod dang 'god bzhin pa ltar yin pa'i phyir dang / de dang de'i sdug bsngal ba yin na de dang de'i sdug bsngal yin pas khyab pa la/ rgyal sras ma las/ 'gyur ba nyid sdug bsngal ba nyid yin pas 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal nyid yin la/ci 'du byed nyid sdug bsngal nyid yin pas 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid do/ /zhes dang / gang spel las/

///)tho /5 sha sa — 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal ba nyid ni 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal nyi—da de/ zhes—dang / 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ba nyid ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid de/zhes dang / blo brtan 'grel bar yang de ji bzhin gsungs pa 'og tudzha'adren par 'gyur ba sogs shis byed dri ma med pa mtha' yasabyupa yod pa'i —phyir/ des khyod rang gi zhib cha ngan pa'i dri ma de nyid shul yang mi mngon par btang ba ni bdag gis rgyal ba'i bstan pa la dus mthar bya ba mchog —cig byas par gdon mi za'o/ /gzhan yang / zag tshor sdug bsngal gyi rkyenaske —grogs rnams chos can/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal yin par thal/ zag tshor sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ba'i dngos kyi rkyen grogs gang rung yin —pa'i phyir/ de la khyab pa yad pa ni shing rta chen po'i dgongs pa yin te/ kun btus las/ sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ba'i chos kyi rang gi mtshan—nyid kyis kyang / sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal nyid duzubalta'o/ /zhes gsungs—pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du rgyal sras ma/ sa ṭīka bu ṭīka red ṭīka dar—ṭīka kun mthun par gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang / zag bcas kyi tshor ba bde ba'i dmigs rkyen gyi zag bcas rnams chos can/ 'gyur ba'i sdug4bsngal yin par thal/ zag tshor bde ba'i dmigs rkyen yin pa'i phyir/ khyab par thal/ de ltar khyab pa rje bla ma'i dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir te/ lam rim las/ gang la dmigs nas skye ba'i yul zag bcas rnams kyang—'gyur pa'i sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang de gnyisasna ga la tshor bas ma khyab par thal/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang gzugs phung girshagazhi mthun yod pa lam rim chem mo'i dgongs pa yin par kun mkhyen bla

37mas bzhed pa'i phyir/ der thal/ dbu ma chen po las/ zag bcas kyi bde ba de tshor ba kho na min pa/ de mtshungs kyi sems sems byung yul zag bcas thams cad de'i mtshan gzhir 'jog pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de rnams zag bcas kyi bde ba dang 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gyi gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir/ lam rim las/ zhes pa nas/ 'gyur pa'i sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na kun mkhyen bzhed pa ltar na 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal la tshor bas ma khyab par ma zad zag bcas kyi bde ba la'ang des ma khyab pa gsal bar gsungs pa 'ji yin pa'i phyir/gzhan yang / don rnam par gdon mi za ba'i 'grel bar yang / tshor ba sdug bsngal dang ldan pa'i phung po rnams la ni sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal gyis khyab po/ /tshor ba bde ba dang ldan pa'i phung po rnams la ni 'gyur badza sdug bsngal gyis khyab po/ /tshor ba bde ba yang ma yin mi bde ba yang sa yin pa'i phung po rnams la ni rgyu rkyen gyis bskyed cing mi rtag pa'i mtshan nyid 'du byed sdug bsngal gyis khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes tshor ba gsum dang bcas pa'i zag phung rnams sdug bsngal de dang der 'jog par gsungs pa sogs lung bgrang gis mi lang ba yod do/ /gzhan yang / zhus chen dang— bco sa bsgyur gyis a thang chad 'os kyang da dung mtho/ bo krog krog gis brel ba'i gsar bcos de dag mi 'thad par thal/ de ltar na/ —ri zag bcas kyi tshor bde dang zag tshor bde ba/ 'gyur bde dang 'gyur ba'i bde ba/zag tshor btang snyoms dang zag tshor btang snyoms pa/ sdug bsngal gyi yadag med dang sdug bsngal gyi bdag med pa/ sdug bsngal gyi rten 'byung

38 dang sdug bsngal mirten cing 'byung ba/ skye ba'i kun nyon dang de'i kun nas nyon mongs pa rnams la'ang de 'dra'i khyad par 'byed rig sa par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /sdug bsngal gsum dang de'i sdug bsngal ba gsum la khyad par yod par thal/ — sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal ba la khyad par yod pha'i phyir zer na/ gtan nas ma khyab ste/ de gnyis mtshungs pa'i go skabs rnam pa thams cad du med pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de gnyis yongs grags kyi tha snyad/ sgrub byed kyi rigs pa/ rgyab rten gyi shes byed gang gis kyang mtshungs pa'i gnas med pa'i phyir/ rtags zur dang po grub ste/ sdug bsngal la tshor ba dang sdug bsngal ba la zag bcas thams cad 'jog pa ma ki bsdus sbyor ba nas ya ki ston pa sangs rgyas kyi bar la rlung ‘ltar grags pa'i phyir dang / 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang de'i sdug bsngal ba la khyad ma phye bar bstan pa'i bdag po nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyis gdul bya nam mkha' dang mnyam pa la gsungs shing gdul bya de dang de'i ngor ji ltar gsungs pa ltar yongs su grags par khyod kyis kyang khas blangs pa de'i phyir/ rtags zur gnyis pa grub ste/ sdug bsngal yin pa'i sgrub byed la skyes tsam nas lus sems ci rigs rang stobs kyis gdung bar byed pa lta bu dang / sdug bsngal ba yin pa'i sgrub byed la sdug bsngal gsum po ci rigs dang rjes su 'brel ba lta bu 'god dgos pas phyi ma'i sgrub byed snga ma'i sgrub byed yang dag tu mi 'gyur la/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang / de'i sdug bsngal ba gnyis la/ las nyon gyi gzhan dbang can lta bu gang bkod gnyis ka'i sgrub byed du khyad med du 'jug pa'i phyir/ rtags zur gsum pa

la //////)/tsob ste/ sdug bsngal la tshor bas khyashaṃ pa'i shes byed dang / sdug bsngal ba la zag bcas thams cad 'jog pa'i shebe byed mtha' med pa'i phyir dang /'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang de'i sdug bsngal ba —khyad med du byas nas gsungs pa'i lung bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod par khyod kyis kyang dngos su — khas blangs shirdeblangs pa ltar don la'ang gnas pa'i phyir dnge / bam bshad rags 'grel tsam ma yin par zhib bshad mtha' dpyod kyi sgo nas gsungs pa 'khrul bral legs bshad kyi yang rtse dbu ma'i yig cha chen mor yang 4ོra ba yul dang bcas pa de gnyirsā la 'jog par don gyis bka' stsal pa'i phyir dang / 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang de'i sdug bsngal ba'i 'jog byed —phyogs mi 'dra bar khyod kyis gsar bzos kho na las gzhan rgya wad kyi gzhung gang du yang mi gsal ba'i phyir ro/ /yang / sdug bsngal ba yin na sdug bsngal yan dgos par thal/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ba yin na 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin dgos pa'i phyir zer na/ 'o na/ 'du —byed dang phung bo gnyis ka yin na 'du byed kyi phung po yin dgos par thal/di 'dus byas dang phung bo gnyis ka yin na 'dus byas kyi phung bo yin dgos pa'i phyir/ khyab pa 'grig de ltar mi mtshungs pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di ma go ba'i dbang gis tshes gcig nas 'phyugs na bco lnga'i bar zer ba'i dpe khyod la— 'gel ma dgos par thog tu babs pa yin pas sems rnal du zhog la somasang—shig de yang thog mar bcom ldan 'das kyis zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal ba/ zhes dang / 'du byed thams cad sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes tha snyad sbyar ba la/ rje thams cad mkhyen pas/ tha snyad bde ba'i phyir nyer

40bsdu'i ming ngo / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dus jis zag bcas dang 'du—byed ces pa'i tshig dag bsdus nas nyer bsdu'i ming sdug bsngal ba zhes ba'i rdzisgras brjod pa'i phyir/ lgodi tsam gyis de ni sdug bsngal gyi zlas drangs pa'i sdug bsngal ba tsam la go mi rung bar zag bcas kyi sdug bsngal dang 'du byed—kyi sdug bsngal gyi zlas drangs pa'i sdug bsngal ba la go dgos pa yin la/tha snyad grags che tshul gyis sger ming spyi la thogs pa ni/ dper na 'du byed ces pa 'dus byas kyi spyi ming yin yang 'du byed kyi phung po byas pa'i tshe spyi —ming bye brag la thogs stabs 'dus byas kyi phung po spyi la go mi rung pa mngon pa gong 'og sogs du mar gsungs pa bzhin spyi ming bye brag dang bye brag gi —ming spyi dang / tshogs pa'i ming ya gyal dang ya gyal gyi ming tshogs pa la—thogs pa'i tshul sde snod spyi skad la mtha' mi dpog pa'i phyir ro/ /gzugs gang phung po yin na gzugs kyi phung po dang / tshor ba gang phung po yin na tshor ba'i phung po dang / 'du shes gang phung po yin na 'du shes kyi phung pordzidang / rnam shes gang phung po yin na rnam shes kyi phung po yin pas khyab kyang / tshul de 'du byed kyi phung po la sbyar mi chog pa tha snyad grags pa dbang btsan pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin pa bzhin du sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang de'i sdugabasngal ba sogs don gcig kyang / sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal ba gnyis don mi gcig pa ni tha snyad grags pa dbang btsan pas sdug bsngal ba sdug bsngal gyi zla la ma thob pas yin no/ /des na sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal nyid kyi sdug bsngal ba/ tshor ba sdug bsngal dang tshor ba sdug bsngal ba/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang de'i sdug bstal badzha

41rnams don gcig pas mtshon shes dgos pa rgya cher brjod du yod kyang /bu ga med pa'i khro gong la/ /lcags kyu rno yang gzer ci thebs/ /zhes pa ltar skal ṅges phongs pa dag la de bas/ go ba med pa'i glang chen la/ /rgyal ba'i brkya/'a las dbyug pa btsan/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar gyi ngang tshul de kas phan snang ngo / /yang / gzhung chen mo rnams dang khyod kyis 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal sgom tshul bshad pa de dag sdug bsngal ba sgom tshul tsayoyin gyi 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal sgom tshul min no zeracan/ 'o na de sgom tshul snami 'dra ba'i khyad par phye ba gang du gda'/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal sgom tshul rgya cher gsungs pa gang dang gang yin/ de nyid sha chod rus chod kyis sgom tshul rma med pa de ji 'dra yin/ de ltar bsgoms pa sems kyi byin g.yo ba'i 'phrul 'degs su 'gro tshul dang / sdug bsngal gzhan gnyis sgom pa las gnad che tshul rnams sdug bsngal ba sgom pa las zur khyad thon nges lam rim lta bu'i sgom yig tshad ldan rnams su rtsal du bton nas yod mchi bas mol bar 'tshal lo/ /khyod la skul ba'i grogs po rnams/dze /re ba snying la ma rdzogs pas/ /bla gos grol ba'i thul 'og na/ /mig chu'i rgyun gyis rgya mtsho gso/ /re mthong byas pa kun gyi gedong / /cig car sa la sbrub pa 'dis/ /gzhi byes kun tu khyod nyid la/ /yi ga mi 'chus de su zhig /da ni khyod—kyis rtsod spong 'dra ba smos pa'i tshul de la brjod par bya ste/'di ltar/ kye rigs pa smra ba'i dbang po rnams dpang mdzod dang / 'dis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i nyi ma dgung la shar ba nas da lta dmar 'od nub pa la nye ba'i bar du legs par bshad pa gang ji snyed pa de dag ni 'du byed

42kyi sdug bsngal dngos btags ma phye ba'i bam ba skod dang / kho bos 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal la tshor btang gis khyab par bshad pa ni dngos btags kyi khyad phye ste zhib thon mtha' dpyod kyi lugs su brjod pagayin no/ /zhetswazer te/ byis pa mgu ba'i yan lag tu bcos ma'i me tog gi phreng ba tshar du bsgrigs pa ltar ma brtags rang nyams dga' ba'i rigs mthun 'ba' zhig la stong bshad dang sgrob bshad kho na lhu bsgrigs pa las tha snyad lung rigs gsum gyi gru gzings yang dag pa las drangs pa'i rinajipoche'i rigs bye ma'i mching bu tsam yang ma mchis pa ribargal lan bskal ber btags pa las 'di skad bsnyad de/ dngos btags ma phyed pa'i blo'i gzhan dbang du song ba'i gdul bya nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa de dag rjes su bzung ba'i phyir dngos btags ma phye bar sdug bsngal gsum gyi dmigs bdag mtshungs ldan rnams kyang sdug bsngal de dang der bstan/ zhes dang / dngos btags ma phye bar bam 'grel go thob kyi tshul du 'chad pa'i tshe yul la'ang sdug bsngal de'i sgra dngos ming du 'thob la/ dngos btags phye nas zhib 'grel mtha' gcod kyi tshul du 'chad pa'i tshe yul la sdug bsngal de'i sgra btags ming du thob par smra/ zhes byang chub lam rim chenarī mo las sdug bsngal gsum gyi rnam bzhag gsungs pa bam bshad dang / rnam bshad du 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ngos bzung pa'ang rtsing bshad dang / sde bdun rgyan rdzolas 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi don ldog bzhag pa lung 'dren pa tsam yang mi rung ba'i rags bshad du shor zhing / tha na ser 'bras kyi yig cha chen mo rnams su 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ngos bzung ba'ang zhib 'grel mtha' dpyod

/ — sna ()lugs kyi rang skad mthon pa'i rags bshad du song bas/ rgya gar chu rshabo gaṅgā tshun chad lta zhog phan chad du'ang bstan pa 'di la zhib bshad gsal bo rigs lam nas smra ba la kho bo gcig pu ma gtogs byung ma myong ngo zhes don gyis khas blangs pa'i sgra skad 'di ya nga ba med par bsgrags so/ /'de ltar smra dgos pa'i khag ci la babs na/ zag bcas thams cad 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal du gsungs pa'i lung rigs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo rtsol med du grol bar ni shes/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal la tshor btang gis khyab nges pa'i lung rigs skra'i rtse mo'i tshod tsam yang rnyed pa ni ma byung / rang las kyi bya ba la brtson bzhin bsdad pas chog pa la la rgya la re ba'i chags sdang shugs drag po'i gdon gyis ni brlams/ dam bca' la rgyab rten tshad ma dang bral pa'i dbang gis yang dag pa'i ngag tshig dri nga ba med pa smra rgyus ni phongs pas/ shing rta chen po srol 'dzin dang ba cas pa dang / rje yab sras dngos slob dang bcas pas rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mthil phyin par bkral ba'i legs bshad sgra don dgongs gsum gzhan du dkyog tu med pa mtha' dag bsam bsla/na log pa'i lam du drangs te/ ngan rtog rnams kyis bstan pa 'di dkrugs so/ /zhes pa ltar bstan pa rin po che la thub tshod gang nus shig bgyis te chos spong gi las kyis rang phung gzhan phung gi bya ba 'di bgyis so / /de ni rnam pa thams cad du mi rung ste/ ji skad du/ gang phyir rgyal las ches mkhas 'ga' yang 'jig rten 'di na yod min te/ /ma lus de nyid mchog ni tshul bzhin kun mkhyen gyis mkhyen gzhan min pa/ /de phyir drang srong rang nyid kyis bzhag mdo sde gangarsān de mi dkrug /thub tshul

44bshig phyir de yang dam chos la ni gnod pa byed par 'gyur/ /zhespogasungs pa'i phyir ro/ /da ni log rtog mkhan khyod la cung zad phan pa'i bsam pas smra bar bya yis/ gzur gnas blo ldan don gnyer ba'i / / zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi yon tan cha tsam e ldan ltos la nyon cig 'o na/— sangs rgyayobacom ldan 'das kyisakā'ami lta bu'i dngos btags phye nas e —gsungs/ ma gsungs/ ang hang / shing rta po gnyis kyis de ltar rmo.e gsungs/ ma gsungs/ ang / shing rta'i srol 'dzin rnams kyis e gsungs/ ma gsungs/ ang / bod kyi kun mkhyen gyis e gsungs/ma gsungs/ ang / gangs can gyi shing rta pa che na pos e gsungs/ ma gsungs/ ang / yab rje rgyal ba gnyis pas e gsungs/ ma gsungs/ ang / sras kyi thu bo nyi zla lta bu gnyis pos e gsungs/ ma gsungs/ ang /ser 'bras dge gsum gyi yig cha mdzad pa po gzhan gyis e gsungs/ ma gsungs/ ang / kun mkhyen bla mas e gsungs/ gsungs na/ phar phyin du gzugs med pa'i nyer len gyi phung po 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal du gsungs pa dang / dbu mar 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal la yul can tshor bas ma khyab pa brtson pa chen pos bsgrubs pa de dag e red/ ri ma gsungs na/lhas byin nas bzung ste zhal nas zhal dang snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa khyod kyis rgyal pa'i brka/'a dang bstan bcos kyi rigs sna tshogs par zhus chen gyis 'byin 'jug gang 'dod bgyid skabs/ 'di yang mngode pa dang lam rim chen mos gtsos legs par bshad pa thams cad la snon pa byos shig ces yid srubs kyi ston pa 'khor dang bcas pas khyod gcig pu snod rung gi

45gadzul byar gzigs nas man ngag sgo skyel gyi tshul du byon te gnang ba e yin/ skal bzang bkra shis/ mdza' bo ma skyes dgra sogs la grogs bcol te legs bshad thams cad la zur rgyan du e chug rems dang / khyod kyis sngon yang bstan pa dang ston pa la 'os min gyi zhabs 'degs bskal ba 'di la sus kyang zhus ma myong ba zhig phul ba de mtshungs da dung yang thub nges su 'dug go /'o na/ dkon mchog gsum snying thag pa nas skyabs gnas yang dag tu khas len pa'i 'dod pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'i blo la skyabs 'gro dngos btags gnyis 'a byed rigs par thal/ zag tshor sdug bsngal mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'i blo la sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dngos btags gnyis 'byed rigs pa'i phyir/ rtags stong bshad chu shing mar/ tshor ba dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems byung gzhan rnams la yul de dag myong ba'i phyir sdug bsngal de dang de yin pa'i dogs pa che na'ang skyon med de/ rang stobs kyis mi myong ba'i phyir zhes sde snod gsum gyi rigs lam spyi 'gre ltar thag gcod do/ /'di ni/ gsung rab gdams par 'char ba'i man ngag gi gnad dam pa yin pas gces par gyis shig ces byis pa so dkar gyi dus nas rgan po mgo dkar du 'gro bar rigs lam la sbyangs/lo ngo bdun la brgal lan rtsom pa'i thugs khur cher bzhes gnang ba'i snying bo'i bcud bdag la gnang ba 'dis grub pas so/ /khyab pa grub ste/skyabs 'gro la'ang rang stobs kyis skyabs gnas su khas len pas ma khyab pa'i phyir te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ 'di ni de dngos 'dod pas khari ri lerwa/ de yang snying brtse las rig bya/ /zhes dang / de'i 'grel bar/ sangs

74//༷ — — — rgyas nyid 'dod pas khas len pa ni skyabs su 'gro ba'i ngo bo nyid yin no/ /zhes dang / 'jig rten snang byed las/ de dag khas len pa las mi 'da'adheba'i shes rab kyi rangacobazhin skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /zhes 'dun pa dang shesarsharab dmigs kyis phye ba'i rgyu mtshan yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'go skyabasarsha'agro nas mjug bkra shis kyi bar la chos yin pa la ma yin par smra ba'i chos —spong kham gang che zhig gsog bzhin la rgya'i rna ba la rems dang 'di phyi gnyi —gar yag gda'o/ /yang / bla ma la dmigs pa'i dad gus bcos— ma ma yinarshapa'i blo gtso 'khor la bla ma'i rnal 'byor dngos btags gnyis phye na legs bshad du 'gro bar thal/ bla ma la mjal kha yang zhus mi chog pa dngos—grub tu thob pa khyod kyi 'dod tshul de 'thad pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ ngo bo'idzhabla ma'i rnal 'byor la dad gus gang rung dgos pa'i byir te/ dge ldan—pa'i bca' yig lam rim chen mo las/ khyad par du rtsa ba dad pa sbyangs pa dang / bka' drin jos su dran te gus par bya ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'idzhardo rje'i tshig gi nus pa yod pa'i phyir/ yang / 'khor bar zhen pa gting nas log pa'i blo rnal ma la nges 'byung btags pa pa yod par thal/ de la rang stobs kyis zhen log 'dod chags med pa'i dge rtsa ma yin pa du ma yod pa'i—phyir/ yang / rsāng thag pa nas thar pa don du gnyer ba'i blo bcos min la nges 'byung dngos ma yin pa yod par thal/ de la rang stobs kyis thar ba don du gnyer ba'i 'dun pa min pa du ma yod pa'i phyir/ yang / gsar du mi bslu ba'i rig pa dngos btags ma phye ba'i tshad ma'i mtshan nyid yin —par thal/ las nyon gyi gzhan dbang can de dngos btags ma phye ba'i 'du ga

47da byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ rtags don gyis khas/khyab pa yod de/ man ngag gces par gyis shig ces gdams pa de'i phyir dang / de rang yul la rang stobasacigyis midzābaslu ba shes rab kyi mthu yin pa'i phyir/ yang gsar du mi bslu ba'i zhen rig yin na rjes dpag yin pas ma khyab byas na log bshad du mi 'gro bar thal/ rjes dpag tu gyur pa'i shes neb las gzhan pa'i de dang mtshungs ldan rnams rang stobs kyis de ma yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa sde snod gsum gyi rigs lamadhethun mong ba yin pa'i phyir/rtags don gyis khas/ yang / zag bcas yin na/snye kun btus las/ zag pa'i bdag nyid dang / zhes pa'i dngos—bstan gyi de yin pas khyab par thal/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal yin na/ tshor ba rang gi mtshan nyid dang / zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi de yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ khyab pa mi satshungs pa sangs rgyas stong gis kyang 'byed mi nus na/ gal la thug dus mo ston phag mgo'i brda tshig tsam yang mi thon pa khyod kyis bskal ba stong du 'bad kyang rngo ga la thogs/ yang / mngon pa las/ ngo bo nyid kyis dge ba gang zhe na/ dad pa la sogs pa sems las byung ba'i chos bcu gcig go /'brel bas dge thā gang zhe na/ de dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i chos rnams so/ /zhes pa'i phyi ma'i skabs nas bstan pa'i dge ba yin na dge ba ma yin pas khyab par thal/ khyod kyi mun nag 'dom 'jal gyi rang lugs 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ theg chen sems bskyed chos can/der thal/ de'i phyir/ yang / kun btus las/ mi dge ba rnams ni du zhig ci'i phyir mi dge phar brtag— ce na/ ngo bo nyid dang / 'brel ba

48 dang / zhes sogs kyi skabs nas bstan pa dang mi dge ba mtshan nyid pa'i gzhi mthun yin na ngo bo nyid kyis mi dge ba yin pas khyab par thal/ sdug sun med pa'i bcos bsgyur de 'thad ba'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mi dge ba yin na nyon mongs yin pas khyab par thal lo/ /yang / dran pa nyeratrebazhagadzhal shes rab kyis khyab par thal/ dran pa nyer bzhag shes rab stechi/ /zhes dang / gzhan ni 'brel dang dmigs pa las/ /zhes pa'i don yod pa'i phyir byas na sde snod spyi skad dang mabyen par thal/ gsung rab gdams par shar ba'i man ngag de'i phyir/ yang dag spong ba yin na brtson 'grus yin pas khyab par thal/ ngo bo nyid gang zhe na/ brtson 'grus so/ /zhes pa'i man ngag la gces spras byed dgos pa'i phyir/ khyab pa don gyis khas so/ /byang 'phags kyi lam yin na dge ba chos sdud sogs kyi tshul khrims gsum po gang rung yin pas ma khyab par thal/ de re re la ngo bo nyid kyis de dang de yin min gnyis re yod0pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin la sems dang sems byung du ma bzhag pa dngos btags ma phye ba'i 'jog tshul yin par thal/ dngos btags phye na de la gtong ba'i sems pa chos bzhi ldan gyis khyab pa'i phyir te/ ngo bo nyid kyis de la des khyab pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ sgo mang yig char theg chen gyi lam yin na sher phyin yin pas khyab par bshad pa bam bshad dam log bshad gang rung yin par thal/ ngo bo'i sher phyin yin na stong nyid rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi mkhyen pa yin dgos pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khyod kyi man ngag gcig chog mas grub/ rtags ma grub na/ mtha' dpyod carkyang ba la kha nu

49mar sbyor sbyor byas te mi sdod par gzhung bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho g.yas 'khyil du bzhugs pa rnams la cung zad 'thungs dang shes par ma zad spyir yang rnam dpyod gzar bu'i zab khyad 'dra ba de nyid brgya lam na je yangs su—'gro mchi'o/ /yang / mngon par thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan gyi sde tshan bshad pa phal che ba la/ yang dag par 'byor ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab gang yin pa dang / de dag dang mtshungs par ldan pa'irshasems dang sems las byung ba'i chos rnams so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i thad—du'ang khyod kyi man ngag de sbyar nas mngon shes sogs yon tan de dang de la dngos btags ma phye ba dang phye ba gnyis gnyis 'byed dgos par thal/khyod kyi bzo bcos snying nor ma de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na gzhung lugs bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho dang 'gal/ ma grub na log bshad dug chu'i rdzing bu dang 'gal/ ma khyab na khyod 'dod gzhir byas la sde snod spyi 'gro dang 'gal lo/ /bstan pa'i gnam thig lam rim chen mo sogs la log bshad kham4gang che byas ba des mi tshim na/ da dung mgo nas bzung ste/ phun tshogs dge legs bye bas bskrun ba'i sku/ /zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi dge legs kyang dngos btags ma phye ba'i bam bshad kyi dbang du byas so/ /zhes pa nas/ /mjug tu/ bkra shis rgya mtshos phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /ces pa'i bkra shis la'ang de ltar yin no zhes mgrin pa sol la smos dang / khyod rang gi—sdig sred kyi skom gedung sel mchi/ mi tsher kha 'gog thabs kyi zol sbyorarsha'aba' zhig lhur blangs pa'i goms shugs kyis sgrob bshad du'ang de kho na rtsal du bton nas bsnyad 'dug mod log bshad gang smras legs bshad du

5) blogro ba'i ku yangs dmigs bsal zhig lo jithon mi'i —mdzad pa bskyangs mthar bdag rkyen du thob pa zhodra min na/ mkhasapa'i rnam 'gyur gyi chu migs tsam du'ang brtsi 'os su med pas/ mdo rgyud kyi rgyab rten dpung che zhing / /gdams rngag la nang byan chud pa dang / — /byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa'in — /mtshan ldan gyi rje btsun bsten pas 'tshengs/ /zhes rtswa ltar gyi khyad par gsum ldan gyi bshes gnyen dam pa zhig bsten na legs so/ /gzhan yang / nged cag gis sgrub byed—gang bkod la don mthun milan phyogs 'gro tsam yang smra rgyu med par g.yag sna khu tshur gyis 'big pa'i rnam 'gyur gsal bar byas te dkyog lan rgyab med kyi gcer rgyug 'di dag rung na/ kho bos kyang sdug bden la dngos btags ma phye tshe ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad dang / phye tshe zag tshor sdug bsngal kho na 'jogakun 'byung la'ang de ltar ma phye tshe las nyon gnyis ka dang phye tshe sred pa kho na 'jog pas mtshon rgya cher smras na khyed lhas byin gtso 'khorornams la bya rgyu ci 'dug yang / yig char/ kha cig rje btsun byams pa sangs 'phags yin zer/ la la rje btsun byams pa byang sems yin zer na/ zhes phyogs snga bsus te bkag pa mi 'thad de/ sangs 'phags su bshad pa rgyan rtsom pa po la dgongs/ byang sems su bshad pa mdo lugs gzhir byas kyi thun mong snang tshod kyi dbang du byas/ zhes dkyog bshad kyis lan 'debs par byed cing / de dag gis mtshon phyogs sngar gnod byed gang btang la gnod byed du 'gro nges gcig kyang mi srid do/ /zhes smos na/ khyod kyis ci smra/ rang 'dod rkyang ba dbang btsan par byas tshe dkyog lan byung rgyal re

— mi — — /5/( smra sa med pa'i gzhung mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /khyod kyi log bshad sbyin ma'i—bu/ /rim pa bdun pa'i 'og rum du/ /ldang ba med par mnan byas—pas/ /thub pa'i bstan ni dgra las rgyal/ /ngan rtog gor ma'i sa 'dzin dbang / /'di 'dra'i gnam lcags 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /rdul phran gzhon nu'i lang tsho la/ /bkod pa'i bka' drin rjes dran byos/da ni khyod kyis gnod sgrub byas pa la brjod par bya ste/ 'di ltar/kye 'dzam gling gi rigs pa smra ba'i tshogs mtha' dag gdan 'dzom par —dpang du bzhugs su gsol/ da lta nyid du rdo bis lhas byin dang / gis—steng 'char ka gnyis kyi su'i mgo bo rtsa ba nas 'chad gzigs shig dang ston par bya'o/ /lhas byin lags/ khyod kyis lung thams cad kyi rno shos rab dang phul dang gtso bo nyid du bzung nas dang por dpung gi ru 'dren gyi —dpa' po ya med bzhin du bdag la rbad pa ni mdzod 'grel gyi lung 'di yin—no༈/ /ji ltar rbad na sgrob bshad 'ja' ris rma ra/ zag bcas kyi tshor ba btang snyoms dang mtshungs ldanatshogyi sems sems byung gzhan rnams dang de'i—dmigs rkyen bdag rkyen rnams khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal btags pa pa yin te/ mdzod rang 'grel las/ de'i dbang gis bde ba myong bar 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i 'du byed rnams kyang yid du 'ong ba la sogs pa'i ming 'thob po/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ ming 'thob ceyo pa'i tshig gi nus pa gces par bzung nas zhib tu 'don dgos pa'i phyir zhes bris nas so/ /ho ho ho/ ho ho ho/ ho ho ho/ gti rgan/ khyod kyi go rigs gnyis la ltos dang / lo ngo bdun gyi ring brgal lan rtsom khur—

52 gyis thugs gzhig medzod pa'i zhib che ang / smyugs bro ba/ lung de'i don khyod kyi log 'grel ltar ma yin par thal ming 'thob ces pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi ming 'thob ces pa ma yin pa gang zhig ming 'thob ces pas btags pa par gton nas mi 'grub pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ 'di'i bshad bya'i lung bkod de lung don bkral na don de bde blag tu rtogs pa'i 4 phyir/ der thal/ rang 'grel las/ sdug bsngal nyid ni gsum ste/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal nyid dang / 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid dang / 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal nyid do/ /de dag gis ci rigs par 'du byed zag pa dang bcas pa thams cad ma lus par sdug bsngal ba yin te/ de la yid du 'ong ba rnams ni 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gyis sdug bsngal ba nyid do/ /ryād du mi 'ong ba rnams ni sdug bsngal gyis sdug bstal ba nyid do/ /de dag las gzhan pa rnams ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis sdug bsnga la ba nyid do/ /yid du 'ong ba ni gang dag yin/ yid du mi 'ong ba ni gang dag yin/ gnyi ga ma yin pa ni gang dag yin zhe na/ tshor ba gsum dang go rim bzhin te/ de'i dbang gis bde ba myong bar 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i 'du byed rnams kyang yid du 'ong ba la sogs pa'i ming 'thob po/ /zhes gsungs la/ de'i don ni/ sdug bsngal nyid ni/ nas/ nyid do'i bar gyis sdug bsngal gsum bstan/ de dag nas/ yin te'i bar gyis zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal bar 'jog pa'i dam bca' bsten/ de la / nas/ nyid do'i bar gyis zag bcas yid 'ong rnams 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal yin pa'i sgo nas sdug bsngal bar 'jog de yid mi 'ong rnams sdug
