106srid pa de 'khor ba yin pa rten 'brel chen mo dang / khyod kyi stong bshad gnyis kar bshad pa gang zhig de de gnyis po'i gang rung ma yin pa'i phyir/phyi ma der thal/ blang bya phung po'i 'khor ba la blang bya len byed gnyis su phye ba'i blang bya dgos par khyod rang gis nan gyis bsgrubs te rang gi yig cha la ngo rgol byas pa de'i phyir/ khyod ltar na bstan pa 'di la ston pa gnyis pa klu sgrub dang 'jam mgon tsong kha pa yang rigs pa la mi mkhas par thal/ 'khar ba rang ngos nas grub pa dgag pa la rtags zur sa/nyis byas pa'i phyi ma don med pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de'i zur phyi ma'i sems can yin na 'khor ba ma yin pas khyab pa'i phyir te/ de yin na sdug bden ma yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ rtags khyab khas/ des na khyod kyis 'phags mchog klu sgrub dang 'jam mgon bla ma gnyis rigs pa smra ba'i gral gong nas phyung ste rkob rgan gyi tshogs su dos shig sdig rgan/ blo gros byi ba'i rtug ril las/ /bongs tshod zhan pa'i gom stabs kyis/ /zab don nor gyi blo gros ma / /gzhal ba'i glen pa 'di su zhig /de bas tshig 'khri'i bzlas brjod kyis/ /mchu sgros padmo'i sbubs brtol nas/ /no tso smra ba'i sde dpon gyi/ /rgyal srid 'dzin pa khyod la 'os/ /gzhan yang / khyod kyis 'bo/ ra ba la rgyud bsdus kyis khyab pa'i dam bca' byas pa de mi 'thad par thal/ dam bca' de la shes byed rnam dag gcig kyang med pa'i phyir/cider thal/ khyod kyis de'i shes byed du ṭīka chen/ tshig gsal/ sher sgron/ sa'i rtsa lag gi 'grel ba tshan pa gnyis rnams drangs pas khyod ltar 'khor ba la khyab mtha' bcad nas de dang der ston pa ma yin pa'i phyir/

—— 107gzhan du na/ 'gro ba nas 'gro bar 'gro ba'i rgyun yin na 'khor ba yin pas khyab par thal ba dang / 'gro ba nas 'gro bar skye 'chi brgyud ga yin na 'khor ba yin pas khyab par thal ba dang / tsho rga shi'i rgyun yin na 'khor ba yin pas khyab par thal ba dang / 'gro ba ris mthun du 'byung zhing skye ba yin na 'khor ba yin pas khyab par thal ba dang / zag phung lnga po gang rung bar ma chad par byung ba'i skye ba yin na 'khor ba yin pas khyab par thal ba rnams 'byung zhing / de dag re re nas khyod kyis khas blang du mi rung ste/ khyod ltar na 'phangs 'bras rnam smin gyi cha ma yin pa'i rgyud bsdus kyi zag phung rnams 'khor ba ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rma ṭīka gi lung don yang khyod ltar ma yin te/ nang gi skye rga shi gsum 'khor ba'i khyab byed yin na/ 'khor ba yin na rga ba yin pas khyab par thal ba dang / de yin na shi ba yin pas kyang khyab par thal ba'i phyir/ sher sgron gyi lung don yang /don dam par nang gi 'du byed rnams 'khor bar ma grub pa'i mthun dpe la/ don dam par 'khor bar ma grub pa'i phyi rol gyi bum pa sogs bkod pa tsam yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan du na/ myu gu chos can/ bden par med de/ rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir/ dper na me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ zhes bkod tshe yang sa/zugs brnyan brdzun pa phra mo mthun dper ma bkod par thal lo/ /tshig gsal dang 'thad rgyan las/ bum pa dang mgal me'i 'khor lo la thog mtha' gnyis ka dang / 'bru sogs la tha ma yod pa lta bu'i thog mtha' 'khor ba la med par bstan pa las/ go med khyod ltar de dag la 'khor ba yin min gyi khyad gye ba ma yin pa a mchod kyis

108 spyang shes nus so/ /yang / 'khor ba dang phyi'i chos 'gal bar thal/dbu ma snying bo las/ 'gro drug skyed tshal dus ston ltar/ /zhes sogs dang / nes bris pa 'di 2dra sha stag gis gong 'og gang 'dug bas lung rigs phal mo che nyin mo'i mar me bzhin mog mog po zhig las mi gda' zhing / de bzhin du rten 'brel snying po rtsa 'grel sogs rigs pa'i gad rgyangs su drangs zin sha stag tshur drangs pa ni khyod kyis gang la bsams nas dang / nged kyis gang la bsams nas drangs pa gnyis las gang gi shes byed du che gzur gnas dag gis rtogs sla bar yod do/ /dkon brtsegs las 'tshe ba bcu rgyud bsdus kyi steng nas bshad pa'i phyir 'khor ba la rgyud bsdus kyis khyab dgos na/ sdug bsngal ba la'ang rgyud bsdus kyis khyab pa khyod rang gis rigs pa smra ba thams cad dpung du sbran nas 'bad kyang bzlog tu med pa'i phyir dang / de'i nang tshan gyi sdug bsngal ba dang spyir sdug bsngal ba la khyad 'byed na tshul de 'khor ba la'ang mi mtshungs pa'i rgyu mtshan bskal ba'i bar du yang mi rnyed pa'i phyir ro/ /'khor ba logs su bgrangs pas khyod la phan na skye ba logs su bgrangs pas kyang khyod la phan par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / khyod kyi 'di la grangs dgu las ma byung yang dang po dgu dang tha ma zhes smros pa ni ngo tsha mi shes pa'i gtam mo/ /myang 'das las/ bag ma mchis pas 'khor bar yongs su 'khor ro/ /zhes gsungs pas kyang nged la mi gnod par ma zad de gang zag tu gyur pa'i 'khor ba yod pa'i shes byed du che bas khyod la gnod pa'i phyir dang / lha dbang blos/ 'khor bar 'khor bas na 'khor ba ste/ zhes pas gti rgan

109khyod 'dra 'khor ba yin par shin tu 'grub pas khyod la gnod pa'i phyir dang / burta shrī dang jo bo sogs kyis kun nyon gsum 'khor lo ltar 'khor bar bshad pas de dag 'khor ba yin par 'grub pa tsam las 'khor ba la de dag gis khyab par bstan pa sus kyang sgrub mi nus pa'i phyir dang /gzhan du na gzugs mi rtag par bshad pas mi rtag pa yin na gzugs yin pas khyab pa'ang sgrub nus par thal ba' phyir dang / thub dgongs kyi don/'khor ba la thog ma med de/ sems can gyi skye ba'i ya mtha' med pa'i phyir/ des pa yin pas des 'khor ba la rgyud bsdus kyis khyab pa 'grub na/ sdug bden la sngon mtha' med de/ sems can gyi skye ba'i ya mtha' med pa'i phyir/ /zhes pas kyang sdug bden la rgyud bsdus kyis khyab pa 'grub par thal ba'i phyer dang / rnam 'grel ṭī7/ chen gyi lung don mtshan nyid lta bu'i go don yin na/ las nyon gang rung yin na 'khor ba ma yin pas khyab par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang / gshen bu rnam rtog za ba khyod kyis/ myang 'das thob gzhi'i phung po dang / 'khor ba bsal bya'i phung po gnyis don gcig ces dang / gang 'khor ba'i phung po de ga rang thar dgos/ zhes bris pa ni bon chos ban chos la bsres pa'i than skad ya med pa ste/ myang 'das thob gzhi'i phung po dang bsal bya 'khor ba'i phung po gnyis zag bcas zag med kyi sgo nas 'gal ba'i phyir dang / 'khor ba rang nyid 'khor ba las thar pa'i phyir du thar lam sgom dgos pa ban chos la mi srid pa'i phyir dang / 'khor zhing 'khor ba zhes dang / 'ongs shing 'ongs pa nes pas/ 'khor ba la rgyud bsdus 'grub na/ 'khor na

110 'khor ba dang / 'ongs na 'khor ba yin pas khyab pa 'grub par thal ba'i phyir dang / chu'i rgya mtsho dang 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho la mi 'dra ba'e khyad par gsum gsungs pas de gnyis 'gal dgos na snying rje chen po dang thugs rje po la khyad par brgyad bshad pas de gnyis kyang 'gal bar thal ba lta bu dpag tu med pa'i phyir/ kye ma kye hud/ khyod 'dra ba dge bshes yin na ༈ bla rdol smra ba'i khyu na dge bshes min pa su/ u hu hu/ snyigs ma snyigs ma/ nges par zhe skyo 'o/ /yang / phyi'i 'byung ba 'byung ba ma yinamipar thal/ phyi nang gi 'byung ba la dbang pos zin ma zin gyi khyad par byu thogs med kyis bshad pa'i phyir/ nang gi 'khor ba 'khor ba ma yin par—thal/ phyi nang gi 'khor ba la khyad par lnga thogs med kyis bshad pa'i phyir/ khyab pa 'grig da ci smra shes/ mi shes na bi ṭi to smos shig bsdu bar/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho de cha gsum du 'dug ste/ 'dod pa'i 'dod—chas/sa dang ma bral ba'i chags par 'gyur ba'i yul lnga'i bye brag dang /'dod chags dang bral ba'i yid kyis shes par bya ba chags par 'gyur ba'i chos kyi bye brag dang / slob pa'i nang gi skye mched drug gi bye brag go /de— la 'dod chags dang ma bral ba'i so so'i skye bo ni yul rnam pa lnga'i rgya mtsho las rgal bar mi nus so/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di las kyang 'da' bar nus pa'i dad shes dang ldan pa su zhig yod/ yang / srid pa de yang phung po lnga/ /zhes pas srid pa la rgyud bsdus 'grub na/ sdug bsngal gyi phung po 'ba' zhig pa 'di/ zhes pas kyang sdug bden la rgyud bsdus kyis khyab pa 'grub par thal ba dang / 'khor ba'i rtsa ba 'du byed de/ /zhes pas 3

1lha1de la rgyud bsdus kyis khyab pa 'grub na/ sems nyid kyis ni sems can 'jig rten dang / /snod kyi 'jig rten shin tu sna tshogs 'god/ /ces pas kyang snod bcud kyi 'jig rten la rgyud bsdus kyis khyab pa 'grub par thal ba dang / gang zhig nye bar blang ba de/ /zhes dang / de ltar nyer blang nyer len po/ /zhes pa sogs kyis dam bca' de 'grub na/ bdag nyid yod pa ma yin na/ /bdag gi yod pa ga la 'gyur/ /zhes pa rtsa 'grel gyis kyang bdag dang bdag bi/ ba gang rung la rgyud bsdus kyis khyab pa 'grub par thal bar 'gyur la/ dpung bzang gis zhus pa las/ 'dod chags la sogs nyon mongs tshogs ldan pa'i/ /sems ni 'khor ba yin par kun tu brjod/ /ces pa 'di 'dra drangs nas 'khor ba la rgyud bsdus kyis khyab par sgrub pa ni/ sgra ni byas yin 'di 'dra kun/ /zhes pas 'dus byas la sgras khyab pa sgrub pa dang tshul mtshungs pa gnag rdzis kyang shes so/ /yang / gangs can gyi palci ta chen po byams pa gling ba bsod nams rnam rgyal gyis/ sems kyi rgyud la chags sogs nyon mongs pa rnams dang ldan pa de tsam ni 'khor ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ shin tu gsal bas bshad mi dgos/ zhes bris pa ni/ nged tshos ma mthong ba'i lung gsar ba lags te/ khyed tshos shes par gyur ba'i shes sgrib 'dod pa'ang sngon nas byams gling ba dang nang nye bo 'dug cing / lhag par khyod spyis rje bla ma'i gsung rab rdo rje'i tshig phal cher la don gyi phyogs na'ang mi gnas pa'i dkyog bshad rna bas mi bzod pa re byed lugs 'di kas byams gling ba dang khyed thugs nang shin tu gshin por yod pa dpog nus pasacho/

112ji skad du/ blun po mdzangs pa'i blo med pas/ rang gi gtam ngan ngo sor byed/ /tsū ta'i yul gyi rgyal phran 'ga'/ /pha bsad pa la rgyal rnga rdung / /zhes gsungs pa der gda'o/ /rigs pa'i sgrub byed til 'bru'i cha shas tsam yang smra rgyu ye ma byung 'dug pas lan gyi mkho gal ci yang mi dgos so// /lhas byin 'khrug pa'i 'khrul 'khor las/ /skyogs kyi rdo ba gang byung ba/ /rigs pa gsang ba'i bdag po'i mtshon/ /'phangs pas phye mar brlags la ltos/ /de des rbad pa'i glang bo yang / /'dzin mar bskyel ba'i rnam 'gyur 'dis/ /lhas byin dpung bcas g.yang sa la / /'phur lding gar gyis ca/ngon sum gshegs/ / da ni khyod kyi sbrang dbyug dgu bskor gyis rang mgo rmas pa'i tshul brjod par bya ste/ 'di ltar/ 'khor ba la ming gzugs ci rigs kyi rten 'brel gyis khyab par thal/ nyer phung la des khyab pa'i phyir/ rtags khyab khas/ 'dod na/ skye ba gcig la mtshams med kyi las lnga bsags nas gang lci ba'e las de'i 'phangs 'bras kyi skye srid phyi mar smin pa'i gzhan bzhi'i rdzogs 'bras su gyur pa'i rnam smin gyi phung po chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ 'phen byed las kyi 'phangs 'bras ma yin —pa'i phyir/ yang lam rim las/ rdzogs byed la nges pa med de/ bde 'gror yang yan lag dang nying lag dang dbang po ma tshang ba dang / mdog mi sdug pa dang tshe thung ba dang nad mang ba dang dbul ba sogs ni mi dge bas byas la/ zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi mi gzhar ba dang mdog mi sdug pa sogs chos can/ 'phen byed las kyi 'phangs 'bras yin par thal/

113'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ der thal/ nyer len gyi phung po—yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de de yin par thal/ rga ba'i rten 'brel du gyur pa'i lang tsho nyams pa sogs nyer len gyi phung po yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar yin pa de'i mtshan nyid kyis grub pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ bde—'gro'i lus la 'phen byed mi dge ba'i 'phangs 'bras yod par thal lo/ /yang / dud 'gro'i lus kyi mdzes sdug gi mdog chos can/ 'phangs 'bras yin par thal/ 'alor ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ dgerteba'i 'phangs 'bras ma yin pa gang zhig mi dge ba'i 'phangs 'bras ma yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sla/ dang po grub ste/ ngan 'gro'i lus rten yin pa'i phyir/ yang / dmyal ba pa'i rgyud la rdzogs byed las kyi rnam smin du thub pa'i tshor bde chos can/ 'phangs 'bras yin bar thal/ 'khor ba—yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ der thal/ nyer phung yin pa'i phyir/de chos can/ der thal/ zag bcas rnam smin gyi phung po yin pa'i phyir/khyab ste/ sgrob bshad las/ gsum pas zag bcas rnam smin gyi phung po la nyer len gyi phung pos khyab par sa/sungs pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes bris pa'i phyir/ yang / thog ma'i ma rig pa chos can// ming gzugs ci rigs kyi rten 'brel yin par thal/ 'khor pa yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ der thal/ nyer phung yin pa'i byir te/ nang gi zag bcas yin pa'i phyir/khyab ste/ stong bshad du/ bzhi pas nang gi zag bcas nyer len gyi phungahopos bsdus tshul bshad/ ces smras pa'i phyir/ dngos 'gal brgya/'khor gsum khri/ yang / bcu pa srid pa chos can/ 'phangs 'bras

1cho14 rkyen par thal/ 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rigs pa dang /ma grub na/ rang gi yig cha dang / ma khyab na/ stong bshad dang 'gal/yang / thog ma'i ma rig pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems chos can/ bcu gcig pa skye ba yin par thal/ 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir te/ nyon mongs can gyi sems yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ dpung bzang gi lung don 'thad pa'i phyir/ yang / nyon mongs can gyi sems chos can/ skye ba bzang ngan sna tshogs len pa po dag gis nyon mongs pa'i mthu la brten nas rang gi shes rgyud du nye bar blang bar bya ba'i ming gzugs ci rigs kyi phung po yin par thal/ 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ rtags grub ste/byams pa gling ba'i lung don de'i phyir/ yang / lhas byin khyod kyi sdug phung chos can// sems rgyud la nyon mongs dang ldan pa de tsam yin par thal/ 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ 9khyab ste/ byams pa gling ba'i tsam sgra de ne tso'i 'don pa lta bu min tshul de'i phyir/ yang / lhag bcas dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi 'phangs 'bras rnams chos can/ sems kyi rgyud la chags sogs nyon mongs rnams dang ldan pa de tsam yin par thal/ 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ slob pa'i theg pas chags la sogs/ /zhes sogs kyi brjod don khyad du bsad/ ma grub na/ a pha'i kha phor rnying ba rdog pas bcag ma khyab na/ byams pa gling ba'i lung tshig sug pas phyis/yang / bcu pa srid pa chos can/ bzhi pa ming gzugs ci rigs kyi rten 'brel yin par thal/ nyer phung dang 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir te/ stong bshad du/ nyer len gyi phung po dang 'khor ba la rgyud kyis bsdus pa dgos

— 115 dzote/ rtsa shes las/ srid pa de yang phung po lnga/ /zhes dang / zhes bsgrubs pa gang zhig gzhung de bcu pa srid pa 'chad pa'i gzhung yin pa'i phyir/ yang / gnyis pa 'du byed kyi las chos can/ 'phangs 'brasarshayin par thal/ 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir te/ skye 'chi'i rgyud mo yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ stong bshad las/ 'khor ba la phyi'i chos med par thal/ de lam gsum gyi sgo nas skye 'chi brgyud mar byas pa'am byed par 'gyur ba la byed pa'i phyir/ zhes bris 'dug pa de'i phyir/ ma khyab mtshams kyi rtagasarshargyub ste / de rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis po gang rung yin pa'i phyir/yang / longs sprul gnyig chos can/ 'khor ba yin par thal/ skye 'chi'i—rgyud mo yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ rtags grub ste/ de gnyis skye 'chirshabargyud pa'i rgyun yin par khyod kyis dpung bskyen nas bsgrubs pa'i phyir/ston pa gcigacibatang bas da gshen ston gcig pu la 'jus shig yang /dngos 'gal brgya phrag 'di bzhin 'khur ba bo choyocan/ 'kher ba yin par thal/ lam gsum gyi sgo nas skye 'chi brgyud mar byas byas pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ ma grub na skyabs su mchi/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ sdug bden yin par thal/ 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ sems can yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'gal 'du'i bang mdzod las/ sems can de dag las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis lam gsum du yang yang skye ba'am 'khor ba sdug bden du bstan gyi sems can kho rang sdug bden du ga la ston/ zhes pa de'i phyir/ da rdo rje rig rig ngan pa de'i lus gshen rabs rgad po zhig gis bskyed par grags kyi/ dge bshes—

116 shes rab kho rang des bskyed pa yin par su la grags/ zhes pa'i zhib cha zhig kyang nyar tshags mdzod dang nam zhig mkho srid do/ /yang / lhas byin gyi ming gzugs ci rigs kyi rten 'brel chos can/ 'khor ba yin par thal/lam gsum brgyud mar 'khor ba'i rgyun yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ lhas byin gyi skye shi spyi tsam po yin par thal/ lhas byin gyi 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ khyab bar thal/ wa rnga mar/ lhas byin lta bu'i skye shi spyi tsam ni de'i 'khor ba yin/ zhes pa sgra ji bzhin par bzung ste/des 'khor ba la nyer len gyi phung po'i skye 'chi brgyud mar 'khor ba'i chas khyab par bsgrubs pa'i phyir/ yang / bar do pa'i nyer phung chos can/mang gzugs ci rigs kyi rten 'brel yin par thal/ 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ bcu gcig pa skye ba'i rten 'brel yin par thal/ ming gzugs ci rigs kyi rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa rten 'brel chen mos grub/ 'dod mi nus te/ rten 'brel chen mo las// bar do'i nyer len gyi phuja po lnga chos can/ bcu gcig pa skye ba'i rten 'brel yin par thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ der thal/ rang rgyu sred len srid pa gsum gyi grub 'bras yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ da sprang bo sdar ma'i ngang tshul gyis snga phyi g.yas g.yon gang la'ang ma bltas bar kha sna la ci thogs kyi lung rigs kyi dbyug pa dgu bskor byas pas 'gal ba khri phrag gi khres po dgu brtsegs su steng du babs pa mi 'dod na yang khur cig blo dang brtson 'grus yod gyur pa/ /de yi sa bsgrub pa mi nus gang / /dgra ngan dpung tshogs bcu gnyis po/ /

117skya bseng bu yis bcom zhes thos/ /zhes pa'i blo gros kyang nged rang gi blo gros 'di lta bu la zer ba shes par gyis la/ sa chung dgon chung gi ri khrid—pa tshor yang slad char bag zon gang nus gyis shig bdag gi pha bla ma sangs rgyas gnyis pa thugs bskyed gzhan 'gran med pa de nyid kyis dus mthar —lung rigs smra ba'i chos grwa btsugs pa'i phyag rjes kyang dmar rjen du mjal —ba 'di kas mi phyed pa'i dad pa sgoms la/ phyin chad/ lam khrid de dang zin bris de dag la yang skyabs su mchi/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ/ zer ba lta bu'i nyes spyod nam mkhar mi shong ba gsog pa'i 'phro chod nges dang / gang ladzhaganod pa byas kyang bde 'brel ba/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la skyabs su mchi/ /zhes pa'i sgo nas skyabs su song dang / kho bo cag nas kyang rjes 'dzin gyi zhu 'bul la ram 'degs bgyid do/ /kho bo la yang / blo—dang ldan pa tshig gcig gis/ /tshig brgya dag ni shes par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dngos po gang dang gang la yang / /goms na dka' ba ci yang med/ /bzo yi rig byed sbyangs pa ltar/ /dam chos dka' ba med par 'grub/ /gsungs pa'i don dmigs pa yid la byas nas chags sdang gi me dpung ha cang mi mched pa re gnad du snang ste/ gzhan du na rang dang rang nye mtha' dag bstan pa la log par zhugs pa sngar bas stobs bskyed de ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'iri dus byed par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro / /sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i me tog ni/ /mdo khams 'dzin ma'i tshal du 'dzum/ /dpal ldan bkra shis chos sdings zhes/ /nā lend+ra yi zla bor snyems/ /lung rigs dpung ba rab gtum pas/ /nyi ma'i bu yang

118'dar ba 'dzine/ /gzhon nu'i rol rtsed phra mos— kyarnga / —— /smra ba'i seng ge mtha' dag gnon/ /de phyir khyod 'drwa'i rgol ba stong / /bsnyel yang bdag ni nga mi rgyal/ /phyogs kyi glang bo'i 'bel gtam las/ /rnam ‘rgyal ba dan 'dzin la re//da ni khyod kyi bshad tshul ser 'bras dge gsum gyi yig cha tshan mo kun dang mi mthun tshul brjod par bya ste/ 'di ltar/ khyod kyi lugs ngan de paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa'i yig cha dang mi mthun par thal/ de'i lugs la 'khor ba la ming gzugs ci rigs kyi rten 'brel mi dgos pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de'i lugs la sdug bden yin na 'khor ba yin pasacikhyab pa'i phyir te/ de nyid kyi phar phyin mtha' dpyod las/ las nyon gyis skyes pa'i skyes bu yan na'ang sdug bsngal bden pa yin pas khyab ste/zhes pa nas/ kho na re/ srid pa tha ma ba'i nyan thos sgom lam pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ 'khor ba yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'khor ba pa yin lar thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig skyes bu yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ ces 'khor ba yin par thal/ sdug bden yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'phangs pa la khyab pa yod pa sor bzhag pa dang / phar tshad gnyis kar/ rang rgyu kun 'byung bden pa las/ byung ba'i 'khor bas bsdus pa de/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i mtshan nyid/ ces dang / de'i rgyud la sdug bden med pa'i phyir/ der thal/ des de zad par spangs pa'i phyir te/ des 'khor ba zad par spangs ba'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / lhag par

— — — — )( )/ (snade nyid kyi rnam 'grel las/ sdug bsngal 'khor ba can phung po/ /zhes sogs kyis sdug bsngal bden pa'i mtshan gzhi dang mtshan nyid 'chad/ ce sa gsungs shing / de gzhung de nyid sdug bden gyi mtshan nyid 'chad pa'i gzhung du gsungs pa'i tshad mar gyur pa'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bu dang —mthun pa'i phyir dang / de nas bstan pa'i mtshan nyid kyang / rnam 'grel—de nyid nas bzhag pa'am/ yang na/ las nyon gyi dbang gis 'khor bar 'khor ba can gyi phung po de sdug bsngal bden pa'i mtshan nyid du 'jog rshadagos pa ni/ lung rigs gang byung la mig btsums nas bsnyon pa ma gtogs cha tsam yang bzur du med pa 'grel ba 'grel bshad dang bcas pas 'grub pa'i phyir dang / gung thang bden bzhir yang / mkhas pa kha cig nas/ sdug bsngal 'khor ba can phung po/ /zhes pa'i don du—bsams nas sdug bden la 'khor bas khyab par yang 'dod do/ /zhes pa'ang sngon —gyi rnam 'grel ba spyi dang lhag don paṇa che na bsod nams grags dzhapa la gsungs pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /kun gzigs phyag na padmo lnga pa chen po'i legs bshad dang / paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa rnam dpyodarshamachog gi sde'i yig cha/ dpal ldan blo gsal gling gi rtsod gzhung / 7gongaskes rgyal ba'i dbang po rim byon gyi 'dzin chos/ tshadarimar gyur pa'i legs bshad 'di bzhin du kho bos khas blangs pa la 'phya smod kyi sgra 'brug ltar dzhasgrog pa ni rang mtshang 'dzam gling la dmar rjen du ston pa yin pas bag —yod par byos shig khyod kyi rang bzo de nyid rjebyubatsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i bzhed pa dang mi mthun te/ de'i lugs la kun nyon—

120 phyogs kyi rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis po gang rung yin na 'khor ba yin pas khyab pa'i phyir te/ de nyid kyi rten 'brel mtha' dpyod las/ rang gi rgyur gyur pa'i rkyen gsum las byung ba gang zhig sdug kun gang rung du gyur ba'i 'khor ba/ kun nas nyon mongs phyogs gyi rten 'brel gyi mtshan hid/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang khyod ltar na 'khor ba la bcu gcig shaṃ skye ba'i rten 'brel gyis khyab pa dang / de nyid kyi rten 'brel las/ spyir srid pa dang 'khor ba don gcig srid pa de la dbye na/ bar srid/ skye srid/ sngon dus gyi srid pa/ 'chi srid bzhi/ zhes srid pa'am 'khor shaṃ la srid pa bzhi bzhag pa gnyis ches 'gal ba'i phyir/ yang khyod kyi lugs ngan phug rdugs de nyid kun mkhyen yab sras kyi legs bshad dang yang mi mthun te/ mdzod mtha' dpyod las/ sdug bden yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ zag bcas kyi phung bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ / zhes dang / zag bcas kyi phung bo chos can/ srid pa zhes bya ste / sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i phyir/zhes gsungs pa dang rgyab 'gal yin pa'i phyir dang / dbu ma'i mtha' dpyod draraṭa zin pa ltar sdug bden phra mo la nyer phung gis khyab par gsungs pa de nyid spyir sdug bden la'ang 'dra bas/ sdug bden la nyer shung gis khyab dgos shing / nyer phung la 'khor bas khyab pa khyod kyis kyang 'dod pas/ khyod kyis 'khor ba la 'phangs 'bras kho na bzhag pa dbu ma'i mtha' dpyod dang yang 'gal ba'i phyir dang / phar phyin mtha' dpyod dang yang 'gal te/ de nyid las/ nang gi sdug bden dang 'khor ba

121don gcig pa'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel las/ sdug bsngal 'khor ba can phung po/ /zhes gsungs/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gal te de ni sdug dzebaden la blang bya len byed gnyis su phye ba'i dang po la dgongs zer na/ de ni chos grwar nyi ma 'phud thabs dang mi kha 'gog pa tsam la me tshe ril po bsgril te/ gzhung chen mang po lta ci mtha' dpyod kyi sgra don dgongs gsum la brtag gzhig rags pa'ang med cing / tha na mtha' dpyod kyi khyab skor gcig po de mgo mjug tshang bar sgrig pa'i nus pa'ang ma byung bar lung don byung rgyal du bzhag pa ste/ gzhan du na/ yig cha'i/ phung po bden 'dzin chos can/ nas/ lhag med pa'i rgyud la khyod med par thal/ khyod nang gi sdug bden yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ nang gi sdug bden dang 'khor ba don gcig pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i khyod nang gi sdug bden yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa de yang / blang bya len byed gnyis su phye ba'i blang bya'i sdug bden yen pa'i phyir/ zhes par 'dod dgos la/ de lta na phung po bden 'dzin de blang bya len byed gnyis su phye ba'i blang bya yin par phyogs sngas khas blangs sam/ snarang lugs la de ltar yin nam/ thang stong la thal stong 'phangs pa yin zer/ dang po ltar na tshul ji ltar khas blangs/ gnyis pa ltar na gzhan la skyon gang bstan rang steng du 'bab/gsum pa ltar na khyod kyis kun mkhyen kun mkhyen gyi sar nges par bzhag 'dug ang / khyod kyis lung don 'jog tsul de yig cha'i dgongs par gnas na/ sras kyi thu bo'i legs bshad las/ 'dod pa'i srid pa la yan lag bcu pa srid pa'i rten 'brel dang / nas/ bcu pa srid pa'i

122 rten 'brel de bdun gyi las kyi srid pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes bcu pa srid pa 'alo/ ra ba yin par gsungs pa de yig cha'i phyogs na'ang mi gnas par khas longs shig gzhan yang / khyod kyi dam bca' gsum char sras kyi thu—bo'i legs bshad dang mi mthun te/ de ltar na kun nyon phyogs kyi yan lag bcu gnyis po gang rung du gyur pa'i sdug bsngal gyi phung po yin na 'khor ba rnadang nyer len gyi phung po dang 'du byed kyi sdu ga bsngal gsum ga yin pas rdzikhyab pa'i phyir te/ de nyid las/ 'dir ni 'khor ba dang zag bcas nyer—len gyi phung po dang khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gsum po spyi la byed dgos pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang 'khor ba gnyis don gcig ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ rang gi yig cha tsam yang mi nges bzhin du phyogs 'dzin ngan pa'i dgag sgrub kyi khur de ci la babs/'on kyang khyod la gzhan gyis nan byas pa yim/ nam/ yin na yin lags zhes smos shig legs bshad las/ dregs can blun po khas len can/ /chen po yin yang nyams par 'gyur/ /gom pa gang gi sa byin pas/ /stobs ldan gyis ni sa gsum shor/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar khyod kyi blo sna gsar ba'i dam bca' ngan pa des rang la grwa sa gsum po gang gi gral yang mi thob par byas 'dug pas da ni sngon gyi lhas byin phebs pa'i sa'i srub der gshegs su gsol lo/ /'di la skul ba'i grogs po rnams/ /bdag las thu ba'i dgra bo 'dis/ /pha klad dkrugs pa'i bsang gtor 'di/ /bsil na nyin bzhin snying la byugs/ /min na kho bo'i rnam dpyod las/ /legs bshad bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung ba/ /gus pa'i

123snyim pa ma yo bas/ /gsol dang thar pa'i srog rtsa gso/ /da ni gser sbyangs btso ma bzhin du lhad med pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od ltar dag cing gsal pa/ gnam lcags kyi 'khrul 'khor ltar bzlog tu med pa'i lung dang rigs pa mgo 'bus tsam brjod par bya ste/ 'di ltar/ 'khor ba la 'phen byed lasajikyi 'phangs 'bras ming gzu gas ci rigs kyi rten 'brel gyis ma khyab par thal/ zo chun rgyud mo lta bu'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo la kun nyon phyos/sa kyi rten 'brel spyi bye brag thams cad 'jog pa'i phyir/ der thal/ mdo las/ de ltar na sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' zhig po de zo chun rgyud mo'i 'khor lo ltar 'khor ba'i 'khor lo'i rgyud du 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de lta'i sdug bsngal gyi phung po ril gyis 'khor ba'i 'khor lo'i rgyud yin par gsungs kyi/ de'i nang tshan 'phangs 'bras lta bu bkar nas ma gsungs pa'i phyir dang / de 'dra'i sdug phung la 'khor ba'i 'khor lo'i rgyud yin min gyi khyad par tha snyad lung rigs gsum po gang gis kyang 'byed mi nus pa'i phyir dang / skabs 'di'i rgyud dang rgyud mo dang rgyun gsum la khyad med la/ de lta'i sdug phung la sdug gun gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i rgyud mo'am rgyun yin min 'byed rgyu rgyal bas kyang mi rnyed pa'i phyir/ yang /'phen byed dang 'phangs 'bras kyi kun nyon gang rung yin na 'khor ba yin pas khyab par thal/ mdo las/ ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed/ ces pa nas/ yid mi bde ba dang 'khrugs pa la so sor rtog par byed cing /de ltar sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' zhig po 'di 'jig rten du

124 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ grub don gyi mdo tshig de'i sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'di zhes pa'i 'di sgra ni gong du bshad ma thag pa'i yan lag kun la snyeg dgos kyi/ rten 'brel bzhi pa lta bu dmigs kyis bsal te der snyeg dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir dang / mkhas pa dug 'dir ni 'khor ba dang zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po dang khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gsum po spyi la byed gsungs pa'i don yang / 'di'i sdug phung yan lag bcu gnyis pa la bsdu mi rung bar kun gyi spyi la byed dgos pa dang / de rnams 'di'i bye brag yin pa'i don yin pa'i phyir te/ dper na/ mdo las/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i phung po 'di ni sdug bsngal dang / la sa dang nyon mongs pa 'di ni kun 'byung gi bden pa dang / zhes pa la spyi bye brag gnyis re go dgos pa bzhin dang / tshad ma las/ yid ches tshig ni mi bslu ba'i/ /spyi las rjes su dpag pa nyid/ /ces pa'i skabs su dpyad gsum gyis dag pa'i lung de la spyi smos don/ rang nyid dpyad gsum gyis dag pa'i lung bye brag pa brgyad stong pa dang / mdo sdes bcu pa sogs kyi spyi yin pa dang / de dag rang nyid kyi bye brag yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin par bshad pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ yang / kun nyon phyogs kyi rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis la 'khor ba yin min gyi khyad med par thal/ 'grub byed dang grub 'bras gang rung gi de yin na 'khor ba yin pas khyab pa gang zhiga'aphen byed dang 'phangs 'bras gang rung gi de la'ang 'khor ba yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ dang bo der thal/ mdo las/ 'dod pa'i srid pa

125gang zhe na/ las gang zhig 'dod pa dang rab tu ldan pa'i nyer len gyi rkyen can ma 'ongs pa na mngon par 'grub par mngon du phyogs pa dang /las de'i rnam par smin pa gang yin pa'o/ /zhes dang / de bzhin du gzugs dang gzugs med pa gnyis la'ang gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/gzhung snga mas 'grub byed kyi srid pa dang / phyi mas grub 'bras kyi srid pa bshad pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa rtags phyi ma grub ste/ rigs pa snga ma de nyid kyis 'os med du 'grub pa'i phyir/ yang / yan lag bcu gnyis ril gyis 'khor ba'i 'khor lo yin par thal/ de ltar yin pa ston pa dang shing rta chen po'i dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir te/ rten 'brel snying bo'i mdo dang /rten 'brel snying bo'i tshig le'ur byas pa dang / rin chen phreng ba sogs las kun nyon gsum phan tshun brten nas thog mtha' med par mgal me ltar 'khor bar gsungs kyi/ khyod ltar skye ba'i kun nyon logs su bkar dgos pa zur tsam yang ma byung ba'i phyir dang / jo bo chen pos/ yan lag bcu gnyis cha gsum zo chu'i tshul/ /nang gi rten 'brel yang dang yang du 'khor/ /zhes pa'i cha gsum zhesami dang / nang gi rten 'brel zhes pas kun nyon gsum ga dang / nang gi rten 'brel spyi ldog nas srid pa'i 'khor lor 'jog par sa/sungs pas kyang tshul de 'grub pa'i phyir dang /bee'u bum sngon po'i 'grel bar yang de bzhin gsungs pa'i phyir dang / paṇa chen mtsho sna rma sa kyang kun nyon gsum khyad med du 'khor bar gsungs pa'i rshaphyir dang / kun gzigs lnga ba chen pos kyang / rang 'bras sdug bsngal—bden pa skyed byed kyi 'khor bas bsdusari kun 'byung bden pa'i mtshan

126nyid/ ces kun 'byung bden pa la 'khor bas khyab par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /sa/zhan yang / de ltar 'thad par thal/ bstan pa'i tshangs thig lam rim chen mo las/ nyon mongs pa gsum las la sa gnyis dang /de las sdug bsngal bdun 'byung zhing / bdun po las kyang nyon mongs dang / de las/ kyang sngar ltar 'khor bas/ srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun chad med par 'khor te/ zhes bcu gnyis po srid pa'i 'khor lor khyad med du gsungs shing / rin chen phreng ba'i dar ṭīka dang / stong thun chen mo las kyang de bzhin du 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /gnad 'di dag gzigs nas rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis/ rang gi rgyur gyur pa'i rkyen gsum las byung ba gang zhig sdug kun gang rung du gyur pa'i 'khor ba kun nyon phyogs kyi rten 'brel gyi mtshan nyid du bzhag pa yin mod/ khyod la rang gi yig cha'i dgongs mthil la'ang mun nag mda' 'phen las med na dam pa so so'i bzhed mtshams nges pa'i re ba ga na yod/ yang / sdug kun gcig nas gcig brgyud kyi rgyun yin na 'khor ba yin pas khyab par thal rang rgyu kun 'byung la brten nas rgyu 'bras rgyun ma chad par 'byung ba de/ srid pa zhes pa'i sgra don dang mtshan nyid lta bu'i 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir te/mdzod 'grel las/ 'byung bas na srid pa ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i don 'grel ba de snyed cig las de ltar bkral ba'i phyir dang / khyad par du mdzod mtha' dpyod las/ zag bcas kyi phung po chos can/ srid pa zhes bya ste/ sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung sa/cig nase gcig tu brgyud pa'i phyir/zhes gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de mdzod lugs tsam du yang 'dod

127mi rigs te/ tshul de la grub mtha' gong 'og mi mthun pa'i khyad yod na/bye smras 'di ltar 'dod kyang gong mas mi 'dod ces pa'i tshad ldan gyi tshig gsal /la can re rgya bod kyi gzhung ci rigs su 'byung rigs pa la de 'dra zur tsam yang snang rung ma dmigs pas khegs pa'i phyir/ des na de 'dra'i log bshad kyi sna shur 'khur ci thub byed pa las/ mdzod mtha' dpyod kyi sbyor 'god de la ri bong rwa lta bus ma nges pa rjod dang khyod la ran pa'i grong chog cig gda' 'o/ /yang / sdug bden yin na 'khor ba yin pas khyab par thal/ de yin na sdug bden snga phyi brgyud pa'i rgyun yin pas khyab pa gang zhig de 'khor ba zhes pa'i sgra don dang mthun pa'i 'jog byed yin pa 'bras spungs chos rje chen mo'i dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir te/ rigs pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings las/ 'khor ba zhes pa snga phyi gcig nas gcig tu 'khor ba yin la/ de tha snyad du snga phyi brgyud pa la nges par 'jog dgos/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rma dang / gnyal ṭīka sogs na'ang 'di 'dra mtha' med do/ /gzhan yang / sdug bden yin na 'khor ba yin pas khyab par thal/ de yin na las nyon gyi dbang gis 'khor ba can gyi phung bo yin pas khyab pa gang zhig de la 'khor bas khyab pa'i phyir/rtags grub ste/ rnam 'grel las/ sdug bsngal 'khor ba can phung po/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ des las/ dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis 'khor ba can gyi phung po de sdug bsngal bden pa'i mtshan nyid du bstan pa'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel du sdug bsngal bden pa'i mtshan nyid ston pa'i gzhung yod pa gang zhig de 'di las gzhan du 'os med pa'i phyir dang /

128gzhung 'dis sdug bden gyi mtshan nyid bstan par rigs mdzod dang / rgyal ba can gyi 'grel bshad lasagasungs tshul sogs rigs pa'i gad rgyangs su gsal ba'i phyir/ 'grel bshad der/ skye ba dang 'chi ba'i rgyun no/ /zhes bshad pas de la rgyud bsdus dgos so zer ba ni byang khog khab mig tu song ba'i rang mdangs te/ 'o na/ 'dus byas yin na'ang rgyud bsdus yin pas khyab par thal/ rtsa shes las/ dngos po ༷mas cad dus kusto tu/ /rga dang 'chi ba'i chos yin na/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab pa don gyis khas so/ /des na/ ṭīka las/ 'gag pa la yang 'chi ba zhes btags pa/ zhes dang / shi ba dang 'chi ba'i tha snyad btags pa yang skabs dang sbyar ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar go dgos rma sa khyod kyi dogs pa de 'dra'i gnas med do/ /gzhan yang / ma dag pa'i snod kyizhe'ajig rten chos can/ srid pa yin par thal/ sdug kun rim brgyud kyi zag bcas yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ rig rig gi rkang dung chos can/khyod srid par sgrub byed med par thal/ srid par sgrume byed gzhan gang bkod kyang mthar 'di la thug pa gang zhig 'dis de sgrub mi nus pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / ma dag pa'i snod srid pa yin par thal/ de ltar yin pa ston pa dang / shing rta chen po dang / rje yab sras ku na gyis bzhed pa'i phyir te/ mdo dang / gzhi bsdu ba dang / lam rim dang / rnam bzhag rim pa'i rnam bshad dang / bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho dang /bzhi brgya pa'i dar ṭīka rnams las gsungs pa gad rgyangs su drangs zin pa ltar yi na pa'i phyir dang / kun gzigs lnga pa chen pos kyang / rang rgyu

1nye9 kun 'byung las byung ba'i 'khor bas bsdus pa'i zag bcas de sdug bsngalasmo boden pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la rten gyi sgo nas dbye na/ ma dag pa'i snod bcud gnyis/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang gsum/ zhes sdug bden dang / ma dag pa'i snod bcud gnyis dang / sdug bsngal lam sdug bsngal ba gsum po thams cad 'khor ba yin par gsal bar gsungs ji pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang / 'dod pa'i snod chos can/ srid pa tran par tha‘ra/ srid pa gsum po gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ der thal/ las nyon gyi dbang gis 'dod pa'i khams kyi ngo bor grub pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rten 'brel snying po'i rnam bshad las/ srid pa ni gsum ste/ 'dod pa dang gzugs dang gzugs med pa zhes bya ste/de dag tu mi sdod par 'khor ba'i 'khor lor gyur pa/ zhes gsungs pali phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ lung des snod bcud kyi srid pa de dag las nyon gyi dbang gis rgyu 'bras rim brgyud kyis khams gsum gang rung du grub pa ni de dang de'i srid pa dang 'khor ba'i 'khor lor gyur pa'i don dang / bcud spyi 'jig rten so skye rnams der 'phyan par bstan pa'i phyir/ yang / ma dag pa'i snod bcud gang rung yin na srid pa yin pas khyab par thal ma dag phung po'i 'jig rten yin na srid pa yin pas khyab pa'i phyir te/ de ryān na srid pa nyer lnga po gang rung yin pas khyab par bstan rim las gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / las nyon gyi dbang gis sdug phung gcig nas gcig brgyud kyis srid gsum gang rung du grub pa srid pa'am

130'khor ba'i don yin par thal/ de ltar min na skra dkar gnyer ma sogs la rgyud bsdus kyi cha nas srid pa dang 'khor pa'i don nus lhag po 'don rgyu spu tsam yang med pa'i phyir/ gal te yod na khams dang 'jig rten la'ang sgo kun nas mtshungs pa'i phyir de dang de la'ang rgyud bsdus dgos par smos shig de bas na phyi nang gi zag phung 'di dag la sdug bsngal 'du byed pa'i cha nas 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal/ nye bar len pa las byung ba'i phung po yen pa'i cha nas nyer len gyi phang bo/ las nyon gyi dbang gis skye 'jig rim ༄brgyud dam sdug kun rim brgyud kyi rgyud mo yin pa'i cha nas srid pa'am 'khor ba zhes sgra don gnyis ka'i cha nas bzhag pa yin te/ de dag de dang de'i mtshan nyid lta bu'i go don dmar rjen yin pa'i phyir/ de'i phyir/dgra nyon mongs rkyen las dkar nag las/ /de'i 'bras bur srid pa'i snod bcud grub/ /tshul de gsum mgal me ltar 'khor bas/ /der 'khor ba'i 'khor lo mi zer ram/ /zhes kyang smos te go yul tsam rnyed pa'ang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i theg pa mchog gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis mnyes bzhin rjes su bzung ba'i drin las so/ /de ltar snying po rnam par bsdus pa shas tsam dang rigs pa'i gad rgyangs kyi gsal byed mdo tsam bris pa ste spros na bskal ba'i mthar yang zad pa med do/ /rigs pa'i sbar mo mi bzad pas/ /'gro skyong sras po mthar byas pas/ /cho nge 'don bzhin 'di yi ro/ /nye ba kun gyis da khur cig /phyogs kyi bu mo'i zur phud du/ /bdag nyid rgyal/ ba'i rgyal mtshan ni/ /bsgrengs dang lhan cig grags pa'i rnga/ /'jig rten gsum du rang sgra rgod/ /

131da ni khyod kyis rtsod spong ltar snang byas pa la brjod par bya ste/ 'di ltar/ yang khyod kyis thog mar/ bsdu ba'i/ sems can gyi 'jig rten gang yin pa dang / snod kyi 'jig rten gang yin pa las dang nyon mongs pas bskyed pa las dang nyon mongs pa las byung ba 'di mthar dag ni sdug bsngal gyi bden pa'o/ /zhes pas kyang zag bcas snod bcud kyi 'jig rten gnyis ka sdug bsngal ba'i bden par bstan pa yin gyi/ sdug bden du bstan pa ga la yin/ zhes bris so/ /kye 'dzam gling gi rigs pa smra ba kun gzigs dang / 'di'i go rigs thams cad 'di 'dra sha stag go /e glen pa/ lung 'di bsdu ba'i ma yin par thal/ 'di kun btus kyi lung yin pa gzhung gnyis la lta thub na gsal bar ma zad yig cha so sor yang kun btus las zhes drangs par ltos dang go ba'i phyir/ gshen phrug lta rgya can/ nang cha lag mthil du bkram pa bka' drin che/ khyod rang gi 'khrul gzhi ni/ gung thang bden bzhir/ shes byed snga ma las de'i don bsdu bar/ sems can gyi 'jig rten gang yin pa dang / zhes sogs drangs nas gsungs pa 'di yin la/ de ni khyod kyis gcod mtshams tsam yang ma shes par bklags nyes pa ste/ kun btus las/ sdug bsngal bden pa gang zhe na/ zhes sogs kyis mdor bstan/ sems can gang zhe na/ zhes sogs kyis rgyas par bshad/ sems can gyi 'jig rten gang yi na pa dang / zhes sogs kyis don bsdus pa yin pa'i phyir te/ dar ṭīka las/ mdor bstan dang / rgyas bshad dang / sdug bsngal du bzhag pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis don bsdu ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyod

132 la gzhung mo dang yi ga cha tshang ma zhib mor nges re su la yod kyang /bden bzhi'i rnam bzhag shog grangs nyi shu po de nges 'os pa la/ ngo gdong— de tsam la'ang 'grel mi 'gro bar nged mdo smad kyi drug sde la/ dgag pa rdzigatong ba'i 'os 'gab e 'dug dpa' po drug sde zer ba sgyu rtsal dang rigachirtsal gang la'ang zla med par grags pa ha e go go stobs til 'bru tsam yang med pa khyod kyis smras pa de rang ngor mdzub mo btsugs nas ma ṇi ltar bzla e dgos/ slad char gung thang bden bzhi'i yig rdog re la lo zlar dpyad pa btang mthar lan gyi stangs ka re gyis dang rkang 'dren 'di tsam mi 'ong mchi/ yang / so so'i skye bo chos can/ sdug bden yim/ par thal/las nyon gyi gzhan dbang can yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ wa rnga mar/ sdug— bden du 'jog pa mi 'gal te/ las nyon gyis rang dbang med par 'gyur zhing de'i dbang gis skad cig skad cig la skye 'gag byed pa'i phyir/ zhes bris pa de'i phyir dang / sdug bden dang sdug bsngal ba don gcig par yang skabs du mar bshad pa'i phyir dang / las nyon gyi gzhan dbang can de sdug bsngal ba'i sgrub byed dang mtshan nyid gnyis kar smos pa'i phyir dang / so skye la 'khor ba dang / 'khor ba la nang gi sdug bden gyis khyagle—pa yang khas blangs pa'i phyir dang / sdug bsngal pa'i bden pa dang / sdugarshabasngal bden pa la khyad par 'byed pa nang ba'i khyu la mjug ma med pa'i dud 'gro khyod las gnyis pa sngar yang ma byung zhing phyis kyang mi 'byung ba'i phyir dang / gzhung chen mo rnams su sdug bsngal ba dang sdug bden don gcig par bshad pa mtha' med par ma zad/ rang gi yig cha gcig pu na

133'ang bgrang gis mi lang ba yod pa'i phyir ro/ /yang / kun btus las/sems can skye ba dang skye ba'i gnas kyis kyang rig par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i non yang / sems can de dag las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis lam gsum du yang 5/nga skye ba'am 'khor ba sdug bden du bstan gyi sems can kho rang sdug bden du ga la ston/ zhes zhib cha bton pa yang 'chi kha'i ngal gso tsam ste/ sems can de dag rgyu las skye ba yin gyi sems can kho rang skye ba ga la yin/ zhes pa dang khyad med pa'i phyir dang / sems can de dang de'i skye ba gnyis ka las nyon gyi gzhan dbang gis skyes pa 'dra bar khas blangs nas sdug bden yin min 'byed pa ni/ rgyu rkyen gyi gzhan dbang can yin pa 'dra bar khas blangs nas gzhan dbang yin min gyi khyad 'byed pa'i ngang tshul tsam du zad pa'i phyir/ sems can skye ba dang zhes pas sems can la mi go na/ las kyi kun nyon dang / skye ba'i kun nyon zhes pa'i tshig zur gyi kun nyon yang las dang skye ba'i khyad par gyi nyon mongs re la go dgos par 'gyur la/ de ltar na shing rta chen po'i gzhung la'ang sdeb gtsang brjod bder bgyid dgos tshul gyis 'chos sgyur sha tsha dang phangs dmar med pa ci 'dod du gyis shig yang / chos longs sprul gsum re re nas rang rgyu kun 'byung bden pa las skyes pa dang / sdug kun rim brgyud kyi zag phung gi rgyun du 'dod pa mi rigs te/ de ltar khas blangs pa ni gshen rabs kyi mi bo la skyabs su 'gro ba las zag zad kyi mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro tsam yang ma skyes pa'i nang rtags yin pa'i phyir dang / zag pa'i sgo drug po gang rung dang 'brel na zag bcas yin pas

134khyab pa'i spyi skad tsam yang ma 'byor ba dang / lha rams pa'i ming skam yang zang zing gis nyos pa'i rang rtags 'khrul med yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na/ zag bcas kyi shes pa de'i myong ba gsal rig gi rgyun tsam sangs rgyas gyi sar 'gro yang zag bcas shes pa'i rgyun sangs rgyas gyi sar mi 'gro ba dang / so skye'i rgyun sangs rgyas gyi sar 'gro yang zag bcas der mi 'grorshab dang / mdo sngags kyi gnad mthar gtugs tshe'ang ma dag pa'i sgyu lus 'ja' yal ba ltar dag nas dag pa 'od gsal gyi bzhon pa'i rlung gis longs sku'i rgyu byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan sogs rtog ge skam po khyod 'dra lta ci/ sa thob pa'i spyod yul du'ang rung mi rung lta bu'i zab gnad phra zhib nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo grol bar snang ste martso/ 'bus tsam yang rung ba'i rshaskabs mi snang ngo / /gnyen pos sgrib gnyis kyi rgyun bcad de sangs rgyas pa dang de gnyis kyi rgyun sangs rgyas kyi ngo bor bskyed nas sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' 'di yang khyod kyis lhas byin dang lus med bdag po gang rigs shig las rnyed pa yin mchi/ gzhan yang / snod kyi 'khor ba snod kyi 'khor ba yin yang 'khor ba ma yin pa'i mgo mtshungs la/ gzhi'i sku—sa/sum sku gsum dang / nags kyi khyi khyir thal ba sogs snag shog kron pa'i lan chags rgya bskyed snang ste/ 'o na/ gzhi'i longs sku longs sku yinardzipar thal/ bcud kyi 'khor ba 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ bcud kyi 'khorarshab 'khor ba ma yin par thal ri mo'i mar me mar me ma yin pa'i phyir/rdo rje rkyal stong rkyal stong yan par thal/ nang gi 'khor ba 'khor ba yan pa'i phyir/ zhes khyod kyi thal ba rnams bzlog ste 'phangs na lan ci gdab/

135bcud kyi 'khor ba 'khor ba yin pas so zhe na/ snod kyi 'khor ba'ang 'khor ba yi' te/ de gnyis la 'khor ba yin min gyi khyad med par gsungs pa ma gtogs de la khyad phye ba rgyal ba'i bka'/ shing rta chen po'i gzhung /rje yab sras kyi legs bshad gang du'ang zur tsam yang med pa'i phyir/ gal te yod na/ shing rta chen pos snod kyi 'khor ba zhes gsungs kyang de 'khor ba dngos min par sgrub tshe cis kyang 'dren rigs par ma zad/ lung snga ma las rang gis gang drangs pa de nyid dbang btsan pa'i tshul rigs pa yang dag gis 'byed dgos pa la/ nags kyi khyi khyi yin min tsam 'a/sa 'dren rgyu gtan ma rnyed pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang / gzugs kyi phung po phung po ma yin pa dang / mi'i rnam shes rnam shes ma yin pa dang / nam mkha'i lha lha ma yin pa dang / sa'i mi mi ma yin pa dang / shing gi me me ma yin pa dang / rgya mtsho'i chu chu ma yin par yang khas len rigs par thal/ gzugs kyi phung po gzugs kyi phung po yin yang de phung po min pa sogs kyi zhib cha 'byed rigs pa'i phyir te/ snod kyi 'khor ba'i zhib cha de'i phyir/ ma khyab na mi mtshungs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang dag pa ci yod/'dod na/ smon rams pa rkyal stong gi shes rab shes rab ma yin pa dang / de'i sdom pa sdom pa ma yin pa dang / de'i yon tan yon tan ma yin pa dang / de'i rtags gsal rtags gsal ma yin pa dang / de'i skad cha skad cha ma yin par thal ba sogs mchod par 'bul pas dgyes bzhes spedzod cig de bas/ snod kyi 'jig rten 'jig rten ma yin par thal/snod kyi 'khor ba 'khor ba ma yin pa'i phyir byas na/ de gnyis mi mtshungs

13kyi pa'i lan yang dag pa zhig khyod kyis mgo bo 'dzin ma'i tho bar byas te rshabaskal bar 'bad kyang rnyed pa'i gnas e mchis/ gshen phrug yang /gang gis shes pa po dang sa/nga zhig shes par bya ba sogs la shes byas ma khyab par thal/ khyod kyi gang gis sgrol ba po sogs kyi khyab 'grig kha stong lag stong de 'thad pa'i phyir/ brgal lan bskal me ma bris na re zhig 'jog par 'dod do/ /de ltar rang mtshang dmar 'byin gyi thal stong gang 'phangs bzlog na rang mgo gzhom pa'i dbyug pa dgu bskor las ma mchis so tshogazhan yang / skye 'chi rgyud mo'i lam la brten nas 'gro ba drug tu yang yang 'khyams shing 'khor ba kho na 'khor bar gsungs pa ma gtogs/ phyi'i sa rdo ri brag 'khor bar 'khor ba gcig gis kyang ma rnyed 'dug pa'i phyir/zhes bris nas gang zag yin na 'khor ba ma yin pas khyab par bshad pa nang 'gal dang / mngon pa lasas rdo ri brag sogs zag bcas dang /zag bcas dang srid pa don gcig tu gsungs par bzung nas gong bzhin smos pa nang 'gal dang / gang dag zag bcas nyer len pa'i/ /sogs kyi brjod don rnams ming rnam grangs pa las don gcig min zer ba dang /'di smras brjod tsam gyi rnam grangs su 'dod pa'ang rigs pa ma yin te/zhes pa legs bshad du mas len pa nang 'gal lo/ yang / 'chi ba'i ming gis btags na 'chi ba yin pas khyab pa pha rol pa la sgrub mi dgos/dgos pa de tsam ya nga 'byin mi spobs na lung rigs par zhib cha'i ro yin par smos pa ni/ rtsa she'i ṭīka chen las de lta'i zhib cha ched sa/nyer gyis gnang ba la dmigs phug nas bshad pa yin mchi ste/ byams gling ba sogs

137dang mdza' sde yin pas so/ /srid pa'i snod bcud yen tshad srid par bzhed pa la ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa dang kun gzigs lnga ba chen po la thug gi bar nged kyi rgyab na lhun po bzhin g.yo med du bzhugs par ma zad/ phar ded na kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje yang nged kyi phyogs na rdo lhung lhung byas te yod la/ a pha'i ya kha/ a ma'i ma kha/ ya ta'i rdo rje/ ma ta'i padma tsam 'khor bar rnyed pa ni rgya mo'i brnye dang / jo mo'i jo phrug khyed cag las/ gzhan mthar gtugs na med pa lung rigs thang mar brdal bas shes sla ba'i phyir ro/ /yang / yig cha rnams su skyes rabs dang nyams cha/gur sogs kyi lung drangs pa de than zhig yin par thal/ snyan ngag dang nyams mgur sogs kyi lung sgrub byed du mi rung ba'i ngan skad de 'thad pa'i phyir/de bas na/ zhib mo rnam 'thag tu 'gog pa long ba'i gom 'gros su gsal bar byed pa yang grub pa yin no/ /des na khyod kyis blo bzang dpal ldan 'khor dang bcas pa mgo la me tog gi phreng ba bzhin du thogs te bskal ba nas bskal bar bkur ba'i dam bca' seng ge'i nga ror bgyi'o/ /zhes khas blangs shing dam bcas pa de nyid dran par mdzod la rjes su sgrubs dang / kho bo cag nas kyang / khyod ni gsung rab lta la phyogs re'i mig /lung don rigs pas 'byed pa'i mthu med pas/ /bstan pa'i gnad rnams rdzogs pa'i gdams pa mchog /mkhas pa dgyes pa'i lam dang bral mthong nas/ /shing rtachen po'i lam 'di bshad pa la/ /bdag gi yid ni kun nas spro bar gyur/ /ces brjod de yang dag pa'i lung dang

138rigs pa'i tshogs brag thog nas chu 'phyo ba bzhin du 'doms par bya 'o/ /smras pa/ 'di mthong tshe na rtog ge rgan po gang / /yid la mya ngan bskal ba'i me mched de/ /snying gi bud shing lhag med zos pa yis/ /lnga pa'i lam la dpyang thag sgo las 'jug /yang gcig lus rid zla tshes ltar gyur nas/ lke /gdungs pas gzhogs gcig stan la nyal thabs kyis//dbugs dron shugs ring dbyu gus 'gram pa'i rnga/ /nyin mtshan rdung ba'i brtul zhugs bltar mi bzod/ /mgo skyes lan bu gzengs pas gdong bkab nas/ /'dren byed lam nas mchi ma bar med du/— /rnam par 'dzag bzhin mdza' phrug phang ba na/ /dur khrod ro bzhin gyur la su mi brtse/ /sngon gyi mdza' ba ma btang ba/ /'ga' zhig gam la nyer 'ongs nas/ /yi ga gso ba'i tshig smra yang / /srid nyams rgyal bzhin gdung ba 'dzin/ /phyi na phal cher ro 'dzin gyi/ /rol mo 'khrol ba'i sgra dag las/ /thod la rang sdug lag pa yis/ /blangs phyir da ni nyos so smra//ka ye dge legs mi ldan zhing / /bde ba'ang de bzhin gyur pa khyod/ /myur bar phyi ma 'i skyed tshal la/ /dge bar gshegs na bde bas 'tshengs// de tshe 'khor gyi dud mo yis/ /khyom mtshe dag la 'on pa sbyin/ /brang la khu tshur bsnun pa las/ /btsun pa nu ma'i rgyan can 'byung / /zhes bya ba yang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa 'khrul gzhan mdzub ston gyis mtshon pa long ba'i mdzub tshugs su gsal bar byed pa ni/ 'di ltar/ sngags rim dang rim lnga gsal sgron du sngags bla med la brten nas 'tshang rgya ba'i gang rdzo

— 139ge zag la tshe 'di dang bar do dang skye ba brgyud nas 'tshang rgya ba'i dbye ba gsum du mdzad nas/ gnyis pa la/ 'gos lugs pas zung 'jug thob la ma goms pa'i gang zag bzhag par/ de dgag pa la/ rim lngar sgyu lus dang 'od sa/sal thob na tshe de nyid la nges par 'tshang rgya bar gsungs pa dang / rgyud blar phar phyin theg chen 'phags pas kyang las dbang gis 'chi ba spangs parngo gsungs na/ sngags kyi theg chen 'phags pas de spangs pa lta ci smos pas/ gang zag 'di las dbang gis 'chi ba ma stangs pa zhig yin pa spyod bsdus sogs las gsungs pas na mi 'thad do/ /zhes byang 'phags yin na las nyon gyi dbang gis mi 'chi bas khyab par gsungs pa dang / grub mtha' chen mor byang 'phags yin na las nyon gyi dbang gis mi 'chi bas ma khyab par gsungs pa gnyis gtan mi mthun pa'i sgra dbyangs ri seng ge'i nga ror bsgrags pa la/ kun mkhyen sku yon dang bka' drin che tshul gyi shed mong dang / bsdigs mo phreng bsgrigs kyi zol sbyor 'phros gtam dang / rang gi nyon mongs kyi dbang gis skye ba mi len pa dang /rang dang rgyud gcig pa'i so skye'i nyon mongs kyi dbang —gis skye ba blangs pa sa/nyis 'gal pa'i go skabs su zhig gis rnyed/ ces lan btab pa ni dngos lan ma yin pa gnag rdzis kyang shes pas/ phyin chad shar dris pa la nub ston pa'i bzo sta 'di 'dra las med na/ byi la snye nang du bcug ste stag yin khul gyi rdzu 'gebs bgyis na thabs su zab po/ /yang / lad mo la rnam grangs mang bas ya rabs dam pa'i srol ka la lad mo rung ba khyod bden mod/ rang la gtad so ci yang med par lad mo byas na/ dred

140 kyis mi'i lad mo byasajipas lus thams cad rmas khyab ste srog 'dor ba dang /lhas byin gyis sangs rgyas mild mo byas pas sa'i mthongs phyes te dmyal bar song ba dang / khyod kyis mkhasapa'i lad mo byas pas rang mgo rmas te mgo bo tshal ba brgyar bkas pa de 'dra 'byung ba'i rigs la spre'u'i rang bzhin 'dzin pa smad pa yin no/ /yang / lhag bcas pas 'khor ba dang 'phangs 'bras spangs ma spangs la 'chad zur gnyis byung ba bden yang /de ni kun mkhyen yab sras grub mtha' dang gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha mthar gshegs pa'i rnam thar khyod lta bus mthong ba dang go dka' bar yod/ ces shom bshad stong rtsis bre phul gyis gdab pa dngos lan du mi rung bas gsal lan mdzub tshugs kyis ston rgyu dgos pa da dung so na gnas so/ /yang /spangs ldan dang rgyud la ldan dang yod kyi khyad par la'ang skabs kyi dngos lan dmar rjen ma mngon pa gong 'og sogs dang mthun pa zhig dgos kyi/ g.yo zol gyi lab gleng snying po med pa thang mar brdal ba 'di 'dra 'u thug pa'i rang bzhin je gsal du gtong ba'i rgyu las ma mchis so yang /yig char nang 'gal med tshul 'di dang 'di'o zhes lan gsal zhig ngar shags kyis gsung rigs pa la/ mang thos mkhas pa'i gsung la sgras zin mi mthun pa 'byung ba gzhan la'ang yod pas pher sha ma che bar kha rog sdod/ces lkog gtam pa'i kha ta byed pa ni sdug gyong nag nag go /yang / thal 'gyur bas shes par gyur ba'i shes sgrib 'jog mi 'jo ga gnyis kyi dgongs mthil mi 'gal ba'i rang lugs kyi ba dan zhig bsgrong rgyu yod kyang re zhig sgreng ba'i rtog pa mi skye zhes pa lan du mi rung ste/ da lta sgrong ba'i dus la

141nges can du babs pas so/ /shi nas ro'i steng dang shul gang du bsgrengs kyang khyod 'phan par mi 'gyur zhing / rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa shes sgrib tu sgrub pa'i rang lugs kyi ba dan srid rtse'i bar du bsgreng rgyu yod na/ de zil gyis gnon pa'i tog cig kho bos sbyin pang nges so yang /sngon gyi brgal lan bgris po yul nas yul dang sa/dan sa nas gdan sar brgyud pa la skyo sngogs bya ba'i 'dun pa re zhig mi skye zer ba de ltar yen du chug pa'i khul byas kyang / gsar brgal mang bo mdun sar byung ba la'ang ma mthong ma thos pa'i 'on long gi smyo rdzu'i zhal 'bag rang byon de bzhad gad kyi sa/nas su ha cang che gda'o/ /bdag las mched pa'i me lce yis//khyod 'dod bud shing kun bsregs te/ /dud pa rlung gi 'khor lo can//khyod gyi phyogs la mun pa'i dpung / /thub bstan mkha' la rgyan bres pa'i//blo bzang legs gsung ā di'i sras/ /bdag sems lha yi rdzing ring na//phyogs las rgyal ba'i rgyal srid 'dzin/ /yang / gad rgyang zhes dag yig shel dkar me long dang shes bya rab gsal lta bu rang phyogs kyi gzhung du mar 'byung mod/ khyod kyis byams gling ba'i smra rgyan lta bu'i gzhung phyogs re ba tsam du sa mtha' yod pa mthong ba las/ kun mkhyen bla mas/ le brnan gad brgyangs smra ba'i brgya/ /zhes dang / dag byed gsal ba'i mi long du'ang / bla brgyud gad brgyangs brgyud mar 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa tsam yang ma mthong ba ra 'bru thams cad nas rdog gcig tu 'dzin pa'i dpe ltar smras mchi ste/ gad mang can de 'dra mi srid na khyod kyis ngag spyal dang ngag 'chal lta bu nges med du bris pa ci'i phyir yin/ pa zhi

tsaji 142 da wa da wa ta dang / rākṣa dang / bha si haṃdang / bha smi bzhi thal ba'i skad dod dang /sarba ṭa dang / bhū ti dang / bha sma dang / bra saṃ ga bzhi thal 'gyur gyi skad dod byas nas de gnyis kyi skad dod 'gal bar bshad pa ni rang nyid gsal byed tsam ste/ 'chi med mdzod 'gyur rnying dang / kun mkhyen gyi 'gyur bcos dang / si tu'i dag 'gyur sogs du mar bha sma thal ba'i skad dod du'ang bshad pa'i phyir dang / khyod la rgya bod gnyis kyi de ka'i sgra don gyi phyogs tsam yang shar mi snang ba'i phyir ro/ /yang / sdeb sbyor gyi dbang gis tshig rkang gnyis re dkrugs na rkang ba gnyis re'i mtha' dang / re re dkrugs na rkang ba re re'i mthar nyis shad dgos pa'i khyad rimabo ba'i 'khrul gtam dbyangs su gyer ba dang / nakhya'i tshogs ya mus bha la wa'i lang tsho dar la babs pa zhes pa ldin pa ni gong de ma thag udhi ṣṭha'i tshogs lnga khri dgu stong sum brgya sum cu pa zhes pas kyang dpog bzhin du dgo༈sa med kyi klan ka btsal ba ni gzhan la gcig tu mnar 'dod kyi nyams bzhes sku tshe dang mnyam par bskyangs pa'i rnam thar ro/ /khyod la sdeb sbyor la mkhas pa'i rang rtsal de tsam mchis na rang gi mdun dpe de dag la gzigs dang / gzhung gi dngos bstan gyi stag rnam rtsen bsgrigs pa khyi rnam rtsen du song ba dang / dal 'gro 'phel ba can bsgrigs pa dal 'gro nyams pa can du song ba sogs la sa/zhi 'chos kyi zhus chen mdzod dang khyod la babs nges su 'dug go /g.yang sa dang dpal g.yang la yang yang 'jug yod mnyam dang / med mnyam dang / khyad par phye ba'i dag yig dang dag par mang po snang ba dang / tshul seng ba dang / seng 'od pa

143sogs kyis gshang lam dang gshang ga ci nes gas 'phul can du bshad par ma zad/ bkras 'khyil thon mis kyang / rol mo gshang dang gshang lam dang / /zhes bris shing / parnyi ta bar ma chad pas zhus chen khyod bzhin byas pa bkra shis 'khyil par khang chen mo'i bar phal mo cher yang de ltar bzhugs pas ro bya bo grag snga 'dug go /ya nga des/ spam mtho spar mo go 'phang spar/ /zhes pa sde dang / rta sbang me sbar sbar mo bsdams/ /zhes pa sder yang bris 'dug pa la/ de yang sgrub byed ci zhig mthong nas/sbar khyim zhes pa ma dag par smras/ yang / sre bo dang sre nag sogs smug mdog gi steng nas bshad pa dang / hre bo dang hre log sogs ni thig le can dang khra khra lta bu'i steng nas btags pa yin pas de gnyis 'dra ba'i gnas med mod/ gal te hre bo zhes pa cis kyang ma dag par sgrub 'dod na ni/ dpa' ris dam chos hre bo zhes bkras 'khyil gyi tshad ma'i ston pa snga ma dag gis gsungs shing / gsungs pa ltar phyi ma dag gis bris la/ shras pa ltar srol 'dzin dag gis par du'ang bkod 'dug pa de dag thog mar sug las kyis phyis dang / des khyod kyi bzhed pa mthar thug pa de 'grub nges su gda' 'o/ /'gar zhes dag par mang por 'byung bar ma zad rang nyid kyis kyang de ltar lan du mar bris pa dang / bkras 'khyil rang gzhung du/ sgra 'badzee'abig byed mtshon gyis 'big /ces dang /lang tsho nam lang nyal ba langs/ /zhes dang / mdun du 'gug dang lam 'gog pa/ /zhes 'byung pas don snying 'big pa dang / nam lang ba dang / tshod med 'gug pa rnamasaspru ma dag par smras pa rang gis rang sun

144ci phyin byas par zad la/ ngag sgron sogs dag yig chen mo phal cher du yid srubs bris pa dang / smra sgron du/ g.yo rgyug g.yor rgyu yin/ /zhes gsungs pas g.yo rgyu ma dag par smra ba mtha' mchod pa dang / kā la kū ṭa dang / mangs bar 'gyur dang / rtswags zhes sde bar sogs dag par rnams su 'byung bas de dag ma dag par bshad pa mthong rgya chung ba'i gtam ste sug par thogs pa'i shog ldeb re gnyis tsam dang ma mthun tshe dbugs rgod stod du 'tshangs ba'i ngar sgra de tshod zungs shig de ltar yi ge re re'i steng nas brgal lan byas na mang bar 'gyur bas 'di ltar shes dgos te/ 'dzam bu dang dzaspu/ 'gu ru dang gu ru lta bu rgya skad bod yig tu 'dri ba dang / brdzun pa dang rdzun pa/ 'phreng ba dang phreng ba lta bu bod—skad sngon 'jug yod med 'dam nga dang / gdam nga dang 'dam nga /mdzangs pa dang 'dzangs pa lta bu 'phul yig 'dam nga dang / yid rang—dang yi rang / yid mug dang yi mug lta bu rjes 'jug yod med 'dam nga—dang / dwogs pa dang dogs pa/ bla dwags dang bla dgas lta bu ba zuradzhayod med 'dam nga dang / snying khu dang nying khu/ kun brtags dang kun btags lta bu mgo can byed min 'dam nga dang / myi dang mi/ dmyigs dang dmigs lta bu ya btags yod med 'dam nga dang / gtsang dang rtsang / btsong kha dang tsong kha lta bu yul ming 'dam nga can dang / — skad gsar bcad la skad cig lta bur gas 'phul spang bar bkas bcad pa —dbang btsan par song yang / phra mo lta bur 'as 'phul yod med kyi bkas bcad gnyis ka byung tshul dang / ngo mtshar rtogs byed/ sgra sbyor bam

145gnyis/ smra sgo rtsa 'grel/ 'o da zer —brgya pa/ sgra don rgya mtsho/ gaṅgā/ za ma tog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ smra ba'i rgyan/ ngag gi sgron ma/ shes bya rab gsal/ shel dkar me long / blo gsal mgrin rgyan/ smra ba'i sgron me sogs yi ge'i gzhung che phra mang por yang / mgar ba dang 'gar ba / mgal me dang 'gal me sogs bzhed rigs mi 'dra pa sna tshogs su yod pa dang / nye ba dang bsnyen pa/ grub pa dang bsgrubs pa lta bu byed pa po la ma ltos pa dang ltos pa'i dbang gis gzugs 'gyur ba sogs dang /rgyal mchog bdun pa'i gsung 'bum du gdam nga'i rigs mang du gnang ba —mkhas pa'i rgyan dang phyi rabs kyi mig ltos su che bar dam pa rnams la snagrags pa ltar shes na/ khyod kyi cha shas me da pa'i ril 'dzin lta bu'i blo ngan de 7/ rang ldog tu 'gro'o/ /des na rigs pa'i gad rgyangs 'di ༷ rags zhus tsam las zhus dag phyi ma ma byas pa'i skabs mched pa'i dpe zhig khyod kyi lag tu chud snang ba dang / sngar smos lta bu'i 'dam nga ma phyedadzhapa'i blo skyon gyis mon yul rdor gcod du bgyis pa mang ba dang / par cung zad re grum pa la'ang skyon sna dgu brjod pa lta bu thal che ba ya nga ches mang bas na sgrob bshad 'ja' ris mar/ 'di la kho bos zhar gyung grur zhugs kyi ngang tshul ltar bltas pas mthong bar bshad pa ltar khyod rang nges par grur zhugs kyi skyes bur ljon shing 'gro bar snang ba ltar ma dag 'khrul ba'i ri mo ci yang shar ba'i dbang gis ngag bton phal mo che zhes don gnas ma yen par ma zad/ par mar med pa lnga bcu tsam yod khul gyis skyon brjod rgya cher bgyis pa bltas pas shes so/ /mdor na gad rgyangs

146su bris pa'i dag cha la par khang bkra shis mthong smon phyogs gtogs dang bcas pa dang / khyed kyi zhus chen ci rigs dang mi mthun pa gcig kyang med pas mi dag pa 'chos pa la dgyes na de dag la thugs brtson bzhes ran par ma zad 'phyis gda'o/ /lar lung tshig phon che bas chad lhag re shor ba dang / rang gzhung dkyus ma la'ang yi ge ma dag pa phran re byung ba bden mchi shaṃng de tsam skyon du mi che snyam ste/ gzhan du na/ kun mkhyen bla ma'i legs bshad rnams su lung drangs pa'i rigs dang / bkras 'khyil par khang chen mo'i par de snyed la'ang khyod kyis skyon du brtsis tshad de thams cad lhun grub tu bzhugs pa dang / khyod rang gi zhus chen ma dang ngag rtsom gyi rigs gzhan lta ci/ brgal lan 'dir yang sha zad rus zad kyis zhus dag chu thub tu bgyis par rlom gda' yang ma dag khyi lud kyi phung po bzhin du spungs pa'i ngang tshul sa/cal du 'grem par 'gyur bas der ltos shig yang / kha sgang ba'i dgag yig ngag kyal min par bsgrubs pa ni skyag mgo sab sib kyi ngang tshul du snang bar ma zad/ khyod rang rang kha bzhi shor mi 'gyur ba'i thabs la bsgrim par bya ba las/ gzhan pa kha sho la 'gebs grogs kyi brtson pa de re zhig res su babs mi gda' 'o/ /yang /khyod kyis kha la ci thogs kyi skyon bgrangs so brgyad tsam brtsis pa ni/ shed bu ser skyas lan ldon ma nus par ngan smras bco brgyad byas po'i ngang tshul las gzhan du med pas spong lan ci dgos/ de mtshungs dngos lan byas tshe khyod kyi 'di la/ don la rmongs pa dang / rang phyogs la chags pa dang / gzhan phyogs la sdang ba dang / bdag bstod dang / gzhan smod

147dang / lo 'dod dang / khe 'dod dang / grags 'dod dang / dge sbyong gi chos las 'das pa dang / bstan bcos ltar snang dang / ma grub pa dang / 'gal ba dang / ma nges pa dang / 'khrul ba dang / byung rgyal dang / than ltas sogs kyi skyon don gnas ci 'dod bgrangs na'ang zhe sun dang lce dbang ngal ba ma byung tsho zad mthar thug bag la srid kyang /de tsho la 'og rlung drag por ldir ba'i sgra tsam yang ster ba la sems phangs so//smras pa/ brtse ba ldan pa bdag nyid kyis/ /sdig pa can khyod rjes bzung bas/ /log par lta ba'i g.yang sa las/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i lam du bcug /mthu la glang bo lcags kyus bzhin/ /slad du dag pa'i legs bshad 'dis/ /khyod sems dge bar dbang byas na/ /phyi nas bka' drin dran pas mchod/ /phan pa'i lan du gus pa yis/ /yang dag lta ba'i ba gam las/ /legs bshad rgyud mangs brdungs pa'i sgras/ /blo gsal dge ba'i dus ston spel/ /dbyug pa can gyi pho nya ba/ /dus kyi srin po khros ba'i lag /'bod pa'i g.yab mos ma brel na/ /da dung zla ba'i ba dan bsgreng / /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //gsum pa skyon mtshang rags bsdus kyi khyes po rang nyos rang sdug gi khur du skur ba ni/ 'di lta ste/ khyod kyis/ sha sha sho bo 'di na snang /zhes pa lta bu'i tshigs bcad mang po bris nas snyan ngag dang / raX lug rwa rong rmongs pa'i ma las nas/ /rwa ro rul bas dbeen par 'dren pa'i rje/ /zhes pa lta bu sgra rgyan ya med du rlom snang ste/ de lta na/ rdzu swā

148 swā kiḍi sgang spya yod/ / shā ma sdu kiḍi ༵nga rku yod/ /ces pa lta bu tshigs bcad du gang bsdebs thams cad dang / ra lugs gang tsho ma bsha' sde ba ༷/ /zhes gnadzor nas kun gyis bzhad rged du byed paphyozhig yod pa de dang de ya nga snyan ngag dang sgra rgyan nyams can du 'gro bar thal ba dang /kun mkhyen legs bshad 'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod yab sras kyi gsung /zhes pa lta bu tshig sbyor nyams can yin na rang rang ngo ma tsha bar tshig sbyor gang byas snyan ngag gi nyams ldan du thal bar 'gyur ro/ /des na kun gzigs lnga pa chen pos/ ba lang tshig ldan rtog ge'i e raṇḍar/ / nyams dang 'gyur ba'i ro bcud ches mngar ba'i/ /snyan ngag 'bras bu re ba'i gzhung lugs pa/ /mkha' dbyings utpal sngon po thod du 'ching //zhes gsungs pa'ang / gyong zhing rtsub la rong zheng stug pa'i bcad lhugs smra ba khyod 'dra ba la gzas pa e shes/ rang nyid kyis dge sbyong gi chos las 'das pa'i ngag tshig /la na ma tho ba star chags su brjod pa rtsod rigs mdzes pa'i yan lag yin pa skad dang / bdag cag gis smras pa'i cha shas re yang than chen por smra ba ni/ ji skad du/ des na sa/zhan skyon rtog la mig 'dra ya nga / /rang skyon lta la long ba ltar gyur pa'i/ /yus po che rnams blo kha nang phyogs te/ /rang mtshang rang gis brus te bsal gyis dang / /zhes gsungs pa der gda' 'o/ /nged cag gis kha sgang dang hre bo gnyis rnam par dag pa'i bag tshig phra mo res kyang che/ga med du bzos pa'i zhar la cung zad re 'bar bas gnod sbyin du song la/ khyod kyis kho bo'i sha la zos/ khrag la 'thungs/ rus pa la mur spyang tshim pa med pa'i

lke 149 bsam sbyor dmar rjen du bstan pa rang nyid gnod sbyi—na nag po'i brtul zhugs can du chags sdang gis gnas bsgyur par mi shes pa ni rmongs pa'i khol bor gyur pa'i dan rtags dang / 'chad rtsod 'di 'dra las mda' mdung gi cho ga legs tshul rjod bzhin du log bshad ngag kyal tshig rtsub gsum gyi gzhi mthun glegs bam du bsgrubs pa ni mda' mdung las brgya 'gyur gyis thu bar thub bstan la rma 'byin pa'i g.yul ngo mi bzad pa dang / 'di las ge sar sgrung rgyud 'chang pa mdzes zer bzhin du rgyal ba'i bka' nas rang gi yig cha'i bar la rgyab 'gal du song ba'i log bshad kham gang che spel ba dngos 'gal du sus mi shes/ yang / kha sgang phyogs 'dzin dang bcas par mchil zhags tsam yang ma 'phangs pa'am ma 'phong ba gang ltar yang de dag gis rtsod yig mchil mas bsubs pa ngo tsha bzhad gad kyi gnas dang / de tsho kha rog ger bzhugs pa brjid brling che ba shes bzhin du rang nyid star rdog skam po'i nang mtshang phyir slog pa de bas kyang rdzingo tsha dgu brtsegs dang / ngag 'khyal gyi nyes par 'dzem pa yi rang gi gnas zer bzhin thub bstan dri ma can du byed pa'i ngag kyal gyi rkyal ba kha rshaphye ba ni 'bu 'thu bzhin ma ṇi zlo ba'i ne tso rang byon dang / dgag yig bris na rang nyid col chung du 'gyur ba shes bzhin mi'i kha la nyan te byi bas glang khur len pa ni blun po chu sna gar khrid kyi rang bzhin gsal byed kyi me long mchog tu 'khums so/ /thub bstan dbyar gyi lang tsho yal ba na/ /thang phrom 'khri shing phra mos snyems pa 'dzin/ /tshul 'dis gnongs pas4sngon med dpag bsam gyi/ /ljon bzang tshwad du skyed la kho bo brel/ yang /

150 sdug yus kyi ngang tshul khur du ma theg pa du mas khyod rang yig cha'i rgyab dpung du btsal zhing / rang nyid kyang dpa' khas len gyis bud pas na ma mtha' yig cha la shas mi bzod pa'i dkyog bshad mi dgos par tshig rnams rang babs su bzhag nas de la ci nus ci spyogs gyis 'bad pa lhur blangs te g.yag sna khu tshur gyi u tshugs lta bu re yin rung byas yod na dgra ma sod kyang gnyen spro ba'i las tsam du mchis na yang / de las bzlog ste kun mkhyen bla ma'i legs bshad la than skyel gyi 'gong 'dre mgo bro dgu brtsegs su langs pa ni/ rigs mthun la rgya'i rna ba 'dzin 'dod dang / /yig cha'i rang lugs yal bar 'dor ba 'gal/ /yig cha'i phyogs kyi phyi dpung byed pa dang / /'phangs tshad de yi gshed mar song ba 'gal/ /yig cha mtha' dag dgongs pa mthun pa dang / /gang dang mi mthun grub mtha' gsar bzos 'gal/ /rigs pas zhib khushad mtha' dpyod yin skad dang / /bam bshad zer nas dkyog bshad byed pa 'gal/ /zhes bya ba'i rang sdug gi khres po dpung bas mi theg pa rin gyis nyos pa'o/ ya nga /blo brtan 'grel ba sogs kyi ba sgra dang de sgra re la'ang nus pa lhag po 'don rgyu yod par smra bzhin/ 'grel ba de las sdug bsngal de dang de'i sdug bsngal ba de dang de'i sdug bsngal du gsungs pa khas mi len pa nang 'gal dang / las nyon gyis rang dbang med par skye 'jig byed pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ba'i don dang / sdug bsngal ba sdug bden sgrub byed du smra ba'i/na du/ las nyon gyis skye 'jig byed pa'i so skye sdug bden min pa ra 'dod pa nang 'gal lo/ /yang / zag bcas thams cad 'du byed kyi sdug

151bsngal min pa dang de'i sdug bsngal ba yin pa'i shes byed du/ mdo las/gang mi rtag pa de sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes pa dang / bsdu bar/ de gnyis dang rjes su 'brel ba yin pas/ de'i phyir de yang sdug bsngal yin no/ /zhes pa dang / slo brtan gyis/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid de/ skye bas zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go— /zhes gsungs pa sogs drangs te/ lung de dag gi nang na/ zhes pa nas/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin pa'i shes byed tshig gcig kyang e 'dug ces smras pa ni rgyang 'phen las kyang thu bar mngon sum la bsnyon pa ste/ mig phye la ltos dang / khyod kyis drangs pa'i lung de dang der sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal ba zhes pa gnyis kyi gang 'dug rnam dpyod rtsa ba rang nas dmus long du 'dug par ma zad/ 'dzer khung gi chu bur yang rdol lam/ yang / de ltar smra bzhin du/ sdug bsngal gsum la yul dang bcas pa 'jog par sgras zin du sa/sungs pa'i gzhung chen mo rnams kyi dgongs pa ni/ zhes dang /nyer len gyi phung po lnga sdug bsngal tha mar gsungs pa'i lung bsam gyis mi khyab par bzhugs pa rnams/ zhes dang / yul gsum sdug bsngal yin pa lta bu'i tshig yod pa/ zhes dang / las nyon gyi lag rjes su gyur pa'i zag bcas thams cad 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal du gsungs pa'i rang phyogs kyi skyes mchog gong ma dag gi lung yang mang ste/ zhes bris pa nang 'gal te/ ba/ 'bar gyi 'o dod che ba las don rtsar bcar na shes rab rgya mtsho gti mug rgya mtshor btang ba rnodis nges par khrun thag gtsang mar chod pa ha go bar gyis/ yang / tshor ba gsum rim bzhin sdug bsngal gsum dang

152 sdug bsngal ba dang sdug bden gyi mtshan gzhir bzhag nas/ de ltar yin pa'i go thob tu rdi rigs par sdug btsāl ba gsum sbyor bar gzhung lugs brgya phrag gis grub pa'i phyir/ rigs pa 'di las blo ldan su zhig gis 'da' bar spobs/ zhes smras 'dug go /de la 'o na/ de'i rigs pa sazag tshor sdug bsngal chos can/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal yin par thal/sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal ba yin pa'i phyir/ zag tshor bde ba chos can/'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal yin par thal/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal ba yin pa'i phyir/ zag tshor btang snyoms chos can/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin par thal/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ba yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'god rigs nga ra thal/ khyod kyis bshad ma thag pa de ngo gdong ltar 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal ba la sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang / 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal ba la 'gyu ra ba'i sdug bsngal dang / 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ba la 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis khyab par thal/ khyod kyi gzhan gyis 'da' bar mi nus pa'i rigs pa yang dag de'i phyir/ de la 'dod dang / ma grub/ ma khyab gang byas kyang 'khor gsum stong dang dngos 'gal khri ste/ khyod kyi ltag chod 'di las ni ngeyopar rang nyid 'da' mi spo bas pa rkang la me btsa' babs pa bzhin ngo 'phrod par gyis/ gzhan du seng ge srad pus bcing bar 'dod pa khyod a re glen/ bon phrug sngags phrug khyod gnyis lta bu rigs pa smra ba yin na mi rigs pa smra ba de su zhig yin/ lha rams grwa skor ci 'dra'i yag po zhig byas yod ang / de'i don spyi tsam shar na'ang rgod bro'o/ /des na aungs

153rtul ltaldan rab 'byams smra ba mtshan nyid par 'dug pas/ de'i ming gi sgro btags can zhes khengs smyung byed dgos pa'i phyogs na yang med do//yang / sdug bden du sgrub par byed pa'i rtags yang dag tu sdug bsngal ba gsum zhib par bshad pa'i phyir/ zhes bris 'dug go /'o na sdug bsngal ba gsum po'i gang rung yin na sdug bden yin pas khyab par thal/'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ so skye chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ stong bshad las/ zag bcas snod bcud kyi 'jig rten gnyis ka sdug bsngal ba'i bden par bstan pa yin gyi/ zhes bris pa de'i phyir/ gal te de sdug thosngal ba'i bden pa yin yang sdug bsngal ba min zer na/ de chos can/ sdug bsngal ba yin par thal/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ba yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ las nyon gyis rang dbang med par skye 'jig byed pa'i phyir/khyab ste/ stong bshad las/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis sdug bsngal ba yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ las nyon gyis rang dbang med par skye 'jig byed pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ba'i don de yin pa'i phyir/ zhes bris 'dug pa de'i phyir/ gzhan yang /so skye chos can/ sdug bsngal gyi bdenartsopa yin par thal/ sdug bsngal ba'i bden pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ khyod kyis/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa la sdug bsngal dngos kyi bden pa dang / sdug bsngal ba'i bden pa gnyis su phye ba de'i phyir/ yang / sdug bsngal gsum gyi mtshan gzhir tshor ba sha stag bzung zhes smos pa de rang nyid lta rgya che ba'i de nyid gsal byed

154 —de / nyan sa las/ des ni sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba rten dang bcas pa bstan te/ de yang sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal yin pas de ni sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal rnam par bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes tshor ba sdug bsngal rten dang bcas pa mtshan gzhir bzung ba 'di bzhin gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bur gsungs pa'i phyir/ lung 'dis kyang sdug bsngal gsum dang sdug bsngal ba gsum mi 'dra bar smra ba'i kha srub med par bcad do/ /yang /bsdu bya sdud byed du 'khyer ba sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i rnam dpyod yin/zhes dang / ma khyab zer ba ni skya lam chod pa tsam gyi rnam dpyod kyang ma yin zhes bris snang ste/ de dag shes pa tsam yang min na rnam dpyod yin min gyi dogs pa ci la yod/ 'on kyang khyod kyi rnam dpyod la bltas na bskal ba snyigs pa'i yang mtha' la rnam dpyod dang bem po'i gzhi mthun zhig kyang 'byung srid tshod du snang ngo / /yang / kho bos rdo rje'i spun spa/ sgang la dgra'i dwangs mar bzung min a bu rang la sa/sal mod/ khyod kyis rang gi rdo rje'i spun gis steng 'char ka la dgra sha zhig lon na tshe 'dir me chu sa/yang sa la thug kyang rung / phyi mar dmyal ba'i zang mthil du lhung yang mi 'gyod snyam pa'i chags sdang gis kha lag dbang med du bkol te sbrang bu dang pha'i klad pa'i dpe bzhin/ 'char ka gsod 'dod kyis kun mkhyen yab sras la mda' 'phen mdung bsgrun gyi sbyor ba snyon pa'i zlos gar lta bu 'di ci'i phyir bgyis/ yang / star ka rang byon gyi lha rams pa chos can/khyod kyis kun nyon phyogs kyi rten 'brel la 'khor bas khyab pa dang / nyer len gyi phung po 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin pa dang / nyer len gyi phung

tsha 155po yin na khyod mi rtag pa khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin pas khyab pa dang / srid rtse nas mnar med pa'i bar gyi snod bcud 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal du 'dzog pa sogs re re nas khas len dgos par thal/ ris pa jubazhin rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rta nag dge 'dun blo bzadzwa/mkhas grub bstan dar ba/ byams mgon bla ma rin po che rnams kyis de dang de bzhed pa'i phyir/ 'dod na dngos 'gal dang / ma grub na mngon sum la bsnyon pa dang / ma khyab na/ rdo bis gti mug rgya mtsho chos can/dam pa de dang de'i legs bshad la khrel dang ngo tsha spangs te khyi rgan ku co 'don pa lta bu byed pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ de dang de'i gnyung gi cha shas re khas mi len pa'i phyir/ de'i khyab pa dpa' phar rgyug gi skabs khas blangs pa e dran/ yang / skyes mchog de dag dgag 'os dang smod gnas ga la yin zer ba dang / lam khrid de dang zin bris de dag la yang skyabs su mchi'o/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ/ zhes brnyas pa nang 'gal dang /kho bo'i blo gros gyi 'od snang 'di lta bu'i lam nas song na 'phags pa rnams kyi dgongs pa la 'gal 'du phra mo tsam yang 'byung ba'i gnas med ces bris pa dang / las nyon gyis skyes pa'i rigs drug sdug bden yin pa rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang paṇa chen bsod grags rnam gnyis kyi dgongs pa yin zhing de min pa kun mkhyen bla ma'i dgongs pa yin par smra ba gnyis kyang dngos 'gal te/ 'on kyang dam pa de gsum 'phags pa'i gral nas phyung ba yin na ni 'as/la ba med mchi'o/ /yang / nged nas rdo rje'i spun la dug mda' bsnun na rnam smin lci ba khyod bden mchi yang / khyed cag

156 gis rdo rje slob dpon la mda' mdung dang gartor rgyag gi las ka cig cer ne byed pa ni rnam smin de bas kyang lci zhing / khyod kyis ston pa bstan pa bla ma gsum gar bya ba mi bzad pa byas pa'i rnam smin mthong chos la de lta na phyi ma la ji lta ang / spyir bla ma sum cur nye ba bsten kyang / sangs rgyas dngos 'dra zhes pa'i phye gtor byed yul tsam las sangs rgyas dngos gcig —kyang med par blo thag rbad gyis gcod pa'i phung 'dre khyod kyi kha/ la rdo rje slob dpon dang rdo rje'i spun zhes bya ba'i tha snyad tsam yang cang e mdzes/ spyang ki'i kha dang rtswa'i dper song mi 'dug gam/ mdzub mo nang du skor cigayang sdug bsngal dang po la sdug bsngal dang las nyon gyis bskyed pa gnyis gaṇildan/ sdug bsngal gnyis pa la bde ba dang las nyon gyis bskyed pa gnyis ga ldan/ ral gris btab pa'i sdug bsngal dang zas zos ba'i bde ba gnyis la btang snyoms su 'bol ler gnas pa mi ldan pas khyod kyi ra mgo lug —sug gi dpe don de ji ltar 'grig glen pa/ glang bu ltar mig 'jur te khyod rang nyid sdod dgos byung ba e shes/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal du gyur pa'i tshor btang yin na rang nyid 'gyur mthar bde sdug gang rung skye bas khyab pa khyab pa 'du byed kyi khyab pa'i go don du rnyed pa'i rtags las khyod go stobs gzhan 'gran med par nges pa rnyed do/ /yang / 'du byed kyi don las nyon gyis rang dbang med par skyed pa dang / yang na 'du byed ces pa rang gzhan gyis 'du byed pa la bshad kyang rung ngo / /zhes pa'i khyad par de khyod rang dngos btags ma phyes pa'i dge bshes shes rab yin rshastabs shar ba ma gtogs/ gzhan sadas 'phags la yang 'char re medal

157do| /shes bya shes mdog gsob kyi stangs ka las/ /rab gsal rab 'byams gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i don/ /gti rgan gti mug bran 'dis gang smos pa/ /log lam log par bshad pa'i rgya mtshor grub/ /yang /'jog byed kyi go don mi rtag pa phra rags gnyis 'gal yang gzhag bya'i tha snyad sdug bsngal gnyis mi 'as/la bar 'dod pa khyod lta bu rigs pa smra ba'i gral du su zhig gis bos/ zhes bris pa ni rang nyid rigs pa smra ba'i gral nas khyi ro rul ba bzhin du 'don pa'i tshig ste/ — 'o na/ mtshon bya dang gcig dang mtshon bya gnyis mi 'gal ba ma yin par thal/ de gnyis kyi 'jog byed dam mtshan nyid gnyis 'gal ba'i phyir/ khyab pa song / /khyod rang cha bsdus de tsam yang ma shes par/ gdan sa chen po'i bshes gnyen skyes sbyangs rigs lam gyi nyi zla khong na 'bar ba rnams dang lhan cig ro 'tshangs brgyab pa las/ zab don rigs lam phra zhib nas smra ba la nged rang khyad du thon pa'i rang mdangs sbar mos mi khebs pa da e gosdug bsngal gsum dang de dang de'i sdug bsngal ba gsum la khyad ma phye ba'i lung rin po che'i phra tshom bsgrigs pa bzhin du gsal zhing skyes mchog mang bos dpyad gsum dag pas byi dor legs par bgyis gda' ba la/ yi ga ldog pa'i zhib cha ngan pa'i mi gtsang ba zhabs nas 'don rgyu kha nas bruton pa lung tshig rnam par dag pa de dag la bsgos te pha wang dang kha ta'i brtul zhugs sus bzung soms dang ce re long / yang / rigs pa'i gad rgyangs su/ nyan sa las 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal la sdug bsngal gzhan gnyis su ma gtogs pa zhig bzhag pa'i lung don gsal rgyas su bkral yod pa ma mthong

/ 158 bar/ dbar gyi gug gu'i cha shas re grum pa tshun chad mthong ba ni khyod kyi sgo gsum chags sdang gi bran du song ste blo mig g.yag zhar gyis rtswa za tshul lta bur gyur pa'i dan rtags las ma 'das shing / nyan sa'i lung de'i 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gang yin pa dang nes pa zur dang po dang / sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal gang yin pa dang zhes pa zur gnyis par byas pa dang / zur gsum pa'i don snga ma sa/nyis dang sgros skyon can du byas pa ni khyod rang blo zhib pa'i rnam 'gyur bla na med pa dang / de bas kyang khyod kyi lung bcos ma de nyan sa na ji bzhin mi snang ba ni khyod rang 'chos sgyur la dga' ba'i grags snyan g.yu 'brug gi skad las ldir ba don gnas kyi ngang tshul mngon sum du sgrog pa'i pho nya'o/ /ya nga / khyod kyi shes rab rdul tsam du gtong mkhan de gang du ya nga ma song / kha gang gdangs la 'jim gong dang / martso/ gang 'bur la tho ba 'phyar bzhin 'di na bzhugs gdan 'jags yod do kye lhas byin/ yang / mi rtag nyid phyir sdug bsngal na/ /zhes sogs rtog ge 'bar ba'i tshig yin na/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /zhes sogs 'grel ba don gsal gyi tshig dang / rtsa ba'i rang bzhin rnam par 'gyur min la/ /zhes sogs kun mkhyen bla ma'i gzhung tshig tu thal ba su zhig gis bzlog par nus/ a kha stong / yang khyod kyis/ sgras zin mi mthun pa'i tsher ma rtsub po/ zhes bris pa'i tsher ma la bka' dang lam rim kun rna khyen gyi legs bshad sogs 'jog bsams pa los yin ang / a sdig rgan/ yang / bla ma bla ma/ mgon po mgon po/'jam dbyangs 'jam dbyangs/ zhes mtshan nyis brtsegs zlo ba rnam
