159thar rtsog pas/ khyod rang gis bla ma ra ma/ mgon po mgon rgan/ 'jam dbyangs a 'jam red ces smos dang / nges don mkhas pa'i mdun sar ba dan bzhin 'phyar rung gi rnam thar gtsang mar 'gro shas che'o/ /yang /'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ba la sdug bsngal dang po gnyis las gzhan pa'i zag bcas shig dgos par thal/ wa rnga mar/ sdug bsngal phyi ma la dang po gnyis po rgang rung ma yin pas khyab par mdzod las/ de las gzhan zag bcas rnams nyid/ ces pa dang / mngon pa'i rgyan las/ /gnyis po de las gzhan pa'i zag pa dang bcas pa btang snyoms tshogs dang bcas pa/zhes pa 'di la shi sbar 'thams nas bsgrubs pa gang zhig mdzod rtsa 'grel 'dis tshor ba btang snyoms tsam ma yin par spyir khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ba ngos bzung ba yin pa'i phyir te/ btang snyoms tshogs dang bcas pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod mi nus te/ chu shing mar/sdug bsngal ba gsum mi 'gal ba dang / zhes dang / de dag zag bcas la 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bas khyab par gsungs ba sha stag yin par sngar rshayang dang yang du lung rigs kyis bsgrubs pa ltar yin pa'i phyir/ zhes bris 'dug pa de'i phyir/ yang / 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal rnams sdug bsngal du rtogs zhes pa'i don rnam grangs pa'i sdug bsngal du rtogs zhes pa tsam min par sdug bsngal skyed pa'i rang bzhin can du rtogs pa la bya dgos pa ni/ blo brtan gyis/ 'di skye ba dang gnas pa na yang bde ba ma yin zhing sdug bsngal ma yin la/ de'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir 'gyur ba nyid kyisda bde pa dang sdug bsngal dag las gang yang rung ba mngon du gyur

160pa na gnyis ka srid kyi/ zhes gsungs pa 'dir shin tu gsal mod/khyod lung de rdzig rdzig byas nas 'dren pa tsam lasga/ de'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i don la ce re long du song gda' 'o/ /yang khyod kyis/ 'di rnam grangs kyis sdug bsngal du ston dgos pa'ang ngo bo bde ba yin pa la thug pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / yid du mi 'ong ba'i bum pa sdug bsngal du gzhung du mar gsungs par yang bshad do/ /'o na/yid du mi 'ong ba'i bum pa de sdug bsngal dngos dang rnam grangs pa'i sdug bsngal gang du gsungs/ phyi ma ltar na de yang tshor bde yin pa la thug par thal lo/ /yang / 'dzam gling na nga 'dra srid pa khyod bden yang / zhe nang can gyi khrod na nga 'dra med thag rbad kyis chod de/ gzhi byes gnyis ka nas kun mkhyen las kyang kun mkhyen du btsal te rnyed pa'i a pho'i bzo sta mig mthong lag zin 'di ka yin pas so/ /yang / bstan dgra drag las kyis ma bsgral na so thar dang 'gal ba ni khyod rang 'dul ba la mkhas rtags sam lhas byin gyi bcas pa'i nang tshan ci rigs shig yin 'dra la/ bla med spyi dang dus 'khor lugs gyi rtsa ltung bcu bzhi pa gnyis yin khyab mnyam min yang ngo bo la khyad par med pa la yin par bshad pa ni gsang sngags la mkhas pa dang / nged cag gis rgan zhugs zhes smos pas kaurnyi n+ya chen po sogs la skyon brjod du 'gro la/ khyod kyis chung zhugs zhes smos pas sgra gcan 'dzin sogs la skyon brjod du mi 'gro ba khyod rang grwa sa'i dge bshes yin pa'i dmigs bsal yin mchi/ de bas khyod kyis kho bo rdo rje'i spun la dgra bo'i dwangs mar bzung yang sdom pa dang mi 'gal pa'i zab chos shig

161yod par nges shing / lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gi yongs 'dzin bdag cag gi thams cad mkhyen pa la bzod du med pa'i mnar sems 'chang pa'i blo sna de 'dra rnyed pa ni mi tsher gzhung lugs la sbyangs pa'i dngos grub bla na med pa'o/ /de bas na/ bud med khyo gsum 'grims pa dang / /bya ni rnyi las shor ba dang / /ban btsun chos las dred pa gsum/ /g.yo yi nang na de gsum ngan/ /zhes pa 'don pa'i dus la babs/ sa steng na 'jigs sa re yod na legs mod/ bsdu ba zhes pa'i 'bru 'grel tsam yang mi thon pa'i dgag yig mkhan po lta bu la su zhig 'jigs/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gdong nas sdod nus yod mi dgos/ yod na/ shi ba'i sdug bsngal shi srid pas mi myong bar thal/ shi srid 'gag pa shi ba'i sdug bsngal grub pa dus mnyam yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal yang de dag las byung ba'i tshor ba sdug bsngal kho na la byed dgos pa gnad kyi don po ste zhes log bshad las smras pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/'jam dbyangs la phyi rgol byed pa gang du bros/ yang / skye ba las byung ba'i tshor ba sdug bsngal de la skye pa'i sdug bsngal zhes tshig sdud kyis gsungs pa yin gyi skye ba kho rang skye ba'i sdug bsngal yin pa'i don ga la yin zhes bris snang ste/ de la 'o na/ las nyon gyis skyes ma thag pa'i gang zag gi rgyud na skye ba'i sdug bsngal med par thal/ skye ba dang skye ba'i sdug bsngal gyi grub rim de 'thad pa'i phyir/ yang / 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la sdug bsngal gyis khyab par thal/ skye ba'i sdug bsngal la sdug bsngal gyis khyab pa gang zhig de gnyis shin tu mtshungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'khor ba'i sdug

162bsngal rgyud la yod pa'i gang zag yin na tshor ba sdug bsnga la rgyud la yod pa'i gang zag yin pas khyab par thal/ khyod kyi zhe 'dod ngan pa deṭāphyir/ 'dod na/ yig char/ sdug bsngal byas tshad tshor ba la mi byed—pa'i phyir/ zhes pa la khyod kyis sus kyang ma thon pa'i nus 'don gyi stangasahoka byed pa mi 'thad par thal/ khyod kyi shes bya sgog rdung gi rigs pa de—'thad pa'i phyir/ yang / 'phags pas skye dang rga ba dang / /'chi ba'i sdug bsngal rtsad nas spangs/ /zhes pa'i sdug bsngal la'ang tshor ba kho na 'jog par thal/ khyod kyi shing thams cad pe tor smra 'dra'i rigs pa de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rgyud bla'i 'grel ba de snyed du de la tshor ba kho na bzhag gam/ skye sogs de dang de ji5nga bzhag ltos shig des mtshon nas skye ba las byung ba'i sdug bsngal skye ba'i sdug bsngal yin la 'gyur ba las byung ba'i sdug bsngal 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal min par 'dod pa'ang dngos 'gal du ngo shes par gyis/ yang / sdug bsngal brgyad dang drug dang gsum bsgom par gsungs pa'ang sdug bden bsgom pa dngos gsungs pa yin gyi 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsgom par gsungs pa min zer ba'ang byang chub lam rim la than skyel ba'i ngan skad thar 'dod kyi rna ba'i dug chu kho na'o/ /yang / dngos btags phye ma phye zer ba zhig gis /ba sna gnyis ka bkang 'dug pa ni hwa shang gi yod min med min gyi tshig bzhin du bstan pa'i 'gong 'drer gsar du slebs pa ste/ gzhan du na bka' dang dgongs 'grel ci rigs par de lta'i tshig lan gcig 'byung 'os pas so yang /nged tshos lo drug tu phar phyin dang / zhag lnga brgyar lam rim gyi 'chad

163nyan byas pa nges par skal ba bzang ste/ mdo dbus su lo bzhi bcu lhag sbyangs kyang bden bzhi'i shog ldeb nyi shu yang ma nges shing / don bsdu ba dang / gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba'i khyad par tsam yang ma phyed pa dang /kun btus dang / bsdu ba'i dbu phyogs tsam yang btegs ma myong ba tsho las ches lhag pas so/ /rje thams cad mkhyen pas zla ba bcur bar ma cad par rgyud sde gsung dus su bla slob thams cad kyis gsol ja tsam yang ma bzhes nga ra khog stong du bzhugs pa'i blo skyed shes rab rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng ji/yo ba khyod las gzhan su zhig gis sbyin/ yang / sdug bsngal yin par thal/ sdug bsngal ba yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ zhes kyang bris 'dug ste/ nged kyi nye 'khor gyi no tsos kyang de 'dra khas mi len na/rig rtsal ya med kyi dga' bo spun drug gi sus de 'dra khas blangs/ lhas byin/ yang / sdug bsngal ba yin pa'i phyir zhes gsungs pa'i tshig gi nus pa 'di snang chung bya mi rigs/ zhes pa dang / las nyon gyi lag rjes su gyur pa'i zag bcas thams cad 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal zhes rang phyogs kyi skyes mchog gong ma rnams kyis gsungs pa'i tshig nus la snang chung ci nus su byed pa rang mgo dum bur 'gas pa'i dngos 'gal rdo rje pha lam dang /yang / rtsod yig phag spyon rtsom pa po sdug bsngal ba yin pa'i rtags grub ste/ las nyon gyi gzhan dbang can yin pa'i phyir/ zhes brjod nas/srid pa'i bcud kyi sems can sdug bden ma yin par bshad pa ni rang mgo rdo drungs nas gcod pa'i dngos 'gal spu gri'i 'khor lo'o/ /yang / sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal rtsod gzhir bzung bas sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal la

164 tshor bas khyab pa shes na/ bum pa rtsod gzhir bzung bas shes bya la gser bum gyis khyab pa yang khyod kyis shes par gyis shig yang / blo gros zhan pa'i 'dod gtam dang / /zhes sogs mgo bo na na'i bar du tshan che bar drangs pa wa sdar ma'i ngang tshul tsam du zad de/ des kyang da dung mi tshim na lugs kyi bstan bcos go tshad rig tshad thams cad mtshams 'dir bkod na rang snang rdzo ba dang rigs mthun glen pa'i tshos/sa las rtsam gtor lon pa'i thabs su 'gyur ro/ /yang / rmongs mo'i bu/ tshig rtsub ma smra zhig zer ba'i dpe bzhin/ dkyus ma las bdag bstod gzhan smod sum 'gyur gyis mang brjod bzhin du gzhan la bdag bstod gzhan smod byed pa zhes kha khengs khengs su smra ba ni rang skyon lta ba la dmus long gi ngang tshul du song bar zad do/ /yang / kun shes pa'i dbang por gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gnyis re re nas chos can/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin par thal/ sdug bsngal ba yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ rtags grub ste/ chos can de'i phyir te/ de yod pa'i phyir zhes bris 'dug mod/kho bo ni de 'dra'i tshor ba sdug bsngal de sdug bsngal yin yang sdug bsngal ba yin par gtan nas mi'adod pas khyod kyis de sgrub par shugs skyed dgos rgyu la/ chos can de'i phyir/ de yod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa tsam las 'god rgyu ma byung bas/ gzhi rtags tha dad med pa'i rigs pa de 'dras gzhan 'dod kyi rgyal mtshan sreg re byed pa'i khyod kyi mkho che'i snye ral ngan pa de khyi lud skam pos gang ba'i dus shig spyang e 'byung ang / de'i rtsa rtags ma grub par ma zad/ khyod rang gi chos can de chos can de yin pa

165dang / chos can de yod na chos can de yin pas khyab pa gnyis sgrubs dang rang nyid kyang rang la yi ga ldog pa zhig 'byung bar nges so yang lam rim gyi bde sdug gang yang ma yin pa'i gnas ngan len du gtogs pa'i lus zhes pa'i lus de chos can/ zag tshor btang snyoms yin par thal 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin pa'i phyir te/ stong bshad las/ de'i skabs kyi lus de 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal la byed dgos pa'i phyir/ zhes bris 'dug ya de'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod mi nus te/ de 'dra'i lus de gzugs yin pa'i phyir te/ stong bshad las/ lus zhes gsungs pa'i tshig gi nus pa yod pa'i phyir te/ de dngos btags ma phye bar nyer len gyi gzugs phung la gsungs pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes bris pa de'i phyir/ gzhan yang / mtshan gzhir tshor ba re bzung ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas sdug bsngal gsum la tshor bas khyab par bzung ba ni rang nyid phongs pa'i ngang tshul tsam du zad do/ /'gran zla med pa'i dge bshes yin rlom dang / /rang gi yig cha tsam yang mi nges 'gal/ /lung rigs mang po'i rgyab dpung yod skad dang / /ba sgra tsam la shi spar 'thams pa 'gal/ /sdug bsngal ba yi bden pa yin pa dang / /sdug bsngal bden pa min par 'dod pa 'gal/ /sdug bsngal ba ni sdug bden sgrub byed dang / /—de la sdug bsngal bden pyom khyab 'gal/ /las nyon gnyis gyi gzhan dbang yin pa dang / /sdug bsngal ba min zer ba lhag par 'gal/ / de de'i sdug bsngal de yi sdug bsngal bas/ /sgrub dang de yi dngos khyab cho rtswa grub 'gal/ /ha sa badzra yid 'ong yin pa dang / /yid du 'ong

166la tshor bas khyab pa 'gal/ /yid mi 'ong la sdug bsngal dgos pa dang //gis steng 'char ka yid mi 'ong ba 'gal/ /'du byed sdug la shes mi sa khyab pa dang / /gzugs su gyur pa'i 'du byed sdug bsngal 'gal/ / blo bzang la ni blo yis khyab pa dang / /tshe dpag med pa gang zag yin pa 'gal/ /blo bzang blo dang grags par sgras khyab na/ /blo bzang grags pa'i yin pa 'jog pa 'gal/ /blo bzang grags pa'i yin pa mi 'dod na/ /khyod rang dge lugs 'gong 'dre min pa 'gal/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i rang sdug gi khur chen po rin gyis nyos pa'o/ / la nga mdzod las/ /chos shes bya ba'i spyod yul ni/ /zhes dang / 'grel ba rnams su'ang chos shes zhes 'byung mod/ khyod kyis de log par bcos te/ chos nes bya ba'i spyod yul ni/ /zhes drangs pa/ sa mthar dmigs bsal zhes ma gtogs/ /zhes pa'i rna thos shig gis 'khrul gzhi byas pa'am/ yang na 'chos sgyur gyi ngan lam grog mor dod pa'i rang shugs la song ba gor ma chag la/ rang gi rgyur gyur pa'i nyer len yod par thal/mdzod las/ chos zhes bya ba'i spyod yul ni/ /zhes pa nas/ lung—mtha' yas pa yod pa'i phyir/ zhes sdug khur du mi theg pa'i 'brel med kyi sgrub byed de 'bral dbugs chad chad du ngal ba bsten pa las/ gzhi grub na rang gi rgyur gyur ba'i nyer len yod pas khyab par thal/ mdo las/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ/ zhes sa/sungs pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/zhes bris na ngal ba dang snag shog gi gron chung ngo / /rang smras yig cha'i—srog la rgol ba dang / /phyogs snga smra la ci yang mi gnod 'gal/ /

167rigs pa smra pa'i seng ge yin pa dang / /'phangs tshad ltag chod kho na ra song ba 'as/la/ /lha ldan rab 'byams smra ba yin pa dang / /lung don log 'grel 'ba' zhig byed pa 'gal/ /dngos med chos rnams don byed nus stong dang / /rang 'dzin shes pa'i dmigs rkyen byed pa 'gal/ /rnam mkhyen zag med shes pa'i mthar thug dang / /nyon mongs tshogs las dngos su skyes pa 'gal/ /tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i lag rjes mthar thug ཿsneng / /dug lngas bskyed pa'i gzhi mthun yin pa 'gal/ /rgyu las 'bras bu snga bar khas blangs nas/ /nang ba'i rang lugs 'dzin par 'dod pa 'gal/ /sdug bsngal ma lus skyed pa'i gzhi rtsa dang / /skyabs gnas mthar thug gnyis kyi gzhi mthun 'gal/ /lam bden zag med bden par smra bzhin du/ /nyon mongs skyed pa'i nus pa can 'dod 'gal/ /bden 'dzin rnam mkhyen 'bras bu ma yin na/ /rnam mkhyen bden 'dzin dmigs rkyen yin pa 'as/la/ /bden 'dzin rnam mkhyen med par mi 'byung na/ /sems can rgyud la bden 'dzin skye ba 'gal/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i nang 'gal gyi phung po sas mi theg pa de yang rtsid thag nag po dgu bsgril gyis ske la bcings te khur cig gzhan yang / khyod kyis dus 'khor bsdus rgyud kyi lung chad lhag nor ba'i skyon gsum ldan du byas nas drangs pa ni/ rgyud rang nyid kyi glegs bam tsam yang ma mthong bar yig nor rgyun 'byams kyi tsadape rnying ser kog ma gzhan zhig tu bris pa mthong ste brtag dpyad med par khyi dang glo ba phrad pa bzhin du bris pa'am/ yang na rang gis 'di 'dra'i

168zhus chen mdzad zin gang rigs las mi 'da' 'o/ /bsdus rgyud kyi/ 'khor ba dag tu rnam pa gsum po gang byas sngon gyi las ni 'bras bu rab tu sbyin par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i lung don yang / bde sdug dbang phyug sogs kyis sbyin 'phrog byed pa min par rang rang gi sngon byas las gyis sbyin pa la bya yi/ khyod ltar bde sdug rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag gis rang gi shes rgyud dang 'brel bar bskyed pa dang / bde sdug gang zag raja gis 'byin pa lung de'i don ma yin te/ de lta na rgyu 'bras dus mnyam srid pa 'byung ba la sogs pa'i skyon gyis reg par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gnas 'di rnams su ro yi 'gro bar skye bo 'khor te las kyi zhags pas nges par bcings pa dag /ces pa'i don yang / srid pa bcu bzhi'i gnas rnams su rigs drug tu skye bo rnam shes kyi chos can rnams 'khor te/ las zhags kyis bcings pa dag skye ba du mas thar par 'akro zhing grol ba min pa'i phyir rsha zhes pa yin gyi/ gzhan du/ 'khor ba la lam gsum gyi skye rgyun gyis khyab pa dang / 'ching byed la phung po dang 'pho chags 'jog pa sogs de dag gis e bstan 'grel ba 'grel bshad dang bcas par ltos shig dus 'khor gyi phyogs la pha mes bu rgyud dang bcas pamo khyim bcu gnyis kyi rnam bzhag 'khrul med du shod pa'ang dka' bar snang na/ rmongs bu khyod la phyi nang gzhan gsum sbyar ba thun min dus kyi 'khor lo smra ba'i res ma babs te/phyogs 'gro tsam re shes par 'dod na'ang kho bo cag gi mdun sar gus chapas snyogs shig yang bzhi brgya pa'i/ gang tshe 'bras bu gcig gi yang //zhes pa'i mtshams sbyar gyi gzhung snga 'grel du bshad pa ni/ gser 'phreng

169las mtshams sbyar gyi gzhung gang yin snga 'grel du byed mi rigs par gsungs pa las bsam bzhin du brgal ba gdon mi za'o/ /yang / rang la bskor tshe/ rgyu 'bras skye 'chi 'khor ba'i rtsa ba ni/ /zhes pa lta bus 'khor ba lasalam gsum skye 'chi'i rgyud mos khyab pa bstan par 'dod pa dang / yang / de 'a dra'i rigs kyis lam gsum gang rung la 'khor bas khyab pa bstan par mi 'dod pa nang 'gal lo/ /rdzogs byed las kyi rnam smin nyer phung dang / /'alor bar 'phangs 'bras kho nas khyab pa 'gal/ /nyon mongs can sems 'khor ba yin pa dang / /ma rig sred sogs 'khor ba min pa 'gal/ /bcu ba srid pa srid pa yin pa dang //'khor bar bcu gcig skye bas khyab pa 'gal/ /'khor byed las nyon srid pa min pa dang / /bcu pa srid pa 'khor ba yin pa 'gal/ /las kyi kun nyon 'khor ba yin gyur na/ — /nyon mongs kun nyon 'khor ba min pa 'gal/ /kun nyon de gnyis 'khor ba yin 'dod na/ /'khor bar kun nyon tha mas khyab pa 'gal/ /kun nyon gsum po 'khor los mtshon mnyam la/ /nang gses 'khor ba yin min phye ba 'gal/ /srid pa'i dbye bar srid pa bdun bshad bzhin/ /de la bcu gcig skye bsacekhyab pa 'gal/ /bar srid 'alor ba'i bye brag yin pa dang / /'khor bar rten 'brel bzhi pas khyab pa 'gal/ /skye 'chi'i rgyun la 'khor bsabyukhyab pa dang / /kun nyon gsum la 'khor ba yin min 'gal/ /skye 'chi brgyud mar byas kun 'khor ba dang / /so skye phal ba 'khor bar mi 'dod 'gal/ /gang zag yin pa'i sdug bden med pa dang / /'khor

170bar blang bya len po gnyis phye 'gal/ /'phen byed las kyis 'phangs pa'i gang zag dang / /sdug bden min pa'i gzhi mthun bzhag pa 'gal/ /'gro ba so sor 'khor ba'i gang zag dang / /'khor bar gyur pa'i sdug bden min pa 'gal/ /'khor bar blang bya'i phung pos khyab pa dang / /len po'i gang zag 'khor bar bsgrubs pa 'gal/ /las nyon dbang gis skyes pa sdug bden dang / /des bskyed gang zag sdug bden min pa 'as/la//longs sku gtan du thar ba'i sangs 'phags dang / /skye 'chi'i rgyud du nan gyis bsgrubs pa 'gal/ /rang ming ci 'dri yid brtan med bzhin du/ /hre bo'i ming la zhus dag gtong ba 'gal/ /mgo dang ming gzhi'i khyad kyang mi thon par/ /lo chen thon mi'i rlom sems 'chang ba 'gal/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i rang sdug gi khur bo glang chen gyis mi 'drongs pa 'gong rgan byi ba col chung gi phrag par phab pa dang bzhes gyis la tsig tsig gi sgra tsam yang 'byin rgyu med par leb leb mor bzhugs shig ༈ /kye deng dus kyi 'jam dbyangs thon mi 'a paṃs/ khyod kyi kha lag sems gsum 'khrul ba'i rnam 'gyur nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba bzhin du cung zhig ston pas ltos shig stong bshad du/ cung zad/ gzhibs/ma bslab/ las/ min cing / sre bo/ zang zing / zhu dag bstar/ldog thong rtsa/ rol ba/ lag nom gyi/ dad gus kyi/ tha tshig go skyed pa/ skyed pa/ ming gi rnam grangs/ so so ba ni/ gsar 'thom/las 'gyur pa'i/ nyid du 'gyur ro/ /bcad lhug chos can nyid 'in/ myang bar byed/ zang zing dang mnyam/ 'dre lu/ snyon/ bsam

171pa'i phyir/ sbo/ /sgreg pa/ shigs shigs/ sgro/ /rnams kyi bsngags/reb kong / mkhan po/ de dag sgrub tu/ sgrub rgyu/ phral/ lo/ e go/snyon ma 'ding / yin no/ bsam na/ nus pa/ smyug cing /dang sdug bsngal/ sdug bsngal med/ sgom tshul/ yin/ /bzhi dang /tshol ba'i tshogs/ tsha rnon/ ji dgar/ smin ma zang zing / sleb na/ skyon tshol/ che grags/ wa yi/ ji dgar/ ri tshad las rgal/'thom/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsnga'ag dkyogs/ las ma grol/ sdug bsngal ba'o/ sdong bo mchog mtsho/ /mi zad/ rdzi ba'i/ ce re 'gyur/ zhig de'i/ yin te/ ji dgar/ snyon/ tshol dgos/blta ba'i yid/ bcud du 'dzags/ g.yang la mchong / da ltar ba'i/byed pas na/ de gnyis/ 'dod chags dang / srid pa/ snyon/ drang gis mi lang / tshol tshul/ che cher/ zab rnon/ thob par 'gyur/rigs 'gros/ gzhigs/ sre bo/ 'thung ba'i/ gshongs/ snyon/snyon/ thog ma dbus/ gsum po sngon/ rab tu 'byin/ re zhig 'khyam/gtang bar bya ste/ 'chi bas gtses pa dang / smre sngags/ bcu'o/snyon 'ding / bgrang bas/ tshogs nas/ rgyun mi chad/ rgyud mar 'khor/ byed do/ myong mi 'gyur/sne tshol dgos/ ma bslab/ stsal ba/ sem can/ 'gags pa'i 'chi ba/ 'gags pa/ rtser rgal ba/bskur bas/ mchong sar wa ma chong / thob byed/ snyon 'ding / byi'i blo'i/ smra brjod/ thongs/ gur gum/ ma sleb/ rdzun rlabs/ce na/ de'i bzhi bar/ byos shig lang 'tsho/ chos de 'dra/ de'i

172 ra gnyis bar/ 'khor lo/ /sa de'i steng na/ dngos po/ /ra lngapar/ mi zad pa'i rin po che'i gter gyi kha phye ba/ lang tsho/ /lang tsho / /sre po'i/ sre bo/ sre bor/ rdo phyir 'brang / gur gum/zhes bris pa dang / yang khyod kyis bskur ba'i yi ger/ bsgyur ba'i/rdzun rlabs/ 'dzags pa/ sre bo'i/ 'phrul sel/ ched mngags lha'i me tog rigs pa'i dpyad/ bcas khyon brgya dang lnga bcu lhag byung ba dang / gzhan yang khyod kyis/ seng ge la ye shes/ gang du la gang su/ston pa la bstan pa/ 'grogs la 'phrog rin chen la rig 'dzin/ bza' la bstan/ phags la phed/ 'khus phyir la 'khrug spyir/ gnyis la gsum/ ma bslangs la ma blang / bzhi la gsum/ pa lha mchog la sa lha mchog 'di gnyis la 'di nyid/ karka ṭa la ka ka ra/ mdor bsdus la mdo lta bu/ brtan pa la bstan pa/ tshe 'di la tshe tshad/ tha skar la tha snyad/ sa yi la pa yi/ stongacipa la sde pa/ go sla la go la/ rdo yi rta la rdo rje'i rta/ skabs gsum pa la skabs gnyis pa/ a dra la a bzhi/ tshogs la chogs/ bong bu la bung bu/ pe bo la se po/ khrag sa phrag brdeg la bteg dud mo la dung mo byas pa lta bu 'di dag ni khyod yig ma dag pa'i rgya mtsho chen po las chu thigs tsam zhig rang sdug rang gis rī nyos pa'i kha snon du byin par zad kyi/ ma nas bshad sgrub kyi bya ba rgya cher bgyid du yod pa'i dus su 'di 'dra'i rigs kyi spros g.yengatre byed pa la ji ltar spro/ spyir yig tshogs lci ba dang mig dang sems kyis non dka' ba gang cis ci 'dra'i dag tshad du rtsi ba'i rigs la'ang ma dag pa gtan mi

ri 173 'chor ba ni mi srid pa lta bu yin pas ma dag pa de tsam byung yang cher mi skyon mod/ 'on kyang khyod nyid la mtshang du che ste/ deng skabs bod yu9 gangs can gyi ljongs na 'jam dbyangs thon mi dang 'dra bar grags shing /grags pa ltar dang bzhes kyi rlom pa dang 'gran zla med pa'i zhus chen gyi khur bsnams pa dang / nged cag la bden rdzun gnyis bsres kyis ma dag par bzos pa 'dis sa rim pa bdun gyi 'og las slar ldang ba med par byas nyams kyi khengs pa ngom ngom byed pa dang / rlom pa ha cang thal drags pas brgal lan ma grub pa'i skabs nyid nas kyang kho bos yi ge la ma dag pa mang du smras yod tshul ngo sor 'khyer ba'i lab yig mdo smad kyi skul ba po so so la springs pa sogs drod chung gi rang bzhin ma hā paṇḍi ta'i rnam thar tshod med du bathung bas so/ /drod chung mi yi spre'u 'di/ /rang smras rang gi g.yang sa la/ /lhung tshe rang gi rigs mthun rnams/ /'tshogs pa'i ngud mo 'brug sgra'i spun/ /rang nyid nas brdzun lab mang du byas spyang rdzu 'gebs kyi gos thul rang grol du song ste gcer bur phyung ba ni/ ra nga hid kyis kun gling tshong dpon la las bcol te 'di ka'i rtsod yig par ma chu sprel lor khyer ba la chu bya'i lor sku 'bum pa dge rgyam nas ched du byin khul dang / chu bya'i zla nang lag tu chud de lan de'i ston grub khus byas kyang / chu bya'i lo de nyid brtsams grub pa'i lo snga ma yin pa ni/ brgal lan rang du/ snga lo dpal gdong chu bya la/ /zhes bris pa rang 'phongs brje ba'i 'gal 'dur song ba dang / phag lo'i dpyid bkra shis 'khyil du yi ge bskur par da dung ma shes par yod tshulha lab pa dang / rang tsha

174 rang yul du slebs pa sogs kyi ngag las spyang de bzhin du smras pa 'di nyid las so/ /yang / kha sgang dang lhas byin gnyis kyis chags sdang dang phrag dog gis rdo rje'i spun 'char ka la dgrar bzung nas 'khon yig ci dgar spel ba ngag kyal du mi 'gro ba'i shesabyed du/ stong bshad las/ kun—gzigs lnga pa chen mo'i phar phyin du ser 'bras kyi yig cha gzhan 'ga' zhig ngag kyal min tsam du gsungs pa'i don yang ma go ba'i skyon nes phran la bkyon mchid gnang gda' ste/ 'di ni bod ljongs lugs gnyis kyi bde skyid rgya mtsho ltar bskyil ba po rang cag gi ma ma lta bu'i phyag na padmo de nyid la bsam bzhin mchod pa zhig 'bul 'dod 'dra minatswan bdag gis lung rdzide'i don dang kho bo la gnod byed du 'gro lugs ji bzhin pa zhig ma 'tshal bas/ kun gzigs mchog gi 'phrin spas kyi gdugs 'degs pa nyid nas dgrol bar zhu/ zur yig tu'ang / mgo'i sdeb sbyor dang mjug gi rtsom dus tsam la'ang rtogs pa don med kyi spros shom bod srid sangs rgyam sogs kyi lad mo sha thon rus thon bgyis pa/ zhes bka' bkyon drag po gnang ba'ang ma 'tshal te/ gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang gi lugs gnyis kyi shing rta'i srol 'byed chen po mi rje 'jam pa'i dbyangs burta'i zhal snga nas kyi mdzad srol la mig ltos cha tsam yang bya dka' ba las phran re thon na nga nga mkhas pa'i rnam 'gyur ches khyad par du 'phags pa zhig yin snyam yang /khyod ni seng ge'i khog zhugs kyi srin bu lcags kyi mchu can gyi reng bzhin la gshis nas dgyes stabs/ sngar yang lugs gnyis khrims srol gyi ra ba las rnam par 'gongs pa'i bdag rkyen spam ma tho ba spyi bos nod dgos byung bar

1150ma zad da dung de bas kyang mtho ba gnang 'os mchi ste/ mi rje 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mardzod srol la bzod du med pa'i smod tshig drag tu byas pas so//'di yang go bar bya ste/ gzhu mkhan sā la'i kho nya mo/ /mda' mkhan zur phud lnga pa'i lha/ /mda' 'phen mkhan gis steng 'char ka ste/ /'been ri rab yin yang thal bar rlog /ces so/ /smras pa/ gling bzhi ri rab rgya mtsho bcas/ /'dzin mas theg la mtshar ci yod/ /'di na 'gal ba stong gi khur/ /mi rgan gcig gis khur la ltos/ /bde sogs rtse ba'i sa 'dzin gyi/ /phrag la rta bdun shing rta las/ /kye hud rang gi byang khog las/ /byung ba'i mi gtsang 'degs la ltos/ /dran pa rku ba'i myos byed la/ /'thungs pas bla rdol mtshar ma yin/ /rgyal mtshan dkar po'i lha rams pa/ /spyo tshig bla rdolasmra la ltos/ /khyi dang phag pas gang byung lud/ /za ba rang si/ zas la 'thu/ /dri chen dri chu spod za ba/ /chen po 'di ni ci yis nongs/ /grwa sa nor bu'i gling nyid nas/ /mi gtsang 'khur ba'i ded dpon 'di/ /go rīs dmod pas bskrun min na/ /yid srubs pho nya las gzhan su/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rje ma nongs na/ /khyod dang 'gras pa'i lhas byin 'di/ /bstan la thub chod 'di lta bas/ /rnam shes ye shes zhing du drongs/ /da ni 'bel gtam yun ring bgyis pa'i mthar 'di skad kyang smra bar bya ste/ yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po lha ldan smon rams pa shes rab mtshan can lags nas/ ji skad du/ bstod pas dga' bar mi 'gyur la/ /smad pas mi dgar mi 'gyur zhing / /rang gi yon tan

176 legs gnas pa/ /skye bo dam pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ /zhes pa'i don phyag tu bstar ngos legs par bshad pa'i tshogs 'di rigs bstan 'gror phan pa'i gsos sman dam par spel ba'i thugs dgongs rab tu yangs pa dang / bstan bcos 'di mthong thos kyi yul du gyur pa rnams nas kyang /ji skad du/ legs bshad don ni gzhan las kyang / /bdag nyid legs par 'dod pas blang / /nyi ma sa steng mig ldan la/ /kun gyi spyi mthun ma yin nam/ /shes bka' stsal ba ltar chags sdang 'phel pa'i thabs su mi 'khyer bar legs par bshad pa'i don tshul bzhin du len pa dang / /dpang du lhags pa rnams kyang gshegs par bzhedabyutshe legs par bshad pa'i me tog gi phreng ba ring bo rnams dgyes bzhes bka' drin che dgos zhu zhing / rtsod rigs mdzes pa'i yan lag ku re dang kyal ka'i rnam pa gang—thal don gtam du mi bzung ste/ nged gnyis legs par bshad pa'i 'bel gtam gyis phan tshun snying nye ba'i mdza' sde pang nas skyes dang nye rgyal bzhin du gnas pa ni/ ji skad du/ pang nas skyes dang nye rgyal ji bzhin du/ /dge zhing das pa'i thugs mnga' khyed dang bdag /su yis thog mar bdud—rtsi thob pa des/ /gcig shos la ni bgo bsha' bgyid par smon/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /nged cag la yul mdo smad kyi drug sde zhes yang yang bzla sa pa yang bka' drin che ste/ /me tog phreng rgyud las/ so ga'i dusarshan mtha' med pa'i/ /rgya mtshor 'jug pa ji bakhyi/na du/ /gang gis dngadzhapor 'dul ba la/ /tshul khrims dri ma sbyong mjad pa/ /drug sde bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /ngo mtshar bcas pa'i spobs pa can/ /mtshon

177 —pa med kyang grub pa de/ /bzang bo de dag drang srong che/ /dga' bo nye dga' 'gro mgyogs dang / /'char ka bdun pa nab so ste/ /mkhas pa dpa' bo drug sder grags/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa srung bar mdzad/ /slar yang de dag shin tu bzang / /rab bsngags mun pa'ajoms byed pa/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis gang ltar yang / /'dul ba las ni 'da' mi byed/ /sangs rgyas sras su gang gyur pa/ /de dag yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /ces ngo mtshar ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa bzhin du dpa' bo drug sde ji lta ba de ltar bstan pa la bya ba rgya cher bgyid pa la nged cag 'khor dang bcas pas smon pa snying nas 'cha'o/ /yang sgos bdag cag la 'char ka zhes pa'i ming gi cod pan yid 'phrog pa zhig gnang ba ni sangs rgyas kyi mthu yin par nges te/ 'char ka chen po ni khyim pa 'dul ba rnams kyi mchog tu lung bstan cing bstan pa ltar legs mdzad lhun gyis grub pa de bzhin du bdag kyang phas rgol 'dul ba'i mchog tu sgra bsgrags shing bsgrags pa ltar don rab tu 'grub pa'i rten 'brel ma bsgrigs rang 'grig gi tshul du grub pa yin no/ /de ltar 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgra dbyangs 'jigs pa med par seng ge rnam par khros pa'i nga ror bsgrags pas phyogs kyi phas rgol ma lus pa'i log rtog gi myos bum dum bur bkas/mkhas pa'i mkhas pa mtha' yas pa'i snying la kun tu dges pa'i bdud rtsi ci yang spel/ blo gsal )ོna gnyer gyi mtshan nyid rgyan du 'phyor ba'i skal ba bzang po rnams gang 'tsham legs bshad kyis rjes su bzung ste thub pa'i bstan pa mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan nam mkha' ji srid du 'dzin par snying nas

178smon phyir/ ji skad du/ bdag gi 'chad rtsod rtsom pa seng ge'i sgras/ /log smra'i wa tshogs spobs pa phrogs byas nas/ /gang gis 'dul ba'i thabs kyis rjes bzung ste/ /mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin par shog /ces gsungs pa bzhin brjod par bya'o/ /smras pa/ dpal ldan lung rtogs mi zad rin chen gyis/ /yongs su gtams pa'i rlabs kyi 'gyu ba yang / /phan bde nor bu'i do shal rab g.yo ba/ /rgyal bstan rgya mtsho che las gzhan na gang / /'phral dang yun gyi dbul ba kun bcil nas/ /rang dang gzhan gyi re ba cig car du/ /yongs su skong ba'i ded dpon 'ga' mchis na/ /brtson pa'i gru rdzings de las gang du skyod/ /de phyir rnam dpyod gser gyi gru bo che/ /thub bstan chu gter phang la bdas pa na/ /kun yid 'gugs pa'i nor bu'i phreng ba 'di/ /kho bos rnam dpyod dpung ba brkyangs nas sbyin/ /me tog sdug gu'i gar gyi ri mo yis/ /legs bris snying la kun dga'i tshor ba bzhin/ /'di yis rab dga' dpyid kyi pho nya pas/ /gzur gnas yid ni rgya chen bde bas gang / /phyogs su lhung ba rgol ba'i don snying ni//mya ngan mche ba stug pos zin pa'i khrag /gdong lag mchi mas gsher dang lhan cig pa/ /bdag gir thob pa rang rang las kyis so/ /dam pa'i legs bshad nyi ma'i 'od dpung gis/ /blo mig ldongs pa nub phyogs 'byung bo'i bya/ /gang las mched pa than skad than pa'i me/ /ting 'dzin chu yi 'khrul 'khor 'di yis gzhil/ /'jam dpal rol ba'i ting 'dzin 'i/ /ngo mtshar ma thu nus bsam mi khyab/ /gang phyir sdigs mdzub

179gcig gis kyang / /gnam sa yang ni bla 'og sgyur/ /ba spu'i rtse mo re re yis/ /stong gsum mkha' la rdul bzhin 'degs/ /kha yi dbugs rlung phra mo yis/ /ri rab lhun po bye mar byed/ /lus skyes phra mo'i bu gar yang / /chu gter rnam bzhi lhag med bskyil/ /rkang mthil sor mo re re yis/ /dregs pa'i lha rnams 'dam ltar brdzi/ /bzhad sgra tsam gyis gshin rje yi/ /don snying 'bras yos ltar du 'gas/ /lta stangs tsam gyis lus med pa'i/ /yan lag bzhi yi dpung tshogs byed/ /sor mo gcig gis gnod sbyin 'bum/ /sa la byis pa bzhin du sbab/ /rigs pa'i gad rgyangs gcig gis ni/ /phas rgol stong gi klad pa 'gems//thal ngag 'thor rlung phra mos kyang / /stong gsum rtsi rkyang bzhin du 'dar//'khor gsum zhags pa ring bo yis/ /rigs pa'i dpa' po ma lus 'ching //dpyad gsum dag pa'i lung rigs kyis/ /thub bstan rdzogs ldan mgron du bsu/ /phyogs kyi ral pa'i gdengs ka la/ /ngo mtshar gsar ba'i me tog rgod/ /de phyir bskal ba'i me dpung ni/ /chu thigs gcig gis gzhil nus na/ /'dzad med chu yi 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /lhag med byed la su zhig tshom/ /de lta'i ting 'dzin rol pa'i gar/ /lhan skyes bzhin du mngon byas 6nis/ /rgyal bstan padma'i dra ba na/ /rnam par bsgyings pa re re tsam/ /drag po'i yi ge 'di springs pas/ /khyod snying rdo rje rab bkas pas/ /rig rig mig gi rnam 'gyur ni/ /ri mor bris pa'i dpal las mdzes/ /mchi ma zags pas mig dmar pa/ /khyod kyi gnyen 'dun sdug bsngal ba'i/ /ngud mo'i sgra ni gangs cam du//

180ngal ba med par drag tu rgyu/ /gnyen bshes grogs po dang bcas pa/ /srog gis bzung bar ma nus pas/ /ro ldan sa gzhi ros brgyan par/ / bya rgod 'phur bzhi zlos gar bkra/ /'di 'dra'i sgra yang 'dzam gling na//rang tshod rig pas mi zin par/ /khengs ldan gang yin mi g.yo ba'i/ /stan la 'god pa'i 'khrul 'khor nyid/ /de phyir dul ba'i thub pa bzhin//bag yod padmo'i tshal yangs su/ /dge zhing des pas gnas pa las/ /rang spyod ngan pa mtshams byos shig /e ma spobs pa'i mtheb long bang ba nas/ /de lta'i lung rigs sgro ldan rim spros pas/ /log rtog dgra sdes nyen rnams nyon mongs pa'i/ /g.yul las rgyal ba'i dpa' bor —bdag gyur cig rigs tshul ma lus chu bo rnam pa bzhi'i/ /rgyun bzang blo gros rgya mtshor mngal khur du/ /smin pas thub bstan khor yug 'dzin ma'i khong / /legs bshad mand+rar yis mdzes par smon/ /rmad byung lung dang rigs pa'i rol rtsed kyis/ /smra byed glog gi dra bar nyer 'khyud pa/ /'di yis gangs ljongs rnam par dge ba'i zhing / /chos tshul lang tso dar bas sgeg la re/ /dri med smon lam bdud rtsi'i rtsa lag gang / /lhag bsam utpal ri mos mngon bzung ba/ /tshul 'dis dpal ldan thub pa'i rang lugs kyis/ /rab yangs phyogs kyi 'khor lo khyab gyur cig /cis 'jam dpal rnam par rol pa'i ting nge 'dzin las byung ba'i legs yar bshad pa chu'i 'khrul 'khor zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi byin rlabs kyi snang bas blo gros kyi skal ba cung zad yangs pa/rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtshos thugs rje'i bden pas byin gyis

181brlabs pa'i mtshan ma brtan po thob pa/ pha rgod sangs rgyas sa/nyis pa yongs 'dzin partsi ta chen po7sa snya'i mtshan can gyi zhabs kyi padmo la spyi bos mchod pa/ gong sa skal ldan bdun pa chen pos yongs 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i ming dbang gtsug tu bskur ba/ yongs su grags par gis steng 7blo bzang dpal ba zhes rab tu yangs pa'i tha snyad kyis bod pa'i rtog ge ba gang gis/ ngo mtshar ba'i rig byed mtha' dag gi rtse dga' nyams pa med par gnas pa'i zhing khams reb gong rig pa 'byung ba'i grong khyer gyi lte ba/ mkhas pa dang grub pa'i skyes mchog zam ma chad par rgyu ba'i chos kyi sde chen bo rong bo thos bsam rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi gong ba/ lugs gnyis kyi dga' ba zad mi shes pa'i rgya mtsho g.yas su 'khyil ba'i pho brang shar bla brang nor bu gru 'dzin gyi ba gam lnga ba'i g.yas phyogs/ mdo sngags rig gnas kyi chos sgra bar ma chad par sgrog pa'i ra ba yongs 'dzin bde yangs 'jam dbyangs dga' tshal nas cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar tshes dge bar grub par bgyis pa deb la 'bobs pa'i yi ge pa rna yul mdo smad kyi dpa' po drug sde'i nang tshan smra ba'i dbang phyug zla mdzes dpal gyi snye ma ste/ tshul 'dis kyang phyogs thams cad du lung rigs kyi dga' ston rab tu 'phel bar gyur cig /bi dza ya na/ /dgag lan 'di dang lhan cig springs pa'i chab shog ni/ dbus ljongs chos kyi zhing khastas rab tu yangs ba'i mdzes rgyan/ mkhas pa'i mkhas pa chen po'i grags dkar gyi snang ba mtha' dbus su rgyas pa/ ma mthong rgyang ring gi chos kyi grogs dam pa lha ldan grwa—skor ba chen po shes rab rgya mtsho'i mdun sa bcu phrag rig byed kyi me tog

182 rirnam par bzhad pa'i lding khang dam par/ zhu spreng / nye char yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge pa'i bshes gnyen chen po nyid/ sku'i 'tsho ba kun tu bde 'am/ ldang ba rab tu yang ngam/ bgres rgud dang snyun gyi rnam pa med dam/ rab dang phul dang gya nom par mchog tu dge mur/ rang gi bgyi 'os rgyal pa'i bstan pa la klog spong zung 'jug gi bya ba mtha' dag phyag 'og tu chud par byas mthar/ phyogs dang ris su ma bcas pa'i skal ba bzang bo nyi zer gyi rdul grangs las brgal bar/ legs par bshad pa'i bdud rtsi dus dang dus su 'grem pa'i mdzad bzangs kyi snang ba cir yang 'char bas rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i bskal ba mgron du bsu ba'i skabs shig na phran la'ang chos kyi 'bel gtam shas shig bgyid bzhed kyi dgongs pa mngon du byas te/ 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i gzi byin ci mchis lang tsho la phab pa'i bstan bcos kyi skyes bzang po nye bar bsrings ba ni/ snying po'i sadza' ba brtan po nam yang ma bzung ba'i zang phreng gi dngos po char du bsnyil bas cha tsam yang bsgrun du med pa'i dga' ba yang dag par brtas pa'i rkyen du babs/ skyes lan du'ang / 'phags pa lhas/ bsam pa bzang pas mchil lham gnyis/ /thub pa'i dbu la bzhag pa dang / /de nyid gzhan gyis bsal byas pa/ /gnyis kas rgyal srid 'thob par 'gyur//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rnam par dag pa'i bsam par ri'i dri mas ma gos pa'i zla shel dkar po'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba las kun la sman pa'i ga pur gyi zegs ma char du byo ba 'di nyid dgyes bzhes kyi sgo nas/ bstan pa la dmigs pa'i thugs 'khyer yang dag pas rang gzhan la phan pa'i sman

———— 18༷3——yon dam par sgyur pa las/ rang la sa/nga nye chags sdang gi lam po cher gzhol ba'i thabs su spel nas bstan srid la gnod 'gal gyi dri ma slong ba'i rkyen du cha tsam yang mi 'gyur ba zhig cis kyang dgongs 'jags thugs rje nges par che ba dang / grogs kyi dwangs mar 'brel ba'i ngang tshul thugs la bcags nas don dang ldan pa'i 'bel gtam dang 'phros 'os kyi 'jug pa rab tu bzang ba dri ma med pa'i mu tig gi phreng ba star la brgyus pa'i tshul du bka' drin rjes skyong mi dman pa sogs 'dor med zhu zhu zhu/ /zhes 'jam dpal rnam par rol ba'i ting nge 'dzin las byung ba'i legs par bshad pa chu'i 'khrul 'khor zhes bya ba 'degs rten dngul dkar thur srang lnga/ lha gos dmar po kha gsum/ bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas dkar po srid du ring ba che legs bcas 'dzin byed kyi lo'i sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes bzang po la/ mdo smad sa'i thig le/ reb gong rig pa 'byang ba'i zhing gi rdo ༄rje'i gdan/ rong bo dpal gyi dgon chen gyi 7 shar bla brang chen mo norangabu gru 'dzin gyi ba gam lnga pa/ yongs 'dzin bde yangs chen mo 'jam dbyangs dga' tshal zhes bya ba nas/ partsi ta'i lugs kyi phun sum tshogs pa'i skyes su spri ba dang bcas te phul ba dge/ //oṃ sgasnyi/ tshangs chen blo gros 'dom gyis ma zin pa'i/ /shes bya'i 'khor lo kun bzang mkhyen pahpho—gdong / /'phyar ba'i mod la rtse dgas 'dzum pa'i daXlaX/ /bcom ldan thub pa phyogs las rgyal gyur cig /rgyal kun gsang gsum mdzadadzhapa'i byin/ /ba spu phra mo'i sdum pa ru/ /bag yangs spyod pa stobs bcu'irdzidabang / /saṃ gha'i mtshan can rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /'orge min dge legs

184brtsegs pa'i rgyan/ /byang rgyud nor gyi blo gros ṅge'i/ khigrin la nyer bgod thub bstan gyi/ /'byung gnas bkra shis chos sdings bajid/ /de na chos kyi rkang ba bzhi/ /lhun grub rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i tshe/ /'jam dpal bdag la rig pa'i mdzod/ /ston phyir theg marngog bshes su rol/ /gang gis blo bzang tshad ma'i lha'i/ /dgongs don ye shes khyor chu ru/ /bskyil pa'i dam bca' rdo rje'i 'ben/ /phyogs glang gis kyang gzhig dka' btsugs/ /phrag dog drang srong dmod pa'i mtshon//snying la 'da' dka'i rgya byas pa/ /de dag ca co'i nga ro ni/ /bstan la nag po brtsegs pa bzhin/ /pha yis nyin bzhin gdams pa'i don// bdag gis rigs pa'i gad rgyangs su/ /bsgrags pa byang phyogs so ldan khyos/ /ma bzod sdug yus gzhan du bskur/ /sdu lus 'bad pas dka' ba'i las/ /maX thub chags sdang zug rngu'i nad/ /༷ma bsran 'khun sgras lha dbang ni/ /swā mar 'bod pa'i 'o dod byas/ /bsil ldan yangs pa'i zla ba grarga/sa/ /mes po bzhad pa'i rdo rje yi/ /legs bshad dkrug pa'i log smon can/ /shes rab rgya mtsho'i ming can byung //nam zhig lhas byin blo ngan des/ /rang pha gsod pa'i dbyug pa'i rtser//me stag phra mo bsgos pa la/ /bskal ba'i me zhes spyo tshig smra/ /tshig rtsub du ba nag po'i sprin/ /lding ba tsam las tsha ba'i rlabs/ /bral ba'i me ltag ches phra bas/ /ri rab thal bar byed do lo/ /kye hud shes bya rags pa'i gdong / /mthong ba'i blo yang rab ldongs pa/ /bdud kyi rigs gyur lhas byin gyis/ /bka' bstan rgya mtsho'i 'jing ba dkrugs//

la ge )(/rte/pade tshe phyogs dus thub pa yis/ /bsgrun kyang mkhyen pa'i cha rer yang / /mi 'gran rgyal ba kun gyi yab/ /dngos gyur smra ba'i seng ge gang / /'jam dpal rnam par rol pa yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs pas/ /legs bshad chu yi 'khrul 'khor ni/ /srid zhi'i gtsug tor rtse nas bskor//e ma bkra shis chos sdings su/ /btab pa'i sa bon bskyed drags pas//dpag bsam bkra shis 'khyil du rgyas/ /me tog dbus gtsang zhing du bzhad/ /gang gi thugs kyi ze'u 'bru ru/ /rnam par bskyangs pa lha yi lha/ /rong ston skal ldan bdun pa ches/ /bdag nyid 'phrul par bzhengs la bskos/ /bka' yi cod pan zur phud la/ /bcings te cha rkyen kun sbyar nas/ /gtan pa med pa'i chos sbyin sgo/ /phye bas skal bzang mig thur byin/ /rkang 'thung glegs bu snyoms pa'i gzhi la gzabs su brkos pa'i yig phreng 'bru/ /thang mar brdal ba'i legs byas 'di yis rdo rje can zhabs bskal brgyar brtan/ /'phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' la brkyangs pas rgol ngan snying la 'jigs pa sbyin/ /'di lta'i legs par bshad pa'i 'bel gtam da dung srid mthar 'phel gyur cig /ces 'jam dpal rnam par rol pa'i ting nge 'dzin las byur ba'i legs par bshad pa chu'i 'khrul 'khor zhes bya ba 'di nyid gyi yongs 'dzin thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po'i sku zhabs nas ljags rtsom mdzad grub 'phral/ sras kyi thu bo gong sa phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba 7 skal ldan blo bzang 'phrin las lung rtogs rgya mtsho dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas rta chen rtser son gcig rab dkar lha rdzas kyi skyes dang bcas kho bo cag la myur bar par du sgrub pa'i 'gan khur cig ces bka' stsal spyi bor phebs pa gus pas mchod de nyer bsdogs brtsams pa na dad gus dang ldan pa ming bos kyang cha rkyen sbyar

bar brten/ 'dzin byed ces pa me byi'i lor par du bsgrubs pa'i dge bsngolismon tshig tu gyi 'jam dbyangs bla ma yongs 'dzin chosru kyi rgyal bo de nyid kyi gsung gi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i yang tha/ shar bla brang chen mo'i zhabs 'bring ba mi pham dbyangs can dges pa'i rdo rjes shar mar bris pa dge legs su gyur cig / / /

187dpal ldan bkra shis 'khril gyi mkhas pa'i yang rtser blom pa dngul rwa'i hre po la springs pa'i pho nya mi 'jigs seng ge khros pa'i nga ro zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /gang gi zhabs sen nor bu'i phreng / /mi shigs padma'i ze ba la/ /nyams pa med par bzung ba las/ /bdag blo rgyas te rgyal ba'i yab/ /chos kyi rgyud mangs ro 'dzin gyi/ /phrag par bkal bas legs bshad dbyangs/ /seng ge nga ro'i sgrar mched de/ /kun rig ma ma'i drin las so/ /mdo dbus chos kyi dga' tshal bu/ bdag ming snying po'i bzlagabarjod byed/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i dpal gyi phyir/ /e ma bshes rnams ci yang mchod/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i 'khor lo yis/ /thub bstan srid la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /mes po bzhad pa'i rdo rje gang / /gsang ba gsum gyi rgya khyon yangs/ /lho rgyud 'dzin ma'i nā lend+ra/ /bkra shis 'khyil ba'i 'o mtsho ru/ /gzur gnas ngang ba'i sde dpon mang / /lung rigs

188dbyangs kyis rdzogs ldan 'gugs/ /rgya bod mkhas pa'i zhabs sen gyis//'byung bo'i ma ma ngal byas tshe/ /legs bshad dpag bsam rkang 'thung gi /me tog ma la ya yi spun/ /rigs pas bang rtsal 'gran btsugs pas/ /thub bstan rin chen rdzogs pa'i nor/ /snyim pa'i mthil la rab bsrel bas/ /mtha' dag rmongs pa'i dbul ba bsal/ /mi zad ngaXg gi dab0nga po'i mda'/ /mkhyen dang badzwan 'asdis mtheb long gis/ /gna' bo'i 'ben dang rab sbyar bas/ /khor yug bar la rang dbang spyod/ /de lta na yang mig stong bas/ /ma mthong gzhon nus mngon sum ltar/ /zer ba gangs kyi srin po 'gas/ /dgag sgrub rim pa'i zam ma chad/ /byang rgyud chos kyi tshal yangs su/ /sngon grol rgyud mangs ngas sbrengs par//phra men ngag gi rol mo zhes/ /phal cher gdol ba'i phrug gus gshung / /da yang drag po'i dmod pa brgyas/ /bslangs pa nor skyong gdug pa'i bu/ /rang gi brag cha'i nga ro yis/ /mnal thabs med par ca co 'tsher/ /tshig 'khri'i skyung la 'thungs nyes pas/ /rang mthong dregs pas sems sngos pa/ /na de'i 'chal gtam 'og rlung ni/ /bsrings yig zol gyis sa 'dir rgyu/ /chu yi me long dwangs ma la/ /rang gzugs 'phos pa la khros nas/ /srog gi mchod sbyin byed pa gang / /mdug ma bral ba'i dud 'gro nyid/ /nags kyi gar mkhan 'ba' le ni/ /khros pas mche ba brgya gtsigs kyang / /rnam par rgyal ba'i 'a phrog byed dbang / /gangs dkar khyim la bag yangs rtse/ /shing rta po kun bgros kyang / /bden grub bsnyad pa sbas zin ltar/ /rung ba'i sgrub byed mi baspu ba/ shes bya'i

189tshal las rnyed do lo/ /li khri'i chu gter khengs pa yang sor mo'i tshad las thung ngu ru/ /byed pa'i gur kum me tog phreng / /dkyil 'khor gcig tu rdzogs pa'i ltor/ /brag ri'i ba gam mngon mtho ba/ /rdul phran lang tshor sgrub byed pa'i/ /bka' bstan tshad ma'i glegs bam ni/ /nyi zla'i phang bar mngon brtsegs shing / /mdo sngags rig pa'i rgya mtsho che//rang gi khong la yongs drangs pa'i/ /phyogs med mkhas pa'i seng ge'i khri/ /gral gyi gong ba'i dpal byas te/ /gangs ri'i mdangs la bdar ba yi/ /zla ba dkar bo'i bzhin ras yangs/ /mchu sgros 'od kyi thur ma yis/ /dgrol 'os sbubs brgya cig car dbye/ /sun 'byin rlung gi srog zos pa'i/ /mi 'jig phyogs kyi rdo rje'i ri/ /lung rigs nyi zlas spud pa'i dpung / /rgyun chags lnga brgya'i zol gyis 'gying / /de tshe legs bshad sder mo'i zil/ /ma bzod dregs ldan myos pa'i bum/ /rus pa'i 'khrul 'khor rgya dral te/ /gshong bu dma' ba'i stegs la 'drad/ /'phongs—la bshang ba'i rgyal mtshan ni/ /yid srubs ba dan bzhin phyar nas/ / dri chu nar bo'i gaṅgā ma/ /ya mu na yi grong la rgyug /rjes su lhags pa'e rtsig ris kun/ /bsam gtan rdzu la mngon 'chel nas/ /dmar ser can gyi gdong ris mang / /bzhin la mya ngan pir gyis 'dri/ /dus mtha'i zhugasardzikyang kha ba ltar/ /bsil byed nongs pa'i me drod kyis/ /lus kyi gangs—la gdungs pa yis/ /rngul chu'i thigs pas rgya mtsho gso/ /kye hud khyod la mdza' ba'i gnyen/ /don snying 'bras yos ltar gas nas/ /lus khog 'gyel bas rang khyim gyi/ /dur khrod lta ba su yis bzod/ /rigs pa'i

190bdag pos gzhu rgyal gyis/ /phyi phyir sgro ldan stong spros pas/ /khyod rting gnon pa'i dpung byer na/ /sems ldan su zhig khyod la bshes/ /yang gcig bdud rtsis gsos pa'i bu/ /dga' byed rgya la bo'i mched po mang /chos kyi sde dang dbeen pa'i rir/ /lung rigs 'phong la ci yang 'gran/ /re re'i kha yi padmo yang / /legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i rgya mtsho bas/ /dud na lo brgyar skam pa'i shing / /dpag bsam myu gu'i tshal du sgrub/ /gzhan du mkhyen pa'i thab nang du/ /bcu phrag rig pa'i me sgron te/ /lus med dpung dang lhan cig tu/ /drag por bsreg pa'i rdzas su byed/ /thub pa'i lam srol mtho ldan pa/ /srid pa'i rtse mo las 'gongs par/ /legs byas dpung bas mngon bsgrongs tshe/ /rgyal rnams 'dzum pa bdag la 'khyud / /ga 'a'i glu dang maṭā ra/ /dbang po'i gzhu ris lnga ldi'i phreng //phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i phrag pa la/ /kun yid myos pa'i rdzu 'phrul ston/ /shing rta chen po'i chos kun gyi/ /bang mdzod gcig pu 'di'o zhes/ /grags pa'i ba dan 'phur ba'i dar/ /skye rgu'i rna ba'i rtse la 'phyang / /skye bar lce rtse legs bshad dang / /mnyam por 'grogs pa'i dpal yon bzang / /phyogs las rgyal ba'i ngag tshig ni/ /seng ge nga ro'i dbyangs kyis song / /dngul ra'i hre bo'i yig lan du bsrings pa/ rgyal ba'i mdo sngags kyis bsdus pa'i nang rig nga 'i sde snod phal mo che la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'e blo gros kyi lus stobs rgyas pa/ tha snyad rig pa'i gtsug lag ma lus pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya rnam par ma chad pa'i gnas la yang dag par sbyangs pa'i pha rol tu son pa/ snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa ji snyed pa 'i bgo

191skal la rdzogs par spyod pa'i bsod nams kyi mthu brtas pas rgyal ba 'jam dpal snying bo'i lam srol la mi 'phrogs pa'i dad pa thob pa/ phas kyi rgol bas brdzi bar mi nus pa'i spobs pa rab tu yangs pas khyu mchog rlabs po che'i gnas su dam bca' ba/ shing rta chen po mtha' dag gi legs bshad kyi bdud rtsi dri ma med pa'i lung rigs kyi ngag tshig yang dag pas 'grem pa la rnam dpyod kyi mthu rnyed pa/ lugs gnyis kyis sa chen po tshul bzhin skyong ba'i skyes chen dam pa che ba'e che ba du ma'i mdun sa rnam par dge ba'i dus ston spel ba/ yongs 'dzin blo bzang dpal bar 'bod pa'i yi ge dpal ldan bkra tris 'khyil gyi grwa rigs dngul rwa'i hre bo la ched don/ kho bo sngon dpal ldan bkra shis chos sdings kyi chos grwa 'grim bzhin pa'i gnas skabs dam bcas pa'i don la/ phrag dog gi gdon gyis zin pa 'gas lab rdol mol bar/ 'di ka'i mchog sprul smra ba'i nyi mas lan gyi rnam gzhag rgyas par spros pas rta rgyug pa'i zhabs me tog gi dpe bzhin rang re'i yig cha la tshig zin mi mthun pa du ma mchis pa'i zur re gnyis dang 'gal bar byas —pa bden mchi yang / rgol yul las gzhan pa su la yang gnong dngos len—dang / dug lces ldag byed dgos pa'i khag ci yang med/ de'i phyir dpal—ldan bkra tri/sa 'khyil bas gtsos chos kyi sde gang du'ang gzur gnas chos srid la mig sdings pa che phra mtha' dag mig ser rngab zhogs kyis bzhugs mi tshugs pa'i stangs ka lta ci/ mkhas pa'i rnam 'gyur la thugs mnyes muralachags pa de ka lags mod/ rang zas rang la dug rang mal rang la ma bde ba khyod nyid drag po'i da mod pa'i thib 'og tu song ste snying po med pa'i

192shog byang kha shas yi ger bris/ rtsa ba'i dam bca' la gnod byed bya rog so 'phreng gi rjes su thal yang / yal ga lta bu'i tshig zur re la gang dran gang thon gyi tshig 'khri kha zin sna zin gsang mthor bsgrags te dpal phyogs kyi glang bo'i rigs pa las kyang rigs par rlom bzhin banyi ba ring mo zhig nas thos/ kho bo zla nang lha mor bskyod skabs yig stong zhig 'byor kyang / spyir phran bu gyi gong sa skal ldan rgya mtsho'i yongs 'dzin du bsdad pa la chags sdang gi rgya ma tsho gting nas khol/ phrag dog gi rba rlabs ches cher sayo ba'i cher rlom zhig gis dgon grong kun tu 'khrug pa slong rtsis dang / sngags bon kun la grub mtha'i phra ma bskyal zhing / rgya dpon tsho la rgyu nor gyi 'gro sgo sa/tong ba sogs mngon lkog gnyis kar nus pa rtsal sprugs sgos yul 'phud srog len gyi sbyor ba nar ma byed bzhin stabs/ da lam yang de phyogs su khyod 'dra gang smras bden par 'dzin pa 'ga' la phra ma ci 'khyol dang / zhe sdang ci slong bgyis te khong ba the nges kyis yi ge 'di bskur ba gor ma chag ci'i phyir zhe na/ nged kyis dam bca' de ka bzhag phyin lo ngo nyer gcig dgag lan mdzad de lo ngo dgu par du bkod de lo ngo lnga tsam thal yang rang yul du sdod bzhin pa'i skabs sus kyang yi ge ma gnang zhing /da lo lha mo dang tsha kho phyogs su brel g.yengs che sgang la bskur ba dang / bkra shis 'khyil ba zhig yin tshe chos srid kyi bab dang mthun nges kyi yi ge zhig skur shes 'gro ba dang / wa mo'i drung yig pa bcol nas ma bris rung yig gzugs re 'dri shes mchi ba dang / rang ming sbas te sus bskur 'dis bskur med pa zhig byed don med pa dang / kho rang dngos g.yog ci rigs

193shig gis pho nyar sprad chog rgyu la ri khrod pa 'khyams po zhig la sprod du bcug skad dang / sa cha mgo mjug yod sa yin gshis 7 gong dang gzhung la snyan mnan byed rgyu la/ gang dran gang 'gyu byas pa dang / chen po'i rtags thel med kyang rang gi rtags rgyas spras chog pas/ mkhas mang —nor bu'i gling nas yi ge 'di 'dra zhig 'byung dogs med par ma zad/ 'di ni dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil ba rang la sha 'khon yod pa zhig gis ched du rma phab 'dod kyis bab col du byas par zad la/ yul gyi bdag po chen po tshos dgongs skabs ngan pa de'i srog la ci 'gyur cha ma 'tshal snyam ste/ de ltar yin yang mchi/ zla nang slar yang yig dkar yig nag gang yin mi shes pa/ mi dang dud 'gro'i sug rjes mi phyed pa/ chos dang srid gtam gang gtogs mi 'tshal ba/ chos srid kyi 'gro lugs mgo dod tsam yang mi shes pa'i rang nyams thams cad rjen par bstan pa gnyis snga phyir khyed kyi yin khul gyis byung ste khyod kyi min las che/ khyed nyid rang ming gi yi ge tsam yang mi dag pa'i yi ge 'di 'dra khrom gyi gto la bkram bzhin dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil ba'i zhabs 'degs su rlom pa zhig ga la— yin/ gal te yin tshe 'di ka'i ja ma chu len tshun chad kyis de tsho la yig lan dgos pa mi 'dug spyir khyi ngan zug tshad la 'ur rdo 'phen pa dang / skad ngan 'don tshad la ang lan ster don med par ma zad/ zhe ge snga ma rang na/ 'di snang chos brgyad kyis yid bslad cing rang mthong khengs dregs )kyi zug zu ma bzod par/ rigs rmum nyi tshe tsam gyis zhe 'grangs pa 'gas rgol 'dod yod pas bkra shis 'khyil 'dir shog ces bris 'dug pas de 'dra'i rgol ba la bstan pa'i

— 194 gnad mkhyen pa zhig lta ci rgad po bsam shes shig gis kyang ya mi bgyid cing / hre bo kho rang ja dang ril ma'i khyad par ma phyed pa/ rang ming girshayi ge'i dag cha tsam yang mi shes pa/ rang kha zas kyis ma sur nd+rang 'phongs—gos kyis ma kheb/ gang bsam lag tu len pa/ gang dran kha nas smra ba/bkra shisaga'akhyil rang na mi gral la ma chud par khyi gral la bton pa/ la dog—dkar dmar gyi khyab pa legs po klong tshul yang ma lob pa zhig gis ar —tsig nir tsig dang a mṛ ta'i sgra don brtsad pas kyang kha la smra bcad kyi rgya byin pa kun la grags pa zhig yin gshis/ snag shog gron pa dang mdzub mo ngal ba'i dgos pa tsam las ma mchis pa'i gros chen yang yang gdab mod/'on kyang khyod kyi yi ger nan che ba'i ngo tsam la 'di ltar/ ci kun mkhyen bla ma mkhas grub tshad ldan yin pas khyed kyi de ma legs she na/ rgya bod kyi bstan bcos de snyed du phyogs sngar gang blangs la mkhas grub tshad ldan gcig kyange med dam/ chen po yin nga/sa so zhe na/ kun mkhyen gyis sa paṇa chen po la mgo bo mgal me ltar 'khor bar mthong / zhes pa dang /bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa la bod kyi kun mkhyen na re zhes pa ci/ rang phyogs yin stabs smra na/ 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i blo gros/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa/ rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan sogs bkag pa ci/khyod kyis sbyangs sa'i yig cha yin pas so zhe na/ wa shul ngag dbang chen pos sgo mang chos grwar gung ru chos 'byung gi gzhung dang 'gal ba'i dam bca' ji snyed byas rnam thar ltar la/ yi ga cha rnying ba la dgag pa mdzad pa 'ang ci tsam mchis/ sde rgan khri rgan gyi dus na rnga ba go thob sogs kyis

1bye5tshogs gleng sogs la yig char khyab pa phyin ci log ga tsam bcad/ kuzug mkhyen la rgol ba su yang ma byung bas snyam na/ sog po bsod nams bya rog dang / zhwa dmar ngag dbang phrin las sogs kyis 'khor gsum me tog gi phreng ring ston gral du phul ba dang / lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje/ pra sti dge bshes che chung / byang rtse sbyin pa dar rgyas/ khu ra'i chos mdzad bstan sgron/ hal ha chos rje dpal ldan/ ser byes blo bzang tshe brtan/ sprul sku chen ku tshig thu/ smra mkhas blo bzang 'phel rgyas/ hor chen ye shes rgya mtsho sogs mtha' dbus na bsgrangs pas mi lang bar ma zad/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo/ gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me sogs gdan sa'i che khag gi khrod na'ang yig char dgag pa res mang re ma btang ba su yod/khyod rang dman ches pa dang da lta'i dus su mi rung ngo zer na/ chos sde chen po gzhan na lta ci/ sdi tsha'i skam pos gtsos gdan sa rang gi tha snyad grwa tshang du grags pas ci byas smra ga la dgos/ par du bkod pas so snyam na/dbus gtsang rong bo bya khyung sku 'bum lha mo nyin srib dmu dge hal ha sogs na gong smos kyi mkhas pa dag gis bkag pa'i bstan bcos shing rta brgya phrag long nges kyi par bkod yo/da pas bya thabs e 'dug slad mar yang ji srid mkhas pa ma zad pa de srid du yig cha la 'thad mi 'thad kyi 'chad rtsod rtsom pa gsum ga rgyun mi 'chad pas/ rgya mtsho chen po las chu mi 'byung ba/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'aspo/ ra las 'od mi 'phro ba/ mkhas pa'i ngag sgo las gtam mi smra ba'i cho ga de khyod la 'tsham pa'i khur e red/ mno bsam thongs/ 'di ka'i rtsod yig rme khas pa rnams kyis gzigs 'os dang gsan

196 'os med rab gsungs pa khyod rang bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun mthar ṣṭiphyin yin stabs bden mchi yang / gsar phyogs la ril sgrub kyi khungs med gsungs par/ oṃ ni ri lu tsa na ka'i/ /'bru tshad tsam du bsams nasarshani / /zhes pa khungs su brjod pa dang / shes par gyur pa'i shes sgrib med—zer bar/ yod pa'i sgrub byed du kun rtog brgyad cu bgod pa dang / rang rkya thub pa dang rang rkya 'dzin thub pa la khyad par bton pa'i khungs rnam dzhadag med gsungs par/ tshig gcig kyang ma drangs pa ras sde las khyadadzhagasungs pa 'di las lhag ci yod/ ces pa dang / zhi lhag cig car durdzi'agrub mi srid ces par/ srid pa'i rgyab rten du rim can du 'grub pa'i lung drangs pa dang / yod sar mi btsal med sar btsal zer ba la/ yod pa ma rnyed pa min zhes lan btab pa dang / thabs shes kyi rgyud kyi khyad par la/pha ma'i rgyud kyi khyad par sngags rim las gsungs zhes pa dang / de yang gtso bor ston pa dang rtsal du bton nas ston pa la rje bla mas khyad par bye rshabar bshad de dogs gcod gnang ba lta bu'i yig 'a/jog gi gral du chud chog pas thugs ngal gyi sku tshegs 'o brgyal de mdzad mi dgos par gda'/khyod kyi yi ge snga ma wa mo'i ri khrod par bcol nas rang dgon la zhabs —'dren bla na med pa byas par ma zad/ phyi ma gnyis la sam ṭar 'bebs mkhan dang shog gur 'dri mkhan so sor bcol yang snga ma la mkhas khyad gzhan lta ci brjod bya rdzod byed ngo 'phrod tsam gyi nus pa'ang bral zhing / phyi mar sug ris legs po gar mchi/chod sa rnams bris ma chod sa rnams bskyur te yi ge mang rab kyi go sa shog stong la lus pa dang / rang nyid sngangs shingardzi

197sems 'khrugs pa dang / ang yig tsam yang mi shes pa'i rtags bstan te tshes dang tshes la bskur ba'i khul byas pa'i yi ge'ang nor nas yig thum snga ma la yi ge phyi ma dang / yig thum phyi ma la yi ge snga ma bcug ste bskur ba dang /'dir sprod mkhan gyis kyang rang brkus rang gis phud pa bzhin du byas song ba'i yig hrul 'di 'dra mkhas pa'i mdun sar mdo smad kyi rgyan du che zhing / de nga tsho'i rtsod yig mtshang du che bar rlom pa ni khyod rang gzur gnas dpyod ldan yin pa'i 'bras rtags su che/ khyod rang mi tshe 'a/di la rang lto phyid pa zhig byung na bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs dang yul gyi la rgya khur du byed pa'i khag re su la'ang ma mchis mod/ spre'u nyal mi tshugs/ ngan pa sdod mi tshugs pa'i gtam bzhin byed nges tshe/ shan 'byed dang tshar gcod kyi dpang bo gnyis 'dzom bcas/ mkhas mang rgya mtsho chen po sa la 'khyil ba lta bu'i dbus su/ nged nas yig chas ser 'bras kyi yig cha snga ma rnams bkag pa phal cher mi 'thad pa'i dam bca'/ gong smos— mkhas pa so sos kun mkhyen yig cha bkag pa rnams shas cher 'thad pa'i dam bca'/ de dang der ma gtogs pa'i yig cha'i ldog phyogs kyi dam bca' du ma sogs rgyun chags lnga brgya bzlas na/ khyod kyis de gcig kyang ma lus par rgyal ba'i bka' dang shing rta chen po'i dgongs 'grel rje yab sras kyi legs bshad rnams dpang du bzhag nas sun phyungs te yig cha'i tshig zur phra mo nas skyon med rnam dag tu sgrubs dang / de'i tshe khyed nas gtsigs bzung ba bzhin khyed rang gis sprang bo nyi ma'i dngos grub kyi rnarme thar bdag gir yalde sa na de lugs 'dod sbyar byas chog la/ gal te skyon med du sgrub ma

198da nus pa'i yig cha'i tshig zur gcig tsam lus na'ang / nged can nas sa yis mi thog pa'i phyi ba/ mkha' la mi shong ba'i che ba ci tsam pa'i gtsigs—bzung yang sgrub nges kyi yi ge gyi gong sa dang gzhung gi rtags thel can/rang sa'i bdag po lan kru'u dang zi lang yā mon du skrad chog pa thog mar —nga la byin/ de nas sku 'bum bya khyung sdi tsha gser khog dgon lung bde chen—rwa rgya sa/tsang lha mo sogs mdo smad lho byang gi bshad grwa gnam gyi ka ba rnams —nas yongs su rdzogs pa'e bshes gnyen nyi shu lhag re bcas mkhas pa brgya —phrag du ma shana'abyed kyi dpang bor gdan drongs/ lan kru'u dang zi lang nas tshar gcod pa'e dbang bor srog bdag 'khor bcas bos la lo ngo du ma min yang zla ngo drug bdun yun gyi de dag gi bzhes spro dang rta chas —sogs ci dgos nyer bsdogs gyis la chas dang / yongs dang yong res su—la babs gnag rdzi la dris pas kyang shes stabs/ de tshe nged nas kyang nged cag gi gyi gong sa shar thams cad mkhyen pa dang / zhing bdag rgya'i phyus krang / bod kyi nang so sogs snyan gsan 'bebs 'os thams cad la snyan mnan/ rma lho byang nas nged cag dpon slob kyi slob ma slob brgyud stong phrag mang po bsdus nas rgol ba'i dkyil 'khor mngon par bshams te dam bca' ba'i sta gon nye bar bgyid/ skya ser gyi tshogs pa khri phrag mang po la bsu bkod kyi bkod 'doms dang / phyogs nges med kyi skye bo nyi zer gyi rdul la 'gran pa ltad mor spran te re skong rig pa 'byung ba'e zhing mthil du gdan zhu bgyid lags/ bzhi mo glas drug man gnam la'i lcags 'phrang yan la mi gtogs pa'i sa cha yin na ku kyog yin dgos pa dang / bkras 'khyil la

199 mi the ba'i mi yin na rkob rgan yin pa dang / kun mkhyen yig cha las gzhan pa'i yig cha yin na log bshad yin dgos pa dang / nged kyis ma ṇi bton tshad kyang bab col yin pa dang / dben pa'i yul yin na khu byug dang khru to'i skad kyi dbye ba shes mkhan mi srid pas khyab pa rnams bsgrubs te par shing thams cad me la bsreg cing chu la bskyon phyir/ nged cag can nas lha sa dang hal ha'i bar la byon cig dang / kho bo cag nas kyang khyed rang 'khor bcas de ltar 'byon nges kyi yi ge snga mgyogs su sprugrem pa'i rogs ram 'degs/ khyed nas bshad grwa so sor yi ge bskur yod smras pa bden phyin/ nged nas kyang khyod rang yig cha thams cad la dag ther bgyid pa dang / ma dag pa thams cad me la bsreg phyir phyogs kun tu bskyod nges yin tshul dang / 'di nas kyang lan yig byin tshul sogs 'grem par 'gyur bas de don thams cad go bar byos/ nged rang 'di 'dra'i yi ge bskur ba la snying thag pa nas mi mos kyang / khyod rang 'byung bo sha khrage la re ba ltar ha cang gdungs 'dug stabs cung zad smos pa ste/ spyir thugs kyi dkyel che ba/ rnam dpyod kyis mtha' rig pa/ chos srid la go myong bzang ba / dug gsum gyi mgo mnan pa/ gzhan skyon la rtog 'jug nyung ba/rang rgyud la dran shes skyong ba/ rgya mtsho bzhin du mi 'khrugs pa/ ri rab bzhin du mi g.yo ba rnams bstan srid kyi gzhung lam las gzhan du g.yo ba ga la srid/ khyod dang khyod 'dra ci byas rmog gis ma bde ba'i dpe ru song ba rnams la yi ge 'di rigs chags sdang gi 'khrul 'khor skor pa'i rkyen du 'gro des las/ bstan pa'i dmigs rkyen du 'gro ba ches dka' stabs slad mar

'di 'dra 'bul mi dgos pa zhig dgongs 'jags gyis/ zhes zla tshes dgedzhabar spyi sger gyi skyabs gnas dam pa rnams dang / gzu bor gnas pa'i mkhas pa rnams la snying thag pa nas bdag la sgrib par mi 'gyur ba'i gsol 'debs dang / kun slong gi ngo bo la yang legs par brtags pa'i khul—gyis springs pa dza yasgru// //

201brgal lan rdo rje'i gzegs ma la rnam par dpyad pa gsang 'dzin mtshon gyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba bzhugs so / /'ji3sa bral sgo bzand+ra thub pa'i sngon med gtam/ /dpatsho stug dam chosabyumadzod kyi sgo mo rborgya/4 /rnam par bkrozlo bas blo ldarwa rgya maphyoldi yid/༷ /garmi mdzad yab sras 'bral med gtsug gis mchod/ lge /rgeng jog legartswagasung dgongs pa yangs pa'i gting / /ma phyin cha bsdus srog gi la/ ba yis/ /klan ka'i gdung chen 'degs der rigs mthun gyi/ /phreng ba rnam par spel 'di dge bar bzhes/ /de yang tshul 'chos dang bzang rdzu la brten nas slob 'khor skyong ba'i khul du yod pa don gnas su rang nyid nas zhal gyis yang dag par bzhes pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po bsang khog mi phrug ces chub nas rtsod yig rigs pa'i gad rgyangs la lan zhig mdzad kin yod rabs ring mo zhig nas thos te lo mang song ba rab rgyal du lug lor brgal lan rdo rje'i gzegs ma zhes bya ba grub par byas te bskur byung ngo / /de la bdag gi bla ma yab srasacho kyi zhal 'phros la/ bsang

202khog bla rgan 'di nyid ma nas lha ma yin las tshe 'phos ma thag pa lta bu'i byed spyod lag tu bstar bzhin yo da pa'i khar/ nye char 'bras sgo klu 'bum lha rams pa shes rab kyis phyogs snga'i tshig zin rkyang 'ded kyis khyi rdo rjes 'brangs pa tsam min par rgol ba'i zhe 'dod kyi steng lung rigs kyi spro stangs/ bcad— lhug gi shom ra/ cishugs 'ergyung gi rtsom rlabs sogs gang thad nas mkhas pa'i nyams che bar yod pa'i dgag lan brtsams par brten/ mi phrug bla rgan kho rang 'phung sri rnga zhon ma bu dgu skor gyis snying brlams pa lta bur gyur te/ rtsod yig snga phyir bkod pa'i sgrub byed gtso bo rnams la rtsod spong dang / yig cha'i rting gnon gyi lung rigs 'gangs che ba gang pa nga ma thon par ma zad/ phyogs snga ma'i zhe 'dod/ skabs bab kyi thob thang / dngos shugs kyi bstan tshod/ gong 'og gi 'gro lugs sogs dpyod 'os gang la yang brtag gzhig ye med par/ snag ris gdong 'ded kyi zin so khar gang thogs dang snar gang bro la so btogs sen btogs tsi tsi'i byed thang lta bu 'ba' zhig mug btsir sdug btsir la sha thang thang du 'bad pa'i sgos wa mo stag mchongs dang kṣa ta rgod 'phur gyi stangs ka byas pa kho nar snang ba dang / kho rang gi rgyu dus kyi kun slong / rnam dpyod kyi go rigs/ bcad lhug gi rtsom nyams sogs kyang grwa sa chen po'i zhabs 'dren dang yi mug zhe skyo'i gnas las ma 'das pas slar dgag sgrub kyi spungs skyed dgos pa'i don gyi snying bo 'ga' yang med do/ /zhes gsungs nas lan gyi bzhed pa tsam yang med par rim 'gyangs su 'jog par mdzad no/ /de la kho bo cag gi0ni/ de ltar brnyas pa'i yul du bskyur pa de

203nyid shas ma bzod par chen po nyid la phu dud kyi tshul du/ brgal lan rang las/ shog grangs mang ba/ mang bo bshad pa/ lung drangs pa/ sdigs mo byas ba/ yig zhus btang ba sogs la thugs ma rangs pa'i gsung zur gyis gal 'gag gi bcas khrims mang bo zhig mdzad pa'i bka' las ma 'gongs/ dam las ma 'das par/ tshig bcad lhug gi shom ra sna tshogs dang thal phyir gyi spros pa mang bo bskyungs/ de chos can dang / der thal/de'i phyir zer ba lta bu'i tshig bsdu yang med par thal sbyor re re bzhin rtags chos don gsum tshig na gnar mas 'god pa'i dka' tshegs spangs/dgag sgrub kyi lung rigs 'gangs gcig pa la chos can kha spos pa tsam gyis nyog 'byams su brdal ba'i ngal ba dor/ phyogs snga'i gzhung deb grangs bcas gyur ru lugs su 'god pa'i bongs skyed kyi khris po bskyur/ 'dod mi nus te dang / rtags grub ste dang / khyab ste dang / rtags khyab khas zer ba lta bu'i rigs smra'i spyi skad bor nas/ thal nyagyur de'i gsal ba la 'dod lan 'debs mi nus te dang / thal 'gyur de'i rtags la rtags ma grub kyi lan mi thebs te dang / thal 'gyur de'i khyab pa la khyab med kyi lan mi thebs te dang / khyod kyis thal 'gyur de'i rtags kyang khas blangs/khyab pa'ang khas blangs pa'i phyir/ zhes bya ba lta bu kha dog dkar dmar gyi rgan zhugs dor ma'i shig ma shi ba zhig gi tshig gi spro stangs lta bu byed rgyu la zhen log gi gnas su yang dag par bzung ste/ skabs don gnad 'dril gyi lugs su lan nyung zad cig gdab par bya'o/ ༈ /de la/ sgra'i skye mched ni rdo rje'i gzhom byar su la'ang ma grags shing rigs pas kyang mi 'grub pas

204brgal lan la ming 'dogs lugs nas bzung 'go tshes gcig nas nor bar ma zad/ rtsod yig rigs pa'i gad rgyangs su grub mtha' gong mas mngon pa'i mdo'i dgongs pa 'chad tshe 'di ltar 'grel dgos zhes gsung gi gong mas mdzod rtsa 'chad tshe dgongs pa 'di ltar 'grel dgos zhes zur tsam yang gtan ma gsungs pa la/ nyid nas de'i khyad tsam yang ma phyed par dgag gzhag gi dbu khyung 'bri ba'i thog mar nya dang nyung ma bgres pa'i bshad pa 'byams klas par bris pa ni gang brtsams byur du 'gugs pa'i sna 'dren dang / rten 'brel lam du mi rgyug pa'i ngan ltas las ba/zhan du 'os med la/ gong ma'i lugs la/ sdug bden dang / rang 'bras sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba'i nus pa can gyi nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas kyi dngos po gnyis don gcig pa chos mngon pa'i mdo'i don yin pa ni rtsod yig snga ting gi dgongs par gsal zhing / de ltar gnas pa'ang yin te/ gzhan du na mdo tshig de'i dgongs mthil bshad du med par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ / des na gad rgyangs rang du/ zag bcas thams cad 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin zhes pa'i zag bcas ni nyon mongs pa'i rgyu las byung ba'i nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas la bya dgos/ zhes dang / nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas la khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis khyab po zhes bdag gi pha bla ma yab sras kyis gsung ngag rnam par dag pa seng ge'i nga ro ci yang bsgrags/ zhes dang / 'phags bod kyi sde snod rgya mtsho lta bu las nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas thams cad la khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis khyab par gsungs/zhes gsungs pa la sogs pa skabs du mar nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas zhes

205pa'i khyad par gsal bar sbyar cing / de yang lam rim chen mo las/ /khyad par sbyar ba gcig byung na ma byung ba'i skabs su'ang thun mong gi chos yin pas sbyar dgos la/ zhes dang / des na mdo 'am bstan bcos de'i spyi'i lugs gong 'og tu smos pa mi sbyo ra bar tshig cung zad re'i ngo gdong gi bstan tshod sgra ji bzhin par gzung du mi rung bab/ nges don gyi gsung rab yin pa mi 'jig la/ zhes gsungs pa'i don gyi spyi 'gros ltar shin tu gnas pas na/ 'dir yang nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas gzhir bzhag ste rang 'bras sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba'i nus pa can zhes gsungs pa yin pas mtshon/ gong 'og kun tu nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas gzhir bzhag gi dbang du mdzad de de nyid tshig zin du ma sbyar ba mang bo zhig yod pa la'ang nges par stor ba'i dbang du byed dgos shing / de yang tshig re re'i thad du byis par ka kha slob pa bzhin ngo sprad pa la ma ltos par/ zhib cha 'di rtsal 'don ma byas pa'i dbang gis nyid nas rgol ba'i khur 'dra bo bzhes skabs kun tu tshul 'di nyid dgongs dgos te/ rtsod yig snga phyir drangs pa'i gzhung rnams su 'ang nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas zhes pa don gyis go ba'i dbang du mdzad nas tshig zin la ma sbyar ba ni mkhas pa'i spyi lugs yin pas na/ kun mkhyen bla mas kyang zag bcas kyi tshor ba bde ba 'gyur ba'i lcug bsngal du bzhag skabs su'ang nyon mongs pa'i zheso ma sbyar ba dang /zag bcardosha sdug bsngal du rtogs pa/ zhes dang / zag bcas sdug bsngal du 'jog tshul/ zhes gsungs pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta min na/mdo las/ mig med/ rna ba med/ ces sogs gsungs pa la'ang klan ka

206'jug par 'gyur zhing / dbu ma chen mo las/ zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal ba zhes khas len dgos pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa la yang khyed nas lan gyis zlog par mi nus pa'i rdo rje'i gzegs ma spro dgos par 'gyur ro/ /des na rgol ba'i gnas min pa la'ang gya tshom du rgol ba'i bsnyon ham ngan pa des bstan pa'i bdag po nas kun mkhyen bla ma'i bar la bshang gci'i bsang gtor de 'dra mi mdzad par zhu zhing / gal te las de kar cis kyang spro na ni/ phar phyin yig char/ 'phags pa dang mi mthun pa'i dor bya la sdug bsngal ba dang / mdzod du/ de la sdug bsngal gyis khyab par gsungs pa dang / dbu mar/ sdug bden phra mor sdug bsngal bas khyab bar bstan pa rnams la'ang shes sgrib phyogs ci rigs res ma nges pa a long yang long du brjod de lan gyis zlog par mi nus skad pa la sogs pa'i btsog chu ngan pa des sme bar gyis shig gzhan yang skabs 'di'i chos canarshakha spos pa tsam gyi khyab skor deb nyi shu brgal ba sogs kyi lan gong smos de kas bya brgya 'ur rdo gcig gi dpe ltar dpyis phyin par bshad zin cing /ga/zhan ji5nga gong 'og gi skabs du mar/ skye mched dang po lnga gang rung gi rtags kyis bdag med kyis khyad par du byas pa'i gzugs rdzas yod du bsgrubs pa dang / longs sku'i rtags kyis de'i mtshan gzhi'i rnam shes nges—pa lnga ldan du bsgrubs pa sogs la yig cha dang grwa sa rnams su lan don mthun ci mdzad kyis mtshon par bya ba'ang mtha' yas pa zhig yod de re re'i thad du bar do ngo sprod 'dra ba byed dgos shad mi gda' 'o/ /ming cha'i tshig zur ci rigs re bsdus pa la yang than chen po gzigs pa ltar stong

207bshur mang po byed pa las/ rang gis/ de chos can/ rang 'bras tshor ba sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba'i nus pa can yin par thal/ rang gi rdzas rgyun phyi mar gyur ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi lam rnams skyed pa'i nus pa can yin pa'i phyir/ zhes bkod pa 'di la/ gzhan dag gis/ rnam mkhyen chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir te/ rang gi rdzas rgyun phyi mar gyur pa'i byang phyogs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyi zag med ye shes mtha' dag skyed byed yin pa'i phyir / zhes brjod na lan ci gdab snyam pa'i dgongs dpyad re mdzad na mi legs sam/ ༈ khyed nas mi shes pa kun shes pa'i dbang bo lam bden min par bsgrubs pa dang / de mthong lam rjes thob pa'i rgyud la yod par 'dod pa'i rang sde su yang med par bshad pa gtan mi 'thad de/ gser 'phreng las/ mdzod las/ mthong sgom mi slob lam la dgu /gsum yin gsum ni dri ma med/ /ces 'dus lam la bzhag cing zag med kho nar 'chad pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas nyi snang du yang de ltar ro/ /zhes nyi snang gis kyang mdzod ltar dbang bo tha ma gsum 'das lam zag med kho nar bzhag par gsungs pas na 'phags seng rang lugs la mi shes pa kun shes pa'i dbang bo lam bden min pa'i dogs pa'i gnas med la/ de mnyam gzhag kho na'i dbang du byas pa'ang ma yin te/ nyi snang las/ mi shes pa kun shes par bya'o/ /kun shes pa dang kun shes pa srung ba'i dbang po rnams ni mthong ba dang sgom pa dang mi slob pa'i lam bsdus pa'i don gyis so/ /zhes dbang po gsum rim bzhin lam gsum sdud byed du gsungs pa dang / de dang / kun mkhyen bla mas/ mi shes pa kun shes

208 par byed pa'i dbang po yin te/ mthong lam yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs—pa gnyis kyang grub mtha'i bzhed mtshams phra mo re ma gtogs khyab mtha' 'dzin tshul dgongs pa gcig pas na phar phyin spyi skad la'ang khyab mtha' de ltar cis kyang 'dzin dgos pa dang / gser phreng las de'i sa mtshams—'jog skabs su'ang mdzod dang nyi snang thun mong bar byas te 'phags lam gsum la rim bzhin bzhag pas na dbang po de gsum la mnyam rjes gnyis re yod pa ni shin tu gsal ba'i phyir ro/ /des na don 'di skor la khyed rang nged tsho bas rtog dpyod dang go tshor che ba thugs mad de/ gzhan du na—'phags pa grol sde nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i gral nas 'byin par byed pa'i —lung rigs kyi dpung shed mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ ༈ /rgyu mtshan dang bcas—smra rgyu yod dgos/ zhes sogs 'di rigs kyi zhal gdams gong 'og tu lan—ga/cig min par bka' drin du bskyangs mod/ de ni/ rang nyid nges bzhin—gzhan dag la/ /nges pa skyed par 'dod pa yis/ /zhes pa'i dgongs—par son yod med ni som nyi 'ba' zhig ma gtogs/ khyed rang gi dgongs—nus rtsad sprugs kyi bstan bcos la brten nas/ skyes bu pha rol bo chos can/ kun mkhyen yin te/ ngag smra ba'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu zhig las gzhan ci—yang rjes su dpog par ma gyur to/ ༈ /yang 'das lam zag med ladzhabarten nas phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu thob ma thag pa'i rgyud kyi nyon yid chos rshacan/ zag bcas yin par thal/ phyogs phyi ma ltar khas len pa de'i—phyir/ zhes 'phangs pa 'dis/ rje bla mas/ 'gog pa mnyam gzhag4gnas skabs dus/ zhes bka' stsal ba la khyel med kyi ngo rgol byas par ma—

209zad/ 'di dang brtag pa snga mar 'phangs pa'i thal 'gyur gnyis kyi khyab pa ji ltar rtsi ba'ang nyid kyi zhe 'dod phug 'tshangs la gzhigs na/ kun mkhyen bla mas/ chos can khyab pa'i rjes mi 'brang / /zhes gsungs pa'ang g.yas 'jog byed snyam gyi dgongs pa shar bar mngon te/ gzhan du na/ sangs 'phags chos can/ zag bcas yin par thal/ phyogs phyi ma ltar khas len pa de'i phyir dang / mnyam gzhag pa'i rgyud kyi bdun yid zag med du 'dod pa'i rnam rig pa rnams chos can/ zag med yin par thal/ bzhed phyogs dang po ltar khas len pa de'i phyir/ khyab pa snga phyi dngos/ 'di la zlon ci mdzad/ nged tshor ma zad khyed la'ang khyab rtags kyi lan rtsi tshul kha dog dkar dmar ba zhig gi bzo sta'ang ma byung 'dug pa 'di rang gis rigs smra 'bum phrag dbang por gsol ba'icispyan sngar ngo tshar mi che 'am ༈ zag bcas kyi sgras bsnyad tshad la zag bcas kyis khyab par mi 'dod kyang /zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal ba/ zhes seng ge'i nga ro dang bor sgrogs—mkhan ni bcom ldan 'das nyid lags mod/ de yang khong ba nai rāljana'i 'gram sogs phag phug rer bzhugs te sangs rgyas ba tsam las/ grwa sa chen bo 'grims nas thal phyir gyi rigs par ma sbyangs stabs nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas zhes pa'i zhib cha zhig ma thon pa yin mchi'o/ ༈ /gad rgyangs su// theg chen mthong lam pa zag bcas min pa dang / zag bcas gnas gyur ces pa'i zag bcas ni nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas nyid las ma 'das bas/ bag chags bsgo gzhi la spyir zag med mi rung yang nyon mongs pa'i zag med ci'i phyir mi rung / khyod kyis bag chags bsgo gzhi'i theg chen

210'phags pa de nyid rang 'bras sdug kun mi bzad pa'i 'byung gnas su khas ma blangs na/ de bag chags bsgo gzhir khas blangs pa don med par thal ba lung rigs gnyis car gyis shugs bskyed nas bsgrubs pa des khyed rang nyid kyi kha la dam rgya ya med sbyin pa sus mi shes/ /bsdu ba las/ nyon mongs pa las byung ba'i 'du byed dang / sdug bden skyed pa gnyis rim par sdug kun so so'i don du bzhag pa de nyid gung thang rin po ches zhing tshor tshags su drangs te/ rang rgyu las nyon gyis bskyed pa'i zag bcas kyi dngos po de sdug bsngal bden pa dang / rang 'bras sdug bden skyed pa'i las nyonaci rigs kyis bsdus ba de kun 'byung bden pa'i ngo bor bzhag pa la yang /nyid nas gad rgyangs la ji ltar brjod pa'i skyon thams cad lhag lus me da par brjod na 'phags pa thogs med dang bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs rnam gnyis kyang zhal rog ger bzhugs nges pas kha thang thang du rgyug chog pa khyod /kho nar 'gyur ro/ ༈ /yang gad rgyangs su 'gog lam so so'i mtshan nyid bzhag pa khyod kyis 'gog tshul ltar na/ ri bong rwa chos can / rang gi rgyur gyur ba'i gzhan don don gnyer gyi 'dun pa las byung zhing rang gi grogs byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dod pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi theg chen 'a ma gyi gzhung shing du bstan pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i yid kyi rnam rig byang bar can yod par thal/ theg chen sems bskyed yed pa'i phyir/ yang de chos can/ rang gi rgyu las skyes pa yod par thal/ 'dus byas yong ba'i phyir/ yang de chos can/ rang rgyu las nyon gyis bskyed pa'i zag bcas gyi dngos po yod par thal/ snag bden yod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa 'di rigs/

211la'ang kun mkhyen rjes 'brang dang bcas pas lan 'debs tshul ma mkhyen pa'am/ mnyam ma bzhag pa ci rigs su 'gyur bas khyed nas lan ji ltar—mdzad kyi mchan bu re gnang bar zhu/ bsdus tshad du zhe 'dod la ltos te—rang sgra'i thad rtsod gzhi 'khrid mi 'khrid ci rigs su mdzad pa la/ khyod ltar4'khrid dgos nges can yin tshe/ rnam mkhyen chos can/ rang 'dzin rtog—ba'i zhen gzhir rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub par thal/ zhes pa dang / de—chos can/ rang rig dang so so rang rig pa'i ye shes gang rung yin par—thal/ zhes pa la'ang rang sgra'i thad rtsod gzhi khrid de mthong tshad kyi shing4thams cad la beto 'o zhes smra ba'i 'gros de nyid bdag gir mdzod cig ༈rang rgyu las nyon las byung ba'i zag bcas la rang rgyu las nyon gyi lag rjes —las byung ba'i zag bcas kyisdo/ khyab par gang du khas blangs/ ༈ yul bden pa la shes spong mngon sgom ci rigs byas na/ yul bden pa nyid spang bar bya ba dang / mngon du bya ba sogs kyi gzhi mthun du 'gyur dgos phyin/rang gi bdog pa'i dngos bo la za 'thung gyon 'ding ci rigs kyis longs spyad na dngos po de nyid bza' bar bya ba dang / btung bar bya ba dang /bgo bar bya ba dang / gding bar bya ba la sogs pa yin pa mi srid pa'i—shes bya dgu brtsegs kyi gzhi mthun du thal bar 'gyur bas mi rung ngo zhes/ smos la dkor rdzas gang yod thams cad 'ug dmar gyi tshang bzhin du sog 4cig nged tshos 'gog bden gyi mtshan nyid bzhag par skyon bzung ba'ang bka' drin che mod/ de bas dbu mar/ lam bden stobs kyis sgrib gnyis gang rung spangs pa'i chos nyid de phra ba'i 'gog bden gyi mtshan nyid

212 du bzhag pa la don skyon zhig 'byung nges pas de sel ba khyod la bab pa min nam/ ༈ gad rgyangs las/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i mtshan nyid kyi zur du cha bzhag sbyar ba'i tigs 'gres kyis sems kyi bslab pa'i mtshan nyid la'ang de sbyor dgos ba go sla bar dgongs nas tshig zin la ma sbyar ba ni/ dper na/ kun mkhyen rtags rig mtha' dpyod du/ rjes khyab kyi mtshan nyid la bsgrub bya'i chos kyi don ldog dang 'brel stobs zhes ma sbyar kyang de sbyor dgos pa/ ldog khyab kyi mtshan nyid zur la de sbyar ba'i rigs 'gres kyis go ba bzhin yin zhing / rnam pa gcig tu na/ skyabs 'gros zin pa'i dang bo'i nyer bsdogs mtshan nyid sor rig dang mtshungs ldan gyi ting nge 'dzinasachos can/ zhi tshoganas yin par thal/ lhag pa sems kyi bslab ba yin pa'i phyir na/ dmigs bsal te/ 'o na sa mthon po'i bar chad med lam du gyur ba'i 'dod sems kyi ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab chos can/rim par zhi gnas dang lhag mthong yin par thal/ rim bzhin lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa dang / lhag pashes rab gyi bslab pa yin pa'i phyir/spyir khyab pa rnam 'grel mtha' dpyod kyis 'grub/ khyab pa 'grigs byas kyang rung ngo / /bslab gsum gyi ngo bo ni/ rnam 'grel mtha' dpyod las/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pa yin na tshul khrims dang / sems kyi bslab pa la zhi gnas dang / shes rab kyi bslab pa la lhag mthong dgos par mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa bzhed pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par rgya bod kyi gzhung du ma las byung ngo / /'on kyang byang chub gzhung lam las/ thos bsam gyi shes rab dang lhag mthong ni shes rab kyi bslab pa sta/

213zhes gsungs pa 'di rjes yab sras kyi gzhung gzhan dang sgras zin mi mthun pa sta bur 'dug cing / kun mkhyen bla mas thos bsam gyi shes rab khyad par can ni shes rab kyi bslab pa'i rjes 'brang du bzhed snang mod/ khyed ni shing bus tshems par 'dru ba 'ba' zhig gi dgongs brel gyis tshul de rigs la sna gtan ma bebs 'dug go /nyon mongs dang sdug bsngal skyed pa'i gnas ngan len dang rjes su 'brel zhes pa ni/ nyon mongs dang sdug bsngal skyed pa'i gnas ngan len rjes su 'brel ba ste de dang bcas zhes pa'i don yin pas byed kyi ngan rtog de 'dra'i gnas med de/ gzhan du na/ rje thams cad mkhyen pas/khams gsum gyi 'du byed thams cad ni nyon mongs ba'i phyogs dang mthun ba'i gnas ngan len dang ldan pas/ zhes pa nas/ nyon mongs pa'i phyogs dang mthun pa'i gnas ngan len dang rjes su 'brel ba ste/ zhes—dang / 'di ni las dang nyon mongs pa snga ma'i gzhan dbang du gyur cing sdug bsngal dang nyon mongs pa phyi ma rnams skye ba'i sa bon rjes su 'brel bas na kun tu 'gro pa'i sa/nas ngan len dang ldan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa la'ang khyod kyi bsnyon ham ngan pa de btsong rigs par 'gyur ro/ ༈ /khyod rang la/ don byed nus ba bum pa'i mtshan nyid du bzhag pa 'gog mi—nus bar thal/ kun mkhyen bla mas/ yul yul can dang gzhi lam rnam gsum bden stong du rtogs pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel de/ dngos bstan gtso bo'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid du bzhag pa lta bu yin khyab mnyam tsam yang ma grub pa ches mang ba'i phyir/ 'di lan gyis zlog par mi nus pa'i thal 'gyur du
