214song ngam ma song rigs smra tshor 'o brgyal mi dgos/ nyid rang nas thugs bsam zhig bzhes par zhu/ phar phyin rang lugs la mi shes pa kun shes par byed pa'i dbang po'i ngo bo ni/ gser phreng drangs zin pa ltar 'das lam zag med kho nar gnas pa la/ khyed la dbang bo de ka'i ngo bo las sde dang nyi snang gtan mi mthun pa'i tshul 'ol 'gros tsam yang ma shar snang ste/ gzhan du na bsdu ba sogs las bshad pa'i zag bcas kyi dbang po nyid lugs 'dir snga phyir yang yang shong rdzong byed don med pa'i phyir ro/ ༈ /khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal zhes pa'i go don yang nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas gzhir bzhag gi steng nas bshad pa yin zhing /yig char/ rgyu dang lam dang zhes sogs kyi dngos bstan lam shes sbyor ba la rnam grangs kyi sag bcas dgos par gsungs shing / rnam grangs kyi zag bcas yin na zag bcas btags pa pa yin pas khyab pa ni/ gser phreng las/ 'di nyi snang du rnam grangs kyi zag bcas su gsungs pas zag bcas btags pa yin/ zhes gsungs pas shes la/ des sgom lam dang po gsum yang zag bcas dngos min par ches gsal ba dang / gzhan yang / spyir zag bcas kyi sgras bsnyad pa la dngos dang rnam grangs pa'i dbang du byas pa sna tshogs shig snang mod/ khyed kyis 'bru thams cad nas rdog gcig tu bsgril bar mdzad 'dug ste/ de lta na/ bdag med rtogs pa'i theg chen rtog bcas sgom lam de nyid bdag lta'i sa/nyen po byed pa nyid kyis na zag med dang / rtog bcas sgom lam yin pa nyid kyis na zag bcas su 'gyur bas zag bcas zag med gnyis kyi gzhi mthun yang khas

215len dgos par 'gyur ba dang / khyed nas lugs 'dir gser phreng dang rnam bshad kyis gsal kha ma thon pa'i zhib cha ya med bton pa skad kyis rtog bcas sgom lam ni bden snang dang bcas pa'i cha nas zag bcas su ba'ag ces bris pa ltar 'thad na ni/ dbu ma'i rnam bshad dang yig cha gnyis kar ma rig pa dang de'i bag chags gang rung gis bslad pa zag bcas dang / des ma bslad pa zag med du 'jog pa thal 'gyur ba'i thun mong min pa'i lugs su gsungs pa sug las kyis dbyi dgos par 'gyur ro/ ༈ /ngor lan gnam lcags 'khor lo sogs smra ngan phye mar 'thag pa'i bstan bcos de snyed mdzad pa po rnams la'ang / pha rol po'i snying la gzir ba'i tshig rtsub rgyan yin na srog la rgol ba'ang rgyan du 'gyur bar mchi bas de 'dra mi gsung bar zhu zhes snyan sgron phub dang / bstan bcos de dang der 'byin 'jug gang dbo/sa byed par 'gyur ro/ ༈ /kun btus dang sa/ser phreng gnyis ka yang bzang rtog dang ngan rtog gang yin spong dgos zer ba'i gras su brdzangs te/ rang nyid kho na skyon gyis ma gos skurshamadog dkar du zhal gyis bzhes spro 'am/ spyir lung zhig 'dren rgyu yod pa—tsam po zhes sting tshig gis smod par 'os pa'i mtshan gzhi la gser 'phreng dmab⑫/ga pa ni rje bla mar 'khon lan 'dra yod pas yin mchi/ ༈ khyod kyis—khams bco lnga la zag bcas kyis khyab par thal ba spro tshul ltar na/ dbang—po nyer gnyis kyi dang po bcu bzhi la kun nyon gyi dbang po dang / dad sogs lnga la 'jig rten pa'i lam dang / rgyun zhugs dang so skye la las nyonarshagyis skye ba blangs pa'i gang zag gis khyab par thal ba sogs kyi sprang dbyug

216dargu bskor du bgyis te thogs med sku mched nas kun mkhyen bla ma'i bar gyi dbu la ci phog gang phog bgyid dgos par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang kun btus su/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dpe dang sku dang zhing gi 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams zag bcas dang spang byar bstan par thal/'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ der rig pa rgyun chad khas blangs pa'i sgo nas gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa la skur ba btab par thal/ khyod kyis gnod sgrub yang dag tu rlom pa'i thal 'gyur de dang de'i phyir ro/ ༈ /'du byed kyi sdug bsngal la dpyad skabs rang rgyu nyon mongs las byung ba dang / de'i lag rjes las byung ba ma phyed par rigs pa sog ma rul ba'i mda' gzhu 'dra ba phyag ma thogs pa gnang 'dug ste/ de lta na/ nyon mongs kyi lag rjes su bzhag pa'i zag bcas kyi phung po gang yin thams cad 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal te/ zhes pa dang / nyer len gyi phung po chos byu can// sdug bsngal ba yin te/ las nyon gyi gzhan dbang can yin pa'i phyir/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa rje yab sras kyi legs bshad dang yig cha so sor byung ba rnamasala'ang bden 'dzin sogs shes sgrib phyogs kyis ma nges ya brjod na sun 'byin nus nges pas khyod kho na phyogs las rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ ༈ /rang rgyu nyon mongs pa las byung ba'i shes sgrib de kho kho rang yin pa rang re la mngon sum yin par thal/ mngon sum la bsnyon tshul de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de bye smra la yang mngon sum yin par thal lo/ ༈ /las 'bras kyi 'brel ba shin tu phra ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi gsang ba shin tu za mo la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa gnyis ni/ 'kho 'bras rags pa sogs la

217rmongs pa'i ma rig pa sogs kyis bzhag pa'i bag chags las 'bras phra ba sogs la sgrib byed du song ba zhig lam rig pa zhes btags pa yin gyi ma rig pa dngos min la/ khyed kyis gsang phra sogs la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa shes par gyur pa'i shes sgripa yin pa'i sgrub byed du shes sgrib dang mnyam du spong rgyu'i shes pa yin pa bkod pa ni ma nges pa chen po ste/ de lta na dag sa'i kun slong gi rtog pa phra mo 'ang shes sgrib tu thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ ༈ /snyas bya la dmigs pa'i tshul gyis spong dgos pa dang / rang rgyud la skye ba'i rgyun gtan du bcad pa'i tshul gyis spong dgos pa'i rigs gnyis las/ de la dmigs pa'i nyon mongs spangs na de spangs par 'jog pa dang mi 'jog pa gtso che chung gis 'byed cig dmigs pa'i tshul gyis spong dgos pa rnams ni de la dmigs pa'i 'dun pa'i 'dod chags spangs pas de spangs par 'jog gi spyir chos de la dmigs pa'i 'dun pa'i 'dod chags spangs na chos de spangs pas khyab par gtan mi 'dod pas nya dang nyung ma'i dpe bdag gir mi mdzad par zhu/ gang zag gzhan rgyud kyi sgrib pa de dngos gnyen gyis rgyun bcad pa'i tshul gyis spong ba med na gang zag gzhan— de 'tshang rgya ba mi srid dgos pa e go ༈ thal 'gyur ba'i lugs la shes par gyur pa'i shes sgrib yod phyin de shes sgrib kyi bag chags 'jog byed du cis kyang rigs pa la/ lhag mthong chen mo las/ sa brgyad pa thob pa'i byang sems la gnyis snang 'khrul ba'i bag chags gsar du 'jog byed zad pa yin yang / zhes sa brgyad pa yan na shes sgrib kyi bag chags 'jog byed med par gsungs pa 'di las lhag pa'i shes byed dge

218ldan pa zhig la ci dgos/ nyid nas shes par gyur pa'i shes sgrib yod pa'i—lung ji snyed drangs pa gang na yang nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i ma rig pa zhes pa tsam las de shes pa yin pa gtan mi gsal zhing / de shes pa min—pa'i sgrub byed/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis/ shesahopardzigacig gis bden gnyis cig car du/ /mngon sum gzigs pa'i sgrib—byed phra ba la/ /ma rig ces btags shes pa dngos min pas/ /zhesachagasungs pa la dgag pa sa rub rdo rub bgyis rma ra ma zad/ rje bla ma'i rjes 'brang gi mkhas pa chen po dag gi gsung drangs pa tsam gyis ci yang mi —'grub po zhes khyod kyis zhal bzhes dngos su mdzad 'dug pas/ de sogs— lung gzhan gang drangs la/ de ni zhe sdang 'ba' zhig las gzu bor gnasadzāpa'i gtam lta ci shes pa rang bzhin du gnas pa'i gtam du 'ang mi snang rshazhes khyad gsod kho na bgyid pa las ma 'das pa de lta mod/ dpal ldan zla—bas/ shes bya'i sgrib pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi nyon mongs pa can ma yin pa'i ma rig pa'o/ /zhes pa'i sgras zin gyi ma rig pa'i ngo bo ngos 'dzin pa4na / rje'i phyi rtsom gyi gsung rab gzhan las ji skad du/ slob dpon 'di'i lugs kyis bden 'dzin nyon mongs can gyi ma rig par bzhed la/ nyon—mongs kyi bag chags shes sgrib tu bzhed pa ltar bya yi/ bden 'dzin shes sgrib la 'chad pa dgongs pa min te/ gzhan du rgyas par bshad zin4rto / /zhes shin tu gsal bar gsungs pa 'dis cang e 'grub/ gal te des kyang mi 'grub po zhe na ni nges par rang nyid shes pa rang bzhin du mi gnasadzhapar song ba yin pa e go gong du bshad pa de dang tshul mthun par

shu 1)1(sbyo/————rje btsun byams pa mgon pos/ 'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa gang / /de ni shes bya'i sgrib par 'dod/ /ces bden 'dzin gyi bag chags la bden 'dzin gyi ming gis btags nas bstan pa sogs shes byed mtha' yas kyang / rang gi zhe 'dod re dang ma mthun tshe kha med mig med ces mgo skogs 'phred g.yug 'ba' zhig byed pa dag la drangs pas ci zhig phan/ ༈ /de dag gi gzhung rnams la sna tshogs pa zhig snang pas mtha' gcig tu thal 'gyur ba'i gzhung gi nges pa med ces smra ba'ang ma nges pa chen po ste/ de lta na dge ldan pa'i grwa sa so so'i dbu ma'i mtha' dpyod chen po rnams kyang thal 'gyur ba'i gzhung ma yin par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ ༈ stong thun sogs las dka' gnas la blo mi gsal ba'i cha dang / dngos po bden par snang ba'i cha sogs shes sgrib tu bzhag pa 'dis shes sgrib la shes pa zhig yod pa ji ltar gsal/ gal te shin tu gsal na ni nyid kyi mkhan rin po ches zhang zhung ba'i gsung drangs te/ thal 'gyur ba'i lugs la shes sgrib la shes pa yod pa'i khungs rje yab sras kyi gzhung 'di ‘pas gsal med/ ces ci'i phyir gsungs/ kho bo cag gis stong thun dang / spyod ṭīka gi lung 'di gnyis kyis shes sgrib la shes pa mi 'jog pa gsal bar bstan ces smra yi gnod byed sab sib tsam ma yin pa yod na smos shig shes sgrib la mngon gyur pa dang lkog gyur pa gnyis bzhag pa ni shes sgrib la shes pa 'jog dgos ba'i sgrub byed mthar thug go zer ba ci la shasams pa yin/ shes pa ma yin pa tham sa cad la mngon gyur pa dang lkog rgyur pa'i khyad med pa'am/shes pa ma yin pa'i shes sgrib nyid la de 'dra'i khyad med par 'dod/ dang

220 —po ltar na/ khyad par bzhis khyad par du byas pa'i rgyu sbyin pa btang ba lta bu lkog gyur pa dang / sbyin 'bras longs spyod lta bu mngon gyur pa yin pa'i khyad par yang med pan thal lo/ /gnyis pa ltar na yang mi 'thad de/rgyu bden 'dzin gyi bag chags de lkog gyur pa yin pa gang zhig rgyu bag chags de las skyes pa'i 'bras bu bden snang ni mngon gyur pa la 'jog pa khyed ce re long gi tshul bzhes pa ma gtogs khyed rang gis drangs pa'i spyod 'jug dar ṭīka na ches gsal ba'i phyir// de yang mi gsal lo zhe na ni so sdom la sdom pa'i bag chag/sa mngon gyur pa dang / sa bon mngon gyur pa gnyis bzhag pa la rigs bsgros te dpyad na nyid nas dgongs par 'gyur snyan mo/ ༈ /rnam bshad las/ shes sgrib kyi gtso bo ni gnyis snang 'khrul ba'i bag chags la bya dgos te/ zhes gsungs pas/ bag chags yin pas khyab na gtso bo gsungs ba don med par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ zer ba ni tshig la skyon che bar ma zad/ dogs pa yang gnas ma yin pa kho na ste/ rnam bshad la brteganas shes sgrib la bag chags kyis khyab par bdag gi bla ma yab sras rjes 'brang dang bcas pas gang du khas blangs/gnyis snang 'khrul ba'i bag chags ni shes sgrib kyi gtso bo yin pa dang /de'i 'bras bu gnyis snang 'khrul cha ni shes sgrib tu bsdu dgos pa rnam bshad sogs kyi dgongs par ring mo zhig nas 'chad bzhin yod pas/ gtso bo gsungs pa don med par thal ba de khyod kyis su la 'phangs pa yin/ ༈zhang zhung chos dbang grags pas/ 'jug pa'i rnam bshad du/ bag chags kyis bslad pas snang yul la 'khrul ba'i blo skyed pa'o/ /zhes

221 gsungs pa dang phyogs mthun par gnyis snang 'khrul ba'i sems 'byung ba ste skyed pa ni shes sgrib yin pa dang / de sangs rgyas kho na la ldog par bzhed pa yin gyi/ gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i sems kho rang shes sgri ba tu 'jog par bzhed pa ga la yin/ de yin na ni 'byung ba zhes pa'i yig don la ma zhugs par ma zad so skye'i shese pa thams cad dang / mnyam gzhag min ba'i 'phags pa'i ye shes thams cad kyang shes sgrib tu thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ ༈ /rtsom pa po su yin cung zad nor ba tshun chad kyang khyed nas rtsar zhib gcod mdzad rgyu yin tshe/ thog mar rang gis/ chu khams gser dang nam mkha' rnams/ /dag pa bzhin du dag par 'dod/ /ces pa'i lung 'di 'dren tshe theg bsdus las zhes drangs nas rang gi de nyid—dmar rjen du bstan 'dug pa'i lung de 'phags pa thogs med kyis brtsams pa yin min rtsar zhib gcod dang / de nas/ bde nas bde bar 'gro ba la/ — /sem sa shes su zhig sgyid lug 'gyur/ /zhes pa de rin chen phreng ba dang / gzugs kyi rten la mthong lam thob pa yod par ston pa/'dod pa dang gzugs na spyod pa'i/ zhes sogs kyi lung de blo gros rab gnon gyi mdo dang / gzugs ni dbu ba rdos pa 'dra/ zhes sogs rtsa she dang / gang phyir rten 'byung ma yin pa'i/ /chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin pa / /zhes pa dbu ma snying po'i thad gang na yod pa rnams dang / don dam de nyid yul la rtag tu ni/ /chen po rnams ni tshig la rton pa min/ /yul gyi ming rnams kyi ni don shes na/ /bstan bcos sgra rnams kyis ni ci zhig bya/ /zhes pa 'di dus 'khor rtsa rgyud kyi gzhung yin pa'i rgyu mtshan

222'khrul med bcas khyed kyis rtsar bcad de nged tshor yang gsung rogasaṃ zhu/'on kyang byug gzhung bas thal 'gyur ba'i lugs la shes par gyur pa'i shes sgrib khas mi len par thal/ kun mkhyen bla ma las gzhan de ltar 'dod mkhan med pa'i phyir te/ kun mkhyen bla ma ma getogs de ltar khas len pa yang med/ ces khyed kyi mkhan rin po ches gsungs pa'i phyir/ ༈ dpal mang rin po che'i rim lnga'i zin bris las/ rim pa bzhi pa'i don gyi 'od gsal ma thob gong du sa chu thim rim gyi skabs su bshad pa'i rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa nyon mongs pa dang / don gyi 'od gsal gyi rjenu/ su lugs ldog gi nyer thob sogs la thim rim bshad pa'i rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa nyon mongs ma yin par nyon mongs de dag gi bag chags la 'jog dgos/ zhes dang / rje ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i rim lnga'i zin bris las/ rim pa bzhi pa'i don gyi 'od gsal yan du snang mched thob/ gsum thim rgyu yod par sa/sungs pa 'dir/ bag chags rkyang pa thim pa min par rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa re yang 'gag rgyu yod dgos/des na rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rlung de'i bzhon pa can gyi sems rtog pa re yod pas de shes sgrib min tshul med pas/ rang res shes sgrib la shes pa 'jog pa 'di sngags lugs la shin tu'ang 'jog dgos pa 'dis shes zhes rdo rje 'chang ratna dhwa dza'i zhal nas gsungs/ zhes pa 'di gnyis kyis rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa la rang rang gi bag chags kyang 'jog pa dang / rim pa bzhi ba'i 'od gsal gyi rjes su byung ba'i rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa de shes sgrib yin par gsungs e 'dug 'di rmi lam min 'dug pas

sku223mig legs par phye la ltos shig 'di dag sngar ma mthong ba min 'dra yang /yab sras nyi zla lta bu de dag kun mkhyen bla ma'i rjes 'brang gi khrid nas khyi ro bzhin drud de gdan khri la bshes gnyen chen po nyid rang lhod bzhugs/ mdzad na snyam pa'i gzims rmis ngo mtshar can byung ba yin mchi/ khyed nas khas len med pa la 'phangs pa skad pa'i mda' de su la zug 'dugadapal ldan bkra shis 'khyil bas bdag gi bla ma yab sras la nongs pa ci yang ma mdzad stabs khas blangs med pa la rdzun khog 'gel mi rigs par bshad pa de de bzhin lags mod/ khyed nas don 'di la sdigs mo dang bcas rdzun lab bam bo ches ngan khag ci lcogs su bskyal ba ni nged kyi bla ma'i mdzad pajil brten nas nyid sku tshe phyed ring ma babs pa'i khur chen 'degs pa'i 'o brgyal gyis 'da' dgos byung ba de'i shajiblan pa yin mchi/nyid nas shog snag gi 'gro sgo dang sku tshegs kyi 'o brgyal la ma 'dzems par shes par gyur pa'i shes sgrib yod pa'i khungs sngar sus kyang ma mthong ba mang bo drangs pa dang / kun rtog brgyad cu shes sgrib tu bzhag pa'i rtsod spong mdzad pa dang / rtog pa de dag spong tshul gyi dka' gnas la dri ba mdzad pa sogs kyis bdag gi bla ma yab sras spa bkong ste bzhugs 'dug go/ ༈ /ma rig bag chags kyi sa dang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'chi 'pho sogs chos can/ nyer len kyi phung po yin par thal/ phra ba'i sdug bden yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ dbu ma'i mtha' dpyod kyi phra ba'i sdug bden gyi mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ byas na khyed nas ci gsung / ༈ nged tsho re 'khang gi gnas min pa khyed dgongs dag tu chug kyang / nyid nas shes sgrib la zag

224bcas mtshan nyid pa zhig dgos pa'i sgrub byed mthar thug la/ de ltar mi mang la grags pa'i phyir/ zhes pa tsam las lung rigs yang dag pa sna sa/cig kyangane'agod rgyu ma rnyed par dka' sla'i sbyang rim sogs kyi bslab 'domasacimang po mdzad pa ni 'khang ra mi bzad pa'i gnas su che'o/ ༈ /khyod kyis 'khor ba la dpyad skabs shes sgrib phyogs kyi spang bya phal mo che zhig rang rgyu nyon mongs las byung bar bsgrubs pa dang / gong du ma rig bag chags kyi sa dang / zag med kyi las dang / des bskyed pa'i yid lus dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'chi 'pho rnams las nyon gyis 'dum byas bar thogs 'grel sogs kyis nan tan du bsgrubs pa gnyis glang chen gyis mi theg pa'i 'gal khur du che ba e dgongs/ ༈ /gzhan rgyud kyi nyer len gyi phung bo de gnyen pos gtan zad byed nus sam mi nus/ mi nus na nyer phung la gnyen bos gtan zad kyis spong dgos pas khyab pa ji ltar sgrub/ nus na ni/ de chos can/ gnyen pos gtan zad byed mi nus par thal/ theg dman mthong lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar gyi lam gang gis kyang zad par byed mi nus ba'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ ma grub na/ shā ri'i bu lta bus dgra bcom thob tshe gzhan rgyud kyi nyer phung gtan zad byas par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag dngos bo'i 'jig rgyur thal ba'i lta ngan phyag bzo ma de rang gis gyon cigayang 'khor ba spangs ba'i lhag med dgra bcom gyis 'dod nyon ma lus pa gtan zad byas par thal/ des nyer len gyi phung bo spangs tshul 'thad pa'i phyir1 'dod na/ mngon sum la snyon par ma byed cig byas na ci

22lhasmra/ ༈ sdug bsngal 'di ma lus par spangs pa/ zhes sogs kyi mdo dang 'gal zer ba ni rdza ma khur ba'i rdo 'thab ste/ mdor sdug bsngal 'di zhes snug bden spangs pa dang zad pa snegs su gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ni/ sdug bsngal 'di zhes nye tshig smos pas na nyer phung la 'jog rgyu'i nang gi sdug bden la dgongs so zhe na/ de lta na de sdug bden la 'jog rgyu'i nang gi nyer phung la dgongs so zhes kyang ci'i phyir bshad mi rigs/nye bar len pa dang ldan ba'i phung po yin par thal/ 'dod chags dang ldan pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir na/ 'dir ma khyab ste/ snga ma'i ldan pa'i don ni/ kun 'dus red ṭīka las/ ldan pa'i tshul yang nyer len gyi bdag nyid dang / nyer len gyi rgyu las byung ba sogs sgo drug dang 'brel pa bya ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar nye bar len pa'i sgo drug ci rigs dang 'brel ba la bya dgos shing / de yang zag pa'i sgo drug ci rigs dang 'brel tshul dang mi mthun pa'i zhib cha phra mo rang 'byed dgos pa la/ nyid nas rtsa ba ma mthong bar thang stong la thal stong spungs pa'i ham bshur des su zhig 'pham/ ༈ grub mtha'i khyad par phye ba ni sdug kun don gcig tu 'dod mi 'dod steng nas yin gyi/ nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas dang nyer len gyi phung po don gcig tu 'dod mi 'dod kyi khyad phye ba gtan min pas/'gal brjod mang po bris kyang shog snag gi gron las med ces khyed rang gis gsungs pa nges par dgongs dag cing / khyed la 'gal ba mang bo zhig 'du ba'i thugs dgongs byung ba ni gangs ri sngon por shar ba'i snang tshul 'ba' zhig las ma 'das so/ ༈ /dbu ma phung bo lnga pa zla ba'i gzhung du

— rdzo26 khas ma blangs pas na/ bu stonadngha dang rgyal tshab kyis zla bas mdzad par dzhabazhed ces gsal kha mjod pa tshig bklags pa tsam gyis shes pas mtshang du rshaji ltar 'gyur/ gzhan du na/ bshes gnyen po nyid chos can na tsho don 'di skor la rje'i gsung rab la zur za byed par thal/ khyod kyis dbu ma phung bo lnga pa de bu ston dang rgyal tshab kyis zla bas mdzad par bzhed ces khas len pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas so/ ༈ /chu'i 'khrul 'khor du 'jug pa'i 'grel bshad la 'jug pa'i rgya cher 'grel zhes drangs pa ni don thob kyi dbang du byas pa tsam las rang ming sba don ci la yod/ gzhan du na/ rje thams cad mkhyen pas mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel bshad 'dren pa'i skabs du mar 'grel chen las zhes drangs shing / kun mkhyen bla ma sogs kyis dus 'khor ṭīka bshad la dus 'khor ṭīka chen las/ zhes drangs 'dug pas / de dang de la'ang bstan bcos kyi rang ming sbas so zhes yi mug sgoms la dzhamachi ma thon cig de bas khyod kyis le'u bcu gnyis pa'i sgron gsal mchanarsha'adren skabs/ rje'i phyi rtsom gyi gsung rab gzhan du'ang gsungs te/ jirshaskad du/ zhes drangs pa ni/ nges par kha zhe med par yi mug ldang ba'irdziganas te/ tshul 'dis/ rna tsho na gnas pa'i nya ni rab gab kyang / /chu mi rlabs kyi 'gyur ba rnams kyis ston/ /ces pa ltar gang gi lhag bsam gyi rang mdangs rjen par mtshon pa'i phyir ro// tsho 'dir/ bal bo'i ze'u 'bru ma zos kyang / kha dog dbyibs las bro ba shes/ /zhes sa paṇa gyi gsung dang / 'og tu/ log ba'i lam la—mtha' med phyir/ /zhes rigs pa'i dbang phyug gi gsungs bcos bsgyur

227gang 'dod 'dod cig bgyis 'dug pa ni gzhung rang rang gi don dngos snang la ma nges bar song bas nongs pa yin nam gzhung 5ra bzhag gis — mtshims pa gang yin cha ma 'tshal to ༈ /'khor ba'i don dang mtshan nyid lta bu bzhag pa na nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas gzhir bzhag yin pas khyod kyis brjod pa'i skyon de dang de 'jug pa'i gnas med do/ /gal te nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas zhes sgras zin par ma sbyar bas skyon rnams cis kyang 'jug go zhe na/ de ltar na/ kun mkhyen bla mas/ zag bcas kyi sung po chos/ can/ srid pa zhes bya ste/ sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa dang / rang gis kyang sdug kun gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa nyer len gyi phung bo 'khor ba yin pa'i sgrub byed du 'gro zhes bris pa la yang / sdug kun gyi 'bras bur gyur pa'i lam bden chos can/ srid pa yin par thal/ sdug bden yin par thal/ 'khor ba yin par thal/ sdug kun gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i phyir/ de ltar brgyud pa las skyes pa'i lam bden yod pa'i phyir/mi dge bcu 'jol nyog tu spyad pa las byung ba'i sangs 'phags yod pa'i phyir/ mo gsham las skyes ba'i bu chung yod pa'i phyir/ khyi mo las skyes ba'i seng phrug yod pa'i phyir/ bong rgan las skyes pa'i glang rgan yod pa'i phyir sogs khyod kyi a long yang long gi lung rigs ngo mtshar can de spros la/ lang rgyu dang bag tsha rgyu med par rang gzhan 'os mi 'os thams cad kyi khi la rgyahongan rim pa bdun po de thob cig ༈ gang rgyangs su/ shes bya chos can/ yod pa yin te/ tshad mas dmigs pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i

228 khu sbyo ra ba lta bu rtags chos don gsum don gcig pa'i sbyor bar gsungs pa la/ nyid nas ser 'bras dge gsum gyi rigs smra dbang por sbran te bzhad gad gnam sa ra mi shong ba mdzad mi ltar na/ sgra de sgra sgrar sgrubs pa'i gzhi rtags tha dad med pa dang / gzhi chos tha dad med pa dang /rtags chos tha dad med pa'i rtags gsum ga yin par gsungs pa dang /sgra yin par thal/ sgra yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur rtags gsal tha mi dad kyi thal 'gyur du bshad pa sogs la'ang / rmongs tshabs che ba dang /khas len shor tshabs che ba sogs tshad ma pa spyi'i gdong gyen du 'degs tshul med pa'i mtshang sdu ga shos su go nas rigs smra gsar bu dag gis khrel rgod sna tshogs byed pa la'ang / khyed nas de rigs par ma byang ba dag gisadzhartags chos don gsum du 'gro rgyu'i sgra gsum tha dad med nga sa de'i gzhi rtags sogs tha dad med pa los yin snyam du bris pa go ba tham thom nag nur ma'i lugs yin pas rma tshan nyid pas bshad tshul dang mi mthun gsungs shig gzhan yang / de sgrub kyi 'bras rtags yang dag la de sgrub kyi bsgrub bya'i chos kyi don ldog dang rten byung 'brel grub dgos pa dang /rtags gsal tha mi dad kyi thal 'gyur yin na khyod kyi rtags gsal gnyis ka tha mi dad yin pas ma khyab par gsungs pa sogs kyang mtshan nyid pa'i zhib cha la bden kha ma byin pa'i u tshugs su khas len rgyu yin mchi/ ༈nyer len gyi phung po rnam smin yin pa'i shes byed drangs pa rnams ni nang gi nyer phung ston pa sha stag ste/ gzhan du na phung po lnga ba rtsa 'brel sogs—las nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas la nyer phung gis khyab par gsungs pa

229sogs rtsod yig snga phyir ji snyed drangs pa dag dang 'gal ba'i phyir dang /gal te mi 'gal ba'i rtsod spong ngos gtsang zhig yod tshe cis kyang mdzad 'os pa la zur tsam yang snang rung ma dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /khyed ltar na yang phyi'i nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas rnam sa nyer len gyi phung bo yin par thal/ rje yab sras kyis de de yin par gsungs pa med du chug kyang min par gsungs pa med pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ thal 'gyur ba'i lugs la shes par gyur pa'i shes sgrib yod pa'i rigs pa'i sgrub byed mthar thug de'i phyir ro/ ༈ /ma rig pa dang 'phen byed kyi las sogs nyer len gyi phung po min par bsgrubs pa ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' dang kun mkhyen ha sa badzra'i gsung gnyis rtsis med g.yasu 'jog tu byed pa'i tshig ste/'phags pa 'dzin gyis dris pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' seryā sa dpa' chen po rnarma sa/ nye bar len pa'i phung bo lnga la yang dag par rtog pa ni 'di lta ste/ ma rig pa'i phung po ni nye bar len pa'i phung bo'o/ /sdug bsngal gyi phung po ni nye bar len pa'i phung bo'o/ /gti mug gi phung po ni nye bar len pa'i phung po'o/ /zhes ma rig pa nyer phung du gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir dang / nyon mongs can gyi ma rig pa dang 'phen byed kyi 'al gnyis kun 'byung bden pa yin pas na nang gi sdug bden du 'grub cing / nang gi sdug bden la 'khor ba dang / 'khor ba la nyer len gyi phung bo zhig yin dgos bar/ rnam 'grel gyi/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal can phung po // /zhes pas bstan pa ni phar phyin mtha' dpyod kyi dgongs mthil/de'i phyogs 'dzin rnams kyi dam bca' mthar thug mamo zhal rtsod pa'i

230gzhi'i rtsa bar bzung ba yin pa'i phyir/ yig chas 'khor ba dang nyer phung don gcig tu bzhed pa min na/ rnam 'grel gyi lung de 'khor ba dang nang—gi sdug bden don gcig pa'i phyogs su ji ltar 'grel/ des na dge ba'i bshes gnyen kha sgang ba dang / nged kyi bla ma yab sras/ rdo sbis lha ramasardzipa sogs kyi rtsod sa mthar thug de gang yin sngar nas nyid kyis dgongs yod 'gro ang / ༈ phung po'i bdud ngos 'dzin gyi lung drangs pa rnams kyangarshanang gi chos gzhir bzhag yin zhing / de yang phung po'i bdud la nyer lenardzigyi phung po las gzhan zhig mi 'jog pa'i don las nyer phung la/ phung bdud ngakyis khyab pa'i don gtan min no/ ༈ /kun btus kyi/ las dang nyon mongs pa las byung ba 'di/ zhes pa'i 'di sgra yang / de las byung tsam min par de'i lag rjes la byung ba'i nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas la snyeg dgos pas/ 'phags pa thogs med la 'phangs pa'am gzhan la yin yang rung /blang bya med pa'i thal phreng khrag rgyun nag nar mang po de rigs la thugs las—mi che ba zhu/ ༈ gad rgyangs su kun btus rtsa 'grel gyi sdug bden gyi mtshan gzhi ston pa'i thad ji ltar 'grel ba'i tshul khyed la 'ol spyi'ang legs ri po ma shar 'dug pa la/ khyed kyis las nyon gyi 'bras bu yin tsam la blo rtse gtad 'dug ces phyogs snga'i dgongs pa'i gtad so 'ang shes ba skad pa'i pher gtam des ci zhig bya/ kun btus kyi don rgyal tshab ltar 'grelarshadagos pa'i phyir/ zhes dar ṭīka drangs pa des phyogs snga'i bshad pa layolhag ci zhig thon snyam pa yin/ phyogs sngas dar ṭīka gi thad 'di dang mi mthun pa'i log 'grel ci /zhigu byas/ de bas dar ṭīka gis/‘ bcud las

231nyon gyi rnam smin dang / snod de'i bdag 'bras yin pa shes pa'i ched/ces 'grel rgyu yin pa la/ khyed kyis/ rgyal tshab rin po che ni rnam smin gyi dbang du byas nas gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes rgyal tshab rin po ches snod bcud gnyis ka rnam smin du gsungs pa skad pa'i log 'grel gyis dpyod ldan yongs la rang gi gzungs gzhug gi mjal kha btang song pa e mkhyen/ dar ṭīka tu// gang skye ba sems can 'gro ba rigs lngas bsdus pa/ zhes gsungs pa 'dis/ kun btus rtsa 'grel thams cad las skye ba zhes pa'i —ṣkag nan gyis sbyar 'dug pa de dgos med kyi tshig lhag tu byas gsung rgyu yin nam/ tsho rgyal tshab thar/sa cad mkhyen pa la 'phred gshags sus brgyab 'dug legs tshopar dgongs shig ༈ gad rgyangs su/ las nyon gyis skye ba blangs pa'i rgyun zhugs sogs chos can/ spang bya yin par thal/ las nyon gyis bskyed pa'i sdug bden yin pa'i phyir na/ sbyor lugs skyon can gyi lan btab pa des de'i rigs 'dra kun phyogs sngas go nus pa gzhir buzhag pa ste/ kha sgang sprel nag pa chen po ni brda dus kyi ming dang tha snyad dus kyi don sbyorahūṃmakhyen pa'i skyes bu yin par ma zad/ pha bzang gi bur song stabs sbyangs pa che zhing go ba zab pa dang / 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa dang / thos don rgyud la sbyor zhing chos 'chad pa'i spobs ba yangs dza sogs chen por rlom pa phal gyis 'gran bzod pa zhig min pas na/ gad rgyangs su'ang tshodangos kyi phyogs sngar song stabs mkhas pa'i lam srol dang bstun te nyamasdori mtshar gyi kha shags re byas pa ma gtogs/ smra ba stobs su rogs pa'i gzhom bya ni/ /mkhas las aungs pa'i bran du bkol rnams —

232min/ /zhes zur gyis bstod pa mang du mdzad pa yin no/ ༈ /las nyon gyis skye ba blangs pa'i dgra bcom chos can/ sdug bden yin par—thal/ rang rgyu las nyon gyis bskyed pa'i zag bcas kyi dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa rang gi yig chas 'grub/ bstan pa'i rtsa pa dang sdug bden—sogs kyi gzhi mthun yod par thal/ bshes gnyen chen po'i so thar gyi—sdom pa de de yin pa'i phyir/ 'di gnyis la khyed nas ci gsung / ༈ gad—rgyangs su nyer len gyi phung po dang / yan lag bcu gnyis/ kun nyon—gsum la sogs pa'i chos du ma zhig rang nyid 'khor ba yin tshul dang / derdzidag rang rang gi thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i 'khor tshul ci rigs re bzhag pa la/ mkhas pa chen po khyed don rags pa 'di lta bur 'khrul ba—ga la srid kyang / 'khor ba'i don zhes pa'i zin so tsam la brten nas—bsnyon ham 'ba' zhig mdzad de mnyam nyid ye shes 'khor bar thal ma thal sogs kyi 'o brgyal mang pos bgres po la mi 'os pa'i sku rlung gi rgyu chen po miphyag tu bzhes pa mi rigs te/ de dang de'i don zer tshad rnam par bzhag 'jog lta bu'i don dang don can kho nar 'dod dgos na ni/ tshad mas—dmigs pa di nga don byed nus pa'i don re bshad na'ang de dang de'i mtshan nyid bzhag pa yin dgos par thal ba dang / dngos bo brgyad dang donadzhabadun cu sher mdo'i don dang / chos kyi sdom bzhi dang bden bzhi gsung rab kyi don min pa'am/ yang na/ dngos po brgyad sogs chos na—dang de la sher mdo dang gsung rab kyis khyab dgos par 'gyur pa'i phyir ro / ༈ /'og min dang bde ldan sogs khams gsum gyis bsdus min ji

233ltar yang / gad rgyangs su khams gsum la 'khor bas khyab par bsgrubs pa ni der drangs pa'i shes byed yang dag pa rnams dang / gzhan yang sbyong rgyud kyi brtag pa phyogs gcig pa las/ de bzhin 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /srid gsum 'khor bar bcings pa 'di/ /zhes dang / dran pa nyer bzhag las/ khams gsum 'di dag thams cad ni/ /zo chun 'khor lo bzhin du 'khor/ /zhes dang / rim lnga'i 'grel ba nor bu'i phreng ba las/ sems can dang snod kyi 'jig rten gyi rang gi ngo bo khams gsum pa 'di ni 'khor ba yin la/ zhes —dang / dus 'khor nang le'i ṭīka bshad las/ 'khor ba yang srid pa gesum gyi mtshan nyid de/ srid pa gsugani khams gsum mo/ /nes dang / rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa las/'jig rten gyi kham sa yongs su dag pa dag na ni sems can dmyal ba dag kyang med/ dud 'gro rnams kyang med/ yi dwags rnams kyang med/'idod pa'i khams kyang med/ gzugs kyi khams kyang med/ gzugs med pa'i khams kyang med/ ces dang / theg bsdus las/ khams gsum las yang dag par 'das pa'i spyod yul ba/ zhes dang / dgongs 'grel 'grel du/ zhing yongs su dag pa rnams khams gsum gyis bsdus sam zhe na/ smras pa/ khams gsum gyis bsdus pa ma yin te/ de'i phyir mdo 'di nyid las/ 'jig rten las 'das pa de'i bla ma'i dge ba'i rtsa ba las byung ba zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams/ dang / khyad par du mkhas grub chos kyi rgyal bos/ dbus mtha'i 'grel bshad du 'dod pa la 'dod chags rgyas par gyur pa rnams la 'dod khams dang /

234 gzugs la 'dod chags rgyas par gyur pa rnams la gzugs khams su gsungs pa khungs su sbyar te/ 'dod khams kyi mtshan nyid du/ khams gsum gyi nang tshan gang zhig 'dod yon gyi dri ro sogs la 'dod pa dang ma bral ba'i sa skor bcas dang / gzugs khams kyi mtshan nyid du/ de gang zhig 'dod yon gyi dri ro sogs la 'dod cha gas dang bral kyang gzugs la 'dod chags dang ma bral ba bzhag pa sogs gzhung chen tshad ma de dang de sgra sor bzhag bgyis na/ dag zhing 'khor bas bsdus pa yin pa'i dogs spong yang mi dgos shing / 'og min stug po bkod gagazugs khams su gsungs pa'ang sgra zoratshuyangs pa'i dbang du byas pa dper na kun btus su semaru/ gnas dgu la zhi rga/nas su bshad pa lta bu'o snyam du dgongs par bcags te gsungs pa yin pas khyed thugayorgyal chen po de tsam mi bzhengs par zhu zhing / 'dir lung 'ga' drangs pa'i dam 'gal gyi nongs pa'ang bzod par gsol/ khyed kyi gnod byed mthar thug bde ldan 'dod khams min na de'i rten la 'bras bu dang po gsum gang yang thob pa med dzir thal ba 'phangs nas/ phyir mi 'ong gsar thob la 'dod rtenacan gyis khyab dgos pa e mkhyen lags/ zhes khengs gtam mi bzad pa'i sting tsho tshig smos pa ni khron pa'i nya'i rnam par thar ba nan gyis bdag gir mdzad pa ste/ 'bras bu dang po gnyis khams gsum gang rung gi rten la thob pa gzhir byas na 'dod pa'i rten la thob dgos kyang de gsum gang rung min sdi'i rten la thob pa yod pa dang / mdzod dang gser phreng sogs las gong rtswa'i rten la mthong lam dang phyir mi 'ong gsar thob med par gsungs pa

— 235ni spyir btang thob dka' ba'i dbang du mdzad pa las/ de dang de gsar thob yod pa ni bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir te/ mdo las/ gzugs na pyeod pa'i lha'i bu khri dag gis chos rnams la chosangakyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral te rnam par dag pa nas phyir mi 'ong gi rtso 'bras bu thob pa'i bar du gyur to/ zhes shin tu gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang khyed kyis 'dod rten can ma gtogs rten gzhan la phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu thob pa mi srid pa sngar nas mkhyen te nges pa rngams chen 'drongs yod stabs/ drangs ma thag pa'i rma do 'di gzigs na mthong tsam nyid nas 'di ni kho bo cag gi dam bca' yang dag dang mi mthun pa rdog pas bsgril bar bya ba zhig go snyam nas mig la khab bsregs bzhin du 'jor 'ong nges pa la/ bka' rin po che'i thad 'dir slebs tshe spyan ro btsums byas pa'am/ yang na shes bya ma red rdo rje red zer mkhan lta bu'i go gyu'i a mchod rog rog cig tu gyur pa gdon mi za zhing / kun mkhyen gyi bzhed pa ltar gzugs kyi rten la mthong lamatsogasar thob yod tshe rten der spang bya rim gyis pa'i nyan thos mthong lam rnam grol lam thob mi srid dgos don med cing / de thob tshe phyir mi 'ong thob pa las gzhan du 'os med pa la khyed sngar dpyod pa ma zhugs pa'am zhugs kyang ma mkhyen pa gang lasas/lha mi gang rung yin na 'gro ba rigs drug gang rung yin pas khyab pa bskal —bar 'bad kyang sgrub mi nus pas/ khyed la bdag cag gi ston pa mi gral nas 'bud dogs mi dgos mod/ de bas khyod kyis ston pa mi gral du bcug pa'i zhar la lha gral nas phyung ba de yags po red ang / ༈ 'khor

236—ba'i don gang la 'khor ba dang / gang zhig 'khor ba gnyis las phyi ma la bya dgos/ zhes pa la tshig skyon che na/ phar phyin yig char/ de'i phyin pa'i don la phyin byed yodwa pa gang zhig phyin zin kyang yod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa la yang tshig skyon che bar 'gyur te/ phyin byed cig phyin pa'i don la bzhag pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de ltar na skyed byed cig skyes pa'i don la lgojog pa sogs su 'gyur ba'i phyir/ rtags don gyis khas/ ༈ sangs rgyas kyi 'khrungs rabs sam sems bskyed tshul lam lam bgrod tshul lta bu'i nyag nyog mang po zhig 'jug pa rtsa 'grel gyi shes byed dang bcas bkod pa des ci zhig sgrub snyam pa'i dgongs phugs lon dka' mod/ sangs 'phags chos can du bzung ste/ gad rgyangs kyi rtsa rtags brgyad pa'i don ltar/sdug kun gcig nas gcig tu brgyud nas 'ongs pa'i zag rgyun yin pa'i phyir zer snyam na ni rtags ma grub po/ ༈ /sdug bden dang kun 'byung bden pa rim par brgyud pa'i rgyun yin na kun 'byung bden pa'i rdzas rgyun yin pas ma khyab ces smos na/ de la kun 'byung bden pa yin pas khyab par gang gis sgrub/ ༈ /gad rgyangs kyi/ —'dis kyang sogs kyi don/ gong du drangs pa'i lung rnams su ma zad/ bshes ṭīka dang sa sder mdo drangs pa la sogs pa 'dis kyang / rdzas rgyun mi gcig kyang kun nyon gsum rgyun ma chad par rgyu dang 'bras bu'i tshul du thog med nas brgyud de byung pa de 'khor bar 'khor tshul yin par grub ces pa yin pa gong 'og bsgrigs na lhag par gsal mod/ nyid nas gong 'og dang kyang sgra'i nus rtswa 'don lugs gang la'ang brtag gzhig med par tshig dum bu re bcad de

237byis pa'i rol rtsed 'dra bas rang snang gyen du bteg pa la snying po ci yang ma mthong ngo / ༈ /nang gi sdug bden dang 'khor ba don gcig par sgrub byed kyi lung drengs pa rnams la nang gi sdug bden 'khor bar ston byed tsam las khyod kyi zhe 'dod la phan nges kyi 'bur dod ci yang med pas 'dis mtshon gang bris thams cad la yig cha'i zhabs 'degs su 'gro nges rdul tsam yang med do/ ༈ /khyed kyi gzegs ma'i dper/ da ni sdug bden dang 'khor ba don gcig par sgrub byed kyi lung gi tshogs 'ga' zhig spro bar bya ste/ zhes yi ge chad skyon byung ba'i rten 'brel gyi che ba la bltas na/ la rgya'i kha 'dzin tsam las thugs kyi bzhed phugs nged tsho'i phyogs la lhung 'dug pa bsnyon med du go'o/ ༈ /sa sogs rtog 'bar gyi sbyor ba de'i rtags chos gnyis ldan gyi mthun dper bzung ba yin la/ shes pa yang de bzhin yin te/ gzhan du na/ ligs ldan yab sras kyis mgo snyoms kyi rigs par mthun dpe rtags chos gnyis ldan zhig bzung ba mi srid par thal ba dang / legs bshad snying por/ gtanasgyutshigs dang bsgrub bya'i chos rjes su 'ahre ba'i dpe sla ba la bsams nas/ zhes gsungs pa dang /kun mkhyen bla ma'i/ rtags dang bsgrub bya'i chos mthun dpe sla phyir/ /dgag rtags phal cher 'gal zla dmigs 'god dper/ /zhes so gas rtsa 'grel yang legs ldan gyi dgongs pa'i phyogs su'ang ma phyin par thal ba dang / sa sogs chos can/ 'khor ba ma yin te/ 'dus byas yin spru'i phyir/ zhes pa 'di dbu ma snying po'i/ 'dus byas yin phyir phyi rol gyi/ /sa la sogs pa mi 'dod bzhin/ /zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi don

238 sbyo ra du thal bas/ khyed nas done 'di rgyas bar 'grel ba'i rje'i legasartso par bshad pa'i snying po 'dod 'jo'i ba'i 'o ma lta bu brtag gzhig gis bsru bas bsrubs pa las 'dus byas yin na 'khor pa ma yin pas khyab pa sogs kyi bshang dri kha bo zhig bton pa ni/ legs bshad snying bo'i tshig tsam yang ma mthong ba las shin tu thu ba'i rgyu 'bras 'chol tshabs che ba'o/ /gal te phyi rol gyi 'dus byas yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'god do zhe na // de ni rang 'grel mkhan pos kyang mthon 'dug pas nyid nas rtog 'bar dang sher sgron gnyis la de rig pa zhib bton gyi lhan thabs shig rna dzad par zhu/ ༈ shes pa chos can/ don dam par 'byung ba ma yinardzite/ 'byung ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa dang / bum pa chos can/don dam par 'khor ba ma yin te/ 'khor ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i sbyor ba gnyis kyi phyi rgol la bshes gnyen chen po nyid kho na 'jog dgos bar 'gyur te/ gzhan du/ sbyor ba de'i phyogs chos tshad rma sa nges nas bsgrub bya la shes 'dod zhugs pa zhig rgol ba rtog ldan gyi gral nas lta ci/ ra rdzi lug rdzi'i khyu nas kyang rnyed dka' ba'i phyir ro/ ༈ /byams pa thogs med sogs kyis 'khor ba la phyi mtha' yod par bzhed pas na de dngañtsades 'khor ba rgyud kyis bsdus bar gsungs zer ba ni mthun phyogs la mthong tsam gyi ma nges pa stetsā gzhan du na/ snod kyi srid brgyud kyis—bsdus pa dang / skye ba'i 'khor brgyud kyis ma bsdus bar 'phags pa—thogs med kyis gsungs zhes kyang khas len dgos par 'gyur te/ bsdu barshalas/ snod kyi 'khor ba ni/ sngon dang phyi ma/'i mtha' chad pa'i phyir thog ma—

239 dang tha ma yod la/ skye ba'i 'khor ba ni rtag tu mi 'chad par rgyun 'jug ba'i phyir thog ma dang tha ma med de/ 'di ni mi 'dra ba gnyis pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ ༈ /'di phyir 'gro 'ong byed pa'i so skye'i yid kyi rnam shes chos can/ khyod gtan du rgyun chad pa yod par thal/ khyod kyi rgyu gtan du rgyun chad pa yod pa'i phyir te/ khyod 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ gzhi bsdu ba'i dka' gnas ya med cig shar mdog kha bo des ci zhig 'grub dgongs pa yin/ ༈ 'phags seng gnyis chos can/ khyod kyis 'khor brgyud kyis bsdus bar bzhed par thal/ rang bzhin gnas rigs rgyas par gtan la phab pa'i phyir/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i khyod kyi sgrub byed 'gangs che rigs de dag ni su la'ang ma shar ba zhig ste/ de lta na/ gser phreng du rang bzhin gnas rigs rgyas par gtan la phab cing 'khor ba mtha' med kyi phyogs gsungs pa de yang rje thams cad mkhyen pas nang 'gal tshabs po che zhig gsungs par khas len dgos par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ ༈ /rgyan snang gi gang gnyen po'i chos dang phrad pa na sogs dang / rnam 'grel gyi rtag nyid phyir ram sogs kyi rigs pa 'dis sdug bden spong nus su mi 'grub par thal/ de grub na sdug bden rgyud bsdus su 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /'khor ba mtha' yo da du gsungs pas de rgyud kyis bsdus par 'grub na/ 'o na mun pa dang gser gyi dri ma sogs chos can/ rgyud kyis bsdus par thal/ mtha' yod yin pa'i phyir te/ gnyen po'i phyogs 'phel ba na 'grib pa'i chos can yin ya'i phyir/ rtags khyab khas blangs/ ༈ gser phreng gis ṭīkka don gsal

240drangs te bkag pa'i phyogs sngas spangs ma spangs zhes pa shes rgyud nas log ma log la bsams pa yin te/ de min na/ lhag bcas dgra bcom pas kun 'byung ma lus par ma spangs par thal/ de'i rgyud na zag bcas kyi las yod pa'i phyir byas pa la pha rol bas khyab med kyi lan 'debs pas phyogs snga mi kheg par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ des na nyon mongs ma lus par spangs kyang phung po'i rgyun ma log pa dang / phung po'i rgyun chad pa gnyis khyad par du 'dod de/ zhes gsungs pa la dpags na'ang lhag bcas pas nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas kyi phung bo yang spangs mod ma log ces bzhed par mngon pas/ des sdug kun gnyis ka spangs zhes bzhed par gsal lo/ ༈ /lhag bcas dgra bcom pas sdug bden ma spangs pa dang /lhag med pas sdug kun gnyis spangs par sras kyi thu bo gnyis kyis gsungs —pa ltar kun mkhyen bla ma yab sras kyis kyang bzhed zer ba gtan mi rigs te / dbu ma che chung gnyis kar nyon mongs spangs ba'i gang zag gi rgyud na—zag pa'i sgo drug ci rigs dang 'brel pa med bar gsungs pa'i myar dang /phar phyin mtha' dpyod du lhag med dgra bcom pas kun 'byung ma spangs —phar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /rje yab sras kyis rten 'brel mdo 'grel—sogs ma gzigs ba dang ma dgongs par ga la 'gyur te/ gzhan du narshakun mkhyen bla mas lhag bcas dgra bcom pas 'khor pa spangs kyang de dang rshaldan par gsungs bas khong bas kyang khyed kyis mthong ba'i rje yab sras kyi legs bshad de dang de ma gzigs pa'am ma dgongs par 'gyur ba'i phyir rdziro/ /'on kyang rje yab sras kyi dgongs pa ni nyon mongs pa'i zag phung—

2yodargyud la 'gags pa'i sgo nas ma spangs ba'i don du byas na/ sa sde dang /rten 'brel mdo 'grel dang / 'jug pa'i rang 'grel dang / rnam bshad dang / kun btus kyi 'grel ba'i skor sogs gad rgyangs su drangs pa rnams dang / thub dgongs las/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa dang / kun 'byung gi bden pa dang / zag pa dang bcas pa'i kun rdzob kyi shes ba'ang spang bar bya'o/ /de nyid kyi phyir 'di thams cad nyon mongs pa spangs na spong bar byed do/ /zhes gsungs pa sogs dang lhu 'grig par 'gyur ro/ /des na lung de dang de'i don 'di 'o zhes zhib bshad lta ci dbugs 'gyu ba tsamartsoyang med par/ gong mas spangs pa dang rgyud la ldan pa'i gzhi mthun mi 'dod do zhes ma ṇir bzlas kyang nged tshor gnod byed du 'akro re med do/ ༈ /gzhung chen gyi nang 'gal spong bar 'dod nas am phrag nas shog tshar zhig bton te 'khor ba ma spangs ba'i lhag med dgra bcom yod pa ni gsung rgyun gyi legs bshad yin pas de ni kun mkhyen gsung la ce re long du ma song ba'i man ngag go zer ba ni kun mkhyen gyi gsung gyen durdzi'adegs par 'dod nas zhabs thur du drangs pa ste/ lhag med dgra bcom thob tshe 'khor ba dor ba ni gser phreng sogs gzhung tshad thub ches mang po dang mthun bzhin du log 'grel gyis dgongs pa gzhan du drangs pa'i phyir —dang / gzhung chen mo dang mi mthun na 'dor spus man ngag tu grags pa la 'bab pa dang / gzhung chen dang mi mthun yang man ngag yin zer ba ni rang re'i bstan pa 'di la mi bzad pa'i gdon chem po yin par rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang mkhas grub chos kyi rgyal bos gsungs pa'i phyir

242ro/ /gal te mtshams 'dir gsung rgyun du grags pa zhig gru bzhi'i nang du zur gsum ltar nan gyis sprod par bzhed na ni/ thugs sras ngag rī dbang bkra shis pas/ thal rang lugs la 'phen byed kyi las lhag med pa'i rgyud la med kyang / yig cha'i myang 'das thad yod par bshad pa nyon st+waṃb phyogs kyi yan lag bcu gnyis nang tshan min par/ shes sgrib phyogs kyi de'i nang tshan gyi 'phen byed kyi las la byed dgos par gsungs pa 'di sprod rigs te/ de kun mkhyen bla ma'i gsung rgyun yin shas che ba'i phyir ro/ ༈ /nang 'gal yod tshul khyed yab sras la gsung rgyu zhig yod na gsung ran 'dug ces bskul na yang / kun mkhyenagabla ma chen po de nyid kyi bka' drin la bsams nas lan gsum kha rog dzadug go ༈ /sdug kun rags pa nye bar zhi ba'i nyer zhi tsam yang ma thob pa'i lhag med dgra bcom de nyid kyis/ kun shes nyid kyis nyer zhir 'khrid mdzad gang yin dngo / /zhes pa'i dngos blostan 'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes su gyur ba'i bar chad med lam dang rnam grol lam cha tshang bar rang rgyud la bskyed yod dgos pa la ci zhig gis nongs dpyad par bya ba'i gnas su che rme'o/ ༈ /khyed nas rtsod yig snga phyir nang 'gal lta bu bsgrigs pa ni gzu lum 'ba' zhig ste/ nged tshos khams gsum gang rung la sdug bden gyis kyāb cing bde ldan de gsum gang rung min par 'dod pa dang / 'gro ba rigs drug gang rung la'ang sdug bden gyis khyab kyang lha mi ci rigs la 'gro ba rigs drug gang rung gis cam khyeb pa dang / medzod kyis mdo don 'chad tshe 'jig rten dang srid pa don gcig tu gsungs kyang gong ma'i lugs la ma

lha43dag pa'i 'jig rten zhes gad rgyangs rang du gsal kha mdzad 'dug pa dang / gang la nyer phung gis khyab par gsungs pa'i zag bcas ni nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas gzhir bzhag yin lta dang / longs sprul khas blangs nas khams dang po ba co lnga zag bcas su bshad pa la nang 'gal yod tshe 'gal ba de kun btus la 'ang lhun grub tu yod par 'gyur ba dang / gdardzirgyangs su/ de chos can zhes pa'i de sgra 'di byang 'phags gcig pu la snyeg—dgos pa dang / zag tshor sdug bsngal 'du byed nus ba'i nyon mongs pa'i zag phung 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal/ gyi don du 'jog pa dgongs par gnas padzhadang / nye ban len pa dang/ ldan pa zhes pa dang nyon mongs dang ldan pa zhes pa'i ldan sgra don mi 'dra ba dang / spyir btang la sdug bsngal 'du byed—pa'am skyed pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi go don yin yang byang 'phags kyi skenyon mongs kyis de 'du mi byed pa dmigs bsal yin pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i zag tshor gsum 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin yang bden 'dzin rshagyi tshor ba de min pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas la nyer phung gis khyab ces pa las zag bcas tsam la des khyab pa dgongs sa min pa dang /gnod pa'i bdeg nyid can du bshad pa spyir btang dang byang 'phags kyi nyon mongs de min pa dmigs bsal yin pa dang / lam bden du gyur pa'i tshor ba sdug bsngal zag med du cisari kyang 'dod dgos pa dang / tshig—tshogs bskyungs te nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas zhes sbyar ba phal mo che zhig sgo la'ang don gyis sbyar ba yin par bshad zin pa rnams la zhib gzhig mdzad na skra shad 'dzag /snang ltar 'gal 'du yod yod 'dra ba'i dgongs tshul ngan —

244pa de zhi par 'gyur ro/ /phyogs sngas byams pa gling pa'i gzhung drangs te bkral tshul gyi dbang du byas te 'phangs pa'ang rtsod yig rang gi bzhed pa gzhir bzhag byas pa sogs rtsod yig phyi ma'i don 'khyor ma 'khyor mang po zhig bkod nas 'thad dang mi 'thad dang 'gal gang zer 'dod pa'ang dpyad mi bzod pa zhig bris 'dug kyang lan gyi rigs phal cher song zin par mngon zhing / ma song ba rnams la lan mi dgos pa khyed kyi dgongs pa yin 'dra ste/ lha rams pa chen po khong ba yang da dung bzhugs gdan 'jags bzhin pas khong ba rang la rgol ba zhus chog ces mdzo khal glang byo zhig gnang ba dang / dam bca' nang 'gal gyi tsha ma rgyag ces nan tan mdzad 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ ༈ /rtsod yig snga ma la mi 'thad pa grangs mi zin pa yod kyang rgyas par 'gog pa ltacici/ grangs tsam bgrangs na yang mi ri nus pa'i tshod du yod/ ces gsungs pa bden du chug kyang / de mthun phyogs 'gro tsam yang khyed kyi spyod yul du ma gyur pa'i lung rigs kyang grangs mi zin pa yod mod rgyas par bkod de rtsod spong sogs lta ci/ grangs tsam yang bgrang mi nus pa'i ched du yod do/ ༈ /rang rkya sdug kun gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i rgyun bar ma chad par 'khor bas na nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas kyi dngos po rnams 'khor bar bzhag par 'dod pa las/nyon mongs pa'i dzwag bcas bum pa lta bu srid rtse nas mnar med kyi bar bum pa'i ngo bo ma dor bar 'khor bar khas blangs pa'i zur tsam yang med pas/ khyed kyi bshad pa mtha' dag gi don bsdu bar btags pa'i dum bu de ngal ba 'bras bu med pa'i don las ma 'das te/ gzhan du na chen po

245nyid spyang thog med nas bzung chos gos rnam gsum gyon te srid rtse nas mnar med gyi bar 'khor ba yin par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / sems can bzhin du 'a9ra bar 'khor na sems can bzhin du skye ba yang len dgos tshe / 'khor bar zo chun bzhin du 'khor na thag pas bsdams pa sogs la brten nas 'khor dgos par thal ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi —/sung gi chos kyi 'khor lo khams gsum du 'khor bar 'dod dgos pas des kyang khams gsum du skye ba blangs par thal ba dang / khyod kyi gnod sgrub ltar na/steng g.yogs ka ba 'bar bas dga'/ /zhes gsungs pas ka ba dang khang—bzang sogs shing bzos byas pa dang / bum pa dang gser rgyan sogs mgar bas brdungs pa'ang min par thal lo/ ༈ /zag med ma yin pa'i phung po zhes pa'ang nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas kyi zlas drangs pa yin pas/nyon mongs pa'i zag med ma yin pa'i phung bo la go dgos shing / de lta narshaphung po lnga chos can/ 'khor ba yin par thal/ nyon mongs pa'i zag med ma yin pa'i phung po yin pa'i phyir/ yang de chos ca na/ 'khor ba yin—par thal/ zag med ma yin pa'i ston mongs pa'i zag bcas kyi phung bo—yin pa'i phyir/ zer ba'i lan ni/ gang zag chos can/ sems can yin par thal/ sangs rgyas ma yin pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ yang de—chos can/ sems can yin par thal/ sangs rgyas ma yin pa'i nyon mongs can gyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa la lan ci gdab kyis mtshon parngo bya la/ bum pa 'khor ba ma yin par thal/ phung bo lnga la de'irshaphyir na/ mi mig ldan ma yin par thal/ khams gsum gyi gang zag la

—246de'i phyir/ gzhan yang khu byug dang rma bya sogs chos can/ dag zhing bde ldan na khyod med par thal/ khyod las nyon gyis skye ba blangs pa'i dud 'gro yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bus bzlog par bya ba'i thal 'gyur tshogs chen zhal ngo ja yin min brtsad pa 'dra bad zad pa yang mang po zhig yod do/ / /nyid nas bum pa tsam srid rtse nas mnar med kyi bar 'khor ma 'khor gyi steng nas dbugs rgod byang khog tu mi tshud pa gnang ba dang /sdug kun gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa nyer len gyi phung bo 'alor rbe yin pa'i sgrub byed du 'gro zer ba dang / phyi'i sdug bden rnams srid rtse nas mnar med kyi ba ra du 'khor bar 'dod rma khan gcig kyang med/ ces phyi'i sdug bden gcig pu dmigs kyis bkar ba rnams gung bsgrigs na/ nang gi sdug bden rnams srid rtse nas mnar med kyi bar 'khor bar khas len nges pas/ de lta na khyed kyi sku'i za ma tog 'di chos can/ sngar 'jig rten gyi khams bgrang las 'das par 'khor zin te da lta bsod nams kyi dbang las khyed kyi phyag tu 'byor pa yin par thal/ blo rtse 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma 'ongs pa na yang de ltar 'khor dgos par thal/ sngar 'khor tshul de 'thad pa'i phyir/ khyed nas 'di la lan ci gsu nga /zhal nas ji ltar yang thugs kyis ngo bo'i gnas tshod la rtags ma grub dgongs mchi/ ༈ kun mkhyen bla mas khyod kyi dri ma med pa'i rigs pa'i gnad 'gag skad pa de thugs la bzhag pa mi 'thad par thal/ kun mkhyen gyis de ma dgongs pa'i phyir/ der thal/ kun mkhyen bla ma nyid kyis gang zag btags yod —pa la spang bya bzhag pa'i phyir te/ lha'i bu'i

24lhabadud de gang zag btags yod pa yin pa gang zhig de spang bya yin par phar phyin mtha' dpyod las gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des kun mkhyen yab sras kyis gang zag btags yod pa la spang bya ma bzhag zer ba'ang bsnyon lab chen por dgongs par gyis/ ༈ nged tsho'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang nas/gzhung chen mo gang dang yang mi mthun pa'i khas len re bgyis te/ de ri khrod pa'i khas len red ces 'phya smod mi byed pa zhig dgos gsungs pa bden yang / khyed la zhal gdams skyor mkhan dag gis ma 'khyor ba'am/nyid kyi lhan cig skyes pa'i lhas log 'grel 'dra byas pa gang ltar yang zhal gdams kyi thur nyams 'dug ste/ gzhan du na/ de nang ba'i khas len red/ de theg chen pa'i khas len red/ de dge ldan pa'i khas len red/de sgo mang ba'i khas len red/ de bla brang ba'i khas len red/ de bsangarshakhog mi phrug gi khas len red byas na'ang mtshang che bar 'gyur bas zhal rog—ger bzhugs shig ༈ khyed nas/ oṃ ni ri lu tsa na ka'i/ /zhes sogs kyi ngo gdong tsam min pa'i dgongs mthil khong na gnas pa zhig sa 'og gi gter bzhin bton pa'i drin las rkun jag gis bsang rdzas kyi zan ril —mang po bsgril ba'ikhungs tshad ma yang 'di red ang snyam pa'i nges pa rngams chen gsar 'drongs byung / nged tshos ril sgrub la khungs yod med gang du yang dam bcas te yi ger bris pa med mod/ khyod nas ci bzhed/ gsar phyogs na khungs med gsung tshe kun mkhyen dā ma'i gsung dang 'gal la/yod gsung tshe lnga pa chen pos gsar ma rgyud 'bum klog kyang ril sgrub kyi khungs yod pa rnams ngo 'byor ba tsam yang ma byung zhes smra dgos pa dang /

248sngar paṇa chen chos rgyan gyi gsung drangs pas ci yang mi 'grub par khas blangs song bas/ dge ldan pa'i nyi zla lta bu'i chen po rnam gnyis la rdog tos bsnun te/ rang nyid mang pos gong du bkur ba'i rang mthong gis srid pa'i gtsug tor gyi rtse la 'gying bag gis bzhugs shig ༈ bsdu ba'i gang ci yang rung sogs kyis ci zhig bstan pa ni mkhas dbang gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu dag gis gsungs 'dug pa las/ nyid nas de la gnod byed rtsal 'don gyi lung don zur ba zhib 'grel mdzad rgyu tsho la ngo chen zhu/ lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rjes rigs pa mkhyen pas na phyi rgol yang dag dang /gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs mkhas pa yin pas na snga rgol yang dag byas pa 'dra ba'i stangs ka zhig gsungs 'dug pa'ang rna bar lhod 'gro'i gtam du satshor ro/ ༈ /hre lan du bkod pa rnams la go rim tsam gyi steng na'ang dpyad par bya ba'i don 'gangs che ba zhig yod kyang de ni nyid la shin lkog ci tu gyur pa'i dan rtags su kha zin sna zin byas te so/ rim dkrugs 'dug mod/ yod sar mi btsal med sar btsal ces par yod me ma rnyed pa min zhes lan btab pa lta bu zhes zur za bgyis pa'i don khyid la phyogs mthong 'ol 'gros tsam 'char ba'i skal ba'ang ma byung bar/ chos mdzad par mkhan chen ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho sogs kyis lan btab zin/ces rang gi nang rten gyi dkar chag gsal rgyas shig bris te brims pa ni rgyang na sdod pa rnams dad pa lhag par 'phel ba'i gsos su che 'o/ ༈ /sngags rim du/ de'i tshe zhi gnas grub pa yin no/ /de nas so sor rtog pa'i/ zhes pa nas/ zhi lhag zung du 'brel ba'i ting nge 'dzin phul phyin

mo 249rnyed do/ /zhes byung ba ma gzigs sam/ zhi gnas sngon du gub nas de rjes zung 'brel 'byung bar gsungs pa ni zhi lhag rim can du grub pa rtsal du 'don pa ste/ khyod rang gi dbu la gnam lcags las kyang rno ba'i lung rang gi sgrub byed kyi snying por sems pa ni gshed ma phar 'dzin las kyang thu ba'i 'khrul rtog chen po skye/ khyed ltar na/ mdo lugs la yang zhig lhag cig car du grub pa yod par thal/ lam rim chen mo las/ nam lhag mthong thob pa'i thog ma nas zung 'brel 'thob bar 'gyur/ zhes pa nas/ yid byed nga/zhi pa sngar bshad pa ltar skyes pa'i tshe na zung 'brel du 'gro ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ zung 'bredzeedu 'gro zhes pa cig car 'grub pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ rtags song / hre lan du/ zhi lhag cig car du 'grub mi srid ces par/ srid pa'i rgyab rten du rim char 'grub pa'i lung drangs gsungs pa ni spyi don nyid la gsungs pa yin pa la/ khyed nas slar sgong spyi don du drangs zin ces rtsod spong mdzad de nang cha tshong rar bkram pa ni mkhyen pa'i rang rtsal gyi de bzhin nyid rjen par mtshon pa'i me long rang byon no/ /lam rim chung ngu'i lung drangs pa'i don la/ khyed gnas tshod la dgongs ba nyi ma ltar gsal ba gzhir byas mod/ snang tshod la mun pa dgu brtsegs su song 'dug ste/ de'i don ni/ dpyad 'jog ji ltar bya pa bshad zin pa de ltar bgyis te zhi lhag rim can du skyed tshul de gang gi dbang du byas na bla med las gzhan gyi dbang du byas pa ste/ bla med la rdzogs rim mnyam gzhag tu lhag mthong gi dpyad sgom gzhung gzhan nas 'byung pa bzhin mi byed pa'i phyir/ zhes pa yin te/ de nyid las/ rang

250gi lugs ni rnal 'byor bla med kyi skabs su yang lta ba'i go pa skyed lugs dbu ma'i gzhung nas 'byung pa ltar bya dgos la/ sbyong lugs las skyed4rim dang rdzogs rim kyi rjes thob kyi skabs 'ga' zhig tu de kho na nyid la dpyad nas yid la byed pa yod kyang / lus la gnad du sgrun pa'i nus pa thob ba'i rdzogs rim pas mnyam gzhag tu de kho na nyid skyong ba na lta thog tu bzhag nas sgom pa nges par dgos kyang lhag mthong gi dpyad sgom gzhung gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar mi byed do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / nged kyi bla ma yab sras kyi gsung gzhan ci rigs su/ kun mkhyen bla mas bla med thun mong min pa'i lugs la zhi lhag cig car 'grub pa zhig srid par gsungs pa la ched brjod bla lhag tu mdzad pa ma gtogs/ rtsod yig snga phyi dang hre lan rnams su bla med kyi lugs la zhi lhag cig car 'grub pa srid mi srid gang du yang dam bcas pa med mod/ khyed nas de yad pa'i shes byed kyi lung mang bo sha thang thang du drangs pa 'di ci/ kun mkhyen bla ma chen po de'i zhabs 'degs zhu bzhed pa'am/ ‘ zhabs la tha gu 'dogs bzhed pardziyin/ dang bo ltar na mi rigs te/ bsam gzugs chen mo las/ 'dirshalas dka' ba'i gnas dam pa shin tu dkon cing / zhal shes las yi ger yang bris mi snang ba'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ nyid nas 'di marshagazigs pa dang don mi mkhyen pa ga la srid kyang / mar me rang rtsar marshagasal ba'am/ paṇḍi tas mnyam par ma bzhag pa gang rigs su gdon mi—za'o/ ༈ /khyed kyi go lugs ltar na/ mngon sum la bsnyon to zhes spyan—'bur tshugs mdzad mi dgos te/ pha rgyud kyi 'jog byed gsal bar—

251gsungs/ pha ma'i rgyud kyi bstan bya'i gca bo rdzogs rim gnyis kyang gsal bar gsungs 'dug pas pha ma'i rgyud kyi khyad par sngags rim las gsal bar gsungs zhes smras na ci yis kyang nongs par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/gtso bor ston mi ston rtsal du 'don mi 'don yin gsungs pas/ de gnyis la khyad phye gsungs lugs kyis/ bum pa yin min lho ldir ba ra grub ma grub la byed ces byas pas kyang / de gnyis la khyad phye zer dgos pas khyed bde mo dang nga bde rdzozer ba las gzhan tshig gi 'gro sgo cang mi gda' 'o/ ༈ /khyed cag gis 'di ka'i rtsod yig snga phyi gnyis gcig gis gcig sun 'byin khul mdzad pa u thug gi bya bar mi 'gro la/ 'di nas khyed cag blo nus kyi pho sgo gang yod rtsad nas sprugs te dpung ba mnyam bsdebs kyis mi gcig gi steng du sa rub rdo rub byas pa'i rtsod yig dag gis sun phyung na u thug gi las su 'gro gsungs pa ni nags na shing shun gyon pa po dang /tshogs par seng ge'i khri la 'gying ba bo'i mgo 'phang gi mtho dma'i khyad du sus mi shes/ ༈ 'di ka'i yongs 'dzin mchog nas dngos su rtsod ma nus pa'am rdo sbis lta rams pa nas de 'dra ma gsungs par bzhugs ma bde ba'am/ gang ltar yang 'di kas lkog nom phran bus kho rang gi rtsod pa bshol bar gzhan la grags pa skad pa de ci/ yul gru gang dang gang du grags tshad bris tshad thams cad bden pa'i don can kho nar bzhed pa'i gsung yin na ni nyid kyis skabs phye zhig dang 'di nas kyang gang thos sgog skya spun phral du zhus chog la/ slad ma'i don gzhan la dgongs te zur miphra mo'i rgyan lta bu'i garnyi nga phebs pa yin na ni blo skyed kyi dngos grub tu che

252yang / nged tsho nags na gnas pa dag la lag pa skyong 'dod kyi phu dung thung bas khyed kyi bzhed pa'i snye ral 'gengs pa'i rngo mi thogs lags/ khyed kyis lha rams pa'i rtsod yig gis sun 'byin byas mi chog ces khong ba phyogs 'dzin ris mthun gyi mdza' sde'i khyu las phyung pa ltar na/ dge bshes pa ci tsam phyogs las rnam par rgyal yang khyed nas de la ra phos lug ril la ngo sor byed 'os ci yang med la/ gzhan du na/ tshad mar gyur pa 'gro la phan bzhed pa/ /ston pa bde gshegs skyob pa lha rams pa/ /zhes thon la khong ba cha gang la yang 'khrul pa med do zhes bzhugs dang / khyed cag la dka' las med na 'di kar ngan du gyur pa ci yang med do/ /bka' sus gnang dang / rkyen cis byas dang / phebs tshul bzhugs tshul sogs zhib gsal mthong thos kyi yul du ma gyur kyang / gangs dkar ri bo'i rtse nas gangs seng dkar mo g.yu ral rgyan du che ba skor gcig mchongs stabs kha thal te/ rgol ba nyin gcig gi lam na yod pa bzhag nas nyin lnga drug gi lam du phyin te rgol ba'i phyogs la 'chor res 'dzin res kyi tsham rngam mang po mdzad rabs khyed kyi gsung la rna ba bzed pa tshos gdong smad de sped gartem du smra ba tsam thos kyi/ phran sa srub kyi 'bur song stabs nyid nas ngom chos su 'os nges kyi legs cha gzhan ci dang ci byung ci yang ma tshor ro/ ༈ /'khor ba la zhen 4ོga nas/ thar pa la don sa/nyer bskyed phyir mdo rgyud dang dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos de snyed cig dpang bzhag gis 'khor ba'i ngo bo la dpyad pa yin pas/ bya rog so rtog lta bur ga la 'gyur/ cis kyang 'gyur na ni/ chos 'di pa pa ra bya rog so rtog 'be'

253zhig la dgag pa gyu ru lugs su 'bri mkhan sngar ma byung zhidzwaphyis kyang mi ske 'byung bas/ nyid bsam bzhin nang ba'i gseb nas rad 'jur byas par 'gyur la/ de ni rang gi rtsod yig dang dgag lan du ming btags pa de yang rtsod pa lhur len gyi bstan bcos 'ba' zhig yin par zhal gyis bzhes pa dang rkang yang 'grig go /rnyed bkur dang snyan pa phran bu re'i ched du 'ang g.yo khram sna tshogs kyis drin lan log 'jal 'dra byas med tshe rje 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho ba'i zhabs pad bsten rgyu byung ba nges par skal pa shin tu legs zhes zhu/ khyed tshos bka' bgros tshul/ rtsom ba por khyed kyi mtshan btab yod tshul/ dus nam zhig nas rtsom gin yod tshul/ tha na snga phyi'i zhus dag pa su yin/ deb grangs tshun chad bcas khyed rnams dang lhan cig chos la spyod pa'i bshes gnyen zhig gis glegs bam mthong ste 'di ga la gnas tshul zhib mor bskyal 'dug pas brtsams dus la zhib 'don de tsam ci la dgos/ de ltar khyed dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen pos rdo rje'i gzegs mar btags ba'i bstan bcos mdzad par kye zhes bos pas yang lan zhig ma phul na brnyas stangs sa'akro dogs nas gsung lan sa bcad ma stongs tsam khu bsdus su phul ba la dgyes pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo mo brgya phrag rdzogs ldan bzhin dbye bar zhu zhing / slad char yang dam pa'i gsung rab rnams su/ nag nyar nyi zla mnyam 'char dang mnyam nub byed par gsungs pa dang / mchod pa dngos la bshams gshegs sogs byar med par gsungs pa dang / rjes mdo dang bstun te 'grel pa 'ga'i bshad pa ltar mi rung gsungs kyang 'grel ba de ltar bshad

254 dgos par gsungs pa dang / theg pa 'i sgra don ston pa la byas pa dang /gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud las/ de yi lag pa ma rig yin/ /zhes sogs gsungs par bshad pa deng / rnam snang mngon byang la gzhung dang mi mthun pa'i lha brgya dang bcu drug brtsis te brgya dang bcu bdun yin gsungs pa dang / skad dod sde snod gsum bar sgyur dgos ba'i rgyu mtshan du sde snod gsum pa zhes gsungs pa bkod pa dang / kun mkhyen gyis ston pas sngon dmyal ba'i shing rta 'dren pa'i gyad kyi tshe smon sems tsam bskyed par gsungs pa la/ de dus 'jug sems kyang bskyed par bshad pa dang /kun mkhyen gyis rab spel gyi rgyan du ngos bzung ba la gzugs can gyi rgyan du bkral ba sogs/ khyed lta bu'i mkhas dbang sa chen po'i rgyan du bzhugs pa la ci'i phyir mi zhu snyam pa'i dogs gnas dman bu'i blo chod la ltos pa'i che tsam mang zhig 'dug ste/ re zhig bud shing 'thu ba'i brel ba sogs kyis long ma byung bas rim gyis zhus chog pa snyan sgron du 'bul ba lags na skabs dbye ba ci ga/nang / smras pa/ rma khas dgu'i mes po ha sa badzra rjes/ /thang mar brdal ba'i legs rbeshad a za'i bcud/ /myangs pa'i dran dbang skar tshogs phreng ba ltas/ /'dra min bzhed pa za 'og gu4 du phebs// /snying gi mchog ma rnam par dpyod pa'i blo/ /rno ldan ba spu 'ga' yi gam bzung yang / /dgag sgrub gnag snum ral ba'i to ker zil/ /rang gir mdzad pa'ang dbang bo'i yul du babs/ /gang gi 'og 'gyu'i rnam rtog srin bu'i 'gros/ /ci dgar bskyod pa'i bshul lam 'khyog po'i rjes/ /yi ge'i rol par shar gang lung rigs kyi/ /shwa 'od

255rnon pos ming gi lhag mar byas/ /dam pa'i legs bshad nor bu'i me long la/ /byi dor bgyid pa'i brgal brtag rnga yab kyi/ /bskyod la sa ba /zhi'i rdul phran zags pa sogs/ /nongs par gyur gang gzur gnas yonganu/ la bshags/ /gang las gang zhig bsags pa dge ba'i dar/ /bla med bla myoshaṃ nyi zla zung gcig gi /legs mdzad legs par spel ba'i ba dam/ cher/ /srid 'dir srid mtha'i bar du brtan gyur cig /ces brgal lan rdo rje'i gzegs ma la rnam par dpyad pa gsang 'dzin mtshon gyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba 'di ni/bstan 'gro'i dpung gnyen gzhan 'gran med pa/ thams cad mkhyen gzigs rdo rje 'chang sa gha'i zhabs yab sras kyi slob ma'i gral mthar skyod pa'i sprang 'khyams pa/ zla mdzis dpa la gyi snye ma zhes bya bas/ ljon shing g.yu lo rgyas pa'i grib bsil/ rtswa ljang me tog bkra ba'i skyed tshal/ bya tshogs skad snyan 'byin pa'i dben gnas nyams dga' ba zhig nas sug bris su bgyis pa dza yadu// // (gsal bshad/ rtsod yig 'di ni yongs 'dzin rin po che'i slob bu dpyi sa blo gros rgya mtsho'i gsung yin la 'dir gzigs pa po rnams kyis rtsod yig rnams cha tshang bar gzigs bde phyir 'dir bkod pa yin/ ) trerī

267yin te/ tshes zla nyi ma 'dod zla nyis brgya dang gcig gis bsgyur ba khyim zla'i22༷3712grangs su 'gyur/ de bcu gnyis kyis bgos pa'i nor khyim lo yin/de gnyis bzhag 'og ma mig gis bsgyur ba khyim lo phyed pa'i grangs yin/ de re bdun gyis khyer ba phyed pa re bdun re'i nang nas bar khyad lo lhag re bud pa'i grangs yin/ des gong gi khyim lo phri lhag nyin lo'i grangs yin te/nam mkha' mig klu me skyon(183820)'char/ lo de zhag gsum ga sna ca/nyam gyi lo yin pa gang zhig de'i phyed phyogs bug rga/zugs bus/(91910)la'ang sna rma nyam/ de las gzhan la gza' tshes man stong mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /zhag 0/sum lo mtshams der sna mnyam yang rdzogs mtshams mnyam pa las grangs mnyam pa ma yin te/ dper na/ tshes zhag nyi ma 'dod zla dang / nyin zhag 'byung 'dod drag po gnyis sna mnyam yang / phyi mas snga mar phri na bar khyad thub ri zla ba(177)'char ba 'char gang zhitha/ de ni tshes zhag de las nyin zhag de nyung ba dang / nyin zhag de las tshes zhag de mang ba'i grangs yin pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ yang zla ba'i rkang stong rtsis song yang rtsa ba'i longs spyod kyi stong rtsis ma song / de bzhin du drag gsum rkang 'dzin longs spyod/ zhi gnyis dal bar dang du ba'i rtsa longs rnams kyi stong rtsis ma song bas/ dus me las gzhan thams cad stong bar bshad pa mi 'thad do snyam na—/ de dag ma song ba ma yin te/ lo mtshams dang drug cu'i lo mtshams gang yin yang dbo zla'i gnam stong gi mtha' las gzhan la lo mtshams su stong 'jug mi 'byung ba gang zhig nyin zhag nyi bar de drag rkang yin pa'i phyir dang / de ka zhi gnyis dal bar yin pa'i phyir dang / gza' lnga'i rkang

268 'dzin gang yin yang rang rang gi dal dag sgrub pa la mi mkho zhing / rang rang gi myur dag sgrub pa'i gzhi myur bar yin pa'i phyir dang / du ba'i rtag longs nyi ma dang phyogs mtshungs shing / nyi ma dang 'grogs pa'i drag 'gros can yin pas nyi ma dag pa nyid kyis 'thus pa'i phyir/ yang dhu ba stong ba de dag la gsum pa'i tshes gcig gi rtag longs nas tshes rtsis byas pa na/ nyi dag gi chu tshod la bco lnga yod pa mi 'thad de/ nyi mas tshes zhag re la phul longs chu tshod bzhi dang srang nyer ba/cig dbugs lnga/ ri ro'i cha zhe gsum las lhag mi spyod pa'i phyir snyam na/ 'di ni dogs gnas shin tu che ste/nyi bar la de snar yin yang / zhib rtsis la de dus khyim du slebs nas zhag gsum lhag song ba yin no zhe na/ stong chen dbo zla'i mthar ma babs pas dal ba thams cad 'bras med du 'gyur ba'i phyir da dung dpyad par bya'o/ /'o na rtsis kyi 'byung khungs ni/ stong 'jug tu gsungs par ma zad/phug lus/sa/ bu lugs/ mtshur phu'i lugs sogs mi 'dra ba'i lugs rnams kyang stong 'jug la brtsen nas byung bar bshad na / de'i tshul gang yin zhe na/ cung zad brjod par bya ste/ zad pa me stag gi mthar nges pa thams cad stong ba la zhugs/ lo mgo me yos kyi gsum pa'i tshes gcig gi lnga sgra gza' lnga dag pa thams cad stong byu de dang de las skyes shing rtsis mgo gang spo'i rtsis 'phro thams cad kyang brgyud nasastong chen las brtsis pa'i rtsis 'phro 'ba' zhig yin pas 'byung khungs yin tshul shes sla/ rtsis gsar rnying gi lugs mi 'dra ba yang de las byung ste/ rigs ldan rgyal dka'

269me khyi latsār bzhugs nas lo nyis brgya dang nyer gcig bar chos bstan —cing / nyis brgya nyer gcig gi thog ma de lor nyung ngu'i byed pa'i rtsis sazhung brtsams pa yin/ phug pa rjes 'brangs dang bcas pas nyis brgya nyer gcig gi 'go'i rtsis 'asro gnas pa'i lo ni me khyi'i snga ma sa skyong shing byi'i lo de yin/ spyir shing bya la stong 'jug nas rtsis na zla bshol rtsis 'phro mda' ro'i lhag ma 1 11 21 31ci 41ci 51 61 6ci 16 26 36ci 46ci 56bcu gsum las gzhan mi 'byung / rtsis mgo'i shing bya yang mda' ro'i lhag ma61can yin te/ 'di yan gyi stong chen lo tshogs la 82776132766945178719'de 'jog dgos pa gang zhig de ltar na zla dag la1023871088378829595231'di dang mda' ro'i lhag ma re gcig 'char ba'i phyir/ zla dag de mig bug mda' rtsa me sogs 'khor lo so sos dor lhag steng nas 'phro bral gyi sgo nas bsgrubs pas gza' ṅgha sogs grub mtha'i rtsis 'phro kun phugs lugs ltar rnyed pa'i phyir/ rtags dang bo sgrub dka' la ji ltar sgrub tshul rtsis 'phro gsal byed sgron me las shes par bya'o//bu ston/ 'jam dbyangs chos mgon/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal ba/ srol de dge ldan rtsis gsar zhes shing rta'i lam srol ltar 'byed pa sum bha paṇḍi ta sogs kyi lugs la/ nyis brgya nyer gcig gi rtsis mgo'i shing bya de mda' ro'i lhag46can yin te/ 'di yan gyi stong chen lo tshogs la157787943639903177019 'di 'jog dgos pa gang zhig de ltar na zla dag la1951715487484340835742 'di dang mda' ro'i lhag la zhe drug 'cha ra ba'i phyir dang zla dag de las lnga sgra gza' lnga kun 'phro

270bral gyi sgo nas bsgrubs na rtsis 'phro kun bu lugs ltar rnyed pa'i phyir/rtags dang bo sgru ba dka' zhing sgrub tshul rtsis 'phro gsal byed nyi ma'i 'od zer las shes par bya'o/ / des na mda' ro'i lhag gnyis la bco lnga'i bar khyad byung stabs gza'angakhyu sogs kyi bar khyad rtsis gas ra la byin na rtsis rnying dang / rtsis rnying la phri na rtsis gsar 'char ba dang rtsis gsar nyung phyogs dang / rtsis rnying mang phyogs yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin/ gzhan yang rtsis 'phro'i dbang gis min yang / bzhed pa'i dbang gis sangs rgyas kyi 'khrungs lo/ sangs rgyas pa'i lo/ dus 'khor gsungs pa'i lo/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i lo/ drag po 'khor lo can gyis g.yul 'gyed pa'i lo rdzogs ldan snga ma'i rkang ba so ngaso'i lo grangs/ bstan pa spyi'i gnas tshod sogs mi 'dra zhing / rtsis rnying bas dpa' bo lcags 'brug la mya ngan las 'das par bzhed kyang / rtsis gsar bas de dus dgung lo so snga ba'i dus su bzhed pas mya ngan las 'das —phyin gyi lo la zhe lngas mang nyung shor bas rtsis rnying la 'das lo mang ba'i phyogs dang / rtsis gsar la 'das lo nyung ba'i phyogs zhes kyang grags so stong 'jug lhan bas byis pa 'jug pa'i lam yig 'di yang tsho 'du mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs di'azin las rnam rgyal dang / tsho bdun skul sku blo bzang bstan 'dzin gnyis kyis rig gnas 'di la sbyangs skabs dran gsos su blo bzang dpal bas spel ba'o/ / spel tshig mchog gsum byin rlabs mi zad rin chen gter/ /

271 bhetshogs gnyis mnga' thang 'dod 'jo'i bum pa bzang / /skye dgu'i bsod nams yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang / /chos dbyings rnam dag bai ḍūr snying bo'i khams/ /rten 'brel mi slu lha yi dpag bsam dbang / /bdag cag las smon kun tu bzang ba'i dkun/ /'di dag lhan cig tshogs pa'i rten 'brel las/ /gang bsam 'dod pa'i don 'di 'grub par mdzod/ /mi la na tsha phyugs la god kha dang / /g.yang la bkang stongs zhing la sad sir dang / /nor la dgra jag chom rkun la sogs pa'i/ //mi 'dod nyer 'tshe mtha' dag zhi bar mdzod/ /pha rol sdang ba'i dgra ngan dpung tshogs dang / /'thab rtsod 'khrug long gyod kha gtam ngan dang / /kham chu nag po khra po'i gleng brjod dang / /gleng log sha 'gel la sogs zhi bar mdzod//btsan pos kanya' gnon ngan pa dgrar langs ba/ /kha drag can gyi gtam ngan 'jigs pa dang / /g.yo sgyu can gyis ngan g.yo'i byed pa kun/ / lhag ma med par myur du zhi bar mdzod/ /sdang dgra gdon bgegs lan chags bu lon dang / /za gshed shi 'dre che sri chung sri dang / /dam sri rgyal bsen the'u rang bsen mo dang / /steng 'og bar gsum gdon rnams zhi bar mdzod/ /byad kha phur kha bad 'dre bod gtong dang / /mnan gtad 'phangs sreg khram kha slus 'debs sogs/ /mi dang 'byung po'i gnod pa ci mchis pa/ /lhag med myur du zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /mdor na bdag cag mi nor zas gsum la / /mi 'dod rkyen ngan bar chad ci mchis pa/ /nyi zer reg pa'i zil ba ji bzhin du/ /skad cig nyid la lhag med zhi bar mdzod/ /legs byas rnam par dkar ba'i bsod

272 nams dang / /btsan phyug dpal gsum 'dzom pa'i bde skyid dang / /miglenor g.yang gsum 'phel ba'i mnga' thang rnams/ /dbyar gyi chu bo bzhin7du rgyas par mdzod// btsan (kha don dge spyor ) bajid kha drag che ba'i rgan rabs dang / /dpa' (rang bzhin don kun sgrub )rtsal stobs dang ldan pa'i dar ma dang / /blo rig dran shes gsal ba'i gzhon nu'i tshogs/ /masdo' dgartsoyar zla'i dpal bzhin 'phel bar mdzod/ /rigs rgyud (tha rigs )sa yi dregs pa bzhin du 'phel/ /stobs 'byor dbyar gyi rgya mtsho bzhin du rgyas/ /bde skyid lha yi dpal bzhin dar ba yi/ /dge mtshan phyogs kyitre'akhor lo rgyas par mdzod/ nang na 'phyor ba dbyar gyi mtsho ltar 'phel/ /ci bar na btsan brjid dpag bsam shing ltar rgyas/ /phyi na snyan grags namamakha'i 'brug ltar ldir/ bde skyid snyan gsum rtag tu 'phel bar mdzod//rang sde nang la ma ltar byams pa'i sems/ /skyes nas phan tshun spun ltar mthun pa dang / chos srid bya ba gangadngha brtsams mthar phyin nas/ /ya rabs lugs srol dar zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /mdor na btsan rgyug stobasa'abyor mnga' thang dang / /rigs rgyud snyan grags kha las rlung rta dang / /chos srid bya ba mtha' dag gong 'phel ba'i/ /gang bsam 'dod pa'i don kun rgyas par mdzod/ /snod dang bcud kyi phun tshogs tham sa cadartedang / srid zhi'i dpal 'byor phywa g.yang ma lus pa/ /'jig rten gsumanegyi legs tshogs ci mchis pa/ /ca/tha' dag yid bzhin dbang du 'du bar mdzod/ /lha yi dpal dang klu yi 'byor ba dang / /gno da sbyin stobasangadang mi yi rigs rgyud dang / /rgya go/ra chos dang rgya nag gos kyi g.yang / /

— shārti/smuX phun tshogs phywa g.yang tshul du 'du bar mdzod/ /stobs 'byor rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i rlabs phreng dang / /rlung rta'i dar chen g.yo ba'i ba dan dkar//snyan pa'i dung dkar grags pa'i rang sgra sogs/ khams gsum dge ma tshan gnas 'dir 'du bar mdzod/ /mdor na srid dang zhi ba'i 'jig rten na/ /legs byas bsod nams nor bu'i bang mdzod dang / /bde skyid dpas/ bsam ljon pa'i dga' tshal dang / /phun tshogs dga' ston gangatremachis dbang sdud mdzod/ /sa 'di'i snod dang bcud la sdang ba yi/ /gdug can dgra dang bgegs dang log 'dren rnams / /drag po'i gnam lcags stong gis tshar gcod pa'i/ /lha dang srung ma'i 'phrin las g.yel med mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs shing / /'bru nor 'phelatshozhing tshe 'phel dang / /bde legs phun sum tshogs pa yis/ /yid larme'adod pa kun 'grub shog / phyogs gcig la chud na phyogs re re la 'di kha tshang re zis namabazang / mi chud na mgo la mchog gsurna gyin rlabs zhis nas don 'di 'argyub par mdzodaces pa'imabar jis nas/ de rjes la shar du zhi ba'i 'dod gsol/ ra drag po/ nub tu dbang rnad/byang ju rgyas pa'i 'dod gsol khris na chog / zhes 'ari rna byang chub sde ba'i ngos madzrad rten gyi spel dzig tu gsungs pa bre gang mkhor bkol rung phar bzhed do/ /sde 'dir dge 'dun ngur smrig 'chang ba'i tshogs / /padma'i tshalartsol bung ba'i tshogs bzhin du/ 'dus te thugs mthun sdom khrims gtsang ba'i ngos// /'bas pad bskal ba'i mthar yang rtag brtan mdzod/ /lung rtogs dpal dang ldan pa'i bshes gnyen dang / /dad brtson nor gyis phyug pa'i slob ma'i khyu/ /blo bzang bzhed dgongs dang mthun legs byas kyis/ /

274pong gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /tshul khrims 'chal bar spyo da pa'i rab byung gzugs/ dge 'dun nang khrims bshigs pa'i sdeg to can /'dus sde dbyen la 'jug pa'i chags sdang mkhan/ /de dag byed pa dmigs med zhi bar mdzod/ /che sri chung sri dar sri dam sri sogs/ /sde 'di'i phun tshogs rgyas pa'i gegs byed pa'i/ /mi dang mi min 'byung bo'i gned pa las/ /skyabs nas chos srid dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod/ /gus mchod tshul bzhin byed pa'i sbyin bdag la/ /lugs gnyis 'byor ba rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin rgyas/ /tshe thag shar nub ri bo'i bar bzhin ring / /dpa' rtsal sred med bu yi rjes 'gror mdzod/ /mi la nad rims phyugs la god la dang // /zhing la sad ser btsa' than mi 'byung bar/ /ser skya drag zhan pho mo ji snyed pa/ /phan tshun sems mthun dge bcur spyod par mdzod/ /bshes pa'i springs yig snying thur spri ma// /lnga rig smra ba'i dbang bo drung chen ye shes tshul khrims kyi drung du ri khrod pa blo bzang nas phul/ zhes go/nang rgyu mkhyen/ yon tan rin chen ma lus pa'i/ /'byung gnas tshul khrims mtsho chen 'e/sa/ /thub pas bsngags pa'i rgya mtsho des/ /khyod la dge legs sbyin gyur cig /mdza' ba'i bshes kyi dwangs ma ru/ /las kyi sbrel ba mi phyed pas/ /te sor gso la nas snying thur 'di/ /khyod snying skul ba'i thabs su bya/ /nor bu'i do shal yal bor nas/ /mthongs la sgeg mo'i 'o ma 'dzin/ /'chang ba smyo/ pa'i mchog min na/ /spyos pa shes bya'i gral las yar/ /bslab pa'i srog dang bral gyur na/ /dbugasaci ldan rtsi/ bo'i lus can zhes/ /ro

275ldan ro las smad bya bas/ /de phyir brang la sor mo khroms/ /lhag par snang mtha'i mdun sa na/ /sgron mor rgyu ba'i brtul zhugs/ ni/ /'dzin na mi yi mjug ma can/ /min zhes snying la bsam 'os sam/ ku ku'i spyodartelas lod gyur na/ /chos kyi rje po'i rjes 'brangs zhes/ /khas 'ches ngo mtshar ngo tsha'i rgyan/ /brtsegs na btsun chos ci la gyon/ /ral gris drima'adzin drungs phyungs nas/ /shul la me long rgyan byas kyang / /khong na khrilartsoba'i khol ba 'dzin/ /gang du phyin kyang zad yod min/ /kye hud tharaneba'i lam rnyed nas/ /srid pa nyam nga srin mo'i sgo ra / /gshed ma 'dzum—pa'i rnga yab la/ /bden par bzung bas su ma slus/ /dpal ldan gragasarmepa'i mu khyud can / /dmod pa can gyi mchis brang la// /rtsen pas rangartsolus grog mkhar bzhin/ /gyur ba'i kto/tam gyis do snying 'gas/ ded dpon ma chog kyang 'jud mthun gyis/ /srid pas rang gi srid sto0sarmete/ /shugs ring dbugs kyi dbyug gu yis/ /'gram pa'i rnga chen ral ba mang / /rang dbang lang tsho nor gyi mjod/ /phrogs nas phongs la ster byas nas/ /gtsug la sdug pa'i rgyan byin te/ /phyi mtshan snyan lanebatags pa mang / /dbang phyug u mar snyoms zhugs pas/ /bye ba'i bskal ba'i mtha' rdzogs kyang / /phyir zhing sred pa'i me chen gyis/ /yid kyi bud shing sreg la ltos/ /grogs khrod ri dwags mig can gyi/ /rtse dga'i longs la 'khrul ches na / /dmyal ba'i sreg byed lus phra mas/ /myur du 'khyud tshe ji ltar bzod/ /myos byed ha la'i btung ba yis/ /chags bral blangs pa'i dgra bcom yang / /bsdus na sems dang ldan pa'i

276 bu/ /dug la mngon sum spyod rung ngam/ /'das dang ma 'das lha tha/yel ba'i/ /rdzas ngan dul ba'i ral ba can/ /spyo da las bskal ba'i me dpung che/ kha la 'bar ba cis ma legs/ /sngon dus dge sbyong dpa' bas byin// nu ldan 'dam la 'gres log kyang / /bag yod khrus kyis rang bkrus pas/ /gtan du dge ba'i lang tsho 'bar/ /kha ba ri ba'i kun mkhyen bus/ /rang gi sras la snying thur byin/ /des kyang ngur smrig slar bgos pas/ /gtsang ljongs zha lu'i thig le mdzes/ /sha bral rus pa'i dra ba yang / /gso ba'i sman mchog snying bo bzhin/ /slar yang thub pa'i bslab khrims sman/ /shi ba gso ba'i bdud rtsir dgongs/ lo brgyar bskams pa'i dpag bsam shing / /bdud rtsis gsos pas legs bris tshogs/ /rang gi dus ston rdzogs ldan las / /'phel ba'i gtam ni rang sgras dregs/ /rgyu skar bdag po mun can gyis/ /btang na snga mkho'i lang tsho nga zhin/ /rnam par dkar bo'i dpal 'dzin pa/ /mngon sum mthong la su yis ngasnyon/ /tshul khrims dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor/ /tshul khrims yon tan kun gyi gzhi/ /tshul khrims 'phags pa'i nor gyi mchog /tshul khrims snyan dang grags pa'i gter/ /tshul khrims rgyan gyi dam pa ste// /tshul khrims dri ngad ldang ba'i ljon/ /tshul khrims rang yid gso ba'i sman/ /tshul khrims gzhan sems dgyes pa'i skyes/ /tshul khrims rgyal rnams mchod pa'i phul/ /tshul khrims nyon mongs zlog pa'i dpung / /tshul khrims ltung ba'i chu lon mchog /tshul khrims sdig pa sreg pa'i me/ /tshul khrims sdug bsngal bel ba'i chu/ /tshul khrims gang smon 'grub pa'i rgyu/ /tshul khrims mtho

277ris bgrod pa'i lam/ /tshul khrims thar ba'i them skas mchog /tshul khrims bstan pa'i nang mdzod yin/ /tshul khrims phan dang byide ba'i gzhi/ /tshul khrims 'phral du legs pa'i rgyu/ /tshul khrims gtan du bde ba'i thabs/ /de lta'i dpe dang gtan tshigs kyis/ /snying la nges pa'i dpal—bskyed de/ /gtsang ma'i dge sbyong dkyil 'khor du/ /'gying ba'i re bangakhyo da la 'dzugs/ /nges par 'byung bas stobs gso sa pas/ /nyams pa4sos pa'i so ldag dbang / /lnga rig nor bu'i dra ba can/ /sa 'di mdzis pa'i rgyan du re/ //e ma tshul sa/nas thos bsam gyi/ /rin chen khri 'phang khar 'dzegs nas/ /gnas brtan chos kyi rgyal bo cher/ /'gyur bar snang mthas byin phob cig /rgyal mtshan mthon po'i ba gam du/ /lha dbangarnadrung na nye dbang bzhin/ /chos bzhin spyod pa'i mdun na 'don/ /chengaba'i che bar khyod gyur cig /gnas bstod/ gangs can yul gyi byehobrag ma dzod dge zhes/ /'dzam gling sa yi thig le gnyis pa gang / /phangamatha' mi mngon gser gyi me long ni/ /tshangs chen yid kyi sor mos brisatrepa bzhin/ /rtsi shing me tog no'u gsing chu ma tsho'i rgyan/ /snod bcud bkod pa rdzogs ldan lang tsho mas/ /skabs gsum dbang bo'i skyed tshal lta na sdug /pre ta pu ri'i grong la rnam par 'god/ /de lta'i phun tshogs khyadama'aphags nor 'dzin ma'i/ /lte bar klu dbang byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /zugs bskyed nor bu'i khams las sman gyi chu/ /kun phan yid bzhin rdzing bu'i tshul du 'khyil/ /mthon mthing bye ma brdal ba'i yur ba nas/ /ci nga lhung dal gyis 'bab pa'i nyal 'gro ma/ /'di yi dri dang bang rtsalo
