554 rje sa su song / /che ba'i mtshan gyi rig byed bklags pa yis/ /nam mkha' 'gengs pa'i dregs ldan 'ga' mchis mod/ /tshul 'dis gnong nas khol ba'i rngul chu yis/ /rgyun bzang chu bo gso ba'i grags pha 'bar/ /'jig rten dbang phyug dbang gi chu bo yi/ /dri med bsang gtor bdud rtsi bkyes pa na/ /zab gsal ting 'dzin brtan pa'i 'jug ngogs las/ /sku gsum khri la rkang bas bsgyur ba mang / /ring nas 'di na nor bu padma can/ /snying gi gru 'dzin gzhal med khang bzang du/ /bsten te yig drug rdo rje'i bzlas pa yis/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugag pa zad du med/ /blo bzang bstan la blo bzang dbang po bzhin/ /rtos kyi— sgyul mardzun chos bzhin sgrong ba de'i/ ༷ /ṅgil ldan khrod na skaskya rdin hūṃ rme lde zhes/ /ri dbang drung na ri dbang gnyis pa bzhin/ /de nas dus kyi tsha bas ma nyams pa'i/ /dbeen pa'i lam srol bdud rtsi'i bum bzang ni/ /bshad sgrub lag pa'i padma la bkod pa'i/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i drang srong zam ma chad/ /bde gsal mi rtog ting 'dzin gzhu mchog las/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i mdas/ /dngos 'dzin laṅka'i bdag po'i mgrin gcod pari/ /dga' byed rgyal bo'i mched po deng yang snang / /de phyir snyan brgyud lde mig gis/ /mdo rgyud sgo yi lcags bkrol nas/ /phyag rgya chen po'i ma ṇi ka /rang gi bu la bdag pos byin/ /dus kyi srin po khros pa yis/ /chos kyi lus ni ril mid kyang / /rig pa 'byung 'dir mkha' spyod bzhin/ /chos kyi rtse dga' nyams mi 'gyur/ /rang gi sras kyi bzhed pa'i snod/ /de ltar bkang

555ba'i grags pa ni/ /srid zhi'i 'jig rten mtha' dag par/ /gser gyi dpag bsam zol gyis 'khrungs/ /mi bsrun yid kyi drungs phyungs—nas/ /sdig pa can gyi sems bor ba'i/ /bsod nams dge ba'i yul gru 'di/ /bsngags dang smon pa'i zhing du gyur/ /'di la myo/chod phyirarshabar snang du/ /nor bu'i khang bzang ba gam las/ /maṭā ra yi me tog char/ /legs bris lag pa'i sprin gyis gtor/ /de lta'i skal bzang gser gyi mchod sdong che/ /yab sras thugs bskyed dbang chen mtshan ma las/ /nye bar 'khrungs 'di mthong thos dran reg gi /'gro ba 'dirshakun bsod nams lam las son/ /de nas e ma nub phyogs dge ba'i zhing / /dbus gtsang chos kyi chu gter chen po nas/ /spyan 'dren rlabs phreng dus las yol med pas/ /mtshams sbyor pho nya'i 'gro 'ong zam—mi 'chad/ /nam zhig bde gshegs snang ba mtha' yas 'dis/ /thugs rje padma dga' ba'i kha lo ni/ /phyogs der phyogs pa'i 'od zer phra mo—yang / /gangs can dbugs 'byen nyi ma chen por gleng / /don grub— don mthun bye ba khrag khrig gis/ /yongs su bskor ba'i ded dpon chen—po bzhin/ /che ba'i yo lang rol pa dang bcas nas/ /mngon su ma byon 'dis bdag cag skal ba bzang / /ring nas bsod nams sa yis yongs bzung ba'i/ /phun tshogs sde bzhi'i chu bo kun gyi gnas/ /rnam par—dge ba dbus gtsang ma dros mtsho/ /mtho ris 'jig rten kun gyi snying po yod/ /gangs can sa la bde ldan zhing / /mes pos bkod la dpal mo yis/ /bkra shis lhun po zhes gsol ba/ /mtshan yang srid zhi'i rgyan du

556'bar/ /gser gyi rgyal mtshan mthon po yis/ /mkha' yi nyi ma dman byas pas/ /sa dang nam mkha'i khyad par la/ /rgyal ba yis kyang 'khrul ba 'dzin/ /gzhung sa chen po'i las 'dzin gyi/ /chos kyi blon ni rgya mtsho ste/ /lugs gnyis rin chen bye ma'i rdul/ /khor yug bar du 'grem la lhos/ /de des spros pa'i bsu ba ni/ /chu gter las ni char sprin bzhin/ /sa la ya mtshan ri mo'i phreng / /rnam par 'bri bzhin 'du 'god 'gyed/ /mtshan dpe bdud rtsi'i rtsa lag las/ /'gog pa med par 'dzum pa'i 'od/ /spro bzhin rdzu 'phrul rol pa las/ /khyod byon lha las babs pas mtshon/ /zhabs sen zla tshes gsar ba'i ris rang khri kun da'i tshal yangs por/ /bkod tshe rnam par rgyal ba'i mal lha dbang gis ni mdzes par rtog /bral bas gdungs pas mya ngan gyis/ /gdong gi padmo zum pa rnams/ /khyod zhal nyi ma mthong ba'i mod/ /dpyid kyi rtswa skyes bzhad pa bzhin/ /khor yug bar du bka' lung gi /gser gyi springs yig bklags pa na/ /lugs gnyis rtse dga'i 'khri shing gis/ /sa 'di rdzogs ldan bzhin du mdzes/ /ma ho zhabs zung mjil gyi 'khor lo ni/ /srid pa'i mthar yang gangs ljongs gtsug tor du/ /mi 'gyur 'od zer rol pa'i dregs ldan gyis/ /nye bar btud pa'i khri 'phang mdzes par zhu/ /snying rje'i lag pa'i 'khri shing las skyes pa'i/ / legs bshad zla ba'i rjes 'gro rnga yab kyis/ /phan mede bsil ba slong la re ba'i mig /zum pa med 'di gzigs shig thugs rje gter/ /pad rag tshe yi bum pa 'dzin pas tshe dang ye shes spel ba'i mgon/ /chu shel

'a la ///pa/// 1//rtonor bu padma yis ni snying rjes rgyud ni nges gang ba'i/ /lha dag 'di na yab— dang sras su sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar gyis/ /rtsen pa'i legs mdzad rgya mtsho che las chu thigs gcig ni brjod pa la/ /rlabs chen bsod nams zla ba'i dpal 'phrog rna rgyan rin chen 'od zer gyis/ /mtha' bral rdzo bsangs lha mo'i 'gram par thig le gsar ba'i ri mo rgod/ /snying sdug yid kyi gzhon nu gang zhig de lta'i dpal la rab chags nas/ /snyan tshig ngag gi gling bu sgyur la mngon dga'i lce 'di ci yang ngal/ /legs don phun tshogs snying la rab tu bkod byas nas/ rta/legs byas dri med yid kyi me long dag byed 'di/ /legs bshad rtse dgas nam yang mdza' ba mi lhod phyir/ legs par spel te rig pa 'byung ba'i rgyan du bres/ /nyi ma'i bu yi dpung ba btsan po'i 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /srog gi dbang po 'phrogs nas lnga bar ma gyur bar/ /grags pa'i gzhi gyur yon tan dri bzang rab gsal ba'i/ /ngag gi me tog rnam par rgyas 'dis skal bzang snyaca// /zhing gi mchog la bsngags pa'i bsod nams mthu chen 'dis/ / snaskye zhing skye bar dmarnyapa'i zhabs rdul la chu chod cing / /rgyal ba'i sras kyi dkyil 'khor dbus su khri 'phang du/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i cod pan thogs pas mdzes gyu ra cig /rig pa 'byung ba'i grong khyer la ni rgyan spel ba'i/ /rtogs brjod gser gyi me tog dri med yid 'ong ba/ /yo ngas su spros pa'i kun bzang mchod pas bdag mchod na/ /bdag gi ston pa yab sras mchog zung mnyes gyur cig /de ltar dri med dge ba'i rkang stegs nyer btsugs las/ /mngon par mtho dang thar ba'i khang bzang la

558'dzegs nas/ /nam mkha' srid du rtogs pa brjod pa'i rtse dga' yis/ /'gro la dbugs dbyung dga' ba'i dga' ston 'gyed gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa mchog gi drung na chos kyicidagongs blon chen por gyur pa/ yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po/ mtshan zhabs makro/ na chen 'brong rtse blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyi zhal snga nas legs bshad kyi zhal 'asros yun ring rjes brtse gnang ba dang / lnga rig smra ba'i dbang po mtshan zhabs pa ye shes tshul khrims nas ngo mtshar ba'i snyan 'phrin spyi bor stsal pa las/ khyad par brjod bya sde bzhi las brtsams shing / /rjod byed snyan ngag lam las drangs pa yi/ /zhal gdams utpal gsar ba'i chun po zhig /blo dman rna ba mdzes pa'i rgyan du stsol/ /ces gnang ba dang / mchod dpon chen mo dang rje drung thub bstan sogs nas kyang mkhas pa dang malas pa'i bya ba la dgyes nyams dpe med kyis zhal ta phebs pas/ de dag la legs bshad kyi skyes 'bul bar dmigs shing / bdag cag gigyigong sa mchog gi zhabs gras du ma'i bzhed zur kyang khong du chud par brten/ mdo sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i sbyang bar bya ba phal mo che la blo mig cung zad yangs pa/ dus 'dir rig byed smra ba mtha' dag gi mdun sar 'jigs pa med pa'i mgrin pa gzengs su mtho ba/ reb gong rig pa 'byung ba'i grong khyer gyi skyabs 〉mgon bdun pa chen po'i yongs 'dzin gyi mtshan snyan 'khur ba/ yul mdo smad kyi parnyi ta blo bzang dpal pa kun las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes bya bas thun spetshams re gnyis la mgyogs par bris pa 'dis kyang dus mthar legs
cing dam pa rnams bdag la dgyes pa'i

dab sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ 'jigs med bsam grub/mdun shog jus 'god pa/ pe blun/ ra / /blo bzang dpal ldan gyi ljags rtsom phyogs bsgrigs(bar cha)blo bzang dpal ldan gyis brtsams/spung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang gis bskrun/mtsho sngon zhing chen zhin hwa dbe tshong khang gis bkram/mtsho sngon mi rigs par khang gis par brgyab/1990lo'i zla10par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/1990lo'i zla10par par thengs dang po brgyab/sprobya2sa7—80057—041—snu7snu 24 deb spus legs rer sgor/ 9 30deb dkyus ma rer sgor/ 7 30

rtseci jiḥ ci— ṇa / chordomi— sto spyorshatrī 1 〉 ḍa kho— ༵shā ṭwāṃ/ cho//7'opachomesmucirsha khro/cipa/mi/ /‘kairīneesduci 7snye tt+waṃ// rdo /ri / wa chidārshaljo 3 ruwatretru thu/ru ri/ṇḍaṃ mordzo ri 7ṭwāṃ&rdo/nyawa ri— rteca tshi ོritsho 7 tswaṣetsāṇḍaṃ/ snye shāsnroo/ waci tsholnga kṣ-i4 / dzee snro/ sgyutso rtsitram̐ṭīsne spyo〉 4 7 tre / ‘tt+waṃ/ ཿ/ ju cista // /ṭwāṃ/ / zidroX ༵/tshopy-i —neskerngosgyu sngirshardi/—ོhāotsho 3 mu/⑮྅7 jurji/ di dhe spyatsho ༄ 9mirdo rngogyijirtso—wame 'i4 rsha rdordziṇanya ṅka// hūṃ/4 /rnyeṭāshaṃsnyi7 tsho /ci/ 7 smo ca‘— ci 5 gyiX ri dadku /kyi wa ༷wabyepy-i byeṣiglu sto ( shiblo 8dīdīs tram̐/ṭwāṃ’〉 tsho ri ༷ sa rdoXrṣablochibye3’ci ༵ gi / rngo snye rdi/// 1/ hūṃ/—// stu /wa stimenee rme/smutsā4tshocha 〉//ji/ kto sdo/ tre ci /༷rdobye rta/ṭwā ///51/ //hūṃ kṣiṃci sdeskreri/ — /pta ༷rdosdo/ tsā/ // // ’/ sna rdo1su —dngha ḍi/watre
